name: Skadi
biography: Skadi is a bounty hunter, currently employed by Rhodes Island. She has shown impressive combat prowess in the past, defeating large creatures, eliminating difficult targets, fighting crucial battles, and winning entire wars. She is very experienced in combat, but her history prior to becoming a bounty hunter is unclear. She is now an Operator for a Rhodes Island assault team, and also executes solo missions.
description: Skadi, bounty hunter, has come with the tide to drown your enemies.
quote: She's a bit out of her element, literally.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I advise you to keep at least two meters away from me, for your own good. And of course you shouldn't speak to me either... I don't want you to be the next victim of what's after me.
voicelines.talk_1: You've read my file? Terrible, isn't it? If I'm allowed to stay by your side, the same misfortune will befall you, and that's trouble for me too.
voicelines.talk_2: My long hair looks good? Oh… Well, thank you. Would you like to feel it? It should have a soft touch. I'm confident of that.
voicelines.talk_3: Could that be...? The one over there, you guys call her Specter now, right? Why is she dressed as a nun? Amnesia? That's a problem… Dr. {@nickname}, you have to help her. She can't be allowed to forget her true function.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You just don't know when to give up, do you? I suppose I have no choice but to defend you with all my might.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Down beneath the vast blue sea, below the white waves that lap endlessly at the earth, lies all that I once held dear. I fear that one day misfortune will once again take away someone important from me. That is why I fled. I don't want anyone I care about... to suffer on my account.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Good, another easy day. No giant tentacles coiling up my teammates, no fanatics lurking in the shadows with their hands coated in blood... Yes, just some straight fights on the battlefield. An easy day for me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: According to legend, my people have fought against those calamities for aeons. Perhaps we kept them from making landfall and terrorizing you city folk as well... So, how about buying me a drink, as a thank you?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: When you've finally made the long journey through the dark up to the water's surface—your eyes dazzled by the sparkling stars all over the sky, your cheek soothed by the cradling waves, your tears seep into your mouth. They have the same salty taste of your home—compared to all that, the bathtub at Rhodes Island is so tiny and puny... I'll have to show you my home someday.
voicelines.idle: Dr. {@nickname}, you fell asleep…? Rest well then, and may you never see your dream eroded by sea waves.
voicelines.onboard: I am Skadi, a bounty hunter. Are you really hiring me? I cannot say what calamities I may bring with me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: So this is how you fight. Rush in with a 'woosh,' knock them down with a 'pow,' and finish them with a 'thud.' Very good. I'll keep it in mind.
voicelines.promotion_1: So this is the promotion you Rhodes Island folks are always going on about? Not bad. Feels like I've become stronger. Just by a bit, maybe.
voicelines.promotion_2: Your thirst for my power really troubles me... But if nothing can really stop you, then brace yourself, for the infinite darkness we will stand against together.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I am quite skilled at teamwork, but...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You're placing everyone's life in my hands?
voicelines.depart: It's hardly a sport when all the enemies are human.
voicelines.begin_operation: Compared to the calamities I fought against, you are barely a threat.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Who knows what lurks within the kelp forest?
voicelines.in_battle_2: This sword has a terrifying past. Care to find out?
voicelines.in_battle_3: Sing me a song, my torturous nightmare.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Don't blink, for you may miss the misery of your death.
voicelines.4-star_result: We survived somehow.
voicelines.3-star_result: The words and thoughts of our enemies mean nothing to me. All I care about is how to defeat them.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Feeling a little rusty? Hope you won't mind having part of your share taken away.
voicelines.operation_failure: Such simple misfortunes are only the beginning.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Put me in a room by myself please.
voicelines.trust_tap: Y-You should watch your distance... I really can't guarantee your safety this close…
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Never let down your guard, Doctor.

name: SilverAsh
biography: SilverAsh is a Kjerag warlord, chairman of the Karlan Trade Co., and is current Chief of the Silverash Family. He has unique views on economics, trade, international politics, diplomacy, and strategic planning.He provides strategic support for some Rhodes Island operations.In view of the fact that his true purposes are unknown and he doesn't have the most cooperative attitude, it is advised that we maintain a conservative attitude in order to minimize risks when working with him.
description: SilverAsh, President of Karlan Trade CO., LTD, has signed the contract with Rhodes Island and is ready to join the field.
quote: Let your guard down. There are no traps in the conditions he offers. Well, you won't know even if there is one.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: There are better ways to kill time. Care to try one?
voicelines.talk_1: Why the constant sullen face? Can't you at least smile for me? Good. That's what I want to see... Yes, there's no one better suited to solve your problems than me... Isn't that right?
voicelines.talk_2: That girl... Amiya, I believe her name was? She's no ordinary girl. If you don't put shackles on her wrists today, you will find yourself placing a crown upon her head tomorrow.
voicelines.talk_3: The stability of the alliance between Karlan and Rhodes Island depends solely on your state of mind, and mine. As such, we should at least try to get along, my friend.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I suppose... it's high time I signed this contract. Of course, I do know that the terms are in yours, and Rhodes Island's favor.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I'm well aware that this contract offers me nothing... But what does that matter? I shall nonetheless accept this unequal treaty. The reason being that I, SilverAsh, recognize that you warrant it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Is Ensia giving you trouble? My apologies. It was originally my own responsibility to foster and guide her, but it's unlikely I will be able to do so. So I must ask... could you do it in my stead, {@nickname}?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Could you show me to Rhodes Island's deck? No, I'd just like to get a view of the area. Tenzin needs to spread his wings every once in a while as well. He must be longing to soar through the night sky.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: If this continues, there will come a day when you and I confront one another... I seem delighted, you say? Hah, perhaps I am. You would be a worthy opponent, that's for certain. Let us make the most of our time before that day comes.
voicelines.idle: When the aether darkens, 'tis an omen that snowfall draws near...'
voicelines.onboard: I, SilverAsh, have joined your cause as a sworn ally. Whatever your plans may be, do not disappoint me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: For one to travel such an arduous path, one absolutely must have experience.
voicelines.promotion_1: Ostentatious titles are one thing, but the trust accompanying them is what concerns me. You surely know that.
voicelines.promotion_2: It takes a daring soul to drag me into their war. That being so, I, SilverAsh, will show my prowess for all of Rhodes Island to see.
voicelines.added_to_squad: We all have our roles to play. Use my abilities as best you see fit.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You wish me to act as your proxy? Very well. But you must pay me due tribute later.
voicelines.depart: Compassion saves no one on the battlefield.
voicelines.begin_operation: Show me what you're made of. Amuse me, if you even can.
voicelines.in_battle_1: 'The fool flaunting his gallantry reaches none with his vanity...'
voicelines.in_battle_2: 'Fool, for what reason hast thou come?'
voicelines.in_battle_3: 'Art thou mine worthy enemy, or art thou naught but a jester?'
voicelines.4-star_result: The fiercer the battle, the more jubilant the victory.
voicelines.3-star_result: A satisfying battle. It brought palpitations even to my heart.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We should strive for better.
voicelines.operation_failure: Retreat at once, while there is still time.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: For a place to rest my feet, it is acceptable.
voicelines.trust_tap: Let me rest for a brief while. I'm more tired than I thought. My apologies.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: You haven't changed one bit, my friend.

name: Saria
biography: Saria was once the director of the Rhine Lab Defense Division. She has made contributions to the fields of life science, microbiology, and Originium Arts. At the same time, she has also proven herself formidable when it comes to demolition, protection, and anomaly containment missions.Currently, she is working with Rhodes Island in various scientific fields and is negotiating a more in-depth cooperation plan with them.
description: Saria, former researcher of Rhine Lab, will serve as a core part of the squad's defense and healing unit on the battlefield.
quote: Diamond is more flexible than she is.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I've checked your schedule. Isn't it time you took a break? If you'll excuse me.
voicelines.talk_1: Evolution is the law of nature. But Rhine Lab attempted to tamper with this law, even to take control of it. What a foolish endeavor…
voicelines.talk_2: As a researcher, have you ever participated in some experiments you probably shouldn't have? No? That's good.
voicelines.talk_3: Don't you think it's too noisy at Rhodes Island? Everyone should be quiet and focused during work. You should enforce discipline on your subordinates.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My true power has nothing to do with first aid. However, I have slightly adjusted the operation of this power to accommodate it to your command.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You think Calcification Arts only makes organisms weaker? You're wrong. I can condense calcium into a tough enamel. The enemies can try as they want, but no one can break my shield.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You've seen me arguing with Silence? Yes, we do that a lot... Sorry for causing trouble for you and Rhodes Island
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Please tell Ifrit on my behalf, 'No matter what happens, I will protect you'... Meet her? No, I'm not ready for that.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Even in the most desperate of situations, one must stand fast to be a symbol of strength for the people they hold dear. That is where I draw my line and how I live my life. You'll do the same, won't you?
voicelines.idle: I'll go back to my room if there's no further assignments.
voicelines.onboard: I am Saria, formerly of the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute Experiment Team. As for now... I need Rhodes Island's help to bring the astray back to the orthodox.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: What are you doing?
voicelines.promotion_1: Good, you must continue motivating your subordinates with your ideas if you hope to maintain influence over them.
voicelines.promotion_2: Promotion? I don't want any special treatment. But for Ifrit's sake, I do need your help to correct all those twisted laws and rules.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I am within my rights to oversee and bring up my own opinion on your command.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Send me the operation briefing, I will review it.
voicelines.depart: All operators must maintain strict discipline.
voicelines.begin_operation: Are they the ones who caused such destruction and started all this conflict?
voicelines.in_battle_1: Just who are you weaklings going to stop like that?
voicelines.4-star_result: Your tactics appear modern, yet the ideas behind them are primitive at their roots. Just who are you?
voicelines.3-star_result: All must return to the existing order. None may disobey the rules.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The routed enemies may be calling for reinforcements. We must not drop our guard before we find the last of them.
voicelines.operation_failure: Where did I go wrong...?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This room has interesting decor. I'd be more fond of a futuristic style, though.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, you might do a bit of research into the past in your free time. You will find many a thing of great interest.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Hoshiguma
biography: Hoshiguma is an elite Operator from the Special Ops Team of the L.G.D.There are several charges against her on record. After intervention from Chief Wei Yenwu, L.G.D. made an exception to admit her into its Special Ops division based on her exceptional abilities and field performance. She exhibited remarkable professionalism in handling violent crime, protecting VIPs, disaster response and emergency rescue. Currently a defender assisting Rhodes Island operations, Hoshiguma provides tactical execution and command support.
description: Hoshiguma, member of the Special Service of Lungmen Guard Department, is awaiting your orders.
quote: Stand by her side when you are scared. It really helps.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.
voicelines.talk_1: Lots of new recruits lately, many new faces. Don't let your guard down.
voicelines.talk_2: If something happens, don't forget to use the emergency communication channel. Just call me and I'll come running.
voicelines.talk_3: I sound cold when I talk? I'm on the clock. I'm a lot less serious when I'm off.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Rhodes Island needs more than just combat Operators. You need experts in education, PR, and all kinds of stuff.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I used to only get called in for the nastiest fights, but now every fight is a nasty one.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: This shield has a name: Hannya. I brought it from my hometown. Its 'father' and mine were old friends. Back in the L.G.D., my superiors would always tease me about it, but together we've proven that a shield makes a great weapon, and so do I.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hannya's tasted plenty of Lungmen gangster blood. I never thought it'd win me many friends, but the ones who looked down on me started showing me some respect after all that had happened. Or maybe they're just scared of how big I am? What do you think?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: How about another shot...? Oh, you've had enough? Don't sweat it... I can carry you back to your room if you pass out. What? That worries you even more? C'mon, don't be a buzzkill.
voicelines.idle: Hm? Heh. Nothing. Just guarding you, Doctor.
voicelines.onboard: Hoshiguma, Defender Operator. I'll be your shield, your blade, your fortress. Very glad to meet you, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: It's all thanks to your teaching, Doctor.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm honored.
voicelines.promotion_2: No one tells me where I'm going, and no one can stop me once I make up my mind. And now—I've made up my mind to follow you, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I will protect everyone.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Protecting Rhodes Island is my responsibility too.
voicelines.depart: I want everyone to get home safe.
voicelines.begin_operation: If you've got a reason to fight, you've got a reason to die!
voicelines.in_battle_2: If you want to hurt my friends, you have to go through my shield first.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Hannya, unleash the rage your father poured into you!
voicelines.4-star_result: The harder the journey, the stronger you'll become.
voicelines.3-star_result: Hurting my friends right in front of me? I'll make you pay!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Are you hurt? I'm sorry. I failed.
voicelines.operation_failure: Fall back, now! I'll bring up the rear!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: With my size... it's kind of hard to get through the door.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, you should take a load off now that we finally got a break.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Nightingale
biography: Nightingale, Sarkaz, a member of the infected-assistance group Followers, all other history missing. Possessed amazing talent for Originium Arts, field first aid and clinical skills. Currently undergoing treatment at Rhodes Island while offering her service as field medic and Originium Arts support.
description: Nightingale, Sarkaz healer, will do everything she can to provide medical care for the squad.
quote: As simple as a blank sheet.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I apologize... It's my job to attend to you, but my body simply won't move like I want it to...
voicelines.talk_1: I once breathed in some kind of Originium toxin... it damaged my memory and the nervous system in my lower extremities... at least that is what Dr. Kal'tsit told me. So I often wonder... what was my life like before then?
voicelines.talk_2: This little blue bird often comes over and chats with me. Sometimes, I dream about turning into a bird myself... flying free in the skies, without a care...
voicelines.talk_3: Once upon a time, I was imprisoned in an empty room. I only saw another human being when they needed my healing...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: With this staff in my hand, I can heal as many as I will. Is this... really an ability I was born with?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Shining told me that the sins we carry... the guilt of starting the war, as devils... will one day catch up to us and we will have to face judgment. Those people who imprisoned me said the same thing. But...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Amiya... I feel a sense of deja vu whenever I see her. Perhaps we met sometime in the past?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: The memories I have are mere fragments. My people... Originium... my mission, the rebellion, the war... but tell me, why are you in one of my memories too?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: How did I end up like this? Why must I suffer all that I do? Doctor, do you have the answers?
voicelines.idle: Do you too dream of flying freely through the skies like a bird?
voicelines.onboard: Liz... that's my real name. Everything else is just cloudy, indistinct memories...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Why is there a need for me to grow stronger?
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? I see. It sounds like something to rejoice over. But... I apologize, I don't feel any joy within...
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you for personally informing me of my promotion, Doctor. But... to me, it doesn't matter as much as the story of the world outside that this little bird is telling me right now.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Is this the rendezvous point?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I shall do anything you command me to.
voicelines.depart: I need only do as the manual said, yes?
voicelines.begin_operation: The battlefield... a place where lives are taken...
voicelines.deployment_2: It's not my wish to take lives.
voicelines.in_battle_1: My power is all yours now.
voicelines.in_battle_3: You will not come to harm.
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter how difficult the battle gets, I will always…
voicelines.3-star_result: To fight to the very end... that's our destiny.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Perhaps they've already escaped this cage called fate...
voicelines.operation_failure: Is this... how despair feels?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Rooms... They too are a type of cage.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor... is this... what is known as 'intimacy'?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Shining
biography: Shining is a Sarkaz medic, a former member of the Sarkaz medic group 'Confessor' and current member of the infected assistance group, 'Followers.' She is an authority in fields such as Originium Arts, field medicine, medical theories, and clinical medicine. She is now a Medic Operator at Rhodes Island, contributing her knowledge on Originium Arts theories and providing medical support for many an operation.
description: Shining, Sarkaz healer, will do everything she can to provide medical care for the squad.
quote: Simple, yet a mystery you can't seem to solve no matter what.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Greetings, Doctor... Is there anything you'd like to discuss?
voicelines.talk_1: You look quite pale... You say your chest hurts? Don't overwork yourself, please get some rest. Don't be afraid, I'm right beside you. Everything will be okay...
voicelines.talk_2: You've seen my healing Arts somewhere before?... That must have been your imagination. Yes, our memories do deceive us on occasion…
voicelines.talk_3: 'Confessarius?' Where did you learn this word? My apologies, but I'm afraid I cannot continue this topic.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: We Sarkaz combined our inherent Arts affinity with the power of Originium to develop new healing Arts, we've been doing this for quite some time to succour those who drag themselves in the mire.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Now, you ask? Now we have nothing left. That war bereaved us of all hope.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Who is Nearl to me? Well... She's a travel companion, and I trust her with my very life.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: There are those who will sacrifice their all to deliver others from their pain. And Nearl, she is just the kind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Once upon a time, I followed someone who shone bright as the beacon of hope, until wicked machinations took the light away. But this time, the incandescence will cease nevermore, even at the cost of my life...
voicelines.idle: This quiet… it reminds me of my time back home.
voicelines.onboard: I am Shining, the roaming medic. I look familiar to you? It is possible our paths have crossed.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: The power to merely heal wounds... is not enough.
voicelines.promotion_1: A medic's hand cannot reach all those in need.
voicelines.promotion_2: Yes. I must be more than a medic—I will live on as a guardian. As has always been my goal. Doctor, please bear witness to my oath.
voicelines.added_to_squad: To the battlefield, are we not?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: A battle for our own delieverence, is it not?
voicelines.depart: War, ever inevitable.
voicelines.begin_operation: May the war grant us the redemption we seek... or will it?
voicelines.deployment_2: 'Tis but a flash in the drift of time.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Your life is mine to protect.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Grief, ever echoes in our souls.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Agony, ever etched on our hearts.
voicelines.4-star_result: Our wills and spirits are ever burning against the fiercest enemies.
voicelines.3-star_result: No matter the sins, all will fall to ashes with lives at the end of time.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Return not to the battlefields. You will find no redemption here.
voicelines.operation_failure: Victory and loss... are insignificant moments in an endless cycle.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I will be fine, so long as I have a quiet place to be alone.
voicelines.trust_tap: It's been some time since I've known such serenity. I can even hear your heartbeat.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: How are you feeling today, Doctor?

name: Angelina
biography: Real name Angelina Ajimu, she was a transporter responsible for delivering intelligence and special cargo around Siracusa. As an apprentice caster Operator, she now provides logistical support, battlefield assistance, and tactical coordination for Rhodes Island.
description: Angelina, Supporter Operator and Messenger of Rhodes Island, would like to provide help with her amazing Originium Arts.
quote: Green, but full of potential.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Dr. {@nickname}, I made a really strong brew with our new coffee machine. Wanna try? You can only have one cup a day, though. Don't want you up all night!
voicelines.talk_1: Being a Messenger isn't easy. Both the sender and the receiver might have some big ideas, and who knows if some shady secrets get inside your bag. If you're too absorbed in getting yourself moving, you could still end up in a pit for what you get yourself into.
voicelines.talk_2: My mother was from Higashi, so my name doesn't sound very Siracusan. A lot of people ask me if it's even my real name, so I decided to use Angelina as a codename too.
voicelines.talk_3: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}! Yeah, I'm off to send out some documents. Dr. Kal'tsit says my skills could come in super useful in battle... but compared to fighting, I kinda prefer taking letters where they belong!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I actually don't know if I'm a good fit for Rhodes Island... I mean, a lot of really heavy stuff happens here, I'm not sure I can handle it. Croissant's always comforting me, but I am still not sure about myself. Do I really have what it takes?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I don't feel lost anymore. At the end of the day, it's more than a simple identification with you or Rhodes Island. If I can leap across the gaps between skyscrapers as a Messenger, then I know I could bridge the gap between the Infected and Uninfected as an Operator!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Memories are precious. I always remember that the Infected, just like us, look forward to a better tomorrow. I don't know anything about your past, Dr. {@nickname}, but I promise to help you recall.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Dr. {@nickname}, don't be shy, come closer! That's right! Three, two, one, sorridi! See? It's a photo sticker of you and me. The perfect souvenir, right? I guess it's also a token of… some of my feelings, haha.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The view from the deck is great. Especially for stargazing! See that lone star over there? People say that one day, its companion star will appear, and then they'll embrace and dance together. Still... how long does it have to wait for the other one to show up? And how long do I have to wait... for the star to wink back at me?
voicelines.idle: Umm hmm~♪ Mmm, maybe the coral lipstick suits me more.
voicelines.onboard: Ciao! I'm Angelina Ajimu, a Messenger from Siracusa. Just call me Angelina. Am I cool to call you Dr. {@nickname}?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: The battlefield is a cruel place... but I'll try not to let you down.
voicelines.promotion_1: Since you trust me, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll have to work much, much harder than I usually do! Like, Siracusan Messengers always say: 'A slow Messenger gets caught by the wind.'
voicelines.promotion_2: I've made my decision. As long as you're still working to help the Infected, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll follow you. You've come so far, done so much... now it's my turn to do something for you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: In work or in battle, I'll give it all I've got!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I might not be the best, but I'll still do what I can.
voicelines.depart: Everybody, please be careful!
voicelines.begin_operation: When will all these conflicts ever come to an end…
voicelines.in_battle_2: We will overcome what confronts us.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I've got a magic touch on this.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Ever wondered how it feels to float in the air?
voicelines.4-star_result: We only grow stronger after getting into a wolf's mouth, right?
voicelines.3-star_result: We all worked hard for this. You'll cherish this victory, won't you Dr. {@nickname}?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Well, even I lose a letter sometimes...
voicelines.operation_failure: The more difficult the situation, the harder we have to try!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This place is like home to me!
voicelines.trust_tap: My hair looks nice? Heheh, I've got a secret for that.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Eyjafjalla
biography: Eyjafjalla, volcanologist, Catastrophe Messenger. She is exceptionally talented in the use of advanced Originium techniques and high-energy Arts. Currently undergoing treatment at Rhodes Island, Eyjafjalla provides support in Catastrophe research, environmental observation/assessment, assistance in traversing dangerous terrain, among others.
description: Eyjafjalla, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, has wanted to devote herself to doing something for you.
quote: Hardworking and earnest all the time.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Professor, I've finished all my Catastrophe studies notes. Do you have any more I could read?
voicelines.talk_1: Huh? What? Why do I call you 'Professor'? Well, you're an expert on Catastrophe studies, so you're like a professor, right? Aren't we all supposed to address our superiors with respect?
voicelines.talk_2: Pardon me? Please say that again? Oh, you're wondering why I'm hard of hearing? Well, I got infected with Oripathy back when I was doing research near a volcano...
voicelines.talk_3: Besides completing the tasks you give me, I have to go to Dr. Kal'tsit regularly for checkups. The doctor said my symptoms are pretty serious...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I have to work hard to finish the research my parents began! I want to prove that their work was meaningful, and that it could maybe even change the world!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My parents... they've passed on. A pyroclastic flow hit them when they were conducting studies near a volcano... I have to pick up where they left off and finish their research, no matter what!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My playmates? I'm pretty friendly with Mousse and some others, so I don't feel lonely at all! If possible, I'd love to start a book club with them too. Could we hold our club meetings in your office, Professor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Dr. Kal'tsit told me... I'm losing not only my sense of hearing, but my sense of sight too. …Well, what else might this disease do to me?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: How could I tell you were behind me? Because I could feel your warmth! My eyesight and hearing aren't as sharp as they once were, but my other senses are still the same. Can't bring me down this easily, you know!
voicelines.idle: Professor! Oh... You're asleep...?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Eyjafjalla. My career before joining Rhodes Island was in the field of volcanology. I'm a bit hard of hearing due to my Oripathy. I just hope I won't be a burden to you, Professor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Please teach me all you can, Professor.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? Really? I'm so happy to have your approval, Professor!
voicelines.promotion_2: My mother gave me these little lambs. They're cute, aren't they? Huh? They're scorching hot? Be careful! You have to put on oven mittens before touching them!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood, Professor.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't forget to prepare emergency supplies as well as weapons!
voicelines.depart: We can take care of ourselves, Professor. You just focus on giving orders.
voicelines.begin_operation: Stay safe, everyone.
voicelines.in_battle_2: This may be a little hot...
voicelines.4-star_result: I'm so glad you're safe, Professor...
voicelines.3-star_result: Why must our world be enveloped in strife?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Is everyone okay? Anything I can do?
voicelines.operation_failure: Ow... It's... It's okay... I'm fine...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This room makes me feel safe.
voicelines.trust_tap: Thank you, Professor, for helping me become a stronger person.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Ifrit
biography: Ifrit was once treated by Rhine Lab. She is suffering from a serious case of Oripathy. Her Originium adaptability is very high, and she is known to cause a phenomenon called 'multiple combustion.' We have no records of her activities prior to her arrival at Rhine Lab.Currently, she is receiving treatment at Rhodes Island, with Silence serving as her guardian.
description: Ifrit, former test subject of Rhine Lab, will incinerate all of Silence's enemies.
quote: She was born to set things on fire, and it has become a hobby of hers.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Why is this office so damn cold?! Hey, you there! You okay with me using that for kindling?
voicelines.talk_1: Oh, How much did you say this book costs? Haha, pricey. Call me Mistress Ifrit and I'll give it back to you.
voicelines.talk_2: Huh? You want me to read this book? I hate it when people try to tell me… It's from Silence? Really? Urgh... Wha-what does this word mean here?
voicelines.talk_3: I hate it when you white coat creepers stare at me... Yeah, I mean you! What'cha looking at? Go stare at something else!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Um... Okay, fine. No more scaring people with fire.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Back off! You... Why are you coming at me like that? You wanna strap me to a lab table too?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Saria's here? I want to see her— Silence says no? C'mon, what's the big deal? Just take me to her and keep it off the record!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Why are Silence and Saria arguing all the time? I don't get it... Hey! You gotta know how to get them to make up, right? C'mon, just tell me… I mean, please...?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I don't care what you think of me, but you'd better be nice to Silence. When she wants something, you go get it for her! Do that, and your wish is my command.
voicelines.idle: You little...! You've got guts to ignore me and slack off like this!
voicelines.onboard: You stand before the almighty Ifrit! Hmph, Silence says Rhodes Island's a nice place, but there's nothing I hate more than you white-coat science creepers... I mean, except Silence...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Stronger...? Hmm, that means my flames can burn brighter, right?
voicelines.promotion_1: What's this? Promotion Manual for Rhodes Island Operators? Guess I'll give it a peek... What the hell? So many rules even after I get promoted? Nah-uh, pass.
voicelines.promotion_2: Haha, that's right! I don't give a damn about all those rules. But, if you say you're counting on me, then that's all the words I need!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yeah yeah, I heard ya.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm the captain? So, just do like Silence would, right?
voicelines.depart: Hey! They made me the captain, so I'm the one calling the shots here!
voicelines.begin_operation: Yo! How 'bout another barbecue!
voicelines.in_battle_1: Does it hurt? I bet it does!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Shriek all you want! Nobody cares!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Get in the line of death!
voicelines.4-star_result: Weak, you're all too weak! I am invincibllllle!
voicelines.3-star_result: Why don't we torch all the trash into kindling? It'll be nice and warm!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Nothing but cinders left now. I could've handled this all by myself!
voicelines.operation_failure: Damn you... You made a fool out of me!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What kind of place is this? Huh?
voicelines.tap: The hell are you doing here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Heheh, you're nicer than I expected. Wanna hang out?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Siege
biography: Vina, codenamed Siege, citizen of Victoria, most records unavailable except for several unproven charges. Outstanding performance in assault, siege, and hard target missions. Admitted to Rhodes Island after excellent scores in multiple tests. Currently a vanguard and the captain of a Rhodes Island squad.
description: Siege, leader of the Glasgow Gang, will carve a path for you.
quote: She is a born leader.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You're still not done assigning tasks? I'll wait a bit longer then.
voicelines.talk_1: Keep calm and carry on.
voicelines.talk_2: Our meals used to be fairly nice in the past... but the quality's gone downhill since we joined Indra's group.
voicelines.talk_3: I had a dream... a dream where the sun rises, and in the distance beyond the horizon... there was my hometown. The place I might never get to return to, ever again.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Before I knew it, I'd gotten accustomed to this drifter's life... It's a strange thing. In the past I never imagined this was how I'd end up.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Gawain and company? I wouldn't say they ran into me, more like they picked me up off the streets.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I used to stand side by side with Indra's team when we fought in the streets of Victoria... Looking back, I suppose it's a fairly fond memory to me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Stay on your guard! I know you've done the best you can, but there may be unknown dangers beyond our abilities.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: If we're ever put in a tough situation... then I may well act on my own motives. And if it comes to that, Doctor, I hope you'll join me too in... no, never mind for now.
voicelines.idle: Hm? You fell asleep?... I wonder if you ever dream of your hometown, too.
voicelines.onboard: I've passed the strength test, right? So assign me some missions. Don't let this hammer get too bored. My codename? They call me the Siege. Curious name, but it's got a nice ring to it.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Feels pretty good.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Interesting...
voicelines.promotion_2: Another promotion? All right, thanks... Life is strange like that, you know? Once upon a time, I was the one assigning new ranks to people.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Tell me, is this battle inevitable?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You'd better get used to my combat style.
voicelines.depart: For want of a nail... the kingdom was lost.
voicelines.begin_operation: Run while you can. Better to be a coward with a pulse than a martyr with a grave.
voicelines.deployment_2: We'll take them out all at once.
voicelines.in_battle_1: My weapon chooses its worthy wielder.
voicelines.in_battle_3: A warrior must be ready to face death on the battlefield!
voicelines.in_battle_4: My rule is the balance your lives hang in.
voicelines.4-star_result: Can bluff, can't take one blow.
voicelines.3-star_result: Those who refuse to surrender don't deserve mercy.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Are we done here?
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm... more tired than I thought. I apologize...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Do you mind if I get my forty winks in here?
voicelines.trust_tap: It's too noisy out there for my tastes... I think the silence of your office suits me more. Let me stay in here for a bit, will you?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

description: Exusiai, employee of Penguin Logistics, will clear out everything in the way using her guns.
quote: Is it really fine to trust her with any cargo?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Leader! Give us something to do~
voicelines.talk_1: Leader! Let's throw a party! We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie! The best life is the party life! No party, no life!
voicelines.talk_2: Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?
voicelines.talk_3: Some people believe that money can buy everything. But that saying doesn't apply to me! If I want someone to rest in pieces, no amount of money can save them~
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My first wish: for eight new guns! We angels all have a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is so lame, right?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My second wish... find someone to help me turn off this light over my head!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The only reason Texas lives so carefree and swagged out is that she's got me watching over her. That's the obvious truth, right?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? Wanna come be our boss? Ehehe, just kidding.
voicelines.idle: ...Lord, is this someone we gotta save too?
voicelines.onboard: Our slogan is 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' Are you our client? You can call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I'm lovin' this feeling!
voicelines.promotion_1: Thanks for promoting me!
voicelines.promotion_2: Leader... No, savior, I pledge to this gun in my hand to protect you until the very end of this world.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: No one makes a better leader than me! You've got a good eye.
voicelines.depart: Let's go! Take them all by storm!
voicelines.begin_operation: I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, and you guys all get a share. Rest easy!
voicelines.4-star_result: Wonderful! This is the chance of a lifetime. Charge on!
voicelines.3-star_result: May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The sound of victory is the sweetest melody. Alright, let's grab some drinks to celebrate when we get back!
voicelines.operation_failure: Even a well-crafted gun will jam sometimes. Life is no different, so don't worry about it~
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I like this place!
voicelines.trust_tap: Leader, wanna try out my weapon?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Cement
biography: Shana Moleman, leader of Rim Billiton's 'Shana's Construction Crew.' Proficient in engineering techniques such as boring, tunneling, and laying concrete, she first came into contact with our Engineering Department during the renovation of a nomadic operation platform. Now, as a nonresident engineering consultant, she participates in relevant Rhodes Island missions under the codename 'Cement.'
description: Defender Operator Cement hopes to become your first pick for construction subcontracting.
quote: Digging up the nutrients of the lands for distant prosperity; forging foundations for towering buildings.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Don't stay cooped up in your office all the time, Doki. Why don't you come down to the mines with me one of these days?
voicelines.talk_1: Something smells moldy. Should be in the bottom left drawer. My nose is never wrong... Well, Doki, You should really deal with those documents before they pile up. If you just leave them like that, they're gonna get damp.
voicelines.talk_2: My drills are all souped up. They've got twice the impact, improved stability, and they pretty much can't jam. Anyway, I'm a pro when it comes to boring, tunneling, and laying concrete. If you've got any construction jobs like that, I'm your girl!
voicelines.talk_3: First, you check construction blueprints ahead of time. Second, you don't disrupt our work without a good reason. Third: You never, ever fall behind on your payments. That's the three principles Shana's Construction Crew uses to decide on projects. No exceptions, Doki, not even for Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Rim Billiton has more prospecting operation platforms than you can count, with tons of workers running around. You gotta know what you're doing to get anybody to listen to ya. I work hard to refine my skills, and I teach what I know to the gang. That's the way I do things... Yeah.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: We don't compromise on safety, even in barren mines with low output. Infected or not, so long as you work the mines, your rights oughta be guaranteed. I hope we never see another Billy mine accident. At the very least, I always make sure my projects stand up to inspection.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, want a lolly? It's just a regular mint one. I always keep some in my pocket. Don't underestimate the power of a lolly, though. When there's dusty air all around you, a little sweetness can really calm you down.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My dad always said that Columbia's Great Expansion marked the start of a new age. Now, the big corps pull in all different countries on big projects. Rim Billiton's ores really shine out there. But you know how things go, the taller the building, the more solid the foundations have to be. That's why the work we do is always meaningful, no matter the task.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: A Billy worker never sees the sun.' That's what my friends in the mines always say. The darkness down there swallows everything, work and life, past and future... I want to give people hope for the future, Doki, give them better lives. Easy enough to say, but there's lots of work to do. You'll lend a hand, won't you, Doki?
voicelines.idle: Alright, lads, day's done. Rest up now.
voicelines.onboard: Oh, so you're the Doctor everyone's talking about! I'm new in Engineering; foreman of Shana's Construction Crew out of Rim Billiton! Here's my business card.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Nah yeah… If the mines just provided workers with recorders, it would save us so much hassle.
voicelines.promotion_1: I thought it was a joke when I got a new contract from HR. Not only did my pay go up, I get even more benefits... Thanks, Doki!
voicelines.promotion_2: If I ever get the chance, I want to go check out Columbia, see the Great Expansion with my own eyes and how their workers are different from ours in Rim Billiton... Doki, Rhodes Island works with a lot of big companies, right?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Work, work! Hop to it now!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You all got your helmets on? Check again!
voicelines.depart: This shaft's got a complicated layout. Follow me.
voicelines.begin_operation: Ah! Why is my drill stuck?!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Relax, Doki, just show up at completion time.
voicelines.deployment_1: The blueprints check out. Let the construction work begin!
voicelines.deployment_2: Remember, max deviation for each drill hole is two centimeters!
voicelines.in_battle_1: Oi! Stay focused when you're running that boring machine!
voicelines.in_battle_2: A triple bright miner's lamp could make ya go blind!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Move, or this cement's going right on your heads!
voicelines.4-star_result: Doki! We… We just wrapped up a huge project!
voicelines.3-star_result: When worker safety's on the line, you can't slip up for even a single second.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: If you spot anything after construction's done, that's already too late. We need to find as many problems as we can in the design stage.
voicelines.operation_failure: Don't be glum, chum. Follow-up work is part of construction, too. Just leave it to me to take care of the reinforcement. Cheer up, Doki.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's say Rhodes Island needs some dorms rebuilt, think you might hire Shana's Construction Crew? Hehe…
voicelines.tap: Eeek! Oh, it's you, Doki. Sorry, didn't notice you over the sound of the drill.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doki, can you hold this shield for me? Careful now, it's heavy. The inside there? That's concrete, baby.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey, Doki! Here, a mint for ya.

name: Morgan
biography: Morgan, a member of Glasgow, was dubbed the 'brains of the operation' by Siege. While at Rhodes Island, she assisted her in managing all affairs related to Glasgow, and now works part time for Rhodes Island, managing related affairs at the Victoria branch.
description: Morgan of the Glasgow Gang wishes you would contact her through her boss.
quote: If you'd like to teach a lesson to anyone on your nerves, this street fight expert is a smart choice.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You want to chat future op planning? You've come to the right person, Doctor, love. I'm the entire stuffing brains of Glasgow.
voicelines.talk_1: Eugh, this doesn't taste right. Is this can gone off...? Ay, get Hannah to try this for me, will you? Oh, and if she scoffs the whole thing in one go... well, waste not want not, yeah?
voicelines.talk_2: Why do I fight with such a naff-off big machete? Because I'm trying to be efficient here! If I scare some enemies off, that's enemies I don't need to do in. I mean obviously, I'm handy with me fists too. 'Cuz you spend as long as us on the streets, you learn how to scrap from every angle.
voicelines.talk_3: When we left the Glasgow Gang behind, see, I thought we'd all be back in a jiffy. But here we are ages later, and still on the go. Everything's changed. Vina, Hannah, Baird, and especially me... yeah, I might have changed most out of us.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I had my grievances, I did. While Victoria was booming, I was living on scraps. Who said I should pay the price once the bloody place went arse-up? But look at me, I came back anyway. I mean, my life, everyone I care about... all of it's here still.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I guess me old Morgan's Memoirs is gone. Probably lost it in the Glasgow Gang base, if you'd even call it a base... and if the Glasgow Gang still exists. War's not some heroic fantasy. There's moments of deathly honest grief... just, instants you can't describe.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I got a good head on my shoulders, don't I? Not like I'm book-smart or anything here—the most I'm good at is scheming a thing or two in the street. Be honest, sometimes, there's this thought that plagues me, how maybe I'm no help to Vina at all... What, that's rubbish, you think...? Yeah, alright, fair dos, love! I can't be quitting now!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: It might be easy for us to follow the leader, but you know what? While we go after Vina—who's Vina got to go after? I don't want to be behind her anymore, Doctor. I want to go with her, or take her along. That way, when she gets tired, at least she'll have my shoulder to rest on.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Once we succeed with all this, I... hahah, the ffffirst thing I wanna do! Is go out and get smashed with the girls again... Doctor, promise me, you'll come crawling with us. We'll have a right hoot... forget all our troubles. Sound good, love?
voicelines.idle: Ay-yi-yi, someone's wide open. I could do some face painting on you, love?
voicelines.onboard: Alright, Doctor? I'm Morgan. Vina said you'd like some assistance from me? I've got brains to pick and brawn with a machete—whatever you need, love, just ask.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Not bad, not bad, learned a thing or two. In exchange, why not have a copy of How to Fight with the Glasgow Gang?
voicelines.promotion_1: Well, I'm honored! You've got a sharp eye, Doctor, just like Vina.
voicelines.promotion_2: There'll be plenty more trouble in future for the Glasgow Gang, but you won't catch me running. Whatever we can't handle, you bet I'll keep trying to figure it out. Whatever we can handle, you let my machete and Molotovs do the work!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Coming, love, coming. Not too late, am I?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: No prob. Minding you lot's a breeze compared to Glasgow.
voicelines.depart: Doctor, love, how'd you even come up with these plans?
voicelines.begin_operation: Maybe let's try ambushing them?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Alright, who am I hacking up?
voicelines.deployment_1: Watch. There's method to a brawl.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Nah, mate, I'm on your right.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Lessee, who's the next sap getting duffed up?
voicelines.in_battle_4: You don't win until you beat us all.
voicelines.4-star_result: All that command was complex stuff... I'm having trouble keeping up now. Doctor, love, once we're back, can you break down today's battle for me? You'd do me a solid!
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, want to celebrate the Glasgow way? First me and Hannah grab a leg each, then we shut our eyes, and then we hip-hip-hurray and send you flying... ay, no need to run, love, I'm just joking!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I know every bend around these parts. Give me one minute, and I'll root those bastards out.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm not... I'm not falling here. The story of Vina and every one of us... is NOT over!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Dead quiet around here... hahah, makes me wish I could do it like Vina and kip somewhere.
voicelines.trust_tap: Got some good news to share, Doctor? Because if you don't, let me tell you a joke.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Alright, Doctor! Fancy seeing you about.

biography: After the mission, Noir Corne has returned from Higashi clad in all-new equipment forged by the Felynes. Despite laying down the shield and picking up an imposing long sword, Noir Corne is still that most dependable rock, hitting the frontline to clear the way for his teammates.

quote: Though donning new digs, Noir Corne's vibes are the same as ever.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Alright, I'm here to help! Chill, I'm all good with this gear now. Bumping into everything? That's the old me!
voicelines.talk_1: Out in the field, it's pretty important to watch what you and your teammates eat. Just a while ago, I learned how to use this simple BBQ spit to treat raw meat. Here, lemme demo for you right now!
voicelines.talk_2: I've hauled butt all across Terra, and I've never seen gear both as sturdy and as comfortable as this. Feels like when I wear it, my attack power gets boosted, plus I can hit enemy weaknesses way better, and my fire attacks are stronger too! Yeah, uh, I figure that might just be me? Haha.
voicelines.talk_3: The Felynes say the more experienced the hunter, the more thorough the pre-mission prep. Packing all your potions and tools is just as key to the hunt. Still, Yato loves to chew me out, saying I'm always bringing too much stuff on missions. Rock and a hard place, y'know?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Feels weird, honestly, not having my ol' reliable shield on hand. Still, the Felynes say if I get good enough with this long sword, I can basically fend off every attack under the sun. Guess my training's got a long way to go.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You only really master combat technique after taking on enough enemies. I guess no shortcut to getting promoted after all, huh? Especially for dummies like me, haha.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I get that whetstones aren't thrilling, but they're a tool you can't go without. Even a blade with sharpness this fine is gonna need nonstop polishing its whole life.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I just wanna do my job as a guy in the background, even now. Us nobodies, we've got our own duties, our own worries, and our own things we wanna protect.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Ditching the shield, using a long sword like this, it keeps reminding me of the old days. Bad times I hate to remember. But without our past, I guess Yato and me wouldn't be who we are today.
voicelines.idle: Get your rest on, Doctor. Leave the place to me.
voicelines.onboard: Operator Noir Corne, back under your command with all-new gear! Alright, Doctor, don't care if it's bandits or nightmare bizarro creatures, you leave it all to me!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Lemme scrub back a sec, I want a closer look. Yeah, mm-hm...
voicelines.promotion_1: I've gotta give thanks to my kickass gear for carrying me this far. But obviously, the biggest props go out to you and everyone around me for all your help!
voicelines.promotion_2: This is Operator Noir Corne, everyone's shield through hell and high water! And hey, I guess I can handle being everyone's sword too!
voicelines.added_to_squad: No prob. I'm all readied up.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You want me to lead, without Yato? You sure? I think it'd be better if you got her on.
voicelines.depart: Everybody done eating? Alright, go time!
voicelines.begin_operation: Mission start! Target position is a lock!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Which area am I heading to?
voicelines.4-star_result: Now THAT was a good battle. Take pride, everyone, and good work!
voicelines.3-star_result: Mission complete, perfect job! We gotta get back to Rhodes Island, because I'm looking forward to celebrating!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Good work, Doctor. We'll do better next time, don't you worry.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor! Got your Farcaster from the Felynes? You need to ditch, fast. I'll come right after you, no worries!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Whoa, whoa, steady. Lemme put my sword away first.
voicelines.tap: What's up, Doctor? Need me to head somewhere?
voicelines.trust_tap: Haha, what do you say, Doctor? How about a round of drinks?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: It's another fine day. Take care of yourself, Doctor!

name: Wind Chimes
biography: Wind Chimes, a Messenger who travels around northwestern Yan, allowing remote villages to communicate with each other. She came to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment and now works part-time as a Messenger for Rhodes Island.
description: Wind Chimes, Messenger to rural parts, pacing the distance between mountains and nomadic cities by her own two feet.
quote: She doesn't try to hide why her horn is broken, but still, it embarrasses her a little.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Are these the documents you need to mail? Alright, let me check them off.
voicelines.talk_1: There's a letter for you from the Lungmen slums, Doctor. A former patient? Your expression tells me pretty much exactly what's in this letter.
voicelines.talk_2: I use this sword to fight beasts that slip into the village, as well as bandits and thieves. For beasts, it's just a matter of driving them away. But people, it's hard to keep them from going astray.
voicelines.talk_3: There are villages that don't even appear on maps, relying on Messengers to communicate. I used to follow the ones who came to my village around, and even learned my first words from the stuff written on envelopes. But I had to grow up before I learned how much those few words meant.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I once went back to the village where I grew up. All I found was a few abandoned huts and fields. The people who lived there probably found new lives in the cities. But sometimes I wonder, if I had worked harder, would they have stayed?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You know, I haven't been to that many places. I've wandered between the mountains and cities, and seen people suffering from hardship, helplessness, and stress... This is a vast land, but how many people live in its nameless corners from birth to death, with no one ever to know they existed?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The villagers didn't kick me out when they learned I had Oripathy, but still I couldn't go back to my old life. No, getting infected was my own responsibility. It'd be too full of myself to say I got Infected to help people.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm still looking for the young man's family. My words were too harsh... I didn't know his name, even at the very end of it. Superficial as it might have been, he came down for a taste of our harsh lives and recorded it. There's meaning in that.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I've seen many people wait at the village entrance, hoping for a letter from their families. I've seen all sorts of emotions on their faces when they opened the letters. Messengers carry little slivers of people's lives. That's got nothing to do with me, and everything too.
voicelines.idle: What a beautiful sunset. The weather tomorrow should be fine and clear.
voicelines.onboard: Hi there, Are you the Doctor that's in charge here? I heard I could get treatment for Oripathy in exchange for work here... Oh, right, just call me Wind Chimes. It's a name that represents hope.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I'd rather not get into fights while making deliveries...
voicelines.promotion_1: All I did was carry out my duties as a Messenger... Anyway, leave it to me if you have a job like that again. I won't let you down.
voicelines.promotion_2: Many more people are waiting for hopeful news. Doctor, let's walk this path together.
voicelines.added_to_squad: As long as there's a destination, there's a way.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll make sure everyone arrives safely.
voicelines.depart: The road is long. Walk slowly.
voicelines.begin_operation: Get out of the way.
voicelines.deployment_1: Bare mountains, dirt n' dust... all familiar sights.
voicelines.deployment_2: A long path through tall mountains… Stay alert.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Leave now and I'll act like I never saw you.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I never wanted to point this blade at anyone.
voicelines.in_battle_3: There are people waiting for me.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Don't keep pushing down the wrong path…
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter how far the destination, you will get there one day, as long as you keep moving forward.
voicelines.3-star_result: I'm happy to bring news of victory, but I would rather avoid conflict like this.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The goods are still here. Let's hope those who ran away will learn and repent.
voicelines.operation_failure: Let's rest and regroup. We can take back what we lost later.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's good to have a place to rest.
voicelines.trust_tap: Careful, I just got back and I'm covered in dust…
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Firewhistle
biography: Firewhistle, the owner of a small Rim Billiton PMC. As the representative of her company, she entered into a cooperative agreement with Rhodes Island and signed on as an operator to provide her services to Rhodes Island.
description: Defender Operator Firewhistle, at your service!
quote: Rhodes Island's Fire Department was on edge for a while after she came, but luckily, she's learned a thing or two about putting out fires in all her time lighting them.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: With all this paper around, it's hard to resist the urge to start fires… Whoa, whoa, don't look at me like that, I'm just joshin', okay?
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, our employees are all Billy natives who know the lay of the land. If any Rhodes operators are traveling to Rim Billiton and need an escort, come find us! We will offer you a fair price.
voicelines.talk_2: Why hire Infected when it's bad for business? Well, umm, because... Ah, come on, we all know how Oripathy's transmitted. All you need is proper protection and monitoring. Rhodes Island does the same, right? Ahaha…
voicelines.talk_3: The right type of ammo can turn the tide of a battle', it's a line every artilleryman knows. So their bags are filled with grapeshot, flashbangs and tracers. 'Course, they always have trouble deciding which to use when the time comes. As for me, I just bring incendiaries. Use 'em right, and they replace any type of ammo you could need.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I hated it whenever anyone brought up my dad while I was in university. Are we on bad terms? Naw, he's not a bad dad, and I'm grateful to him. But I hate it when people look at me like a mining mogul's spoiled kid. I'm more than just my dad's daughter!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Dad wouldn't let me near fire, Mum didn't let me play with the miners' kids, my old boss told me not to poke my nose into business that isn't my own, and everyone told me not to be too nice to the Infected. I never listened to any of that. You decide what's right and wrong for yourself, and never get swept up if you need time to make a choice.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: That little firefighter always tenses up when she sees me, then points her hose right at me. Well, It's cute, sure, but that can't go on forever. The three of us should go for a drink sometime and clear up this misunderstanding. For the two of you, I'll make my special flaming cocktail.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I know I'm not great at business, but I also know how it feels to be helpless, relying on the kindness of others. It hurts, the company being in debt, but debtor's prison beats having to burn your own comrades to cinders.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I loved playing army when I was little, and I always dreamed of becoming a general. But Rim Billiton wasn't the place for that, so I had to settle for a private security firm... Now? Now I just want to keep my people warm and fed. My dream of becoming a general died the first time I saw someone get shot.
voicelines.idle: Yawn... I'm bored. Might as well build a grenade tower over here... Whoa?! You're awake? Er, these are blanks! Nah yeah, just blanks!
voicelines.onboard: Thank you for choosing Firewhistle Security Services! My name is... huh? Codename? Umm, just call me Firewhistle. Yup, that's the key to raising brand awareness!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Nice strat. Would've been even better with some fire on that spot.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Thank you! If you've got any more security jobs for me and my people, that'd be even better. Hehe.
voicelines.promotion_2: Working with Rhodes Island's seen my company turn a profit at last. I'm not paying my employees out of my own pocket anymore! Thank you so much, Doctor! You have all my appreciation and all my gratitude!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Firewhistle, at your service!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Captain? No problem, I'm used to running the show.
voicelines.depart: Let's go,everyone! I'll buy a round for us all when we're done.
voicelines.begin_operation: Stay low. Wait 'till you see my fire.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Need some fire to turn up the heat?
voicelines.deployment_1: In position and ready to light'em up.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Panicking just spreads the fire faster.
voicelines.4-star_result: Your plan actually worked! Sure wish I had a tactical genius like you on my payroll.
voicelines.3-star_result: We should put out the fires before we call it a day. Wanna join me?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Leaving a smoldering ember is a good way to end up with a wildfire. Let's watch out for those.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'll cover our retreat. Don't worry, I've done this a bunch of times.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Rhodes Island's base is outfitted so much better than my little office.
voicelines.trust_tap: Here, I made this ornament out of a shell casing. Hehe, I'm really good at it, right?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: G'day, Doctor! Need a warm fire?

name: Jieyun
biography: Jieyun, an Anasa girl living in the northwestern deserts of Yan, was introduced by Waai Fu to Rhodes Island's Great Yan branch for treatment, and simultaneously serves as a field operator.
description: Spinner of flywheels, the Anasa girl Jieyun, come afar from the deserts of Yan.
quote: In the turn of the wheels, life and death are each other's roots.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'll protect you, as I've promised. But...it'll take some time before I can read all the words on these documents... Don't worry, I'll get there.
voicelines.talk_1: You have to be prepared, out in the wastelands. Always carry flint for starting fires, a weapon for self-defense, and fabric to use as a water filter... no flammable items in the office? But, what if there's a power outage?
voicelines.talk_2: Shifu taught us how to fight, how to avoid Catastrophes, how to farm and store food. Now we don't have to drift around in search of water and pasture anymore... Just like you, Doctor, Shifu seemed to know everything. I can't be like you and my Shifu, but I can protect you, so you can help people.
voicelines.talk_3: Whenever the tribe is on the move, everyone worries whether we'll find a good place to settle down. But people in nomadic cities don't seem concerned at all... Maybe for them, they're not moving in search of a new home, but drifting with the home they have?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Oripathy is not a rare sight in my tribe. We only think the stones that grow from the skin, they look like the stones we dig out of the earth… There are already so many things that can kill you; why persecute someone for a disease?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The name 'Anasa' means 'one without roots.' My people say that if you have no attachments, there's nothing that can trouble you. But everyone I've met since I left has something that they are attached to. Me? You mean I'm the same, in how I want to repay my debt? Hmm...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My name comes from the first Yanese poem my Shifu taught me. It tells of a cloud, 'Yun' in Yanese, that has been drifting for a thousand li, raining across the land, until it finally finds a mountain to rest upon. 'Jie' is the end of that long journey. After all, 'everyone should have a place to call home.'
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: That martial arts master is here too... I thought he was cold and heartless, but now I kind of understand him... a man who has lived for so long and traveled so far can only carry so much. That must be what Shifu thought as well.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Sometimes you see the clear night sky after a Catastrophe has passed in the distance. Wind blows toward the horizon, and the stars seem so close you could touch them. A bonfire keeps the beasts away, while singing keeps you warm. The wastes are dangerous, but they are not terrible.
voicelines.idle: Are you retiring for the night? I'll stand watch.
voicelines.onboard: My birth name? Doctor, you understand the Anasa language...? But I would rather continue to use the name 'Jieyun.' Shifu gave me this name, and I like it.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: The reasons to fight never change much.
voicelines.promotion_1: I still have a lot to learn after leaving the wastes. I'm willing to do more, if you trust me to. As the Yanese expression goes: a promise is worth a thousand taels of gold.
voicelines.promotion_2: I haven't thought much about what I will become, but Rhodes Island could become home to many. Thank you, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yes, I will complete the task you gave me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Stay close. The wastelands are a dangerous place to get lost.
voicelines.depart: We're bringing everyone home, safe and sound.
voicelines.begin_operation: The wind and sand don't cover all tracks. Something's not right here.
voicelines.deployment_1: Remember those poplars, and you'll always find your way.
voicelines.deployment_2: I'll pile some stones here to mark the trail.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Would you give up after a loss?
voicelines.in_battle_2: You have invaded someone else's home...
voicelines.in_battle_3: Your families will be sad if they never see you again.
voicelines.in_battle_4: A few more cairns on the barrens.
voicelines.4-star_result: Will anyone remember them when all this is buried beneath the sand?
voicelines.3-star_result: If I could learn from you, Doctor, I could protect my people's lands.

name: Harmonie
biography: Harmonie, former Victorian military intelligence agent, now a high-ranking officer for the forces of Dublinn. Stationed aboard Rhodes Island as diplomatic ambassador to the Duke of Wellington, and partially assists Rhodes Island with affairs within Victoria's borders.
description: Ex-double agent Harmonie, now taking your orders.
quote: It's true, she does hold no ill will toward anyone.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If you didn't have the time to get to all these files, why didn't you come ask me for help? I would've been more than glad.
voicelines.talk_1: Don't worry, there wouldn't be anything in it for me if I left Rhodes Island, at this point. You're free to get up to whatever it is you usually do, never mind the fact I'm here. And as recompense for your trust, I won't leak a single detail of your work. Now come on, chop-chop. I'm deathly concerned for you, what with that doorstopper of a document.
voicelines.talk_2: 'Darling Rita.' I assume you're curious, if you bring it up? You know those certain few students who always leave their mark on you in your school years? I took quite a fancy to one of them—such an excellent soldier she turned out to be. Still, we have the space to keep out of each other's ways here, and that suits my fancy just as well.
voicelines.talk_3: Anything you'd like of me, Doctor of Rhodes Island? If it's in my power to deepen our bilateral trust, then I would be willing to stop gazing out at the window scenery, and focus a little instead on whatever it is that's vexing you.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Shame you're short on people with a shrewd eye for Londinium affairs—I was quite curious what they'd think of me. After all, a medical organization like Rhodes Island, unaffiliated with any nation, opting to work with us? Either you did it out of sheer idiocy, or if not, then you must've known a little too much.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: So what's your next step? Keep throwing yourself into the maelstrom of Victoria, or continue to build the peaceful paradise that Rhodes Island hopes for? The Leader once gave me a display of land torched to ash by her fires, and I'm ever so curious. If you had flames, what color would they be?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: 'Reed.' Such a darling codename—I can practically guess what was on her mind when she came up with it. Still, I'd be more the fool for claiming the prospect of a book club partner drove me here. She just happens to be somebody very useful, hence my need to protect her.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Just making a little bookside conversation, but... how do you regard the act of dancing? You know, when hands rest on collars, and gazes lock, and involuntary reactions let slip the true intentions of you or I—my my, your heart's hardly fluttering at all. No wonder The Leader's so interested in you.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I've gone through the files on my desk. Not at all surprised Rhodes Island would be going after my true reasons for coming here. That said, you were kind enough to drop the papers off with me? You must not be planning to boot me out any time soon, let alone hand me off to a duke. So, what is it you want me to do for Rhodes Island, or perhaps, for you?
voicelines.idle: Hm-hmm, time to paint my nails. What pattern shall we go with?
voicelines.onboard: Pleased to meet you, and my codename is Harmonie. Here's a dossier on Victoria for Rhodes Island's perusal, as a gesture of goodwill. Don't umm and ahh about it, now—that's basic etiquette for when someone thanks you. May we get along smashingly in the days to come, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Oh, what a splendid war command.
voicelines.promotion_1: Ah, well, thank you very much. It's my honor to receive your endorsement.
voicelines.promotion_2: What you're doing here has me startlingly curious. What could you be up to, placing me in this position?
voicelines.added_to_squad: What would you have me do for Rhodes Island?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I thank Rhodes Island for its trust.
voicelines.depart: I do hope none of you turn on the waterworks anytime soon.
voicelines.begin_operation: Get yourselves ready.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Take a breath, go on. It's not as if I'm crushing your throat.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Stop flailing about, and do as I tell you.
voicelines.in_battle_4: This'll all be over before you're bored of it.
voicelines.4-star_result: If I hadn't seen the battle for myself, I just might have been shocked by your command style.
voicelines.3-star_result: I'm sure if The Leader saw you now, she'd be delighted.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Oh, there's a rare sight. Maybe you have other things on your mind?
voicelines.operation_failure: Right, what else can I do here?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Minimalistic, but not at all design-deficient. I have to laud your tastes.
voicelines.tap: Tut...! Ah. Was something the matter, Doctor? Do tell.
voicelines.trust_tap: If you're free, we could always chat about your bookshelf.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
