name: Puzzle
biography: Puzzle, a Victorian military intelligence officer, came to Rhodes Island with a letter from the Duke of Caster, seeking treatment as an Infected. He has reached a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island, and is active in various operations and preliminary intelligence gathering while receiving treatment.
description: Victorian Intelligence Officer Puzzle, ne'er a detail that passes him by.
quote: His gaze is as sharp as the dagger he conceals.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Sorting files, serving tea, and transcribing meetings? Of course, I'm at your disposal... Come to think of it, in my first mission, I also approached the target under the guise of a secretary. One week later, I'd hollowed them of all valuable intel, and torn their influence down to rubble.
voicelines.talk_1: If you don't trust me, you have permission to search my briefcase, and ascertain whether any data inside is critical to Rhodes Island. The Curio Collector's Guide to Antique Appraisal? Learning material for skills required under certain guises—nothing more, certainly not a personal interest. Pardon me if you wanted specifics, but no comment.
voicelines.talk_2: The Dublinn Feline, name of Harmonie. Her plan had a lot of moving parts, and almost went off without a hitch—shame she still left an opening. Even your smallest mistake can have irredeemable consequences, such is the cutthroat nature of intelligence work. Yes? Do I consider her an enemy? Hardly; there is no value in a spy whose identity is exposed.
voicelines.talk_3: I'm working on a puzzle... Sorry, please be quiet for a while; your voice is disturbing the pieces. A puzzle's answer is unique; do you solve it through incessant trial-and-error, or through calm analysis and a hold of every detail? Only morons would elect for the former... Well then, did you need me for something?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Inside the aristocrat's ballroom, you need to mind every gaze, to pry into or guard against one another. That is the battlefield the spy roams. It demands of us the proficiency to cruise through it, but I highly doubt anyone truly enjoys it.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I rarely make decisions based on emotion, but my saving a completely unrelated civilian was out of fear, it's true. It didn't amount to a mistake, Doctor, and it won't impact anything... War only showed me some of its spiny thorns, but I know It will crush every emotion we feel and every concept we hold
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Rhodes Island's doctors constantly limit my usage of Originium Arts. Aside from ensuring my condition doesn't worsen, they must be concerned that I'll cause some sort of uncontrollable accident... You can put your worries to rest, I know my limits. But nevertheless, thank you for caring.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: It was on a mission that an unanticipated explosion infected me with Oripathy. Of course, that mission was still a success... Why didn't I take cover? Doctor, a variable like that could impact the entire operation. But we could also accept it, and implement it as part of the plan.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Thanks to work reasons, I've met quite a few people as unique and interesting as you. And for those same work reasons, the 'me' they got to know has vanished. Is it a shame? No, it's just the piecing of a new puzzle. All that said, I don't plan to ditch my current codename, for the time being.
voicelines.idle: No pending intelligence work for the moment... What a rare break.
voicelines.onboard: You'll have received personal correspondence from the Duke. I'll be stationed and active aboard under the codename Puzzle. No need to bother investigating me; I've handed you all personal information that's been made public.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This deployment is somewhat sloppy... or does it speak to your confidence in their individual abilities?
voicelines.promotion_1: Doctor, you need caution when promoting intelligence workers. It may well add danger to your situation... But I'll let this one pass, seeing as you're affirming my work ability with it.
voicelines.promotion_2: The last promotion wasn't that long ago... I appreciate your trust. Of course, if Rhodes Island is wishing to work on closer terms with any nobility I serve, I'd be willing to pass on the message.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Doctor, my public activity with Rhodes Island is better kept on the minimal end.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: An intelligence worker in this position is barely a good fit... I have no reason to decline, naturally, if you have your own considerations.
voicelines.depart: Do you need me to tell you all, you seem like a pack of children at a holiday camp?
voicelines.begin_operation: Within expectations.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: The intel work began long beforehand.
voicelines.deployment_1: Probing the enemy's weak points, posthaste.
voicelines.deployment_2: Be ready at a moment's notice for the info I send back.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Don't leave it written across your face.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Every look you take has value.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Every expression you make is an opening.
voicelines.in_battle_4: I can read you like an open book.
voicelines.4-star_result: Such adaptability and command proficiency... I'm all too glad you're not my target.
voicelines.3-star_result: Intelligence is the invisible scaffold, each battle merely following whatever course it lays out. With the boon of our preceding work, this victory should come as little surprise, Doctor.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Check for lost weaponry, cover all tracks, don't let anyone in the future discover what happened here.
voicelines.operation_failure: A comprehensive plan must include a contingency for failure at every step. We're prepared, so evacuate ASAP... wait, destroy this intel before we leave.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: If certain Victorian nobles decorated their residences the way you do, my work would be more than twice as difficult.
voicelines.trust_tap: I was out of practice with a few skills—it seems I can revise here.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Oh, I see it's you again, Doctor.

name: Qanipalaat
biography: Operator Qanipalaat has extensive experience in wilderness rescue, having functioned on a search and rescue team in the Sami region. Born to a Sami tribe, he knew very little about the outside world and left Sami in search of a higher standard of medical care. He now works as a field operator for Rhodes Island, supporting operations in extreme environments.
description: From a Sami tribe comes Operator Qanipalaat, taking his first steps into outside lands.
quote: Plunge forth with courage! There's new discoveries around every corner.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor! Do you want these files here? A Liberi lady just taught me how to use a printer! Look, I even learned how to print on both sides! This needs to be single-sided? Uh-oh, sorry! I'll print it again!
voicelines.talk_1: My mother has gotten a lot better. That time, even divination showed a dark future. If not for the medical equipment we got from the explorers, she might have left us... Since then, I decided to go out into the world. I hope to bring more equipment like that back to the village.
voicelines.talk_2: I'm really grateful to Magallan. We've only met a few times during search and rescue operations, but she put me in touch with Rhodes Island after hearing my situation. And she's an incredible lady. Not many people dare to explore the ice fields like her. Even people in our tribe seldom set foot there. It's a place that's feared and revered.
voicelines.talk_3: I'm part of my tribe's rescue team, helping people who accidentally wander into the bog, or get lost in the snowstorms. That's how I met a lot of explorers from Columbia. Woah, Doctor, how did you know they always compliment my tail?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I never thought I would leave the tribe and come here. I was never interested in things from the outside world. But that shiny medical equipment blew me away. They went against our divination. That's a miracle to me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The explorers told me things I've never heard before, about 'corporations', 'timetables', 'entrepot'... we don't even have these words because we've never had a use for them. But I learned them quickly, thanks to my conversations with the explorers.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Can I see the future like Gitano? I suppose I could divine your future, but I'm not great at it. If you really want me to tell your fortune for the day, let's see... Okay, it says... the stars will fall from the sky, and eggplant must go on top of rice.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, Accounting says my 'reimbursement claim' has been delayed. What does 'reimbursement claim' mean? Sorry, but there's still so much I don't understand about paperwork…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor! I'm back from my field mission! We delivered some equipment to my tribe and taught them how to use it. Turns out aunt's leg pains were caused by bone spurs. Now that we know how to treat it, she won't have to rely on my cousin's Arts to relieve the pain.
voicelines.idle: Oh, the phone is ringing! What did the Doctor say I should do in this situation… Okay... He-hello? Um, nice to hear you. This is the Doctor's office.
voicelines.onboard: I forgot to ask the Perro man what I should call you. I only learned the word 'company' from the Columbians. Do you have a name? Oh, just 'Doctor'? I can do that!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Is this one of your technologies? How do you manage to record everything like that?
voicelines.promotion_1: Doctor, is this what you call a 'contract'? It's very difficult to understand. Do I have to sign it? You say if I don't sign it, I'll be forced to work day and night by a cruel boss? But Doctor, you are not cruel… What? What do you mean don't be so sure?
voicelines.promotion_2: I won't make a fool of myself like before, Doctor! You've helped me so much. My mother's getting better, and my tribe is learning to use Rhodes Island medical equipment. I hope I can do even more for them in the future.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Don't worry, I've been on a lot of rescue operations.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everyone, follow my orders and don't run off on your own.
voicelines.depart: Begin rescue operation!
voicelines.begin_operation: Make sure you're well-prepared. That's the foundation of a successful rescue.
voicelines.deployment_1: Don't worry, help is on the way.
voicelines.deployment_2: Please save your strength, we will get you out!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Don't worry. You're going to be fine!
voicelines.4-star_result: I was nervous, but my experience really came in handy!

name: Lunacub
biography: Lunacub, a wandering hunter from the Siracusan wilderness, joined Rhodes Island after an introduction by Penguin Logistics. Serves as a guide for Rhodes Island's field operations in Siracusa and as a part-time Sniper Operator.
description: Lunacub the hunter, lingering on civilization's edge, here to pursue your most cunning quarry.
quote: Provided you weren't hers first.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Assistant? File Work? Not sure I followed. Anyway, I found a nice-looking mountain with a great view the other day. Want to see it?
voicelines.talk_1: This makes no sense. Why did you build so many walls and corridors? They block your vision. A mad burdenbeast could crash into this little room without any warning, and you don't seem to be a bit conerned. Danger can be prowling at any corner and you must stay on your guard. That's what Agnese taught me.
voicelines.talk_2: You call the outside 'the wilds', but you can find everything out there. Put in a little effort and you'll find food and water just fine. But in the city, there are no places to hunt. How do you even survive?
voicelines.talk_3: Um, Doctor, have you ever been to one of those 'parties' Exusiai talks about? They're scary! Those little balls of exploded plant seeds, those sweet, smooth milk puffs! Listen, this is not how you should live... What? They're having another party today? I wanna go.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Agnese told about a dangerous scent on Rhodes Island, but she and the pack would stay with me. Hmm? You can't see her? But she was just here a moment ago... Maybe she went to go get food?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The man named Bernardo died, and Zaaro ran back to his territory with his tail between his legs... Seems like the hunt Agnese told us about is in the bag. But still she doesn't look happy. Why? The pack has more than enough food.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Can I get a couple extra sets of Rhodes Island clothes? They're well-made, very warm, make good tents, and you can tear them up for bandages. No? Awww… Then how about the storage depot? I'd like to go and... uhh, take a look around.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, Agnese spoke highly of you, and told me to learn from your 'cunning.' What does cunning mean? Oh! Is it cunning when you hide here by yourself, eating in secret, not sharing with anyone else? I don't think that's hard to do.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Recently, I've started thinking that maybe life under a roof isn't so bad. Here, you are not a pack, you don't group up and subject yourself to one another. You're, well, something strange... Ugh! It doesn't make any sense! Anyways, I'll stay here a few more days! So get me something good to eat!
voicelines.idle: Asleep? That means nothing for me to do? Agnese, let's go play outside.
voicelines.onboard: Agnese called me Lunacub, so you can call me that too. I heard there's a 'canteen' place here, where you can eat whatever you want. Is that true? Where is it? Can I go there right now?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Too much trouble! Hunting really isn't that complicated.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Does that mean you'll listen to me? How many of these shiny... 'medals' does it take for you to obey me?
voicelines.promotion_2: Agnese always tells me that humans are dangerous and cunning, their bellies full and hearts wicked, but you've proved you are different. You are allowed to join my pack.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I still prefer hunting with my pack. They are much more open than humans.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Since I'm the luna wolf, you all must listen to me. I'll make it clear first: if I don't see your fangs bared in the hunt, you won't get a share of the kill.
voicelines.depart: How much will we bring back today?
voicelines.begin_operation: The hunt begins.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Where are the idiots who came to die?
voicelines.deployment_1: Hurry, the pack and I are waiting.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Pipe down already! I'm not going to miss!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Stupid burdenbeast, you're not getting away!
voicelines.4-star_result: Good hunt. If you lived in the wild, I'm sure you would survive for long.
voicelines.3-star_result: Tired. Already did what you asked me. Can I go eat now? What's on the menu today?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hey! Some of them just got away! Do you even know how to keep the prey surrounded? I'm gonna teach you next time!
voicelines.operation_failure: Grr... Agnese, the hunt failed. Come help us! Don't let this idiot die here!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I don't like roofs.
voicelines.tap: Don't scare me like that! You wanna die?
voicelines.trust_tap: Hey, Doctor, don't you get tired of staying in these little cubes every day?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: What took you so long? Next time you make me wait for you in a stuffy little box, don't blame me if I get a little rude.

name: Paprika
biography: A member of the Columbian mercenaries recruited to Londinium by Manfred. She and her squad left his command owing to conflicting ideals, and when they were ambushed, we were there to rescue them.Now employed by Rhodes Island, she provides on-field medical support to our combat squads.
description: A young and tender Sarkaz mercenary, still a child in the eyes of many.
quote: She's still fumbling for a direction, and in fumbling she'll grow.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'm not good at this stuff either. Huh? They need it done today? Eh... Fine, I told you I'd help. I keep my word. Give it here. I'll take half, but you gotta finish the rest on your own!
voicelines.talk_1: Got any salt on you, Doc? Here, gimme some. I made potatoes. They taste so good when you sprinkle salt on them! We eat them like this a lot when we're out on a job! I roasted some fruit, too. Take it to W and Ines... Don't tell them it's from me! Got it?
voicelines.talk_2: I heard I might run into W here? Seriously? She and Ines saved me a while back, and I'm thankful for it, but she can be real annoying sometimes... Doc, I'm surprised you had the guts to hire her.
voicelines.talk_3: Manfred, that jackass! He actually did it! And he was serious about it, too! I totally thought I was going to die... Ugh, I know he's got his reasons... but I still can't let it slide! I've got a grudge!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You were leading the squad then, right? Hmph, how could I forget? You gave me a real bad time! But if I had to do it again, I'd still choose to take everybody and bug out... I don't want to have to watch somebody sacrifice themselves ever again.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Is rebuilding Kazdel really a good idea? I don't know. All I know is I care more about the people around me—my squadmates, everyone from Rhodes Island... of course, that includes you, Doctor! We're buddies now, right?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: If Kazdel really gets rebuilt, does that really mean us Sarkaz all get to come back and reunite together? What will the Victorian rebels think of us? I can't see how this all ends... I don't know...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doc! Is the mail in? Anything for me? Thing is, I was raised by my nana in a small town in Columbia, and we still write to each other! I'm always telling everyone here to write home more often, but for some reason they get pretty upset about it. I wonder why.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: C'mere, Doc. Try this on! Hm... Looks great on you. My nana knitted it for you! It matches mine, too! How's it feel? Comfy and warm, right? I told Nana all about you, and she called you a good egg!
voicelines.idle: So bored... Maybe I should knit something. What do you think of this little pouch? It's very practical!
voicelines.onboard: Hey there! Starting today, my squad and I are at your beck and call, Doctor. Call me Paprika. You seem like a solid employer, but you're still on probation! I've got my eye on you!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Are these the ancient Sarkaz tricks the old folks talk about?
voicelines.promotion_1: Awesome, I finally got promoted! Hehe, you said you'd let me lead my own squad after my promotion. You're a doctor of your word, aren't you?
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor! You're a mighty fine employer! Amiya looks real dependable, too. There's no going wrong, hitching my wagon to you. If you've got any more high-paying gigs, be sure to give me a holler!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Hehe, you picked the right girl for the job!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Just leave it to me! I've got some experience leading a squad.
voicelines.depart: Stay safe and keep in contact. Remember, the mission comes second. Your lives come first!
voicelines.begin_operation: Let's clear the place in one fell swoop!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Don't worry. I've been standing by here.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I don't pick fights I can't win.
voicelines.deployment_1: Not one of you is getting away!
voicelines.deployment_2: Don't get careless just because I'm here!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Get behind me, if you feel yourself slipping!
voicelines.in_battle_3: We can't have any more casualties...
voicelines.in_battle_4: You bastards... Scram! I'm busy here!
voicelines.4-star_result: You're pretty amazing, coming up with a strategy like that... I gotta say, you're a lot better than W just lobbing bombs at everything.
voicelines.3-star_result: Awesome, smooth like butter! Hehe, I didn't need any backup that time. Let's see what W and Ines have to say!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A few footmen slipped past us, but that's no big deal, right? Yep, everyone made it out of the fight alive. I call that a big win!
voicelines.operation_failure: N-No way... Doctor, you aren't trying to hold the line here, are you? C'mon, quit spacing out. Hurry up and run!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Rhodes Island really treats us well... Oh, don't be so humble. This is much better than the dump we used to live in!
voicelines.trust_tap: This poncho feels great, right? Nana knitted it for me. It's so warm.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey, Doc. What kind of missions do we have today? Oh, right. Let me get this out of the way. I'm not taking anything too crazy!

name: Dagda
biography: Dagda, Former Knight of the Tower and current member of Glasgow who joined Rhodes Island alongside Siege. As a member of Siege's squad, she plays an active role in all kinds of siege operations.
description: Dagda, member of the Glasgow Gang, she and her metal claws calmly awaiting assignment.
quote: She defends the dark night of Victoria, and you within that darkness too.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Siege's ordered me to serve as your assistant. I'll be a harsh supervisor for you, if it's called for.
voicelines.talk_1: Huh? Do you have a problem with my metal claws? They're totally brill! ...I mean... They're very... Wieldy. Please don't get the wrong idea about my taste.
voicelines.talk_2: Morgan picked this outfit. Obviously, something with a knightly air would definitely suit me more. Although this street style... is just a little bit... wicked.
voicelines.talk_3: Indra's a mess, both the way she lives and fights. That said, she'll go through hell and high water for her mates, and she'll fight to her last breath for Siege—maybe, she's more knight than some knights out there, and she's never even had to try.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Most of Victoria's people live out their whole lives in their own cities, while everyone aboard Rhodes Island has left their homes to drift around this land. It just bowls me over.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The Montague name and the title of Knight of the Tower used to be more precious to me than anything. But gradually, I came to see how change for Victoria was unavoidable, and it doesn't just stem from the flames of war before us. I may have to abandon my past to follow Siege, but I'll follow through, unto the very end.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Bound to uphold Victoria's dignity, the Knights of the Tower never once shrank back in the face of the Sarkaz's blades. I was the only one who escaped, protected by my brothers and sisters in arms... I often think to myself—if... just if... I could've fought to the end with them...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Siege said I should choose the life I truly want to live when the war is over. Once that day arrives, how will Victoria turn out to be? And how will I turn out to be? I... I can't imagine it. All I hope is I'm still able to stay by their sides.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Dr. {@nickname}... From here onwards, my blade belongs to both Victoria, and you. You can call me either Dagda or the 'Dark Blade.' Isa? T-Too frivolous! But if you've got to... then keep your voice down!
voicelines.idle: It's a Knight of the Tower's duty to stand night watch. May you rest well, Doctor.
voicelines.onboard: Knight of the Tower Isabella Montague. On behalf of Siege and our little alliance, I express our sincerest gratitude… What do you mean I don't dress like a knight? L-Looks can be bloody deceiving!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Umm...I'm seeing a wide gap between these tactics and my old training.
voicelines.promotion_1: A medal? I can't accept any that's not Victorian... hmm, but you are the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Okay, I'm making an exception just this once.
voicelines.promotion_2: Ever since we left Londinium, I've trained up a million more techniques than just knightly combat! Now you're going to see my true strength!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I've got no need to hide my identity if I'm fighting for Rhodes Island, yeah?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: What style of command do you want from me? The knight type, or the gang type?
voicelines.depart: A fight? Wicked, bring it on... Ahem, as a Knight of the Tower, I accept your challenge.
voicelines.begin_operation: These punks are nothing compared to the foes Victoria's surmounted!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Even without a blade, I can run you through!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Any soldier's will is worthy of respect.
voicelines.4-star_result: Be of firm enough conviction, and it won't matter what difficulties you face. You'll have nothing to be afraid of.
voicelines.3-star_result: Is that it? I didn't get to show off my real skills yet... If there is a next time, permit I continue to stand by your side.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: You can't reach perfection without pushing yourself to the limit. I must do better.
voicelines.operation_failure: If only I had a blade on me, I could... No, I can't give up now. Doctor, I'm ready to enter the next battle.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'll assume guard duties for this room.
voicelines.trust_tap: Stop calling me Isa...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Highmore
biography: Highmore was brought to Rhodes Island for medical treatment after being involved in an operation in Iberia.Based on observation and her test results, she was approved to become a field operator and now supports various missions around Iberia.
description: Branch Operator Highmore, more belligerent than her looks suggest.
quote: Daughter of the sea, yet willful rejecter of the ocean.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If some work is beyond even your power, then how can I possibly take on a share?
voicelines.talk_1: That nightmare still comes to mind, even now. My life denied by some grand ecology... no, not denied. It would admit everything, it was more sublime than life itself... it made me feel shame at the selfishness of life.
voicelines.talk_2: I don't want to belittle the Medical Department's effort, but I don't believe life can be 'cured' like a disease. Human or Sea Terror, I'm doomed to live on as half-baked, and that's the price I pay for my own foolishness.
voicelines.talk_3: That special 'collaborator' of yours is just something other right now, using biological function to imitate his old form, and you should know that better than him. You're still seeking possibilities in him? I hope you aren't repeating my mistakes.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I've felt at ease in my time residing aboard the landship, even come to recognize it as a feeling similar to my long-lost home... You don't need to be concerned. Even if Iberia will never be a home to the Ægir, I'd never refuse to execute my responsibilities there, such as we've agreed.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Anything that seems to be given for free will eventually demand some price of you. That's the lesson I learned. And some of what you do appears to practically overturn that... I'll have to wait and see.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You're wondering what this song is? It's just something my mother taught me when I was young. I didn't take much interest back then, only humming perfunctory notes to follow along. It was only after losing her, I realized... these melodies form one of the few things I still have to my name.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: An ignorant girl gives up her song, and gains naught but a dream snuffed as quickly as the foam in return. It sounds just like a fairytale, doesn't it? And the fact that such a stupid girl could be saved at the story's end... seems like a fairytale, too.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You've helped me recover the courage to trust in other beings, so I hope you see this responsibility through. Lead those willing to follow you, and put an end to those disasters that should never have befallen the innocent. Please, don't disappoint me.
voicelines.idle: You see them in your dreams too, don't you? All those faces who've quietly left your life.
voicelines.onboard: So, you'd be the 'Doctor'. I don't have much to introduce about myself. If I'm standing here, you must have read and approved all the files about me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Maybe I shouldn't doubt the value of these records, like I did before.
voicelines.promotion_1: The more you seek from a power you should reject, the deeper you fall into it. Eventually, it will engulf your entire being. You understand this, don't you?
voicelines.promotion_2: You wish to forge a space that can admit me, and hope for me to admit everything surrounding me...? An arrogant notion, truly. But maybe I could bear witness with you, until the day you give up.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Looks like we've gotten our approvals. It's time to go.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I might bring their ruin, but only you can bring our victory.
voicelines.depart: Let us reap those naive delusions and immature obsessions.
voicelines.begin_operation: I hear the sound of the flooding tide.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Do you have instructions for me?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Do I still have to wait?
voicelines.in_battle_1: They have no position to evade.
voicelines.in_battle_2: They have no power to withstand.
voicelines.in_battle_3: They have no way to advance.
voicelines.in_battle_4: They have no path to escape.
voicelines.4-star_result: Sometimes, your grasp of the surrounding situation makes me instinctually fearful. Yes, I believe you could make even Sea Terrors comprehend fear. So, do you intend to feel happy about this?
voicelines.3-star_result: The waves have subsided. If you have no other tasks, I should leave immediately to undergo a 'routine' inspection.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Were you showing mercy? Are enemies of this level worth your indulgence?
voicelines.operation_failure: We should go. Before the next wave has us drowned.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: So this, too, is the place you promise I can belong.
voicelines.trust_tap: This place might be more... calming than expected.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: We still have some time, before the tide floods the soil beneath us.

name: Proviso
biography: Proviso, real name Deszcz, former attorney of Longrein Law Firm in Kazimierz. Now working in Rhodes Island's Logistics Department as a legal consultant.
description: Legal advisor Proviso, open for consultation on all business matters.
quote: Either cough up massive legal fees, or be of true and sincere heart, and she'll be willing to help you out.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: These documents won't take me long to take care of. Why don't you show me Rhodes Island's old business contracts? You never know what kind of restitutions there might be hidden in a contract's terms.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, when you work out your business plans, feel free to put off the legal ramifications till the very end. I've never lost a case as a defense attorney.
voicelines.talk_2: Huh? Even that ice-cold Młynar is here? And here I thought he'd want a breather after leaving his job behind in the Grand Knight Territory. Well, Rhodes Island isn't a bad place. At least they don't expect you to wine-and-dine clients here. Otherwise, considering his alcohol tolerance...
voicelines.talk_3: Is that a Kazimierzian newspaper you're reading, Doctor? 'Despite Conclusive Evidence, Knight Sports Match Fixers Found Innocent'—Oh, I was in charge of that case. What does that mean? Hehe, if they walked away scot-free, then obviously the evidence wasn't conclusive enough.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I've never actually worked for a multinational corporation before, so I've been reading up on other countries' laws, too. But no matter where you are, the lawbooks make it clear as day who benefits under their rules.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The courtroom is a place of victory and defeat. Both sides submit their evidence, and their disputes are arbitrated within the confines of the law. I never expected to find any justice in that process, but when the law can be freely trampled on by capitalism, being a lawyer gets real boring, don't you think?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Ugh, my back hurts. I kind of want a massage chair, but money's tight with my current salary. But considering Rhodes Island's revenue, I suppose the pay isn't completely unreasonable—Speaking of which, what do you think of my plan to demand compensation from companies we've worked with? What? How can it be extortion when we're asking for pocket change?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, I think there are a lot of problems with the medical malpractice liability clauses in Rhodes Island's contracts. In most countries, we as a medical company wouldn't be liable for a lot of the scenarios listed in there—You don't want to fix it? Alright, I'll give it some more thought.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I'm slowly starting to understand that expecting the law be able to judge all disputes fairly isn't just naive, it's intellectually lazy. The law is not perfect, and it will always be riddled with holes that we need to fill with humanity.
voicelines.idle: So even the Doctor likes to sleep at the desk, just like me. I'll be worried about your spine if this keeps up, though…
voicelines.onboard: Hello, my name is Deszcz. I'm your new legal consultant. If you need to call me by a codename, then use Proviso. Let me get this out of the way first, though. The general practice of obfuscating all your employees' identities isn't going to fly with me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: If you're putting me in charge, I can make sure the enemies will be liable for all damages.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Let me take a look at the new contract... Alright, everything checks out. My salary did go up. Thanks!
voicelines.promotion_2: If you're letting me read these high clearance level materials, this is going way beyond a normal partnership, isn't it...? Thanks for your trust, Doctor. I hope I'll be able to accomplish with law what I never could before I came here.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm glad to help, but before we get started, can we be more explicit with regards to the terms of compensation?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everyone, please be sure to handle the work you're assigned. Do not give our opponents any loopholes.
voicelines.depart: The court is now in session!
voicelines.begin_operation: I've gathered enough materials on our opponents. They will lose this case.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Ahem. Allow me to present my argument.
voicelines.deployment_1: If you are not party to this suit, please leave at once.
voicelines.deployment_2: Order! The court will soon reach a verdict.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Hold it! The evidence submitted by the opposing party is suspect.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Objection! The witness's testimony is self-contradictory.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Anything you say can and will be used against you. I suggest you exercise your right to remain silent.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Based on the above, you are found guilty.
voicelines.4-star_result: No surprise there. As long as you understand how to use the system, the results follow naturally.
voicelines.3-star_result: I take it I met your expectations, Doctor? Now, per our contract, let's discuss legal fees.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Don't worry, we'll get this case thrown out and win the retrial.
voicelines.operation_failure: Something must've gone wrong somewhere... I won't let this kind of failure happen again.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can I apply for a more comfortable chair?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, I took a photo of what you just did as evidence.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hello, Doctor. I'm happy to report that Rhodes Island is not currently involved in any legal disputes, for now.

name: Cantabile
biography: Cantabile was rescued from the slums by the Bolívar office of Rhodes Island and sent to the landship for further treatment. She was accepted into Rhodes Island as an operator six months later, at her own request.
description: A woman who grew up in the midst of disorder, with hopes of seeking a new direction here.
quote: If the past is beyond change, then she will turn to decide her own future.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, watch your hands. If you aren't careful around my weapons, you'll get hurt.
voicelines.talk_1: Here are the instruments I used to play. There aren't too many of them, but the gems on them are very valuable. Sell them, and they should cover my medical fees... Once my debt's cleared, I'd like to go back to living on my own. Would that be alright?
voicelines.talk_2: I've seen pets kept around your hospital here, and you have a training room. I've seen some of the children you're giving intensive care in the wards. 'Instructor?' 'Professor?' My previous savior brought me to those with the same title, and look how I ended up.
voicelines.talk_3: This? This is my lyre. I may be better with other instruments, but I like playing this one most. Listen. Such an airy, lingering timbre, and the hand moves so beautifully when playing. But when you fully lose yourself in the melody, the knife concealed inside will... I'm sorry, I got carried away.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, do you intend only to treat me here? Strange. You really don't need me to do anything? I can't trust kindness with no strings attached. Let me do a little something for you, okay? I'm sure you'll be satisfied, no matter the task—But, you must share with me your motivations.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I remember coming back from my first fulfilled mission when I was young, weeping and throwing up, scared I didn't do well enough, that I would starve to death in some forgotten corner, unknown to anyone... No longer do I fear these things. Thanks to the days with Rhodes Island, I now know how it feels to be truly alive.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The Originium on my arm... it hurts terribly, but it's much more manageable by now. I know none of the physicians, but I can tell how sincerely they're working to save me. Doctor, once my illness has stabilized to a point, can I... stay here?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: A lot of my past mistakes were made out of fear. I was scared—I felt that if I didn't listen to them, I was dead. But after catching Oripathy, they threw me out there to die. I should have been terrified at that moment, but instead I was... relieved. The sun shining on my face—it was so warm, it really was.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, could you take me with you on your next field mission? I want to know the reasoning behind your every decision. Why did you save me, a stranger? Just what does my life mean to you...? I want to figure you out, just a little clearer.
voicelines.idle: All the ones before you would sleep with one eye open, when I was around. Do you... trust me that much?
voicelines.onboard: So you're the Doctor from Rhodes Island...? Thank you for what you did. I'll pay for my treatment in time. Otherwise, I'd like to be on my own for now.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I'm a fast learner, don't worry.
voicelines.promotion_1: So this is how it feels... to hold my life in my own hands.
voicelines.promotion_2: This isn't the first time someone saves my life. But, if I had a chance to get back to those barrens, a chance to weigh up what's behind those helping hands again, I would choose to starve to death there. Doctor, I've been thinking... how nice it would've been, if you were there offering your hand instead.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I trust your judgment. You won't lead me astray.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: If I make any mistakes, please point them out to me.
voicelines.depart: Things are different. I don't want to hide myself any longer.
voicelines.begin_operation: It's them, right?
voicelines.deployment_1: In time, I'll find the right place for myself too.
voicelines.in_battle_1: I'm aware of what I'm doing.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I know what it is I want.
voicelines.4-star_result: That's one more step in the right direction, isn't it?
voicelines.3-star_result: Someday in the future, I'll have as clear a direction as you do.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We have a few runaways. A little like I once was.
voicelines.operation_failure: This isn't happening, don't abandon me... Doctor, where are you?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Are you interested in my instruments? I can teach you how to play.
voicelines.trust_tap: If I leave someday, you'll send me off, won't you?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: I heard the sound of your footsteps, Doctor.

name: Minimalist
biography: Minimalist is a Durin structural engineer and architect. He suffers from advanced Oripathy and is currently undergoing treatment at Rhodes Island. He works in the Engineering Department and occasionally participates in field missions in that capacity.
description: Durin architectural designer Minimalist, hauled surface-side by Gavial.
quote: He's here on a voluntary basis, honest!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You want me to do file collation work...? These documents of yours all look dusty. I don't want to touch them. And how was your office even planned in the first place? Did you genuinely not feel personally, utterly disgusted leaving this cabinet here?
voicelines.talk_1: I propose swapping for more corrosion-proof materials next time you do maintenance on the ship's core structure. Why? Because when all's said and done, it's not you or me that'll be left behind. It's this landship's skeleton. That's what's going to endure. That's what will stand for us.
voicelines.talk_2: You've got some planning work for me? I'll ask to review my partners' design styles first. As long as they aren't too complex about it, I might be able to accept—okay, okay, fine, I'll do it, I'll take it, it's not as if collaborations are some big deal. Besides, it's not that you have disastrous taste.
voicelines.talk_3: What is it... Ah, darn it, the pencil smudged my belt again. I just got it replaced... Last time it was Gavial, saying she'd get me a new one of the same look. As if! The emblem on the clasp was straight from my designs, and obviously she didn't even give those an honest look!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I know, I'll go to the infirmary in a bit. I don't want to interrupt my thought process at the moment. And you know, Doctor, the moment is the exact thing I most value—you called Gavial in? Was she on duty at the Medical Department today? You can't fool—hello, Gavial, no no, I wasn't just working on any designs.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I used to appreicate a fan base of one, one who can truly see to the core of my designs, rather than having a crowd of followers with their superfacial admiration. For me, the latter holds absolutely no significance. But now… I suppose it's not all bad to let the masses see them. Discussion swirling around my work means I'm still alive.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Why do I tend not to greet anyone? Because once I do, I have to make small talk, and that forces me to crane my head up to speak with them, which makes me seem insignificant. We should be seeing eye-to-eye, on EQUAL footing... Are you asking if it weighs on me? As if! It just makes my neck ache.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I was genuinely full of anxiety back then. I always felt I didn't have enough time, though I'd never even accomplished a thing. But nowadays, I've gotten to the point where I can appreciate my own designs. The only thing is, it's been years since I last saw my teacher. I wonder if he'd be proud of me?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: A close look is all it takes to unearth the core sense of a man from his work. Just like how I used to disdain anything superfluous. I treated my own life in the same way. Doctor, an artwork is a microcosm of its creator's life. Yours, I can understand.
voicelines.idle: Hmm. Such a counter-conventional sleeping posture, such a complex yet stable load-bearing structure... miraculous. Is this not going to give you neck arthritis?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Operator Minimalist, freshly dragged here by Gavial. So this is what a nomadic landship's like? You must have a much easier time avoiding Catastrophes than we do underground. Hmph, the only thing in those fools' heads is merrily drinking their lives away—ow, Gavial, what did you hit me for?!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: ...If it's not architecture-related, I don't want to see it.
voicelines.promotion_1: A medal? Decently tasteful. You just give this to me, and that's it, right? I've absolutely no need for any sort of commendation ceremonies, and I imagine you don't like to waste time anyway. But I will—ahem—thank you for acknowledging me.
voicelines.promotion_2: Everyone's experiences are different, and the significance lying behind my works will be out of sight to most... but there are some, like you, like my mentor, that I hope can understand.
voicelines.added_to_squad: If Gavial's going, I'm not.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You want me for captain? What are you even... You're joking, aren't you? Hey!
voicelines.depart: Hm... alright, let me be clear, I don't have any prior combat experience. However, I am going to take this mission seriously.
voicelines.begin_operation: Instrument debugging complete. I can begin any time.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: I am aware. Don't push me.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: If you break anything, you're paying!
voicelines.deployment_1: Instrument is operating fine. Now scanning terrain.
voicelines.in_battle_2: We're not here to be courteous.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I just don't get you people...
voicelines.4-star_result: Huh. You're mightier than you let on, aren't you?
voicelines.3-star_result: *cough* *cough* *cough*... There's so much dust—it's filthy. Gah.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: What are you looking at me for? You want me to chase them?
voicelines.operation_failure: Snap out of it! Get running!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I don't want to open my eyes . I'm worried the interior design is going to scare the life out of me.
voicelines.trust_tap: Phew... what time is it? No, what day of the week? Er... did I eat anything yet? I don't think I did...?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, sitting for too long can leave you prone to neck arthritis. I suggest you watch out for yourself.

name: Greyy the Lightningbearer
biography: Greyy has passed multiple engineering examinations.Now working at the Engineering Department, he specializes in R&D and the applications of new technologies, as well as participating in combat and technology testing as necessary.
description: Greyy, Rhodes Island Electrical Engineer, determined to be the pillar bearing the weight of the next generation of engineering tech.
quote: To carry the hope of others is to shoulder an even greater responsibility.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: There's a limit to the types of documents I can help you with, Doctor. But I'll try to learn. I'm hoping to lead my own major engineering project someday, so I gotta accumulate knowledge from different domains.
voicelines.talk_1: Just spending some time reading. No, I'm not pushing myself too hard. Oripathy doesn't leave me too much time, so I must... Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to make things awkward.
voicelines.talk_2: I've gotten quite a bit taller in the last couple of years? Hehe, I'm still growing, after all. My ears have gotten perkier? Er, I guess it's also because I'm still growing...?
voicelines.talk_3: No, Doctor, I haven't gotten more talkative... but Engineering veterans say we have to sound certain of ourselves, in order for our skills and designs to feel certain... I'll keep working at it.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Looks like the upcoming courses are even more complicated, and Engineering's idea of an internship is a little… *sigh*… never mind, I can handle it. Yes, I'll be sure to get enough rest. Rest is important to studying efficiently.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Mankind may have learned to overcome the darkness of night, but there are always shadows that even the brightest lights cannot breach. If I can continue to improve this technology, and bring warmth and light to those who shiver in the cold night...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Though I now fully leave the line patrol work to my drones, it doesn't mean my early intership years are worthless. Look at my physique now, even Medical doesn't have to worry about me anymore... um, Doctor? Why are you crying?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Volvort Kochinski... I've seen their mark on Mamá's equipment. Not even Rhodes Island intelligence has been able to track down Mamá since the incident. Is she covering her tracks, running from something?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, I'm going to visit a client to help with PLC testing. It won't take too long. You can use Rhodes Island Messengers to contact me if you need something... but I'm sure you can handle anything that comes up.
voicelines.idle: Doctor... Doctor? Asleep already?... I see... This next segment is prone to bugs. I should set alerts to silent...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. This equipment was my graduation project. My initial plan was to... huh? Putting it into service? Dios mío(My goodness), so this is the 'Doctor's Thesis Defense' that Closure talked about?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: No matter how much I watch, I just can't help but feel… everyone's style is so individualized, it's hard to summarize anything for general application…
voicelines.promotion_1: It's an honor to earn your recognition, and that of Engineering. I know this is just the starting point, and I'll keep working to make sure that I don't let you down.
voicelines.promotion_2: Countless frontiers remain uncharted on this land named science, waiting to be mapped and discovered. Though our latest technologies help get their views from afar, we have yet to set our foot on them. My dream, Doctor, is to be the pioneer that explores these realms with engineering.
voicelines.added_to_squad: A practical field study... in combat? Sure, no problem.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Understood. I'll compile a deployment report with suggestions for improvement.
voicelines.depart: We're into an assault mission. Before we breakthrough the enemy defenses, I'm counting on you to hold the line.
voicelines.begin_operation: Battlefield is where soldiers and war machines witness their own prime… and their own end.
voicelines.4-star_result: Things were worse than expected, Doctor. Even our contingency plan was pushed to its limit... but we still did it!
voicelines.3-star_result: Phew… Everything went according to plan. All equipment in good condition. We're ready for the next phase.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Effect on target below expectations, risk of potential failure… The re-simulation of both Doctor and PRTS are required for next steps.
voicelines.operation_failure: No obstacles on the evacuation path. It's time to retreat, Doctor!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: These facilities could use an upgrade...
voicelines.tap: One moment, I'm almost done here... just a few lines more...
voicelines.trust_tap: Here so early, Doctor? Give me a moment, I'm almost done...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Astgenne
biography: Rhine Lab Energy Section Researcher Dr. Elena Urbica. While aboard Rhodes Island, she will use her original name as her codename.While she is more than capable of keeping her enemies at bay with her handmade staff and unique Originium Arts, rather than fighting on the frontlines, she prefers to provide support from the rear by working on research and machinery maintenance.
description: Elena, Rhine Lab researcher. You may call her Astgenne on Rhodes Island.
quote: She is a spark of lightning as well as a trumpet by your side.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: No problem. I've done all of this before, and I won't have any trouble handling it, but let's be up front, Doctor: If you come to me in the evening with a stack of documents and tell me to sort everything out that night, chances are that you might not get what you want.
voicelines.talk_1: Research is actually kind of a pain. Sometimes, you go all in on your research. Other times, you have to spend time going over progress with somebody else. You need to know your specialty like the back of your hand, and you also need people skills. If I wasn't already decent at both, my head would've exploded a long time ago.
voicelines.talk_2: My sister Astesia is really good at our family's chicanery, but she only ever uses it to help people. To think there would be such a pure, kind-hearted shyster running around... Oh, Doctor, don't tell anyone about this! Please, I'm begging you! If she finds out I told, Astesia will whap me upside the head!
voicelines.talk_3: Rhine Lab? Hmm... Sorry, I don't really want to talk about them right now. If that place were really so great, I wouldn't have asked for a transfer to Rhodes Island, right? Okay, break time's over! Back to work!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm the one who got infected, but then even Astesia... *sigh*... You probably can't tell, but she's actually pretty depressed. Enough is enough, I gotta do something to help her.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Columbia's technology keeps advancing, and as a researcher, I can almost see that future I'm looking for. My dream is right there, and I'm going to make it come true.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Our family's... well, how should I say this? My parents are the old-fashioned type that like to order people around. They don't care about your opinions, only the joy of being in control. It sucks. That's why I haven't been back home since college. Now they can't stop me from studying the stuff I like.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: There are those who help because they really want people to have a better life, but there are also those who help so they can use people as stepping stones. Doctor, you know how to tell the two apart, don't you? It's easy. You just need to look at the way they smile.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My dad's kinda famous back in the city, and our names are a little peculiar, so I thought I'd give myself a new name to get away from all that trouble. But feel free to call me whatever you want, Doctor. We're friends, don't sweat it.
voicelines.idle: Yes, this is the Doctor's office. Yes, the Doctor is resting right now. Please call back later.
voicelines.onboard: Researcher Elena Urbica of Rhine Lab. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. We're supposed to call each other by codenames here, right? No problem. In that case, call me Astgenne. It's simple and easy to remember.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I don't think I've seen a problem like that before. Gotta take notes...
voicelines.promotion_1: What a pretty medal! Let me help you pin it on. Hm? How come you're the one wearing it instead of me? Isn't this commemorating your good eye for people?
voicelines.promotion_2: Let's join together and break the shackles, Doctor! The future is unfolding right before our eyes!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Hello, everybody!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Hold on a sec. I'll finish reading the team leader's messages in a jiffy.
voicelines.depart: All charged up and ready to go.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'll show you the power of technology.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Miracles don't just drop out of the sky.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I'm not gonna sit here and wait for my demise.
voicelines.in_battle_4: My lightning will illuminate the starry sky!
voicelines.4-star_result: You had even the finest details under control. You must be a professional.
voicelines.3-star_result: I knew everything was going to be okay.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Everything's under control~ Just a little scuffed, that's all...
voicelines.operation_failure: No way... How could my calculation have...?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's see how far this is from my workstation...
voicelines.trust_tap: Oh, Doctor! What a coincidence running into you here! Why don't we go shopping together?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Hibiscus the Purifier
biography: Following both systematic training in medical theory and long-term training in clinical practice, Hibiscus has graduated from intern doctor to formal Medic Operator, as well as one of the Medical Department's attending physicians. Hibiscus possesses not only ample experience in medical field work, but has made considerable contributions to health management and aftercare as a theoretical researcher.
description: Hibiscus the Purifier, Rhodes Island Medical Operator; her ideal of caring for the sick and wounded has never wavered.
quote: Relieving pain, soothing souls.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor—oh, no need to panic, I'm not dragging you into a checkup, I'd just like to sit down in here for a moment... Out of all of Rhodes Island, it feels like your office is the one place that hasn't changed.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, we're about to partially renovate Rhodes Island's wards to better meet patient aftercare needs. I've written down all the supplies we need here. Would you like to check over it quickly? Yes, I am in charge of this work now.
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor, I've adjusted the flavor of my healthy meals based on everyone's input. I came to realize that blindly insisting on my own views might not actually be best—you can only resolve conflicts better once you listen to the other side, and stand in their shoes... It would've been nice if I'd realized that sooner.
voicelines.talk_3: I've always been so hard on everyone, keeping them to healthy schedules, never letting them do anything bad for their illness. It turns out I was the one failing at all of that, heheh... But don't worry, there's still a lot I've got to do. I'm not giving in yet.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Diseases don't just torment the body—they impact the mind too. 'How will others see me? Can I ever live how I used to?' Everyone has worries like that... If I can't help my patients put them to rest, then my treatment isn't done yet.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I once saved a child in Leithanien. When she came to and saw me, she screamed for her life and ran away. Before that, I never thought there was much of a difference between Caprinae horns and Sarkaz horns. We can't change how everyone sees things, but at the very least, I don't want my patients to fear me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I think Lava's really changed lately. She gets up and sleeps early without needing me to remind her, and she barely ever talks back when I nag her, but it's all the more worrying for some reason... Doctor, if you ever feel tired or depressed, you can come vent to me! I'd be perfectly happy!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: This flute? It's actually an Arts staff. It's from when I went to Vyseheim. It was there I used Arts to harm someone for the first time, and it was the first I saw a friend leave us forever, just out of reach. Every time I hold this staff, all my feelings in that moment come back to me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: We happily see off recovered patients, and say goodbye to former companions with a smile. People come and leave. Our varied dreams may lead us to different paths, but we'll always mean something to each other... Doctor, would you be open for food with me today? I'll go and ask Lava along.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, you might be reliable with work, but you act just like a child when you're off. Now you're sleeping on desk again. I've told you so many times, it's bad for your spine, and you might catch a cold just like that... *sigh* If I'm not there one day, could you really take care of yourself?
voicelines.onboard: Doctor, I'm back—Umm, Doctor, I know my last field assignment took longer than usual, but don't look at me like you don't recognize me... Medic Operator Hibiscus, reporting in.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Everyone's taking charge of themselves, now—that's nice to see.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm suddenly reminded of my time in A1, training with everybody... Everyone's matured so much now. I'll keep up the effort, for all we've been through.
voicelines.promotion_2: Bodily trauma can be treated through medicine and surgery, but how do we cure the pain from hostility and prejudice? Healing people's hearts, Doctor, that's what I will devote myself to.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I won't fail you—this time, I'll be sure to protect everyone.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm leading? I wasn't usually the one doing that before... No, I won't shirk responsibility.
voicelines.depart: Don't be afraid. I've got your backs.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'm not going to let you harm my friends.
voicelines.deployment_1: First aid ready. Medical support standying by.
voicelines.deployment_2: I wish this to be the last time, if possible…
voicelines.in_battle_1: If we can prevent more harm this way, I'll stand my ground.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Please tell me if this hurts.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I can do more than just heal.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Hold it. There's no sense in getting any more hurt.
voicelines.4-star_result: It's always easier to harm than heal. But... is it really something to be proud of...?
voicelines.3-star_result: I'm so glad everyone could come back safe...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Prioritize treating the wounded. I'll guard against counterattacks.
voicelines.operation_failure: I still couldn't... protect everyone...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Some beds have emptied.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, here's your healthy recipe for today. Make sure you eat on time.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Staying healthy is just as important as working hard, Doctor. Don't let either slip.

name: Czerny
biography: Czerny, renowned musician from Leithanien's Afterglow. Took up a concurrent post as a Defender Operator at a local Rhodes Island branch office following the Vyseheim incident.
description: Czerny, musician from the Afterglow, journeying with the rhythm.
quote: From his fingertips flow an endless stream of light and hope.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I've never been an assistant before. It's a novel experience, but rest assured that I will not be remiss, even if this work is not my forte.
voicelines.talk_1: If any children aboard Rhodes Island wish to learn piano, you may send them to me, but I am a strict teacher. I am not one to release a student partway once he begins his studies.
voicelines.talk_2: I hear a musical school known as 'jazz' is currently popular in Columbia. I've had the fortune to hear a few records. The free, unweighted playing style greatly amuses me, but sadly, I seem to lack the temperament for performing in such a swing.
voicelines.talk_3: Are you curious about my hands? Indeed, they're broader than others' at a glance. Please, they're no freakish things. I have them to thank that I can rain every melodie that swims in my head down onto the keys.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The Infected are only comparatively freer in Leithanien, and not that free. Outside of the Afterglow, there was hardly anywhere I could live, or eat... there was almost nowhere to turn.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My near-death experience unleashed a sudden, completely new melodie upon my mind. Compared to it, the musical forms I'd once learnt seemed like shackles. Just what tremendous feeling brought about its birth? Perhaps in the face of Death, I was nowhere near as fearless as I imagined.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Thank you for your concern. I'm not feeling ill—my writing is merely bottlenecked, and I haven't slept in several days. My hair, well... I often unconsciously grab at it while composing, if that explains its current unruliness.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, would you like to exercise with me? You seem surprised. Fräulein Hibiscus requested it. Most artists are the frail sort, but my recitals often exceed two hours in length. How could I handle it without a sturdy physique to support me?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You flatter me. So many voices have been snuffed out in the rapids of history. Their owners were hardly without talent; they simply left too soon, before anyone could stop and listen to their masterpieces fine as nature's song. And I was but slightly luckier, enough so to escape with my life.
voicelines.idle: Asleep? I hardly expected the lullabies I wrote to have an actual effect on you...
voicelines.onboard: Greetings, Doctor, my name is Czerny. Any charm or taste I may have had has been poured entirely into my compositions. And as for myself, I am no more than a run-of-the-mill performer. That's all the introduction you need.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I will commit to watching these as you require, but this is hardly how I prefer to study. I have always approached others' second-hand experiences with skepticism.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm extremely grateful for your sponsorship, Doctor; I am currently struggling financially. The annals of Leithanian art will commemorate your giving.
voicelines.promotion_2: I thank you for your approval. I had never seriously pursued Originium Arts before, and I hope henceforth that my Arts may be cast as freely as my melodien.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Through my creations, both pain and joy become immortal.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Compared to my piano, my ability with a baton actually fares quite well.
voicelines.depart: I've finished tuning. I may perform now.
voicelines.begin_operation: Please be seated.
voicelines.deployment_1: To tremble in my music is your honor.
voicelines.deployment_2: Extraordinary melodies can only be played by the soul that quakes.
voicelines.4-star_result: Huff... I may be—exceptionally tired in both body and mind, but I do not want the music to end here.
voicelines.3-star_result: Drawing the final barline here is perfect. I hardly want any movement of mine to approach tedium.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: There are times when stubborn pursuit of a technique hinders more than helps. Allowing your emotion to follow the music's natural flow can take you further.
voicelines.operation_failure: Please, don't be disheartened. Not every composition is smooth from start to finish. There'll always be a few rounds of polish before you land where you want to.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The deck of this ship is very spacious. Have you ever considered holding a concert there?
voicelines.tap: Watch that the noten in my pocket don't spill out.
voicelines.trust_tap: Perhaps you like to try learning an instrument? I could teach you; I'm qualified to tutor for the majority of them.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: I've written a new song. Would you like to hear?

name: Erato
biography: Erato, a wandering bard from Minos and a member of the guerrilla opposing the Sargonian colonizers.Despite Erato's repeated claims of being 'three-time Hymnic Games archery champion' and 'Minos's foremost harp player,' none of these claims can be substantiated and will therefore be left out of this file for the time being.
description: A wandering bard from Minos, ready to explore the unknown scenery with you.
quote: Paint a great and beautiful land through verse, and then defend it through bow and arrow.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You want me to be your accompanist? Sure thing.
voicelines.talk_1: Whether in harpistry or archery, my skill is second to none in all of Minos. Look, this is the medal I won in Hymnic archery. Beautiful, isn't it? Proof of my skills as a harpist? Several troupes have asked me to accompany them, you know~ Hmm... Actually, sit down. I'll play something for you.
voicelines.talk_2: Minos is a land of Romance. Day in and day out, you can see philosophers debating, warriors competing, and actors rehearsing grand epics. I will say though, our booze is some dangerous stuff. It's enough to drive one crazy, make one do fearsome things... How do I know? As if I'd tell you!
voicelines.talk_3: Tragedies are the most dazzling gems among our grand epics... or so I'd like to say, but Pallas's story is one of great disappointment. There is no greater humiliation than for a hero to remain unsung. 'There must be no flaws in a hero's mythos?' She said that? I simply cannot agree.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: From Minos to Bolívar, from Columbia to Leithanien. Each place has its own scenery and its own romance, and it is precisely because of this uniqueness that endless enmity and conflict are inevitable. But just as roses do not lose their beauty simply because they have thorns, this great land is equally worthy of love.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Even the mightiest hero cannot win a war alone. Just as an epic must be passed down to be meaningful, a hero must stand with others to even become a hero. In the past, I always felt as if something was missing from my journey. That 'something' has been found since I came here.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The Supreme One spread an incurable disease across the land, and the Healer was banished for opposing Him. The Healer, stripped of the power of divinity, descended to alleviate humankind's suffering through knowledge... Oh, this isn't Minos mythology or anything, it's just a story I made up.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Is this instrument a bow or a harp? Both~ The techniques behind the two are similar, both requiring discipline and elegance. Like this, gently place your fingertips on the strings, and thoughtfully acquaint yourself with the vibration from your fingertips. Want to give it a try? No, no, not like that. Give me your hand, I'll teach you.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: What am I reading? A volume of Victorian love poems. Shall I read some aloud for you? There's no need to be bashful; love and courage are one in the same – they should be red-hot and eye-catching, things that need not be concealed. Come, let's read some poetry together, Doctor.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, Doctor? Oh, you're asleep, huh? I was thinking about playing a little song for you, oh well...
voicelines.onboard: So this is Rhodes Island, huh? At last, at long last... No, all of this was ordained by fate, so I should be saying, it's about time! You can call me Erato. Is Pallas here, may I ask?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I didn't realize there was still so much to learn when it comes to team combat...
voicelines.promotion_1: Rankings? Promotions? No, no, heroes ought not focus their sights on such trivial things. But, I will accept this accolade as proof of our mutual trust.
voicelines.promotion_2: Should I celebrate this occasion by playing a song, or no? Let me think about what to say... Hmm, in the name of the Twelve Heroes of Minos, I dedicate my bowstring to thee, and my harp shall accompany thee into the ages.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Witness the crown jewel of Minoan archery.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Leave everything to me.
voicelines.depart: My arrow points toward victory.
voicelines.begin_operation: I shall witness your end.
voicelines.deployment_1: What wonderful scenery. A fine place for a battle.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Sleep to the sound of my harp. Sleep and death are of a kind.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Listen well to the requiem I play for thee.
voicelines.4-star_result: Life must eventually end, but legends live on forever. We've done it, Doctor.
voicelines.3-star_result: A victory worth celebrating. Let us sing! Doctor, did you witness my performance?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Chasing stragglers is scarcely fit for heroes of legend. Let them be.
voicelines.operation_failure: Hurry, run...! Our story mustn't end here!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can I play some music here?
voicelines.trust_tap: You seem to be in a good mood today, Doctor. Did you want to share a dance?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, did you want to listen to me sing?

name: Windflit
biography: Windflit has two degrees in engineering and Originium engineering and is particularly experienced in mechanical design. He is currently a member of the Engineering Department and produces mechanical devices to aid our operators in combat.
description: A fresh college graduate from Columbia—he's finally found a company that'll give him a job offer.
quote: Don't doubt his ability. What causes the youth to hit wall after wall is less simple than he thinks.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I get oil on me real easy, so I don't clean my apron often... There's some on my face too? Uhh, I'll go get it off.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, I don't know if this is offensive to ask, but... say you start things out with a mindset that gets people to live in peace with the Infected. Do you ever feel like your effort is in vain? What do you do, in times like that?
voicelines.talk_2: I consulted with my profs and sent a lot of resumes out close to graduation, but got no reply. I was told later how a lot of spots and big companies are fixed in advance, and not for students with no background like me. So the day I got Rhodes Island's hiring invitation, I thought it was some employment scam.
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor! I ever tell you about my club at college? We used the funds from the school to buy new machines on the market, tear 'em down and reassemble 'em. Learnt a lot of new stuff that way. Is Rhodes Island about that too? Check this one out! It's smoking right now, sure, but it's got new functionality.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I helped out at my parents' factory when I was a kid. Lots of stuff you've just gotta count on pure manual labor for. I've gone over all the notes the vets at Engineering lent me. If we can pass all this new tech down to my parents, we can save 'em a lot of effort.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My parents saved hard for a good school when I was a kid. I had classmates clowning on us for being poor, so I was dead set on learning something, showing them who's boss. They might still be living a cushier life than me, but nowadays, I just focus on myself.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, Rhodes Island is all real passionate folks. Saying they wanna make me clothes, they wanna gimme a haircut, and then they drag me off to show me around their own stalls. What do I do...? H—Hug 'em? Got it. I'll go try right now.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, I've never had a boss like you before. Ones I met before were all money-grubbing owner types, so... y'know hugs have really worked out. Can I hug you? C'mon, here we go!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I used to feel like this world was unfair, no matter where you went, and no one could do a thing to change it. But here, poverty or infection, none of that discrimination exists, and everyone gets rewarded equal to what they put in. Doctor, pulling this whole thing off...it's incredible.
voicelines.idle: You out? Real quiet... Woof! —Ooh, awake now, Doctor?
voicelines.onboard: Nice meeting you, Doctor, I'm Windflit, new Operator at Engineering. You said you saw ability in me? Real thankful for that.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Effort is the root of progress. Regular review lets me realize a lotta issues I overlooked before.
voicelines.promotion_1: I really love Rhodes Island's standards for promotion. No unfairness about 'em.
voicelines.promotion_2: Getting to this level of endorsement makes all my previous effort really kinda pay off. Doctor, Rhodes Island truly is a company worth sticking with for a long time.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I've got no combat experience, but I'll give it my best shot.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm not circling you all because I wanna. You're all too scattered apart. It'll be dangerous.
voicelines.depart: Can't let 'em bully us. Let's go!
voicelines.begin_operation: I wonder if these guys have their own problems too...
voicelines.in_battle_3: What is it you guys fight for?
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew... Each new battle teaches me a lotta new things. Maybe one day, I can finally get my own issues figured out.
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, how was my equipment this time? Real useful, right?!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Let's forget chasing 'em, maybe they've got their own problems. They chose to run, so no need to corner 'em now.
voicelines.operation_failure: Ugh... how did this happen...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Real spacious room. And real clean.
voicelines.trust_tap: I welded together this little metal doll kinda thing to look like you, hahaha...
voicelines.title: Arknights.
