name: Mulberry
biography: Member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' primarily carrying out relief efforts in some colder regions of Yan prone to Catastrophe. After enrolling in Chun-qian's exchange project with Rhodes Island, was selected for her outstanding application, and accepted dispatch to Rhodes Island to study Oripathy and relevant aid knowledge. Outside of study, also serves as an interim operator assisting the Medical Department.
description: Mulberry, of the rescue team, carries out her work conscientiously.
quote: Regardless of position or status, life always comes first.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, I'll leave the files I sorted here. Oh, you don't have to thank me. I am used to it, and it's nothing difficult... Um, are you thirsty perhaps? Should I make you some tea?
voicelines.talk_1: I'm not very good at speaking any languages other than Yanese. That's why I was a little scared at first and didn't talk much. But everyone's very friendly, and there are a lot of people from Yan here. Phew... it really puts my mind at ease.
voicelines.talk_2: Sorry to disturb you, Doctor, but would you happen to know where Provence and everyone else went? My family sent me some goodies from back home, and I thought I'd share some with them since they've been taking care of me... Oh, there are some for you too, Doctor. Please have a taste!
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor, could you help me look for my little dumpling? It's the small black-and-white doll. I thought I'd left it here, but I can't find it... *Whimpers*, please, I can't sleep at night without it.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The rescue team has to deal with the Catastrophes a lot, so it's only a matter of time for us before we become infected. None of us reject anyone because of that. The crystallization on my body isn't very conspicuous, and it doesn't hurt even if you press down on it... Sometimes, I even forget that I have this on my body.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: When I first joined the rescue team, I wasn't very used to the climate or the food there. I'd get too homesick to fall asleep at night, and I cried to myself many, many times, but whenever I see the people we rescued, I start to think that maybe I can keep at it...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, sorry to bother you... I've been studying Oripathy prevention techniques during Catastrophe relief, and Tsukinogi suggested that I come ask for your advice... Um... Sorry, am I being a bother?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Uhh! Doctor, why would you sneak up on me like that? Huh? What am I holding? Oh, this is a letter I got from home. When I made the decision to leave, my parents were so angry that they said they would disown me, but there's a saying where I come from: Blood is thicker than water...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: When I got infected with Oripathy, I knew I probably wouldn't be able to live the peaceful life my parents wanted for me. I don't regret it, though... Besides, if I hadn't made my decision, I would never have met you or anyone else from Rhodes Island here and now, hehe.
voicelines.idle: Doctor? Doctor? Sorry to bother you. Please lift your head up a little and sleep with the cushion. If you fall asleep like this, the letters from the report will get all over your face...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm a member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' dispatched here as an intern. My name is... Oh, I-I'm sorry. We need to use our codenames here, right? I'm terribly, terribly sorry. Please call me Mulberry.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Uhh..The mountain collapsed, and the ground crumbled...! They're not special effects from an action movie, are they?
voicelines.promotion_1: Huh? A promotion? Really? I get a salary from Rhodes Island as well as Chun-qian?! I... I'm so happy...!
voicelines.promotion_2: This time, I'm not doing this to help someone else, I'm doing it for myself... Doctor, thanks for always being there to cheer me on. Now, I'm sure that everything that I've done is truly meaningful.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll do my best to support everyone!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Huh? Me as team captain? Ah... Are you sure?
voicelines.depart: Okay, we'll head out right away... Everyone, please stay safe. We'll meet again once this is over.
voicelines.begin_operation: Watch out, everyone! There's movement up ahead!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Safety goggles... Okay, I have mine on. Let's go!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Phew... Haah! Oh, I'm here! I-I'm not nervous!
voicelines.in_battle_2: I... I can do it too!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Where are you looking? It's dangerous to get distracted!
voicelines.in_battle_4: It's my job to ensure everyone's safety!
voicelines.4-star_result: Report! All rescue operations in the area have been completed. Evacuation and escort proceeding without issue! Phew, thank goodness nobody's hurt...
voicelines.3-star_result: Phew, that wraps up the operation. Doctor, was I helpful?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Wait! It's not safe that way... We have to do something. I'll go fetch them right away!
voicelines.operation_failure: It's not safe here! Everyone, please evacuate! Doctor, follow me!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Whoa, this is the staff dormitory... Um, will I need to pay rent?
voicelines.tap: Huh? Ah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor! I really appreciate it, but please stop trying to sneak any more amulets onto me... I have way too many already!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

name: Tequila
biography: The former deputy director of the International Trade Management Department of Dossoles, real name Ernesto Salas, was dismissed during the riots in Dossoles City. After that, he was recommended to Rhodes Island by Operator Ch'en, and joined after passing the test.He was taken to Rhodes Island by a person who had clashed with him just a few days prior. Even in the face of such an embarrassing situation, he still behaved as if nothing had happened, maintaining a friendly and jovial social atmosphere along the way. Truly, Operator Tequila is a rare diplomatic talent fitting for one who serves the Mayor of Dossoles.
description: Guard Operator Tequila, all smiles on the battlefield too.
quote: Don't worry, he'll set everything up just hunky-dory.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Good work, Doctor. Why don't you take a break? Don't worry, I've already finished handling the report... Haha, there's no need to praise me. It's not that I have any extraordinary talents, I've simply become experienced with these things.
voicelines.talk_1: Wait, wait, Doctor, s-stop tugging, I'll take them out myself! *sigh*... Alright, all the cards I hid up my sleeves are right here. Haha, sure enough, you saw right through me. Next time, if we get a chance to go to Dossoles, I'll show you some even more interesting things.
voicelines.talk_2: Every time I talk to Miss Ch'en, as well as that Miss Lin, I get all nervous. I don't want to get beaten up again... Huh, you can't tell? No way, Doctor, can't you see my palms are all sweaty?
voicelines.talk_3: Yo, Doctor, how unusual running into you here. Are you looking for someone? Oh, if it's about Rafaela, I'm afraid I can't help you there. As you can see, without the old man here, we have very little to say to each other.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I was thrown into the army reserves by my old man. All of them were pretty much kids, more or less. Some of those people had burning ambitions, but I'd say most had nothing of the sort. Life was tough, so everyone was looking for a way out, nothing more.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Dossoles has Miss Candela, so there shouldn't be any issues. It's better that the old man was put behind bars, so he has time to calm down and reflect on his actions. The last time I agreed to help him, I was actually trying to make sense of my thoughts. And that was the last time I asked myself that question... because now, I've found the answer.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: When we first arrived in Dossoles, Rafaela and I were still very young, and we quickly adapted to life there. Only the old man was still stuck on his old ways, his old ideology... Can't do anything about it, but I figure I should at least try to help.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, here's the mission report from last time. I've already handled the follow-up. Don't worry, there won't be any problems. We've carefully laid out the plans, and if any contingencies pop up to disrupt the situation, I'd be supremely disappointed.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: So how about it, Doctor? Did you draw the card you were hoping for? Ah, that's too bad. That's a loser... Well, when it comes to gambling, there's nothing less reliable than luck. But rest assured, if you're ever in need of it, I'll be there to deliver it right into your hands.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, I'll put all the information I've sorted through over here. Hm? What the... you're asleep. And look at all the important documents you left lying here... You must trust me a whole lot...
voicelines.onboard: Hello there, are you the Doctor? Great, you're just as recognizable as Miss Ch'en said you'd be. Right, I should pick out a code name, then? Hmm... Let's go with Tequila! Sounds pretty nice, eh?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I'm supposed to imitate this move? Seems painful though.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Huh, already? Thanks a million. In any case, without further ado, let's talk about my work...
voicelines.promotion_2: When Miss Ch'en brought me in, I never thought I'd see a day like this. So, does that mean I'm one of your most capable subordinates? Haha, it's not a joke, whether you need me to be tour guide or something else, you can rest easy knowing you're in good hands.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it. Leave it to me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm in charge of the squad? Haha, I appreciate the trust...
voicelines.depart: Follow my lead. Be careful, and don't fall behind.
voicelines.begin_operation: Come, let us show our guests some hospitality.
voicelines.deployment_1: Sorry, this path is closed for business.
voicelines.deployment_2: I'd like you all to stop right there.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Don't get worked up, and say what you need to say.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I'm also not keen on using violence to resolve problems.
voicelines.4-star_result: You even managed to account for their sneak attack, Doctor, so there's no shame in them losing like that. I still have much to learn.
voicelines.3-star_result: Everything's taken care of, Doctor. ...How did I take care of it? Doctor, do you really need to hear that?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Close one, close one. Are you alright, Doctor? Huh, a few of 'em got away. Let me think...
voicelines.operation_failure: Retreat now! Live to fight another day!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: So this is the dorm, huh... Mind if I give it a makeover, and buy some little decorations for it?
voicelines.tap: Tsk... Who's tugging on me? ...Oh, it's just you, Doctor.
voicelines.trust_tap: It was raining out there just now, and my hair got a little wet... Ah, excuse me, Doctor, could you grab a towel for me?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: How are you feeling today? Want to head out for a bit?

name: La Pluma
biography: The daughter of a True Bolívarians lieutenant. After her father's death, she was adopted by her father's comrade-in-arms, Pancho, became his adopted daughter, and moved to Dossoles with him.After the Dossoles incident, she came to Rhodes Island along with Tequila. Due to her special identity, she was finally allowed to join Rhodes Island following a review.
description: Guard Operator La Pluma, a complete compliance with command.
quote: Of course, there are times it's not necessarily a good thing.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Be your bodyguard? Sure.
voicelines.talk_1: I don't know how my papa is doing nowadays... But, I trust the mayor, so it should be fine.
voicelines.talk_2: Though Dossoles is noisy and filled with unsavory people, life is still a lot better there than for the Bolívarians outside... Have you not been there yet, Doctor? Let's go together next time then.
voicelines.talk_3: Phew... Staying indoors all day is so stifling. Doctor, let's head up to the deck to get some fresh air, yeah? I'm sure you must be tired from working for so long.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, do you like the whole fighting and killing business? I'm actually not a fan, but I've seen too much of that stuff, as well as too many people around me doing it. And it kinda rubbed off on me...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Getting stronger is a good thing, but there doesn't seem to be anything to do after getting stronger... Doctor, how'd you decide on the things you wanted to do?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: For the longest time, papa didn't actually want me helping him with work. Given my personality, as you know, I'm not really cut out for it. But, I still gave it my all, because I became his daughter.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hey Doctor, can I scooch over a little closer to you? Um, because the office is so big, it feels a little deserted if I sit this far away. Can I?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, you clearly can't throw a punch, but you're just as reliable as papa. It feels like I can just obey your every word, and not have to think about anything. Huh? For me, that's a good thing.
voicelines.idle: I wonder what's under the Doctor's mask. Lemme sneak a peek...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. I'm Rafaela, the one Miss Ch'en introduced, and I'll be formally joining Rhodes Island today. Huh, a code name? Hmm... let's go with La Pluma then.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hmm... Wonder if I can really do this.
voicelines.promotion_1: Doctor, did you need me for something? Oh, a promotion? Hmm... did I do something special?
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, I'm stronger now than I was before? Really? I don't feel it... But if you say so, it must be true.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Oh, time for a mission?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm pretty good at leading the way.
voicelines.depart: Where are we going this time?
voicelines.begin_operation: Now then, I can't afford to get sidetracked.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Woah, Doctor, don't scare me like that.

voicelines.in_battle_3: It's a little harder than I expected...
voicelines.4-star_result: Huh, I had no clue I'd even be able to complete a mission like this...
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, you're incredible!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, leave the rest to me. I'll get them.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, this way. We need to run.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The corridors in Rhodes Island are so wide...
voicelines.trust_tap: Let's go see what Doctor is up to.

name: Kirara
biography: Higashi student Kirara, chose to leave home due to her Oripathy. After sending out an SOS message to her former classmates, she got a reply from Utage and sought treatment from Rhodes Island following instructions. Has a considerable understanding of electronic equipment. Presently providing assistance to Rhodes Island with broadcast communications and equipment maintenance.
description: Higashi student Kirara, all videogame consoles forbidden while she's forced on missions.
quote: Confiscate one, and she's still got a second, third and fourth.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Done with everything. Um... Sorry, do you mind if I read my manga here?
voicelines.talk_1: Doing human relationships is so not working out... And all you've gotta do on SNS is send a request and you're friends. Reality is a nightmare.
voicelines.talk_2: Utage was my classmate in middle school, and the one who introduced me here. What are we like? Not bad, I guess... but, Doctor, this is what you wanna remember: riajuu are a terrifying species!
voicelines.talk_3: Whuh? Why send messages even though we're face to face? I mean... it's 'cause it's easier that way, right, of course...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Back in Higashi, I saw Koga election vans on the street a bunch. I guess their representative was pretty cool... uh, but I don't understand much about that whole side of things, so usually I just voted whatever.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My family says that we all came out of the sea onto dry land forever ago, and that's how we settled down. Huh? Would I wanna go back into the sea? Mmnn... honestly, I could take it or leave it. As long as none of them get Oripathy, all of them are doing pretty fine in Higashi anyway.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: World's been kinda messy lately, huh. I hear us and the Kougon guys up north of us are getting heated again. This could suck... I wonder if the new games from them are gonna make it over...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, do you... think my hobbies are weird, or anything? When I was young, all the other kids made fun of me a bunch, like, I was so gloomy, or gross, stuff like that. H-Hmph. Who cares what they said, not like it was anything to care about...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctoooor, I'll lend you this game, and this manga and CD too! These are all masterpieces I chose from the heart so once you know them all we'll be soulmates, and then we can have so much to talk about! If you have any other genres you like you can tell me—oh—okay, how about you come over to mine and pick something out?
voicelines.idle: Oh jeez, gimme a sec here, just a little bit more... just need to land one more hit! —Nice! Rare drop, please and thank you!
voicelines.onboard: ...I'm Kirara. Nice to meet you... Uh, um... So that's all then? Can I leave?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Crap, this goes... uhhhh, but this is kind of a... humiliating name to give a special move, isn't it.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? As in a whole job upgrade...? Ugh, middle management is gonna wear us all out in the end.
voicelines.promotion_2: I wanted to thank everyone for sticking by me all this way, and... uh, I guess this isn't something you should really do by text, so... um, tha-I mean, it-it's not anything other than that, even! I just wanted to say that!
voicelines.added_to_squad: If you want a supporter, I guess I can help out... I think.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: ...Huh? Me? Captain? Me? Are you being serious?
voicelines.depart: Alright. Begin quest.
voicelines.begin_operation: Ah. Yeah, look over there. Enemy came right out of the tall grass.
voicelines.deployment_1: Oh, crap. I think I'm getting a little nervous.
voicelines.deployment_2: I've... seriously never seen scenes like this beyond manga before.
voicelines.in_battle_2: This is good, right? Okay, I got it.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Huh? Hey, that move was kind of... kind of pretty cool just now, right?
voicelines.4-star_result: Hoooooh, holy crap! You're kidding! You can take no-damage runs this far?!
voicelines.3-star_result: Quest complete. Phew... done.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Aaarrnngh, missed, darn. No savescumming in real life. Whatever...
voicelines.operation_failure: Yeah, this is done for. Let's quit out.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I mean, if it's an option, I'd like to just stay in my room forever...
voicelines.tap: Whah! Aaaahh, mispress... this one's seriously not happening.
voicelines.trust_tap: Oh, hey, Doctor. What, hey, you want me to step in to clear an action game or something?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Oh, good stuff on the login bonuses today.

name: Bena
biography: Specialist Operator Bena, retained aboard Rhodes Island after her attempt to bring Iris back to Victoria turned out fruitless.Uses unique doll manipulation techniques, able to demonstrate a special strategic value on the battlefield.Considering her age and her own wishes, only to be deployed under special circumstances.
description: Little rapscallion Bena, both intelligent and obedient.
quote: I've got one over on you, hee-hee.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Do you think me a princess, sitting elegantly in an office?
voicelines.talk_1: Don't take Iris's songs as true. They're for the young children, you know. What? Yes, I'm the guards with the scissors—what about it? Chop-chop? That's me making clothes—what did you think it was? *sigh* Adults, honestly. So eager to assume worse.
voicelines.talk_2: Preservation techniques? I wouldn't know. Even Iris hasn't the faintest clue how I keep things safe, so why would I be telling you?
voicelines.talk_3: Let me introduce Annie to you. She's my very best friend, and another 'me.'
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Don't ask me. I don't know why the Castle takes things in from everywhere to keep and then sends them back out. Granny wants me to do it, so I do it. In adult terms, it's work, isn't it? Something someone has to do.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Annie's a quiet one by nature, nothing at all like me. C-Controlling her? What are you talking about?! She's a person, she goes where she wants to! She's only by my side because she likes being with me. That's what best friends are like. Aren't they, Annie? 'Mm.'
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There's too many children here. No wonder Iris doesn't want to leave. Hrmm... if this goes on any longer, we may as well move the whole Castle of Dreams here onto Rhodes Island. It'll save time, and effort.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: What even is a good girl? Are you saying I'm not good? —Well, I suppose Granny has said there's situations you can't do as you please in, where you need to 'act' a little. Like? Well... 'My greetings to you, I come from the County of Linton. My name is Bena.' More or less like that, you know!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Granny brought me into the Castle when I was young, and I grew up there. When she retired, I took over her post at the Castle. How am I anything like Iris who just inherits the whole place? What, you think I'm jealous? Not a chance! Iris has to watch out for her figure, and me? I can eat all I want without putting on a pound, ahah!
voicelines.idle: 'Rest soundly. Doctor.' Who cares about that Doctor? Come out and let's go play! 'Alright.'
voicelines.onboard: I'm Bena, here to retrieve an idiot who went out and forgot to come home. But I hear there's still things she has to do, and I suppose that's fair. I'll stay and keep her company for a while.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You can't show something this violent to Annie and me.
voicelines.promotion_1: Ahah! Well, looks like you know how to work with children after all!
voicelines.promotion_2: Annie, are you ready? We're going to show this eternally hooded hoodlum what our Arts are made of! 'Alright, Bena.'
voicelines.added_to_squad: Two people for a single job. This won't be tricky.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Annie's got some ideas for you. Listen to me, now, everyone.
voicelines.depart: Let's take it just like a walk in the forest.
voicelines.begin_operation: Interested in pulling these toys apart too?
voicelines.in_battle_3: Whatever breaks needs to be fixed.
voicelines.in_battle_4: If there's no fixing it, turn it to pieces.
voicelines.4-star_result: What did you expect? I'm a dab hand at doing bad things to bad people!
voicelines.3-star_result: No piece of work who still needs trimming, then?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Leave the rest to the adults, then. We're going home.
voicelines.operation_failure: Annie, where are you?!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: We're two people here! This room's not big enough!
voicelines.trust_tap: Annie's off on an adventure. Want to come along?

name: Akafuyu
biography: Akafuyu, a swordsman from Higashi, is the successor of the Nobukage-ryu Iai-suemonogiri Kenpou. Aside from her mastery of traditional swordsmanship, she also possesses excellent modern combat and tactical abilities. Given how distinctively extraordinary she is as an individual, it will take some time for her to familiarize herself with Rhodes Island's combat style.
description: Higashi swordbearer Akafuyu, the Nobukage-ryu disciple.
quote: If you trust in her blade, she'll trust in you.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: What did you need me here for? Hah, that's a huge pile of papers on the desk. Filled to the brim with words, too. Just the sight of them makes me want to cut them in half!
voicelines.talk_1: Hfph—haah! Leave me alone. I'm trying to feel what my new technique is. Aren't techniques meant to be conceived instead of felt, you say? Hmph, I don't need to think. I just need to quiet down and feel it in my heart, and my technique will naturally unfold on my blade when the time comes.
voicelines.talk_2: That ninja... She may be able to stay out of your sight, but she cannot fool my senses. I know not what she's scheming, but I can promise you I shall not engage her right here and now. That said, if I find her trying to do harm to my master—You won't be able to stop my blade.
voicelines.talk_3: Who says I cannot see? Hmph, this medical report is full of shit. If you don't believe me, just try taking me on. Bring as many men as you want, and bring your strongest, swiftest men. Attack me from whichever direction you wish. If you make it anywhere close to my body, I'll accept defeat.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: It hurts my head when I have to listen to those righteous men and their principles, especially the ones that go on and on like they are preaching their scriptures. It doesn't matter what a feast for the ears their words are. They won't hesitate to stab even their family in the back if it benefits them. How is there any righteousness in what they say? They are hypocrites, and my blade will slice them apart!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've seen winters like that many times. The snow fell on the ground and turned red in an instant. They were everywhere, either lying prone or still sitting. I could not make out their faces, nor did I want to figure it out. My face and my chest were frozen cold, though my hands, with my blade held tight, felt hotter than ever. Tsk, why am I even telling you all this? You needn't listen, either.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Hm? How many times have I told you? Don't stand in front of me without a word! What? You wanted to make yourself more clearly seen? You're a strange fellow. I don't need to look at you to tell you apart from others! You think I just let anybody come this close to me?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: {@nickname}, you look just like my master when you have such a serious look on you. I suppose... it's because both you and her are forced to go forward in chase of a grand, ambitious goal.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My master had me come to Rhodes Island for some peace and quiet, but there is no peace to be had as long as the flames of war rage in my homeland. Nonetheless, as a commander, you have my respect. {@nickname}, I am under your command. Together, we will take to the battlefield, and I shall slay everyone that stands in our way as your blade!
voicelines.idle: The air here is nice and cool. Move over a little. Let me lay down a little too.
voicelines.onboard: Akafuyu, a swordsman, and the strongest you'll find. Taking a fancy to my katana? I will never set my katana down wheresoever I go. Haha, you better keep your distance if you are scared.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hey, I'm as strong as it gets already. Stop wasting my time!
voicelines.promotion_1: I don't need anyone's acknowledgement, but I appreciate your kindness. I will work to repay the favor.
voicelines.promotion_2: Heh... if these guys are still here, they should be dragging me into their celebrations any minute now. How about this, {@nickname}, come with me! We'll drink till we drop tonight!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Let's get going already. My katana is starting to rust.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Now we're talking! All of you, come with me!
voicelines.depart: Now! Sortie!
voicelines.begin_operation: No matter who, I shall slay them by my katana!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I've been waiting to draw my katana.
voicelines.deployment_2: Try taking on my blade head on!
voicelines.in_battle_2: It doesn't matter whether there's one or a thousand of you! I shall slay all that come my way!
voicelines.in_battle_3: I'll slay even your will to fight back!
voicelines.in_battle_4: My katana knows exactly where my foes are.
voicelines.4-star_result: Where are the foes actually worth fighting?
voicelines.3-star_result: That was hardly a battle. I didn't so much as break a sweat.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We had enemies slip past us? Impossible. There's no way I didn't see them.
voicelines.operation_failure: I won't run away. As long as my katana is in one piece, I can still fight!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What a small room! Don't keep me waiting in here for too long! I might not be able to keep myself from drawing my katana!
voicelines.tap: Hmph... Hey, if you were my enemy, I would already have cut you into two halves.

name: Toddifons
biography: A dropout from the Cyr Military College of Victoria. Though not a professional soldier in formal service, she has undertaken systematic training and excels in all respects, most notably in siege tactics and creation of relevant weaponry.Presently with Rhodes Island, serving as a Sniper Operator and junior craftsman, principally responsible for long-distance destruction of enemy fortifications and artillery suppression.
description: Sniper Operator Toddifons, with arrows sent to the sky, and flames falling to the earth.
quote: Following her heart, doing as she pleases.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Just let 'em burn. You weren't gonna give those papers a second look anyway.
voicelines.talk_1: If you wanted me to lay defenses in here, I'd break up the floor for starters. Not that I mind, it's up to you to think about it.
voicelines.talk_2: You've got people from Royal Guard knocking about too? Heh—ain't that interesting.
voicelines.talk_3: Calibrate the sight? Nah, the stuff I ordered last should be here almost, I'll make the arrows first... Push off! Out my way!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Most who leave Vouivre don't agree with the mercenary life in Sargon. Move to Victoria, end up doing something else instead. You know, like... yeah, factory-working, farming. Right. Having their own little touch of land.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You could probably tell, but I didn't used to be artillery. Recon, infiltration, CQC, mainly learned all that. I know I didn't like it, and the instructors wouldn't let me switch, so I dropped out, simple as. Where's the point in learning things you hate?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Oh, you're helpless! How am I going to the workshop wearing this?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: It's meant for attacking nomadic cities, this weapon. Using it to help you lot cope with skirmishers? It's like a hatchet to a cupcake. Let me try hitting a city or two sometime for practice, won't you?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Don't you think these crystals on my shoulder here match well with my hair color? I like my off-the-shoulder clothes too, so it's perfect. Shame, though, it would've been nice if they covered the whole way like that Siracusan Messenger girl.
voicelines.idle: I'll be heading back to sort stuff out, then. No point wasting time on this rotter.
voicelines.onboard: Arianrot, codename Toddifons. I don't like working for ordinary people. Here's hoping you can show me any signs you're not like them.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Boring. Off we go.
voicelines.promotion_1: What goes on in those Logistics' minds, cleaning up my side projects... tch. Fine, I accept. Your feelings are loud and clear. See you.
voicelines.promotion_2: You have to have seen a Draco's flames before. Ever imagined how it'd be to rain them down on the enemy? I... can make that your reality!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm listening.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Work's on. Focus.
voicelines.depart: You lot go ahead. I've got things to prepare.
voicelines.begin_operation: Visibility clear. Awaiting orders.
voicelines.in_battle_1: I don't need visuals. Give me the map.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Nothing remains after it rains arrows!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Hah! Why would fire go out before burning everything up?
voicelines.4-star_result: Not that many people can make this thing shine—I guess you're one of them.
voicelines.3-star_result: Out without too much ash on me. Good.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Ammo's more precious than that little lot. Deal with 'em yourself.
voicelines.operation_failure: Still good to move? We're heading home. Grab on.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Like this titchy bit of space is enough? Let's break this wall down and I'll have the whole area behind, thanks.
voicelines.tap: Think it through before you put your hand out.
voicelines.trust_tap: Go on if you need something. No point in waiting for me to switch my contacts.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: So it's you. If you need something, out with it.

name: Heavyrain
biography: Formerly a soldier under the wings of a previous Lord Ameer of Sargon, Heavyrain left its army after the betrayal of an ally has left her disillusioned, eventually making her way to Rhodes Island.A seasoned combat veteran, she is currently active in a variety of missions as a defender operator.
description: Defender Operator Heavyrain, uncomplaining and diligent.
quote: She's got a lot she wants to say, just no idea how to say it.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Yes, I'll protect the Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: I may sit down? No, I mustn't. I'm a bodyguard. As a bodyguard, I must protect my target no matter the time and circumstance... Am I perhaps being a bother, standing here next to you?
voicelines.talk_2: I've met Spot before... Oh, no, the squad I was a part of traveled through a city he was stationed in, and he gave me a hand then. He most likely doesn't remember. It's okay.
voicelines.talk_3: (I'm not sure what the Doctor is doing, but that looks so amazing...) Eh? Uh... I-I didn't say anything. You misheard, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, you mentioned this just now, so I thought I'd bring you some. Umm, I'm not doing anything unnecessary, right?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctor, I'm so sorry. I rushed ahead by myself on my last mission... I noticed somebody was wounded, and it felt like the blood in my head just started to boil. I forgot your order and ran straight to her. I didn't mean to do that. P-Please don't hate me...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Umm, Doctor, were you looking for me...? No, I wasn't trying to hide from you, and I definitely don't hate you... It's just that... Sorry, I'm not sure how to explain...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: When I was in the Sargon army, most people didn't like me, but there was one person who treated me really well. She was my best friend, but... in the end... she betrayed me. Doctor, I don't know anymore. I'm not sure how to trust anyone now.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: (The Doctor is such a nice person. Everybody hates me, but he talks to me willingly. There shouldn't be any problem if I put my trust in the Doctor, right?) Oh, Doctor, I'm listening. Yes, I will always trust you. Whoever makes an enemy of you, they're making an enemy of me too!
voicelines.idle: (I kind of want to... watch the Doctor sleep.)
voicelines.onboard: (Looks like a kind person, but is this guy really going to be as easy to get along with as Amiya said...?) Uh, um, I'm sorry, I-I was spacing out. Operator codename Heavyrain, reporting in.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Yes, I should be able to reach this level too.
voicelines.promotion_1: (Amiya is here too. Am I getting fired...?) Eh? I'm getting promoted?
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, is it okay if I don't get promoted...? No, everyone is being so kind... I'm a little scared...
voicelines.added_to_squad: By your command.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll do my best!
voicelines.depart: (I mustn't betray the Doctor's high hopes...)
voicelines.begin_operation: Incoming!
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, did I do okay?
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, I can still fight.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, let me go after them.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, I'll protect you!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Rhodes Island is so big...
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor?! Please don't scare me...!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, can I assist you in any way?

name: Frost
biography: One of the members of Team Rainbow, Frost is a firm, focused and energetic individual adept at combat in outdoor environments.She mainly uses modified mechanical traps named 'Welcome Mats.' Through strategic placement, they can obstruct the enemy and provide tactical support to the entire team.
description: Frost, a member of Team Rainbow, has already deployed her Welcome Mats.
quote: This congenial hunter always has things planned out even for the most haphazard of guests.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Here's the schedule. You'll also need to review the weekly reports, expense records, and meeting agendas. Which do you want to do first?
voicelines.talk_1: We'll overcome any obstacle as long as we work together.
voicelines.talk_2: Excuse me, sir, but do you mind if I tidy up the bookshelf?
voicelines.talk_3: Sometimes humans behave exactly like wild animals. Understanding this makes me a more efficient operator.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: To see the really interesting things, you have to get out of the city. That's why I'm always so far away.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Putting out the Welcome Mat is the first step. Luring the prey takes a bit more doing.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: No, no. This is all wrong. Let me reconsider for a bit.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Is there anything I can help with?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Who's the hunter? Who's the hunted? That's up to Mother Nature and the battlefield in question.
voicelines.idle: Simply pull this string and there's the Welcome Mat...
voicelines.onboard: RAINBOW Operator, codename Frost. At your service, sir.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I've got a good idea.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you for your trust, sir.
voicelines.promotion_2: There are two things we absolutely need in a survival situation: water and hope.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Let's work together.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't forget, we're a team and we have a plan.
voicelines.depart: Time for all the planning to pay off.
voicelines.begin_operation: I've got eyes on the hostiles.
voicelines.deployment_1: Don't let them get the drop on you.
voicelines.4-star_result: Stay two steps ahead of the enemy at all times.
voicelines.3-star_result: Always think ahead.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Maintain a perimeter.
voicelines.operation_failure: Administering aid. Friendly injured.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This isn't so bad.
voicelines.trust_tap: Come along, join our hunt.

name: Blitz
biography: Blitz is a member of Team Rainbow. Humorous and good-natured, he specializes in indoor and urban thoroughfare combat settings.His primary weapons are a handgun and a modified G52-Tactical Light Shield. The latter can be operated when in close quarters to blind all targets within a few meters, conferring a tactical advantage to his entire team.
description: Blitz, a member of Team Rainbow, wields a charged-and-ready tactical shield.
quote: Considering how most enemies we deal with have eyes, a blinded enemy is the best enemy.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Instead of sitting here, why don't we walk out together?
voicelines.talk_1: I'm in the starting lineup for next week's football match. Come watch the game!
voicelines.talk_2: If you know how we can improve my G52 Tactical Shield, please submit a test application. I'll be there anytime.
voicelines.talk_3: Ease up, there's nothing to be nervous about. Should I invite Tachanka to dance a little ballet for you?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The doctors don't test me because I'm sick. They test me because I'm too healthy. Good thing I'm not afraid of needles!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Flash! Bash! Kapow! That's all you need to know.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Not only am I sweet, but I've got a great sense of humor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: If you find something interesting to play with, count me in.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: We have a responsibility to look after one another. I take that very seriously.
voicelines.idle: This is really interesting, but not to me.
voicelines.onboard: RAINBOW Operator, codename Blitz. Give the order and I'll bash 'em in the face with my shield!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This is pretty good. The popcorn, I mean. Want some?
voicelines.promotion_1: Medals, awards, promotions. They go really well with my shield, don't you think?
voicelines.promotion_2: I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Should we go get the bad guys maybe? Just a suggestion.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Remember: point your guns at the bad guys.
voicelines.depart: Let's look alive out here.
voicelines.begin_operation: Bad guys in our way!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Do think I have time to use the bathroom?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: If anyone needs to sneeze, do it now.
voicelines.4-star_result: Are we good? Can we go home now?
voicelines.3-star_result: Everything will be fine, I'm here after all.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Am I going to need to save all your asses again?
voicelines.operation_failure: Dammit, did anyone remember to bring the ammo?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's go say hello to our neighbors first.
voicelines.trust_tap: You should invite me over for dinner. We are friends, after all.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Tachanka
biography: Tachanka is a member of Team Rainbow. He is tenacious, candid, calm-minded, and excels at positional warfare.His primary weapons are a modified DP-27 machine gun and the Shumikha Grenade Launcher. As the main firepower for his team, Tachanka is an undisputed master of the battlefield.
description: Tachanka, a member of Team Rainbow, is ready to lay down suppressive fire.
quote: If the machine gun still isn't enough firepower, just launch some grenades into the mix.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If you invited me, you must not be looking for a tactician.
voicelines.talk_1: I love my country, for better or for worse.
voicelines.talk_2: Have you met my sister? She's the one in the white coat in the photo, and those are her children.
voicelines.talk_3: Survive. Be a leader. You don't want your loved ones crying over your grave, do you?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I don't want my kids to follow in my footsteps. Being a soldier is too dangerous.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: In my country, focusing firepower on a target is considered a simple and effective way to achieve victory.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I like the way you think.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Personally, I prefer the enemies come to us in search of death. How about you?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Relax, baby. When this is all over, I'll buy you some vodka.
voicelines.idle: Are you bored? Why not clean your weapon?
voicelines.onboard: RAINBOW Operator, codename Tachanka. I'm ready. Where do you want me?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: First, we learn about them. Then we outsmart them.
voicelines.promotion_1: Good.
voicelines.promotion_2: They told me I'd died. They were wrong. I was reborn.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yes, yes. I know.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Just don't play hero, it never works.
voicelines.depart: Stay right with me!
voicelines.begin_operation: Hostiles in sight.
voicelines.deployment_1: Guys, you are all lucky I was there.
voicelines.4-star_result: That was unexpected.
voicelines.3-star_result: I've seen it all.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We're not out of the woods, bratan.
voicelines.operation_failure: Protect the doctor!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Not a problem.
voicelines.trust_tap: Call me in for support if you need it.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Mr. Nothing
biography: Mr. Nothing, a man of Kou-wu City, Yan. Learned martial arts from a young age. Became quite skilled, but was forced into exile after offending local powers. Came across Rhodes Island Operator Lava, and upon reaching a mutual understanding, he sought a post at Rhodes Island.
description: The Yan martial artist, Mr. Nothing, holds back from scarpering and stands guard on the battlefield.
quote: He's armed with a parasol, a fan and a mouth. Who can say if he has anything else on him too?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hm. The office of the vaunted Doctor, then? Marvelous, truly. Allow me a brief moment to consult my feng shui crash-course guidebook...
voicelines.talk_1: I'm no mere braggart! Beyond a little kickboxing in a scuffle, I can rustle up meals, practice acupuncture, divine with feng shui, work masonry, tend to rice and angle fish alike—I'm a maestro of all kinds! Doctor, you need only give the order, and I'll see everything through!
voicelines.talk_2: D-Doctor, I was a little idle, see, and went to make myself useful at HR, and by carelessness glimpsed at a few operator files, and... er, well, could FEater be the very star of 'Fiends of the Gods Reincarnated Immortal' herself? Truly? Could I go get an autograph?
voicelines.talk_3: Who was my master? Hmm, a question as complex as a showdown of Yan cuisines. Normally I'd refrain from answering that, as slipping up would get me beaten sideways. That said... you need only know, Doctor, I'm the last descendant of the Lien line. Ah, but my family name's not Lien. I'm a Ch'u.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: M-Miss Dusk really did... come to Rhodes Island with us, then? My, um... what was it now? My recollection's quite fuzzy now, yet I have the vague impression that within her painted dreams, I had a peek into my own miserable future. Ah, let's never we mind. Dear, oh, dear. You be quite careful too, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Now, now, Doctor, don't worry about me. I and the Infected do get along well. Back at my old place, a Catastrophe once struck not too far away. It frightened all of us, seeing the world go pitch black. My master remarked then that Catastrophes were Heaven's false charge against the human realm. Ah, truly a bitter thing.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Benefactor Lava? Yes, I call her my benefactor. She once saved me, and as time went on, it became second nature. Throughout my life I've been saved thrice, and every time, I engrave it upon my soul. The gloompincer incident, you mean? No, not that. She showed to me a path, and that was true grace beyond all.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Say, Doctor, are people able to brush the past away as they live? Certainly not, hm? If the bonds you once left behind still hold fast, what ought you do? You've no idea either? Well, then. It seems we're companions in our misery. Here, what say we crack some sunflower seeds?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Countless, they were, the ancient parasol trees about Kou-wu City. Oh, just reminiscing all of a sudden. I remember the leaves scattered across the ground come fall, when my parents would visit me from the country. Only then would my strict master speak nothing but good, and her other disciples, my brothers and sisters, wouldn't bully me. No, well, just reminiscing.
voicelines.idle: Hmm. I've been pondering a fan for you too, but what ought we write on it?
voicelines.onboard: My codename? 'Mr. Nothing.' The latter man of Tzu-hsu and Wu-yu; Nonexistent and Nothing indeed. And you, fine soul, are the Doctor? That is to say, my new boss? Well, then, would you like me to massage your back? Loosen up your legs?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ho, what a hundredfold bouquet of martial prowess. You've got my eyes wide open now!
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion and a raise?! Ohh, ohh, I thank you, Doctor, in all respects possible! Be it for you, I would brave the greatest fires and waters, I would not hesitate to... well, that said, how much might my wages be growing by?
voicelines.promotion_2: Sooner or later, I plan to return to Kou-wu City and set every debt in my books straight. My only worry is I may invite trouble and sweep others up in its path. You know this, dear Doctor, and yet you still wish to bestow such partiality on me...? Your kindness toward me is a grace, and I will never, in eternity, forget it.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Very well! Doctor, I'll see to it that you have nothing at all to worry about.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Me, the captain? Hold one moment, just let me find my secret tomes for the art of war, now...
voicelines.depart: As they say, all have their own methods, whether arms against a force or earth to a waterspout. There'll be a way!
voicelines.begin_operation: I'm witnessing fiends, one and all! Quite frightening!
voicelines.deployment_1: Very well! Leave this to me.
voicelines.deployment_2: The Doctor, you are! What a sagacious decision!
voicelines.in_battle_2: A perfect technique makes freedom to act!
voicelines.in_battle_3: The moon waxes and wanes. The fan opens and shuts!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Let's have you make a move first, now.
voicelines.4-star_result: More hands bring more fuel for the fire. When we concert our efforts together, yes, we truly can burn the sky a red to rival sunsets. Not bad, not bad.
voicelines.3-star_result: As they say, those of just ways have much support, and those of lost ways find little. Seen as such, our victory is assured.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Pursue not the cornered. Suppose anything troublesome should happen, we'll just bear it together.
voicelines.operation_failure: Go on ahead, everyone. No worries. My runaway act is first in class. I'll be just fine.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Oh-hoh, Rhodes Island truly is a wondrous land. I feel quite dizzy just looking.
voicelines.tap: Hoh? What's this for exactly, Doctor?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, what say I teach you a thing or two about some moves?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Well, if it isn't the Doctor! What a happy coincidence!

name: Lava the Purgatory
biography: Born in Londinium, Victoria, Lava is the younger twin sister of her fellow Operator, Hibiscus. It has been a few years since she contracted Oripathy and came to Rhodes Island for treatment. She has remained ever diligent during her time in Rhodes Island and never wasted even a moment in her quest to hone her Originium Arts prowess.
description: Rhodes Island Caster Operator, Lava the Purgatory, skillfully creates space for you with her outstanding Originium Arts.
quote: Her Arts have grown immensely stronger since when she was fresh aboard Rhodes Island.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I have some free time, so I guess I could help you out... What's this? This has got nothing to do with disasters and Arts, just some normal paperwork? Hey!
voicelines.talk_1: You wanna try some fortune-telling? Well, that brings me back. I haven't done it for a while. I could take a look at your fortune to kill some time, I guess. Hmm, if your luck isn't beyond words as always... Well, you're gonna have to prove my results wrong.
voicelines.talk_2: I do research on Arts because it's part of my responsibilities as a Caster. If I can't even do that, how am I supposed to protect those who... Huh? You got sweets? For me? Uh, thanks...
voicelines.talk_3: Hibiscus... My sister always helps people whenever they need, even if it's not part of her mission. It's like she's not a Sarkaz at all, what with how kind she is. She treats this world with kindness, but how many people know to repay it?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Why I'm not into fortune telling anymore? 'cause the fear and curiosity that people have about the future usually has to do with natural phenomena. That, and I've realized the results you get with fortune telling don't really mean much, having come face to face with so many cruelties.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: In terms of performance, books and staffs are just about the same as Arts conductors. If you ask me, I think knives are much more practical. When you run short of your Arts and have to throw yourself into a melee, or you're out in the wilderness, just trying to survive, all those words in the books aren't going to do you much good.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: It's a pain to fight as a team, but when I look back on those times I fought side by side with my Reserve Ops teammates now... It brings back memories, I guess. If I get the chance to fight alongside them again... No, never mind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I wasn't that grumpy and curt now, was I? How come Hibiscus still treats me like a kid who hasn't grown up yet? It's like she's doing it to pick on me! We finally managed to make up, but it just ticks me off when I see her act so calm about it!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The times we live in are so messed up, there's just way too much malevolence going around in this world. We have to change that. I can't stand all those rotten hypocrites acting all kindhearted treating my fellow Sarkaz like that... just because of who we are.
voicelines.idle: Sheesh... You always look so peaceful in your sleep.
voicelines.onboard: Hey, what's the big idea? Who let you come in without knock—Oh, it's you, Doctor. Why am I wearing this? Well... I'm hitting the training grounds to test my limits once more. Wanna come watch, Doctor?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I got it all down.
voicelines.promotion_1: There are lots of talented Casters out there, but I'm not so lucky. That's why I have to get stronger if I want to be able to save the world. Thanks for helping me out, Doctor.
voicelines.promotion_2: I've got the hang of fire Arts now. If I keep working on this, I might just make it to the boundaries of modern Arts theory... I might even be able to manipulate space and matter.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I've got a good idea of the enemy's weaknesses. Let's go.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm not good at this kinda stuff... Just gotta get this over with quickly, right?
voicelines.depart: I'm counting on you to have my back while I take care of the enemies.
voicelines.begin_operation: You've strayed from the path of righteousness. Your sinful souls deserve no mercy.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Too weak. There's no point in hiding!
voicelines.4-star_result: It's only by overcoming challenges that we manage to accomplish something.
voicelines.3-star_result: Hmph... Accept your defeat in pain and fear. Evil will always be defeated.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: This shows how powerful we are now. It's far from enough, though. I know I can do better than this. I have to do better.
voicelines.operation_failure: Gah... I gotta... eradicate all evil...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I still have lots to do. Let me stay here.
voicelines.trust_tap: I'm reading. There's still a lot I need to learn... It's time for tea already? Let's get going, then.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Tuye
biography: Former trading company employee, responsible for logistical technology R&D along with transport route planning. Unfortunately infected with Oripathy due to an incident in a sandstorm during the course of her work. Holds a post at the Rhodes Island Medical Department on introduction from her previous employer, simultaneously undergoing necessary treatment for Oripathy.
description: Medic Operator Tuye, a Forte most unlike a Forte.
quote: Avoid touching the device on her back or that umbrella of hers, else you'll be spending quite some time scrubbing your face out.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You want me on work this boring thing...? Fine, fine. You're interesting enough to me. I'll go along with you.
voicelines.talk_1: If you want something moved, don't ask me. I'm not that brand of Forte.
voicelines.talk_2: This is some insanely precise instrument... huh? What, familiar sight? Huhhh. Oh, right. If that Mayer person comes 'round, don't tell her I'm here.
voicelines.talk_3: Never seen the equipment on my back before? Right, come over, put your hand here... keh-ka-hahahahahah! Look at your dumb face! You wanna know what just came out? It's water! And what's mixed in? Heh. You don't get to know.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My interest in helping others is zip. But higher efficiency is good for everybody.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Battles finish up faster now. Good to know, I guess.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Cake? Soft and squishy—not my speed. But. Mmp, mmnm... the umeboshi on top's not bad, sure.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: No rain in the ship? Wow. Like I don't know that? Now try and predict how it goes down out there. Next time there's a storm, just try it, get a little closer. Bet you won't stop thanking me then.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Oi. How does a day trip in the desert sound? I'll take you. I mean, anywhere else is fine too. As long as we have my multifunction jetpack, following the scent of the wind... heh. You must be dumb happy, having a guide as stellar as me.
voicelines.idle: You out cold? Then let me just try this. Harder flow, greater spray area... And you get no right to complain.
voicelines.onboard: You the Doctor? They all say you're the one here who knows more than the rest. You're gonna let me figure that out.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Combat's just like crossing the desert, where experience means nothing. Your only need is survival instincts.
voicelines.promotion_1: Doesn't this Elite Medal have any other kind of function? No fun there.
voicelines.promotion_2: Medical pro? It's a weird world where I get called that. Anyway, it's all about getting my jobs done, either way, right?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Out for field work again? Fine, fine. You're helping me test new equipment when we get back.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Leading team combat doesn't differ much from being a guide.
voicelines.depart: Route, OK. Equipment, check. Go.
voicelines.begin_operation: More boring than running into a sandstorm.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Time to test my upgraded equipment.
voicelines.in_battle_3: How's the newest nutritional fluid taste?
voicelines.4-star_result: Tch. The sandstorms I've seen beat this any day.
voicelines.3-star_result: Scraped through, huh. Wasn't a waste of time.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Efficiency lacking. Gotta head back and adjust my equipment, or switch reagents, maybe.
voicelines.operation_failure: At least you figured a good retreat route...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: You have a lot of rooms, huh...
voicelines.tap: You gotta stop the boring crap.
voicelines.trust_tap: Wanna try touching my bag again? Won't hit your face this time. Promise.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Rain again. Good weather, huh, Doctor?

name: Iris
biography: A Victorian Caster who came to Rhodes Island to return a certain Operator's safekept items, temporarily residing at Rhodes Island until all related matters are dealt with.Uses peculiar Originium Arts, able to induce sleep in people and control the contents of their dreams.
description: Master of the Castle Iris, giving her utmost to grant all children sweet dreams.
quote: As a spinner of dreams, perhaps she's the one who most believes.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: What? You think this work is going to do itself? Hmph! There's no such fairy who'd finish somebody's work off while they go dozing off. Forget your wild ideas and get your nose to the grindstone, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: I and my companions will often receive children who come to the castle. Of course, on occasion we'll have a good and honest adult come lodging, but that sort of person is few and far between.
voicelines.talk_2: I came to find a girl named Mabel. Ah, twenty years ago she was a girl. She's a woman by now. ...Codename? How would I know what her codename is? But I know for certain she's here, without a doubt!
voicelines.talk_3: If there's nothing to keep us, then let me take my leave. I'm still quite busy. I have an appointment with the children being treated here, and I'll be telling them stories today.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Children are much better off compared to adults. Children are much more innocent. They have fine qualities. They are the most valuable, cherished thing upon this world.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: A beloved rag doll, a pretty flower, a storybook turned until its pages are worn... Children who've come to Wonderland have left much to the castle. Things they believe are precious, that they haven't much way of keeping safe themselves, all can be put into our care.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Now come wisplight and lamplight, come light up the way~ Come to our little tea party to stay~♪ Here come the guards, and they dance and sing for us, carrying scissors to chop-chop away♪ I sang this song about my friends to entertain the children with me. Learned the words? I shan't sing them to you again.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I know. Mabel's no longer with us. You called her Bluishsilver, didn't you? I've seen records... asked after her with her teammates—her tale is so sad. How strange. Though this is the time we'd set, I can't help but feel I was too late...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: 'Wonderland,' 'Slumberland,' 'the Cradle'... have you never heard these names before? Oh, you poor soul. Had no-one ever told you any bedtime stories? ...Sigh. Oh, I suppose. Close your eyes, now. I'd rather not, but let's have you see for yourself, just once.
voicelines.idle: Oh, really! How do you fall asleep somewhere like this? And the files are all still at sixes and sevens! ...Fine. Seeing that you work so hard normally, I'll help you just this once...
voicelines.onboard: I am Iris, Master of the Castle of Dreams, Keeper of the Cradle. As per our agreement, I've come to return something a guest once left to the castle... How strange. Why can I not find her?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: How barbarous, though it does have its merits.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm the master of a castle. If we're to talk promotions, I ought to be giving one to you.
voicelines.promotion_2: Right, then! You'll see first-hand the full power of the Master of the Castle! Fairytales uphold such purity, such beauty, and they owe it only to their protectors' sufficient strength. Is Rhodes Island not like this, too?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Oh, fine, I suppose.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Listen to my orders, now. Agreements made are not to be violated.
voicelines.depart: I will lead you all to the proper place.
voicelines.begin_operation: And those are the people we're driving off, then?
voicelines.deployment_1: The air is quite thick here.
voicelines.deployment_2: Hmph! I'll help you just this once.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Would you all like a bedtime story too?
voicelines.4-star_result: How's that? I've driven them all off, now!
voicelines.3-star_result: So this is the taste of victory. Yet... I wonder why I can't feel happy about it...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hmph. They've run off by themselves. Doesn't that sort things?
voicelines.operation_failure: What's going on? Did you fall asleep?! Quick, with me, out of here!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What a strange place. Is there no larger bed anywhere?
voicelines.trust_tap: Careful, there, don't ruffle the headdress... yes, quite, comb just like that...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Robin
biography: Former Columbian bodyguard, passed examination and joined Rhodes Island on Operator Silence's referral.Expert at remote lethality in coordination with homemade traps. Presently active in the gamut of missions as a Specialist Operator.
description: Specialist Operator Robin, a city girl.
quote: Sometimes she'll mimic moves from the movies.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor. Should I help with anything?
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor. You always seem busy with work. Don't you have any hobbies? Me, I like seeing old movies people don't really remember.
voicelines.talk_2: Truthfully, I learned how to fight because of this movie I saw when I was young. Main character used all these knives and homemade traps, and I thought it was really cool, so I started learning myself. My knives here, they're actually the same kind as the ones in that movie.
voicelines.talk_3: In Columbia, anything can be bought with money. It sounds great, maybe, until you turn it around. Without money, nothing's yours at all.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Rhodes Island feels just like a company in a movie. Medical corp on the outside, actually a private military underneath. Operating to save more and more people... feels pretty cool.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctor, do you think I come off gloomy to others? ...Uh, I didn't used to be like this. It was ever since my pop got the way he did, and I had to start worrying about keeping the family afloat. *Sigh*...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I don't hate Anthony. If we have to talk about the past, I think my pop's to blame too. And honestly, I thank Anthony. If he weren't where he was, I might've done something by now I could never take back.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Pop never understood. Mom didn't leave because we had no money. It was 'cause his temper got worse every day. I've thought about if I went with Mom instead, but Pop used to be... so nice to me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, there's times I'm following you, and I ease up so much I forget my own stuff. I have the money for treating my pop's illness now, but he's got troubles, and I can't cure that just on my own... Doctor, could you help me?
voicelines.idle: So you drop right where you are when you're tired too, Doctor...
voicelines.onboard: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm a new Operator. Robin's the name. I've got money issues, so if it's okay with you, you can send me to do whatever.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Intense. Feels just like I'm watching an action movie...
voicelines.promotion_1: Huh? I got a raise so quick...? That's great. Thank you, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_2: I never stuck with my old jobs for very long. The company itself had problems, or it was something with my pop... This time, it feels like I'll be able to stick with Rhodes Island.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave it to me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm not too good at figuring teamwork...
voicelines.depart: Wonder what kind of place we're going this time.
voicelines.begin_operation: Status check, first...
voicelines.in_battle_4: I'm wielding more than knives here!
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, can we cut this sort of mission down a little? Bad for the heart...
voicelines.3-star_result: I bet everybody dreams of having a boss like you, Doctor.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, need me to chase them?
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, you go! I'll cover you!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's get to know this place, then.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor. Taking a walk?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor. Need me to guard you today?

name: Kafka
biography: Former gardener from a Columbian city, joined Rhodes Island on Silence's referral.Robustly talented, keen-witted, and ever lively no matter the secret mission she's on.
description: Gardener Kafka, with a skip and a hop.
quote: When she laughs, something wicked this way comes.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You give Kafka the work that needs doing, Doctor, and then I pass it all on... okay. This's just like how underground work goes!
voicelines.talk_1: Seeing as you're my friend now, Doctor, you can ask me for anything. Uh, apart from lending you my shears.
voicelines.talk_2: Rhodes Island's fulla people I never met before. Everywhere I go, I see what I wants. Hm? You're wonderin' WHAT it is I want? Thaaat's a secret, y'know. Seee-cret.
voicelines.talk_3: Hmm... still can't read your eyes. They're calm as a lake... but there'll come a day when I get your number, Doctor, just you wait!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctooor, Silence kicked me out againnn, I just can't take it, sob, sob... huh? I started it by messing up her experiment? Hmm, Silence got to you first... eh-hem, well, I'm just gonna go now!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Well, until I can get what I want, I guess I'll lend you a hand. Just lending it, though, okay?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Story goes, I used to live in a real baaad place, dealing with bad people almost everyday. Then ever since I came here, everyone's been nice with me, givin' me snacks and all! Mm-hm, that's why I like it here at Rhodes Island!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: ...Y'know the secrets everyone tries their best to hide? They're like monsters, hidden in the dead shadows, waitin' for their chance. Beautiful... and dangerous. That's exactly why I do my darndest to collect them! Doctor, don't you got anything for my hoard?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, if you've ever got a problem, we can always call my 'friends' from Columbia in to help... though you don't really gotta. One Kafka'll sort out all your troubles head to tail!
voicelines.idle: Bet you think I'm goofing off right now, Doctor. But I aiiin't~
voicelines.onboard: What did you need me for...? Wait, not in front of everybody! Just treat me like a normal gardener, okay?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Just gotta figure what they're aiming for, and I can draw up some counterplans. C'mon, ain't I a wiz?
voicelines.promotion_1: Seeing as you really need my power, Doctor, just c'mon and say it. Be like Kafka here, all serious and open, yeah?
voicelines.promotion_2: Gardenin' or fightin', I didn't start doing either for compliments. But having my own efforts get noticed by you and the rest, well, that makes a Kafka real happy.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Wonder what we can harvest this time?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Just leave it to me. I guarantee you're all in for a fun time!
voicelines.depart: Ah, thinkin' sucks... I guess I'll be listenin' to you, Doctor.
voicelines.begin_operation: Look at all these naughty li'l saplings. Ain'tcha cute... sit tight and Kafka'll trim ya up~
voicelines.in_battle_1: Watch your eyes... I see all your weakpoints in 'em.
voicelines.in_battle_2: You're all just hedges who know how to walk~
voicelines.in_battle_4: Kafka knows you're scared. Tremblin' li'l bare branches.
voicelines.4-star_result: Smooth sailin' just like always, Doctor. Alright, makes a Kafka wanna go get 'em!
voicelines.3-star_result: Man, were those enemies pushovers. If I'd known sooner, I woulda messed with 'em some.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hmm, guess I gotta be more careful with the pruning next time.
voicelines.operation_failure: So I guess I couldn't read their plans in the end, huh.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Where's Silence's lab, again?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, Kafka here wants to deck out your office with some bonsai. Don'tcha worry, I'll make 'em look real good~
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: What work you got for me today, Doctor?

name: Amiya (Guard)
biography: Not provided
description: Amiya, leader of Rhodes Island, will fight alongside you.
quote: Keep fighting, Doctor.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, what's wrong? Oh, I'm fine, just a little tired. Please check these two files in a moment. A lot of new Operators have joined Rhodes Island, and we can't disappoint them.
voicelines.talk_1: Rhodes Island and this land at large have already lost so much. We will put a stop to it... Rage may destroy us, but when confronting malice, ever more people have no other choice. Until the land finds peace, no one will be able to extinguish this fury.
voicelines.talk_2: My rings look different? I couldn't hide it from you, Doctor... You're right, one of them broke. But it's okay, Dr. Kal'tsit helped me switch it for a new one. Did... that have something to do with when I blacked out, you ask? Doctor...
voicelines.talk_3: In this whole operation, we gained no commercial profit at all, and we gave so much... But there are many things you can't weigh in terms of business value. Rhodes Island was never a company born exclusively for profit, and this land needs more than just physical medications.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Chernobog's Reunion... it's over, and is there any more point to denouncing what they've done? Think of the people who trampled them, abused them, massacred them... hatred breeds hatred. That was something that should've never happened in the first place.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Once, there was a Sarkaz betrayed, who walked this land bent on vengeance, only to cast his own life into the cycle of revenge. What I can't understand is, he'd already settled on his own end before he drew his sword. In his rage… he settled on death, with a clear mind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Death should be carved into our memories, never to be forgotten, no matter who brought that death about, nor who was brought to. Our mistakes will never be right... those scars should always remind us, warn us how frail we are.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Even now, they still sometimes come to mind. Misha's gaze, FrostNova's roars, Patriot's cries... Ace, Scout, and so many operators sacrificed their lives for a single belief. But the Infected all across Terra—what is it that they've died for?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor... recently... have I been a little less like myself? The nameless anger that rises up, time and again... is that mine? If so... no, even if so, I won't give up. I will protect you, Doctor, by this sword.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, are you okay? Do you need to rest a little? I'll help carry you. Don't worry, I'm doing fine. So long as you're rested.
voicelines.onboard: Doctor, it's so good to see you. My appearance? Um, please don't be afraid... I can explain this. But don't worry, Doctor. Whatever happens, I won't ever let you come to harm. I swear it.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: 'If the fight is unavoidable...' This is what the person I most trusted once taught me.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I shoulder the wrath of so many others.
voicelines.depart: Operation commencing. Let's go!
voicelines.begin_operation: Incoming! Ready, all members!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: This sword thirsts for revenge... I won't permit it.
voicelines.deployment_1: My sword is cloaked in Chi Xiao's shadow.
voicelines.deployment_2: Madam Ch'en's swordsmanship... flows within this weapon.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Your thought, your Arts, I can cut them.
voicelines.in_battle_3: 'With what do I answer your failure of justice?'
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, thank you for always supporting me. Our battles will only get harder from here, but we can't give up.
voicelines.3-star_result: How long do we fight? How long until the flames of anger on this land die down...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, good job. Let me handle the clean-up.
voicelines.operation_failure: ...What happened? This shouldn't have...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Phew... we can take a little breather now, right?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, could you... hear me out for a bit? Is that okay?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
