name: Astesia
biography: Astesia is a member of a Columbian occult organization, serving as a philology consultant for Rhine Lab as part of a cooperation agreement. After contracting Oripathy, she and her sister came to Rhodes Island for treatment, where she qualified to become an operator. She uses unique sword skills to execute close range Arts attacks.
description: Astesia, Guard of Rhodes Island, has summoned the power of the stars to hold the line.
quote: She is the boundless starry skies, as well as your personal alarm clock.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I drew up the work schedule for you. Please kindly follow.
voicelines.talk_1: How to make a celestial globe is a secret, but as we know, anything can be on the table for a fair price. I'd be happy to reveal my trick of the trade as long as your price is right.
voicelines.talk_2: Observing the stars everyday makes my neck sore. Wonder if the medics would have any suggestions for that... What, Miss. Warfarin is the physician on duty today? Um... I'll check again another day.
voicelines.talk_3: Astrology is learning about the present and the future from celestial alignments. It's not quite divination, but with the same result. So, would you like to give it a try, Doctor? It's free of charge!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: 'Similar genes, among blood relatives, causes, uh, reverberations of Originium...' I can barely understand a word in this work of an occultist. Doctor, Can you interpret the medical report for me?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Ever since my Oripathic infection, the stars have diminished their responses to me. I must find a way to reverse it before I lose all my power. Otherwise I'l… Could you help me, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You want to know more about the organization I'm with? Sorry, I took an oath not to divulge anything, and it's not for public knowledge, anyway. If you're curious, just think of it as a completely neutral community.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Sometimes, I envy Astgenne... Ah, guess I should call her Elena now. She has everything I'm missing... But like you said, Doctor, we relied on each other because we complement each other, that's why we're sisters.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: As the nights bid us farewell, so do the starlights fade and quell. If this is the end that awaits us ahead, I should be picking up something more meaningful to do. Such as? Umm... Doctor, do you mind me waking you up every morning?
voicelines.idle: The tea's ready, Doctor. Time for a little break.
voicelines.onboard: Astesia, astrologer, reporting for guard duty. I'm yours to command, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: No report after viewing?
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion medal? How exquisite. I'll treasure it well.
voicelines.promotion_2: Stars shine bright, bearing witness of our past nights.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm over here, Doctor.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Let me be the guiding star for all.
voicelines.depart: There's no turning back now.
voicelines.begin_operation: The stars will light our way.
voicelines.deployment_1: Don't panic, Astesia. Do it like you usually do.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Lend me your wings, avians among the stars!
voicelines.in_battle_3: The serpent has brought about your end.
voicelines.in_battle_4: The light of stars shall be my blade!
voicelines.4-star_result: So this is 'our' power, a power even the stars failed to foresee...
voicelines.3-star_result: Fantastic results, Doctor. But don't overwork yourself, be sure to rest up well.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: If I put in more effort, maybe the outcome could be better…
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm dead on my feet... but it's not time to quit yet
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let me see... Yes, the layout's good. The furniture won't attract any unwanted spirits this way.
voicelines.trust_tap: W-What's that... something on my face?

name: Glaucus
biography: Glaucus was born in the Ægir Region, but left at an early age to wander about. By chance, she happened to join Rhodes Island and is now a Raythean cutting-edge weapon tester.In addition to performing research on cutting-edge weapon modification, Glaucus also carries out assaults on air missions when required.
description: Glaucus, weapon reviewer of Raythean, is ready to take down enemy machines with the latest technology.
quote: Please keep the receipt for that portable communication device.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'll be quiet modifying the Raythean Franker close by... I won't disturb you, I promise.
voicelines.talk_1: Why does everyone always keep their distance from Blue Poison? Am I missing something...? All right.
voicelines.talk_2: Anything you would like to say, Doctor? No? Well, anyway, I'm here.
voicelines.talk_3: No one in a hot dorm is going to have any appetite... Oh, it's a family thing, I'm not actually complaining.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Why would I leave home to come here if I can't even run free?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: While Vulcan doesn't appreciate 'old things' like me, I still feel we have different fundamental philosophies.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: So, Doctor, Blue Poison said I always seem to be hiding something. Do I? Occasionally? No way...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: It's not I don't want to talk, it's just that I seldom had the right to in the past, so I got used to not speaking up! Hope you won't take it the wrong way, {@nickname}.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Two memories stand out to me. One is the wide-open, splendid scenery I saw the first time I ran with the child. For the other, I'll say right here, right now on Rhodes Island.
voicelines.idle: Hey, when did the Doctor fall asleep...?
voicelines.onboard: Operator Glaucus reporting. May I go back to my room now?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Huh? Yes, I see. Got it.
voicelines.promotion_1: I named the weapon, actually. Maybe that's what I really think... What, did they just announce my name for promotion?
voicelines.promotion_2: Trust...? Well, I don't know how to show it, but I'll keep trying.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Have the members followed the proper landing procedure?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: What? I'm the captain? Did I agree without realizing it?
voicelines.depart: What interesting thing will we pick up this time?
voicelines.begin_operation: EMP field ready.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Fully charged and ready to go.
voicelines.deployment_2: Don't worry, it's a successful landing.
voicelines.4-star_result: Enemy silent. Please check damage on yourself.
voicelines.3-star_result: All units silent, EMP field canceled. Nice work, everyone.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Did some enemy escape? Aren't we pursuing?
voicelines.operation_failure: EMP field is canceled. Call for backup, quickly!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: No problem, as soon as I find that screw first...
voicelines.trust_tap: Mind taking a walk with me, Doctor?

biography: Swire, Senior Superintendent of the Lungmen Guard Department.Now a special attache at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command.
description: Swire, Guard Operator from Lungmen, will provide professional police assistance and extra training for you.
quote: Sure enough, the pride of Lungmen comes from the prosperity of its commerce, trades and capital flows!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!
voicelines.talk_1: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!
voicelines.talk_2: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...
voicelines.talk_3: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!
voicelines.idle: Uughh... I'm exhausted... Two shifts in a row really does... zzz... zzz...
voicelines.onboard: Swire, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.. I'll be joining Rhodes Island as a training consultant. Dr. {@nickname}, I'm looking forward to working together with you for the future of Lungmen!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hmm, as far as tactical theory goes, this is a decent application!
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Hmm? But it doesn't do anything for me back in Lungmen, does it? Well, if you insist, I suppose I will accept it!
voicelines.promotion_2: Maybe it's that you want me to improve your relationship with Lungmen. Or, possibly, you truly need my talents. I suppose it could be something else you want, too... I'm not sure exactly what, and I can't promise it'll be on offer. But I'll be a stalwart with you to the end.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Aha~! You finally need my wisdom!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everyone, follow my orders to the letter!
voicelines.depart: Wipe them out in one fell swoop! It's cheaper that way!
voicelines.begin_operation: Let's finish this quickly. My time is far too precious!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I've seen through the enemy's strategies!
voicelines.deployment_1: This is far from my only battlefield!
voicelines.deployment_2: Business competitor or not, you will get a lesson from me!
voicelines.4-star_result: Fantastic! In battle as in business: high risk, high return!
voicelines.3-star_result: Capital is all mergers and acquisitions! Victory is like investigation and arrest!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: ...Bad... just bad... You can do better, can't you? We'll work it out together. Don't give up!
voicelines.operation_failure: How could this have happened? How could I... How could I have blundered so badly?!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Not bad... No, I think this room could use some more renovation!
voicelines.trust_tap: How... How about we go for dinner together? M-my treat!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Grani
biography: Grani, formerly of the Victorian Mounted Police, specializes in high mobility operations such as raids, mechanized warfare, and infiltration. Now works as a contract Operator providing support for all Rhodes Island op teams, as well as patrols of the island and its surrounding areas.
description: Grani, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island and mounted police, will clear all obstacles in the way using her lance.
quote: She will fight to the end, for her dreams, and for you.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Reporting in, Doctor! Patrol completed. Nothing out of the ordinary!
voicelines.talk_1: I'm starving. That battle really took a lot out of me... You say you've got something to eat? Just for me? Whoa... It's… it's an apple pie! Thanks a lot! It looks great!
voicelines.talk_2: Everybody here at Rhodes Island calls me 'Tiny,' but it really doesn't bother me. The boys back on the force always teased me the same way. Hey! Don't pat my head! Or rub my ears! Or squeeze my cheek for that matter!
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor, I might not make it to training on Wednesdays or Fridays... Right, I need to be out there helping the civil corps to keep the peace and catch the bad guys! Wh-waht? I have an important mission on Friday?!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Rhodes Island has lots of strong Operators, but there's no one who can match my speed!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Time flies, Dcotor. We've been working together so long. I will never forget anything we've been through. But we can't stop now! We have to keep striving for that bright future, don't we?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I just bumped into Skadi in the hallway... Doctor, you think she's cold and distant, don't you? She's actually very kind. Really!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Compared to everyone else, I'm pretty ordinary. I don't have any superpowers, or spectacular achievements to brag about... But I don't need magic or claws to make the world a better place. I can do that with my own two hands! But before that, we still have to eat well.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, you always worry so much about your people, but you never remember to take care of yourself. You can't do that! No matter what dangers you may face, I promise I'll be there to hold your hand! Definitely, you have my word!
voicelines.idle: Hmm? Why do you smell so good, Doctor? You're definitely hiding something tasty, aren't you?!
voicelines.onboard: Mounted Police Officer Grani, here to answer your call for help! Fear not. From this point forward, I will protect you!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I see. That's another thing I should watch out for. Got it!
voicelines.promotion_1: An elite promotion medal? For me? Thank you, Doctor! I'll hang it up with my police medal!
voicelines.promotion_2: Since the day of my first mission, I've been leaning on this lance to get back on my feet. As long as I grip it tight, my heart will brim with the courage it needs to protect the people and their dreams.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Shall I go scout the battlefield?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You're making me the captain? Okay. I'll protect the whole squad!
voicelines.depart: All right, let's bring home a victory!
voicelines.begin_operation: Your crimes stop here!
voicelines.in_battle_1: My lance will clear a path!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Only one comes out on top when the lances are crossed!
voicelines.in_battle_4: My battlefield extends well above the ground!
voicelines.4-star_result: If you look to harm those under my protection, you'll have to go through me first!
voicelines.3-star_result: Nice! That was an excellent fight! You all did splendidly!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, please stay close to me. There may still be some enemies around.
voicelines.operation_failure: Damn it... I can't let myself fall here!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Anyone need help here?
voicelines.trust_tap: If we get the chance, I hope we can see the world together, Doctor.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Nightmare
biography: Gloria Rebel Pasbelletti is a Victorian operating under the code name Nightmare. Before her induction into Rhodes Island, she was a college student with two specialties: advanced medical Arts and intervention counseling. Skilled in both medical and combat Arts, she currently works in Rhodes Island's triage section. Note: She is a good candidate for Special Management. The paperwork has been signed by Lena and is effective immediately.
description: Nightmare, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide help with her Originium Arts, no matter which personality is in at the moment.
quote: I'm not quite sure who's standing in front of me.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Um, it hurts my eyes in here... Doctor, could you turn down the office lights a bit? I'm not so used to bright rooms...
voicelines.talk_1: Um, did you really bring me here to be an Operator? Not to keep a watch on me? What about that doctor, Miss Kal'tsit? What is she going to do to me...?
voicelines.talk_2: My staff was passed down to me by my father. Its magic does something called 'Evernight' to those it touches. Anyone trapped in that illusion will... have trouble waking up the next day...
voicelines.talk_3: I'm used to being alone. When I feel lonely, I'll just talk to myself. Eheh... Hmm? Is that weird?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Stare deeply into my eyes. Feeling sleepy, aren't you? Hehe... Now, wouldn't you like to do something for me? Tell me, where does Rhodes Island store all its Originium?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You called for me? Oh yes, my disease is worsening. That's because you wouldn't give me your Originium, which means now this body is gradually disintegrating... So, just what should we do, Doc-tor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Um, please let me apologize! I mean, erm, I m-might still end up saying something weird, but please don't get angry... I just have no way to control 'her'…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Say, Doctor, if I were to suddenly end you, right here, how would everyone else react...? Argh! Grgh! No! I have to stop myself from... Hehe, I really would like to see it...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, don't you get tired of it, from time to time? Your work,life, feelings, everything... What would you say to just forgetting all of it, all at once? With my power, things like that can be arranged...
voicelines.idle: Your sleeping face is so cute, it makes me want to...
voicelines.onboard: I'm Nightmare... Ah, that's a code name. My real name is Gloria. But, if you don't mind, I'd rather you call me that... I think my code name... is kind of scary...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You're making me stronger... but why...?
voicelines.promotion_1: I came here as a patient, to get treatment for my disease. But now, I'm given to understand that that doctor wants me to fight for you, doesn't she?
voicelines.promotion_2: Don't you think I'm only barely qualified for this promotion? Not that it matters—go ahead and call your shots. At this point, I'm just lucky to even be alive.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Alright, I'm coming.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I can't do this alone...
voicelines.depart: What sorts of incredible powers will you show me? I can't wait to see.
voicelines.begin_operation: So these are our enemies? Well, well, you look like fun.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Um, is there anything to eat?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Say, why don't you let me take you on?
voicelines.deployment_2: Ah, the battlefield. How I missed you.
voicelines.in_battle_4: You'll run if—if you know what's good for you.
voicelines.4-star_result: Victory... Always so refreshing.
voicelines.3-star_result: Well, sorry, but this is the end I prepared for you.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We won. What more could you ask for?
voicelines.operation_failure: What... have I done...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'll be fine in the corner...
voicelines.trust_tap: D-did I do something bad again...? J-Just, please let me apologize. I'm so, sooo sorry...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Savage
biography: Savage was originally part of Rim Billiton Mining Company's security forces. She was an exemplary agent, known for taking down hard targets and protecting key company executives. She now serves as a guard for a Rhodes Island combat squad.
description: Savage, Guard Operator of Rim Billiton, has always been thinking of doing something for you and Amiya.
quote: Whatever you do, don't get her mad.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Heheh, Dr. {@nickname}, What can I do for you today?
voicelines.talk_1: Combat missions take up most of my job, where I just havoc around with my hammer... It feels nice to get to sort files like this every once in a while.
voicelines.talk_2: When I worked for RIM Billiton, I was in charge of a lot of things: mining ores, doing geological surveys with electromagnets, all kinds of stuff. Hmm... sounds like a mouthful, right? To put it simply, I smashed what blocks the way and kept digging down!
voicelines.talk_3: Amiya has a lot on her shoulders. If only I could help share her burden a little... And perhaps yours too, Doctor. Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything you need help with!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Providing cover, trailblazing, area denial... I might not be able to literally shield my teammates like the Defender Operators, but I can still protect everyone in my own way!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Did... did I manage to keep everyone safe?... *Sign of Relief* I'm so rapt... Please, Doctor, from now on, let me stay with you and Amiya!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, want a cabbage veggie salad with mushroom pies? Yep, I made three servings! Yours, mine, and another for Amiya. She loves the pies I make!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: The running backs on the football field are unstoppable. They just keep charging forward in spite of everything, all to clear a path for their teammates. And then they just fall down and leave it to everyone else to finish the job. Isn't that sort of like what I do? It's very cool! I hope I don't have to get tackled though.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, as long as I get to stay with you and Amiya, it's enough for me. Memories belong in the past, while the future is waiting for us to color it in. Amiya and I will continue to create more memories with you in the days to come!
voicelines.idle: Doctor, seems you've got some time to spare... Then let's go get groceries for tea tonight!
voicelines.onboard: Savage, from RIM Billiton, reporting for duty! The moment I got the message from you and Amiya, I rushed right over to see what I could do. Huh? You don't remember anything? Strewth!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ooh, I see. Uh-huh… I totally understand it now!
voicelines.promotion_1: I feel a lot better taking orders from you, Doctor. I won't let you down!
voicelines.promotion_2: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter how many enemies there are, as long as you're with me, I'll smash 'em all!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Savage, in position!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everyone, follow me closely!
voicelines.depart: Begin the attack!

name: FEater
biography: A famous action movie star from Yan, FEater was forced to give up her film career after contracting Oripathy. She found a new purpose in life at Rhodes Island.
description: FEater, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will settle disputes with her excellent martial art skills.
quote: No stand-in, NO.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.
voicelines.talk_1: These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.
voicelines.talk_2: You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.
voicelines.talk_3: Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!
voicelines.idle: You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!
voicelines.onboard: You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!
voicelines.promotion_1: Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_2: This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!
voicelines.added_to_squad: All right, it's show time!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...
voicelines.depart: This is gonna be exciting!
voicelines.begin_operation: I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!
voicelines.in_battle_2: This is straight out of one of my movies!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!
voicelines.4-star_result: Wow, it's over?
voicelines.3-star_result: It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.
voicelines.operation_failure: Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Now that's stylin'!
voicelines.trust_tap: Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

name: Manticore
biography: Much of Manticore's history is unknown. It is known that prior to her employment at Rhodes Island, she had engaged in the 'removal' of certain individuals. She has excellent stealth, infiltration, and surprise attack skills.Now she serves as a special kind of Operator who provides these unique services for Rhodes Island.
description: Manticore, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will hunt down enemies silently with her scorpion tail.
quote: I'm right here!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Umm, excuse me… I've been waiting here... for two hours…
voicelines.talk_1: Sorry… I know people keep ignoring me... But... my Arts aren't to blame…
voicelines.talk_2: My Arts... make me undetectable to people... in certain environments…
voicelines.talk_3: I… I've never had any friends... S-surely no one wants a friend that… they can't even notice… right?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My tail... It curls up when I'm not fighting... So please, don't be afraid…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctor... you can leave the dangerous work to me... After all... my Arts were made for that…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: These ID tags around my neck… I collected them... I like holding onto evidence... that someone once existed...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Don't let that 'Nightmare' girl near me!... She's dangerous... My Arts don't work on her... Why…?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I… I really want to cure my Oripathy. But if it's cured... what's going to happen to my Arts?... If they're gone, will I... still be of any use...?
voicelines.idle: Doctor's ignoring me… I don't like it, hmph...
voicelines.onboard: I'm Manticore... My Arts can take out lives silently... Please don't be scared, you're not my target…
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you... I-I'm looking forward to you teaching me... more...
voicelines.promotion_1: Finally, I got a promotion... I always thought I wasn't good enough… so you didn't promote me…
voicelines.promotion_2: Did I... manage to help you? I don't have anywhere else to go... My home is here... at Rhodes Island... So please, let me protect it with you...
voicelines.added_to_squad: Okay...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Nobody will like me... as their captain...
voicelines.depart: Please don't leave me behind…
voicelines.begin_operation: Please choose tactics that make use of my Arts... even if it's something crafty and underhanded... I won't mind...
voicelines.4-star_result: Even in such terrible battles… your judgement and decisions didn't seem to waver… You're incredible, Doctor…
voicelines.3-star_result: A victory by all means... Still...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I can handle the runaways... if you wish...
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'll sit... in the corner...
voicelines.trust_tap: Thank you for paying attention to me... I know it's your job... but it still makes me happy…
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Sora
biography: For reasons unknown, this active idol is currently boarding with Penguin Logistics. After Penguin Logistics formed a partnership with Rhodes Island, Sora also became a Rhodes Island Operator.She is able to naturally channel her Originium Arts through her voice to support allies with her unique songs on the battlefield.
description: Sora, employee of Penguin Logistics, will provide all sorts of tactical support for the squad with her singing.
quote: Hope she can bring peace with songs.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Heya, Doctor! So, what are you up to? Looks like fun!
voicelines.talk_1: Are there any karaoke venues at Rhodes Island? It would be great if we had a place to sing the night away when we don't have battles to fight!
voicelines.talk_2: My duty as an idol was to make my fans happy with my songs and performances. But I'm an Operator now... what should my duty be, then?
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor, anything I can help with? Don't you underestimate me—I'm considered quite physically capable at Penguin Logistics!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Yup, my special skill is singing! Let's see, I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo! Though I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator... If only I had a more practical skill...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Ears...? Uh, I can't tell you... even if you ask Texas, she's not gonna tell you! I'll explain if I get the chance someday...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You know, Texas actually saved my life and taught me so much I never knew. Which is why... I want to stay by her side whenever I have the chance... I'm uhh, trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas today, right? If only I were as skilled as Exusiai, I could...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor! Could you teach me to use weapons? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with weapons... Huh? You're not good at fighting either?!
voicelines.idle: ...Texas, are you listening to my songs?
voicelines.onboard: Hiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Hmm...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Levely uppity!
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? You mean like debuting as a trainee idol?
voicelines.promotion_2: I feel as excited as I did during my first live performance! I'm just so happy that you trust me this much, Doctor! It's like all my hard work has paid off! ...Huh? My ears? What about them?
voicelines.added_to_squad: As a member of the squad, I'll start by learning the very basics.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: The leader? You mean like being the lead singer?
voicelines.depart: Singing on the battlefield... now that's something new!
voicelines.begin_operation: If only my songs could put an end to all this fighting...
voicelines.deployment_2: All right, let's make some noise!
voicelines.in_battle_1: Come on, we can do it!
voicelines.4-star_result: I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!
voicelines.3-star_result: Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, were you watching me?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Good job, everyone!
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm sorry... my performance wasn't good enough...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!
voicelines.trust_tap: Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

name: Istina
biography: Before the Chernobog incident, Istina was a middle school student. In school, she wrote many articles about Originium Arts. Her areas of expertise include: Arts, detective literature, and sociology.In a number of tests, she has demonstrated an excellent aptitude for control-type Originium Arts. She has been approved for service in battle. She also provides intel and data processing services for Rhodes Island.
description: Istina, member of Ursus Student Self-Governing Group, will beat the enemy with Originium Arts chosen from one of her books.
quote: Education is the key to life's riches.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Greetings, I'm here for my shift… That's a peculiar look on your face. Do I seem so unreliable?
voicelines.talk_1: We don't throw ourselves into battle because we want to. We just have a stronger will to survive than most. If you understand, that alone would be enough.
voicelines.talk_2: Zima, the girls, and I all came from different schools. But all the students in the city knew the legends of General Zima. Doesn't that sound cool? Literally. Zima is Ursine for 'winter', you see. Hm, yes.
voicelines.talk_3: How did we escape from Chernobog? Hmm... you really don't want to know. Sometimes the truth is better left untold.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Oh? I'm reading a mystery novel… As a matter of fact, it taught me some lessons that proved useful in getting me through that terrible time.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My favorite books? Hmm, I enjoy topics like politics, economics, and dialectical materialism… Baking magazines and stuff like that are nice too.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Home? My hometown? Obviously, we can't go back there. You know as well as I do that there's nothing left of it. Even if we rebuilt Chernobog, I still…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Rhodes Island is safe. And there are so many books here in your office... If I could, I'd really prefer to stay here…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: What will I do in the future? Hmm… No idea. My books don't have an answer for that. I hope someone will give offer me one, someday…
voicelines.idle: Such a twist is beyond my imagination. 'Every last one of the passengers on this train, you're all murderers!'
voicelines.onboard: I am Istina. I'm still a student, but I was recruited for my ability to use Arts… Yes, it is rather strange for a student to serve here, isn't it?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You want me to be stronger?
voicelines.promotion_1: Do you feel like you understand me better now? Naive, you're far from really knowing me.
voicelines.promotion_2: Now that you've offered me such recognition, I will reveal my true power. Allow me to demonstrate by reducing this office to a fine powder… Just kidding. There are too many precious books here. I would never do something so awful.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Hmm… The team is somewhat different from what I imagined.
voicelines.depart: Let's show our determination, earnestness, and boundless passion.
voicelines.begin_operation: May the star of victory shine upon us.
voicelines.deployment_1: I have a distaste for war.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Time to teach you a lesson.
voicelines.4-star_result: Why do they fight... even when it may cost them their lives? What do they gain from it?
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, if you have to commend us, now is the time.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Those enemies who fled... We probably won't see them again.
voicelines.operation_failure: Neither our numbers nor our efforts were sufficient…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: A secret room, where, shall we say, interesting things happen.
voicelines.trust_tap: It's too noisy here, I'd rather read in the Doctor's office.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Pramanix
biography: Pramanix is a Karlan Saintess born in Kjerag, the leader of the entire religion of her homeland. She uses the holy bell given to her by the gods to summon the power of wind and snow. She came to Rhodes Island by secret means, and the post she holds as well as how long she's held it are both confidential.
description: Pramanix, Karlan Saintess, is willing to send holy blessings to you as a Supporter Operator.
quote: She doesn't actually feel like working that much.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hm? You're here to pray? Sorry, I'm busy right now.
voicelines.talk_1: Hm? Yes, I'm the current Karlan Saintess. But everyone swamped by work deserves a little break from time to time, don't you think?
voicelines.talk_2: Wasting time on trivial affairs is what I call slacking off. What I'm doing right now is… taking the opportunity to recharge.
voicelines.talk_3: Work hard, play hard, right? Don't force all those rigid rules on me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The Karlan Goddess? We share a good relationship, thanks to my duty as the Saintess.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I'd be happy to help you, but the life of a Karlan Saintess is a busy one. Well, I guess I'll make an exception for you this once, but please make it short.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My sis... Ensia... you people at Rhodes Island are all pretty fond of her, right? So it's not like she received any special treatment from that guy. And now... well, I think I get it now. It's fine like this. I'll just keep watching over her. It's fine.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I twisted my ankle once when I was a kid. My brother carried me on his back all night, going from house to house until someone agreed to take us in. I decided that very moment that I wanted to grow up to become someone like my brother! But now... heh, forget it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Huh? How did you find me? I'll freeze your toes—Um? Coffee? For me? Thanks. Oh, right, Doctor, wanna hang out here with me for a while? The view is pretty nice. But let's keep it a secret, okay? A secret between just the two of us—aw, this coffee is so bitter!
voicelines.idle: It's rare to get to rest like this.
voicelines.onboard: Shh, I sneaked out—oh, um, hi, HR Director! I... I'm here to lend my powers to Rhodes Island. Pramanix, Karlan Saintess, at your service. Bless you, my friend.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I hear a voice... repeating something in my head...
voicelines.promotion_1: 'You shall emerge victorious one day.' This is the pledge of Karlan, and what I'm praying for as well.
voicelines.promotion_2: Since when did you need blessings too? Can you wait a bit? I'll get ready.
voicelines.added_to_squad: May the Holy Mt. Karlan be with us.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Follow the bells and you'll find the way.
voicelines.depart: Let me pray towards the mountains for you.
voicelines.begin_operation: Impurities must be purged.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Here come the bells, cold winds binding my enemies.
voicelines.in_battle_3: These powers are a gift from the Holy Mountain.
voicelines.in_battle_4: As the bells ring, the impenetrable armor shall be no more.
voicelines.4-star_result: It was simple, thanks to the Spirits' power.
voicelines.3-star_result: The light of Karlan was shining on us.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: If only we could have won without bloodshed... just my wish...
voicelines.operation_failure: It's not looking good... I suggest we retreat at once.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's a really peaceful place.
voicelines.trust_tap: Close your eyes and I'll bring you somewhere new... Do keep your eyes closed, okay?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Cliffheart
biography: Cliffheart is a Rhodes Island Operator who was born in Kjerag. She is a specialist in rock and mountain climbing and is proficient with all kinds of climbing tools. Currently she is undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island.
description: Cliffheart, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, possesses both the tenacity of a climber and the sensitivity of a warrior.
quote: It really hurts to be hit by a climbing pick.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.
voicelines.talk_1: Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!
voicelines.talk_2: Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!
voicelines.talk_3: The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.
voicelines.idle: Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!
voicelines.onboard: I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hmm... what a novel experience!
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!
voicelines.promotion_2: Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!
voicelines.added_to_squad: All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...
voicelines.depart: Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'll show them what I can do!
voicelines.in_battle_2: My hook never misses! I've got this!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!
voicelines.4-star_result: There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!
voicelines.3-star_result: Of course we won with me around!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Wow, they sure are good at running away!
voicelines.operation_failure: Dangit... I messed up...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!
voicelines.trust_tap: I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Firewatch
biography: Firewatch comes from unknown origins. She fought for many years on the border between Kazimierz and Ursus. It is suspected that she was a guerrilla during this time. She shows deep experience in asymmetric operations like ambushes, sniping, unconventional tactics, and mobile tactics.She currently works as part of the Rhodes Island sniper group to provide protection services.
description: Firewatch, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will await your orders while undercover.
quote: When will she smile for us? Even the faintest one...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'm keeping an eye on our surroundings. So far everything seems fine.
voicelines.talk_1: You should know that some of those eyes on you hold nothing but malice. You're not safe, not even at Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_2: Don't be afraid of those hostiles hiding in the shadow. No matter how those criminals try to hide, they can't escape my eyes.
voicelines.talk_3: I'll have my revenge... even if I must lose my life for it.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My clan, my friends, they all perished in the woods of our hometown... The only ones who mourned them were the trees, which gave unto them their leaves.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: This crossbow is manufactured for the sole purpose of punishing sinners. The day will come when I use it to pass my final judgement on those who deserve it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Meteorite... we used to be friends. On the day my hometown was destroyed, we were part of the small group that managed to escape.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Since then, I've never stopped searching for the traitor who led the rebel army to our town. Could it be Meteorite? No, I... It couldn't be her...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, I've been spending more time patrolling these days... It's fine, you say? But... um, thank you for caring.
voicelines.idle: I'd like to take a nap...
voicelines.onboard: Firewatch here. I'm a sniper. To avenge my fallen clan, I need all the power I can get.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I need more power...
voicelines.promotion_1: Thanks for appointing me to this position.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you for the promotion. I hope you'll keep using my powers for the right thing. If you don't, however...
voicelines.added_to_squad: The team is complete.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Got it.
voicelines.depart: All Operators, get ready!
voicelines.begin_operation: Enemies spotted. Taking action.
voicelines.4-star_result: I'm not done until I have my revenge...
voicelines.3-star_result: All targets eliminated. Mission complete.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Mission accomplished, request search for remaining hostiles.
voicelines.operation_failure: Retreating... immediately...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'm not used to being in a room with so many people...
voicelines.trust_tap: Uh, please don't touch my antlers... it tickles...

name: Provence
biography: Provence is a Catastrophe Messenger. She has demonstrated superior combat capability in coordinated assaults and marksmanship. She now serves as a sniper on a Rhodes Island squad, Provence is also tasked with investigating Catastrophe zones and providing early warnings of impending Catastrophes.
description: Provence, Catastrophe Messenger of Rhodes Island, always keeps an eye on the movements of Catastrophes and the enemy.
quote: She also keeps an eye on everyone's health.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If you need your room cleaned, I'd be glad to help, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: You seem really interested in my tail, don't you? You say it's furry and looks cute? Well, wanna touch it? No one else has a tail like this, you know!
voicelines.talk_2: Water is precious in the wild. Rhodes Island is in no danger of having a drought right now, but that doesn't mean we should waste water.
voicelines.talk_3: It's my duty to search for and rescue those who encounter Catastrophes. I rarely find any survivors though...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Retrieving beacons, exploring mineral deposits, and recycling... Then we can call it a day!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Mr. Grape is my buddy and a capable partner I can rely on! Where he came from, you ask?... Uh, hmm... Now that's a good question. Where did we first meet?...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: W-what's with that red one...? I... can't stop trembling... uh... Doctor, can you lend me your arm? I'd feel much safer that way...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Those who do Catastrophe relief work often develop all kinds of mutations. What mutation do I have? Well, it's better not to ask. The more you know, the more dangerous it gets for you, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Catastrophe relief workers in the wilderness... don't usually come out unscathed. No need to worry about me, though! I'm already very happy to have a chance to rest at Rhodes Island.
voicelines.idle: Aw, falling asleep in this kinda place again... Guess 'safety' isn't a part of your vocabulary.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Provence, your average Catastrophe relief worker. Hmm, why are you staring at me like that? Interested in my tail?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: So... does this bring me closer to what you imagined I should be?
voicelines.promotion_1: It's fun working with you, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_2: I sense a storm approaching Rhodes Island. But don't worry, leave the evacuation to me! I'm an expert at Catastrophe prevention!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Who will I be teaming up with this time?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't worry. Everything will be fine.
voicelines.depart: My job is to bring everyone home safely.
voicelines.begin_operation: I despise natural Catastrophes and enemies equally!
voicelines.deployment_1: Let's greet 'em with a warning shot.
voicelines.in_battle_1: I've warned ya! Now time for Crowd Control!
voicelines.in_battle_4: The wilderness has its own rules.
voicelines.4-star_result: Compared to natural Catastrophes, these enemies are really powerless.
voicelines.3-star_result: Disaster assessment report: we received zero damage!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Everyone worked hard. Even if we suffered some damage, let's not be discouraged!
voicelines.operation_failure: Aw... my assessment was off. This'll leave a spot on my record for sure...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It'd be nice to have a room to rest in!
voicelines.trust_tap: I've got a fluffy tail~ a fluffy tail~♪
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Vulcan
biography: Vulcan is a blacksmith from Minos who sought treatment at Rhodes Island after contracting Oripathy, ultimately reaching an agreement to become a part of the team. In charge of smithing and maintaining weapons for other Operators, Vulcan also goes on missions when necessary.
description: Vulcan, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, has lit the furnace for you. She's ready to start forging at any time.
quote: Fixing things hardly interests her. Instead, she prefers to invent stuff.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hm? You want to watch me forge weapons? Sure, but be careful not to get singed.
voicelines.talk_1: Only weapons that are never in use will remain undamaged. Therefore, leaving a weapon spotless is actually the worst sacrilege for it.
voicelines.talk_2: The modernized weaponry and equipment manufacturing processes have left many traditional craftsmen jobless. But those who can't keep up with the times will of course be left behind... that's only natural.
voicelines.talk_3: Firearms... these weapons will truly change the world completely.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My right leg? Oh, it's fine. You know, all craftsmen make mistakes.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Thank you for giving me a chance to show what I can do.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You saw my name engraved on some equipment? No... that's not me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: With steel and copper as the core...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My greatest wish is for the hammer I forged to come in useful to you.
voicelines.idle: They're promoting new drinks at the bar. What should I have today?
voicelines.onboard: They call me Vulcan. I can do maintenance for your damaged weapons if you want. Oh, by the way, the forging equipment I need is all listed here in this blueprint.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ah, I'm feeling inspired. Get the blower machine ready, it's time to get down to business.
voicelines.promotion_1: I see that you, too, understand the importance of an excellent craftsperson to a military organization.
voicelines.promotion_2: Keeping your weapons in good condition is the best way to keep yourself safe. Ah, you agree with me? I see that I've finally found my soulmate.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I just want to... focus on my work.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Leader? Well, if I have to... Still, compared to giving orders, I'm much better at designing and manufacturing weapons.
voicelines.depart: Can't I just stay behind and work?
voicelines.begin_operation: Hopeless imbeciles...
voicelines.in_battle_4: I'll destroy your weapon with my next blow!
voicelines.4-star_result: If you pick up some enemy equipment, show it to me. Could be useful for future development.
voicelines.3-star_result: A victory, just as expected! That's why we need high-quality weapons.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Please submit a damage report for each of your weapons. I will work on repairs when we get back.
voicelines.operation_failure: My crafting skills are still lacking...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Got a melting pot here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Any equipment you have in mind? I can try making it for you.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Croissant
biography: Croissant, a member of Penguin Logistics, is a proficient defender who is able to hold back several enemies at once. She also possesses monstrous strength, able to send lesser enemies flying with her massive hammer.
description: Croissant, special agent of Penguin Logistics, is willing to provide reliable defensive power for Rhodes Island as a Defender Operator.
quote: Business is like a war without bullets! All the training and hard work has lead to this day!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: This here Croissant guarantees yer safety, no matter where yer headin', Baws! Oh, 'n payment's upfront! 'Member that!
voicelines.talk_1: Make a buncha money workin' yer butt off! We can't be livin' in no poverty, after all!
voicelines.talk_2: Yer kiddin'! All yer people got such shiny gear on 'em! Lemme have a touch too!
voicelines.talk_3: Boy, I sure love orderin' new gear! Feels like I bought enough stuff to fill the whole depot! This what they call a 'shoppin' addiction'?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Every month there's more 'n more bills to pay... 'n that's why I sell some stuff I find on the side! Everythin' I got is cheap 'n high quality!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Move this, lift that. If we gotta be haulin' things, might as well pick some easy-to-use and yummy-yummy stuff!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Baws, Baws! Found this here heckin' tasty thing lyin' around, ya want a bite? Ya ask me, the only thing second to gud gear is gud food!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Baws, c'mere a sec, wouldja? Take a gander at my wares! From fancy clothes 'n everyday items to office supplies and gear, ya name it, I got it! Buy in bulk 'n I'll give ya a discount!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Baws, I gotta thank ya! With all them referrals, I can buy everything I ever wanted! Yer the best, Baws! Love ya lots!
voicelines.idle: Aw shucks, gotta tighten my belt again this month...
voicelines.onboard: The name's Croissant, and by golly yer in luck, Baws! Won't find nobody as good at their trade as I am! I'm strong, don't break easy, 'n if ya hire me right now, I'll give ya a 20% discount!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I reckon I'll get more work if I get stronger!
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank ya kindly, Baws, fer helpin' me find such a nice job.
voicelines.promotion_2: Baws, Baws, I made good use of that there bonus ya gave me! Check it out, I don’t got myself some new gear. All the better to keep ya safe!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave the defense to me!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Listen up, y'all! Let's do this here mission nice and cleanlike!
voicelines.depart: We'll be back with the best results ya ever did see!
voicelines.begin_operation: Well lookee here. The bad guys're comin' to donate their gear!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: What can I do ya for?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Time to try this here new gear!
voicelines.in_battle_4: That ain't gon' work on me!
voicelines.4-star_result: Ya reckon the enemy dropped a treasure chest or somesuch?
voicelines.3-star_result: Yeehaw! Mission accomplished!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Dagnabbit... the enemy got away! That ain't good for my rep…
voicelines.operation_failure: Aw, shucks… First I lost the fight, and now my wallet…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Ya got any treasure chests hidin' 'round here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Baws, Baws, got any nifty stuff on hand? C'mon, I wanna see!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Liskarm
biography: Liskarm is an employee of Blacksteel Worldwide, a private security contractor that provides security and protection services to international business, state agencies and non-governmental organizations. She has a lot of combat experience in conflict zones. Liskarm is currently under contract to provide professional security and other consulting services to Rhodes Island.
description: Liskarm, Defender Operator of B.P.R.S. of Blacksteel, possesses both a solid shield and a sharp spear.
quote: Her spear-like lightning will pierce all enemies in front of her.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, I'm on shift today.
voicelines.talk_1: Take all missions seriously: that's the guiding rule for us security professionals.
voicelines.talk_2: I'm actually not that good at dealing with people like Franka. I'm not even sure how we became partners in the first place...
voicelines.talk_3: There's a strict selection process before you qualify for BSW. I'm short, have no outstanding Arts talents, and I'm not from any particularly prestigious bloodline. No one believed that I would make it... not even myself, once upon a time.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: BSW is a top security contractor and a great fit for me, I think. But I do enjoy a little more freedom here when dispatched to Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Isn't it amazing how far I've come? I feel like a real dragon... uh, ahem, forget I said that... Anyway, I'm okay with whatever as long as it helps our side in battle!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Thank you, Doctor, for trusting me this much.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: People who know me always say I'm more easygoing than I seem. Do you think so too, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Franka is telling you about our time at Blacksteel again? Ahhh, for the love of... Just don't believe anything she says, okay?
voicelines.idle: Doctor, we're still at work...
voicelines.onboard: Defender Liskarm, awaiting orders. I've been involved in multiple special operations like VIP protection, assaulting fortified positions, rescuing hostages, and clearing out threats.Your safety is my mission, and I will use every tool at my disposal to guarantee it.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Upgrade complete.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you for appointing me to this position, Doctor.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you, Doctor! I will devote myself to defending Rhodes Island, as your trusted Operator.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm ready.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Understood. I will ask my team to rigorously adhere to the guidelines and procedures of Rhodes Island.
voicelines.depart: Permission to attack granted.
voicelines.begin_operation: Waiting for further instructions.
voicelines.4-star_result: This is nothing. Franka and I have been through much worse.
voicelines.3-star_result: Clear. All targets down.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: All green. This area has been secured.
voicelines.operation_failure: Emergency squad, retreat with the injured Operators! Everyone who can still fight, follow me and hold back the enemy!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is this room protected against electrical discharge?
voicelines.tap: Watch out you don't get shocked.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, is Franka still being treated? By the way, you need to rest after work.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Projekt Red
biography: Projekt Red's real identity unknown and her background a mystery. She was taken in, raised, and protected by Dr. Kal'tsit. Extremely talented in high mobility warfare, special ops and stealth combat. Projekt Red now serves as a Specialist Operator for Rhodes Island under Dr. Kal'tsit's guidance.
description: Projekt Red the Wolf Hunter, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will join the hunt.
quote: Her blades are her fangs.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: This place smells… dangerous.
voicelines.talk_1: I prefer to work alone, by myself.
voicelines.talk_2: Name, bounty, kill. Simple. That's the agreement with Kal'tsit.
voicelines.talk_3: Wolves have fangs, I have my blade. Wolves do not rest, neither do I.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Granny's calling... I can hear her.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Bleak wind, corpses on the ground, screams under the stars... I smell them all, the scent of wolves. I join the hunt.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Family? I have no family. I am always alone. Do you need a family, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: They avoid me... I just want to touch their tails. Provence, and Texas... I like their scent.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, sometimes I wonder... if I weren't a wolf hunter, would my life be different? Oh, you mean… I should answer the question... myself?
voicelines.idle: Doctor... no, nothing. I thought you fell asleep. Don't sleep, not now.
voicelines.onboard: Projekt Red, wolf hunter, smells wolves.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: As long as it helps me hunt.
voicelines.promotion_1: As you like it.
voicelines.promotion_2: A promotion? This will disguise me. I accept.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Infiltration successful.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: What should I do?
voicelines.depart: The hunt begins.
voicelines.begin_operation: The scent... it's thick.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Your death... is in my eyes.
voicelines.4-star_result: Targets, all down
voicelines.3-star_result: The one way a hunt can end.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: This kill... too small.
voicelines.operation_failure: Sorry... My blade... not sharp enough.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I prefer to be outside. But… it's okay.
voicelines.tap: Watch your hand. I might cut you.
voicelines.trust_tap: *sleepy noises*
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Nearl
biography: Nearl, once known as the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz, is a member of the Infected support group, 'Followers.' She has demonstrated remarkable combat techniques and military discipline, whether it's covering allies, mobile warfare, all-out assault or field battle. Currently a heavy-weapon Operator for Rhodes Island and provides command and combat support in person.
description: Nearl, former knight of Kazimierz, is a core member on the battlefield with her defense and healing skills.
quote: It feels relieving to have her by your side.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Salutations, Doctor. May the light be with you.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, I ask that you give me the most dangerous assignment available, such that my shield and I can best protect those in need.
voicelines.talk_2: The title of 'Knight' should be a symbol of honor. And yet now, it's been reduced to a mere commodity...
voicelines.talk_3: As long as the light continues to guide me, I will neither bow to cruelty nor kneel to violence.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm grateful as always for your service, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The Kazimierz chivalric spirit should have been a force of salvation for all who suffer in this world. But now, it's nothing more than a rotten legacy, used to benefit the rich. Nothing is more shameful.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Shining, too, is a beam of light that guides me forward. She carries the hope I've long sought.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Something flickered in Shining's eyes when she heard the name Rhodes Island. I had no idea what it meant...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: In this time and age of a world plagued by Oripathy, may the ray of hope from Rhodes Island light the way.
voicelines.idle: Let us embrace this momentary respite.
voicelines.onboard: Margaret Nearl, the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz...and now a Rhodes Island Operator. I will defend your life and your honor with my shield.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you for granting me power.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you, Doctor. These new powers shall bring relief to those who suffer. This I shall engrave upon my heart.
voicelines.promotion_2: Shining once said that dawn remains distant. But I believe that, one day, we will revive the dying glory with our very own hands.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I shall protect them from all harm.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I shall not blemish Rhodes Island's name.
voicelines.depart: I am ready. Set out!
voicelines.begin_operation: Honor must be defended.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I shall give my all to you.
voicelines.4-star_result: A true knight will not bend to the threat of violence. Now, repent for your sins, in front of my warhammer.
voicelines.3-star_result: Let us go forth. And there will be one day…
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A true knight will not chase one who's lost the will to fight. Everyone deserves a chance to choose a new path.
voicelines.operation_failure: We must not give up now.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I shall keep watch here.
voicelines.tap: I sense an intru- Oh, Doctor?!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, umm... may I enter your office? I've heard you have a vast collection of literature.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Warfarin
biography: A senior figure in the Rhodes Island leadership, Warfarin's background remains unclear. She is the founder and administrator of the Rhodes Island Blood Bank, and very accomplished in the medical field. She laid the foundation of the island's medical system with Dr. Kal'tsit.
description: Warfarin, Medic Operator of Rhodes Island, sees the safety of her fellow Operators as her duty.
quote: Of course, medical research is a tiny little bit more important.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit sent me to take a blood sample from you. We can chat as I'm getting the needle ready.
voicelines.talk_1: Can I control the urge to feed, you ask? How dare you underestimate me! I'm a trained professional. Of course I can tell patients from food!
voicelines.talk_2: It's my job to track blood indicators for all our operators, even if they aren't exactly happy about it—huh...? These blood bags? They're samples, of course! What were you thinking!?
voicelines.talk_3: There's another one of my kind here. And she's an... engineer? Hm…maybe she likes the smell of machine oil more than blood?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Why I chose to become a doctor? I can't say it was any sort of lofty calling. It's just that, you know, OUR kind... we don't exactly have the brightest prospects. But it turned out my skills were actually in surprisingly high demand, so... I just went with the flow.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: How do we fight the urge to feed? We actually have a course that helps us control our desires. And we've invented artificial blood, so we drink that if we need. We can be very resourceful, you know.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: This is the standard procedure. It's the same for everyone getting blood drawn. Don't move, Doctor. Ah... blood... your blood... it smells delicious... It's just… it's just… captivating...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Replenishing saline solution! Changing filters! Sterilizing sand and charcoal canisters... all done! Doctor, you'd better keep your medical supplies well-maintained. As Dr. Kal'tsit said, when your kidneys give out, these machines are going to save your life... aw, come on, just kidding.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Fine, fine, I'll come clean... I have tasted lots of blood of many different types from all different races. And I do enjoy the subtle differences in flavor, okay? In fact, the only type of blood I've never tasted is... yours, Doctor. Heheh...
voicelines.idle: Hm? So you still have time to sleep? I'm jealous.
voicelines.onboard: I am Warfarin, the blood-scientist-slash-doctor. Besides typical healing Arts, I also bring you specialized medical treatments, courtesy of my remarkable expertise in hematology and plentiful experience. Anyway, look forward to working with you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hm, my work efficiency seems to have improved.
voicelines.promotion_1: Are you even listening? We're having trouble collecting rare blood types for the emergency blood bank. So—what? What did you say? A promotion? Now?
voicelines.promotion_2: This only means more work for me, right? Ha, I saw that a mile away! I'm an expert in this field after all. Don't worry, I am well prepared!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Wait, I need to prepare my equipment first.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: A leader reports only to you, right?
voicelines.depart: My equipment is ready. We can start any time.
voicelines.begin_operation: I don't have the leisure for enemy intel at the moment. Taking care of our operators has already occupied my whole schedule...
voicelines.deployment_1: Call for help immediately if you're injured!
voicelines.4-star_result: It's really nerve-wracking being in the medic squad. Support troops are really under lots of pressure! Good thing I'm already used to it.
voicelines.3-star_result: The battlefield is a place of tragedy. I hope they come to understand this one day.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Forget about those fleeing enemies at the moment, our priority now is to help the injured.
voicelines.operation_failure: I am sorry, we've even ran out reserve medicine…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I guess I'm more accustomed to figuring things out myself...
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, isn't it almost time for your annual checkup?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Silence
biography: Silence was an Originium researcher at Rhine Lab, LLC. She was involved in several unknown applied research projects as well as several clinical trials on Oripathy.She now provides battlefield medical treatments to Rhodes Island.
description: Silence, medical specialist of Rhine Lab, will make use of the latest scientific developments on the battlefield.
quote: There's no risk in the fruits of research, as they are only byproducts after all. Experimentation, on the other hand...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, these are your tasks for the day. Yeah. A whole pile of work. Let's get to it.
voicelines.talk_1: Is Ifrit making trouble again? Sorry. I'll discipline her later.
voicelines.talk_2: Zzzzz… Sorry, I was taking a nap… I'm still not used to working during the day.
voicelines.talk_3: My reasons for quitting Rhine Lab? So much happened since I signed on, I don't even know where to start…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Have you ever heard of a woman named Saria? Like me, she was once a scientist at Rhine Lab, and she was one of the people responsible for the creation of Ifrit…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Our biology research at Rhine Lab went so far as to implant Originium Shards into living bodies… Sorry, we'd better change the subject.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Saria? You mean she's here at Rhodes Island too? Is she here for Ifrit…? After she walked out on us like that, why would she come here right now…?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I will not allow Ifrit to see Saria. Please trust me, this is for Ifrit's own good…!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Are you trying to cure Oripathy too? I heard that you were involved in the development of medical technology at Rhodes Island. Heheh… you must be looking forward to a breakthrough, as a researcher yourself.
voicelines.idle: …Asleep already? All right. I'll handle the rest of the work.
voicelines.onboard: I am Olivia Silence, an Originium scientist from the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute. My hope is to rid the world of Oripathy… even if it means risking my life in the process.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I will make good use of this new power.
voicelines.promotion_1: Is my medicine effective? Wonderful. This news brings me even greater joy than my promotion.
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, I am looking forward to the day when the world is finally cured of Oripathy. In fighting and studying with you, I think that day may not be far off.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood. I'll focus on support.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Come on, team, let's fight with all our might.
voicelines.depart: Originium… Are you to blame for this battle?
voicelines.begin_operation: Observe and determine the form of Infection. Such data will be useful for research.
voicelines.4-star_result: In order to defeat stronger enemies, must we make further use of Originium's power…?
voicelines.3-star_result: Medical team, please take tissue samples from the Infected, we need to see the composition of the Infection in this area.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: All wounded personnel, please remain calm. The medical team will get to you.
voicelines.operation_failure: …Now is not the time for despair. We must withdraw immediately.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This room… Ugh… It's like it's designed to make me sleepy!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, you're kinder these days.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Mayer
biography: Mayer was born in Columbia and was a member of the Rhine Lab Research Lab. She is the inventor of the 'Meeboo' wire control system. She is outstandingly capable and runs her own workshop called 'Lutra.' She is currently working with Rhodes Islands to provide assistance with construction, planning, and development.
description: Mayer, researcher of Rhine Lab, is ready for combat with her Meeboos.
quote: A genius at multitasking in all aspects.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Structural design, industrial R&D, scientific research. You name it, and I can do it, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: The Engineering Department never approve my proposals. Do they have any bias toward me? What should I do... Oh! Actually, Doctor, would you please submit this suggestion on improvement for me? It's a deal then!
voicelines.talk_2: There are many workshops like mine in Rhine Lab, but what takes others six weeks to finish, I can have it done in one. I'm not boasting!
voicelines.talk_3: DO NOT interrupt me when I'm doing my research, or I'll have my Meeboos bite you! And I will bite you too!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: At night I'm always full of inspiration... and the… urgency to sleep! No, I can't bear it... Where's the pillow... I need to rest...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Hm? Why are these cuties called Meeboos? That's because they go 'meeee-boooo' when they boot up. So I named them after that. Fitting, don't you think? Just listen and you'll get it. You press this switch to... NONONONO, That's the self-destruct button! Ahhhhhh run！
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: That girl who just passed by... that was Silence, right? If only back then... Oh, sorry, the non-disclosure agreement is still in effect. I should keep my mouth shut.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I feel kinda empty when I've got nothing to do... I guess that's just how engineers are. I bet even you have to idle your time away on occasion, Doctor. Huh? You don't?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, may I request... No! Not 10 square meters! I asked for too much last time, so this time... all I need is 3! W-Wait! Don't leave yet! 1 square meter, just 1 more for my research will do! Please, Doctor, I'm begging you...
voicelines.idle: Geez... where's the coffeemaker... Oh, there it is... You want some too, Doctor?
voicelines.onboard: Lutra Workshop of Rhine Lab, at your service. Yup, I run the workshop on my own. No assistance needed. Amazing, right?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This structure... Interesting. I'll look into it.
voicelines.promotion_1: This raise came just in time! I can afford to upgrade my equipment now.
voicelines.promotion_2: I promised that you'd not be disappointed. Now look what I have! Surely kept my end of the bargain, didn't I?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Time to go, Meeboos!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Commanding both Operators and my Meeboos at the same time is a bit much even for me...
voicelines.depart: Hopefully we can get some useful experiment data!
voicelines.begin_operation: Come on, Meeboo, show them what Rhine Lab's technology can do!
voicelines.in_battle_3: If anything breaks, just make another one!
voicelines.in_battle_4: My Meeboos are more than just machines!
voicelines.4-star_result: Come on, Meeboo! Show everyone your victory dance!
voicelines.3-star_result: Nice! We practically rolled over them!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The device is slightly damaged. I'll fix it in no time.
voicelines.operation_failure: Oh no! My Meeboo...! I'll need to make more...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Now I want a new workshop!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, let me touch your head! Inspiration can strike, you know!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
