name: Skyfire
biography: Skyfire is affiliated with King's Wand, the central organ of Foxtail, an Originium power research institute. A tech specialist from Victoria, she holds degrees in geology and Originium geology, and is respected in fields of Originium study both practical and theoretical. Currently the Chief Caster stationed at Rhodes Island on loan from the King's Wand, Skyfire's mission is to jointly research Originium while providing combat mission assistance.
description: Skyfire, Operator from King's Wand, is ready to burn anyone foolish enough to stand in her way.
quote: Fine her if she triggers the fire alarm again!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: The fire alarm's gone off? Sorry, it was only me passing by your office. My body temperature must've sailed too high again.
voicelines.talk_1: There's no language that's impossible to learn, no Arts that are impossible to understand. Isn't that the plain and simple truth? ...What? I'm the exception to the rule, you say?
voicelines.talk_2: My life plans...? Tch, everything was going swimmingly until that dreadful attack. But after Reunion murdered Phil, their eradication jumped to the top of my to-do list.
voicelines.talk_3: Rhodes Island's methods aren't nearly tough enough. All they'll do is drag King's Wand down.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Can you talk to Amiya for me? Poor girl, her kind heart clouds her judgment. As far as I'm concerned, total annihilation is the only fitting end for the wicked.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Your current skills wouldn't compare to even the average level of a King's Wand member such as myself. Ha, yes, I'm powerful... and the power of all five of us put together... words wouldn't even begin to describe.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Luminarie's blade was a gift from Shiro. I heard that the owner before Shiro was a swordmaster who could fell all the cherry blossoms of Higashi with a single swing. But even that legendary swordmaster was no match for Shiro, and had to surrender the blade.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: What happened to your shirt? What? I burned a hole in it? But... impossible... my self-control is impeccable, don't you think...? I... well, I'm sorry. Really, truly sorry.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: We might be on opposite ends of the spectrum when it comes to ideals, but I do enjoy seeing the people of Rhodes Island sweat away with bright hopes for the future. Yes, that is a compliment. It's a heartwarming sight.
voicelines.idle: How lazy. You think it's fine to just sleep here and while away the precious day?
voicelines.onboard: I am Skyfire of King's Wand. I will remain at Rhodes Island until my objective is accomplished. What's my objective, you ask? To burn every last Reunion thug to ashes, of course.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This is no way to go about unleashing my true power.
voicelines.promotion_1: Naturally.
voicelines.promotion_2: Ha. Enjoying the privileges I deserve from time to time is a good way to relax.
voicelines.added_to_squad: This battlefield needs some heating up.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: The rays of the sun are my shield.
voicelines.depart: Now's the time to attack.
voicelines.begin_operation: Kneel before the flame of the heavens.
voicelines.deployment_1: Bad luck is always in waiting for the weak.
voicelines.deployment_2: The wise alway take the initiative.
voicelines.in_battle_3: May the flames of the sun devour you!
voicelines.in_battle_4: May the rays of the skies set you ablaze!
voicelines.4-star_result: There isn't a soul who may survive the sunflame.
voicelines.3-star_result: Pathetic... you're nothing but ashes now. Were you hoping to leave a trace behind?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Is that it? I had higher expectations.
voicelines.operation_failure: Impossible... how could I...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Couldn't you ready a slightly cooler room for me?
voicelines.tap: Are you trying to get your hand burnt?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, could you explain this theory to me? I'll need twelve minutes of your time, that's all.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: How are you doing today, Doctor?

name: Amiya
biography: The public face of Rhodes Island and its top executive. Although Amiya appears to be a young and inexperienced girl, she is universally trusted and highly qualified for her position. Amiya now leads Rhodes Island in fighting for the future of the Infected and striving to exorcise the dark shadow of Originium from the land.
description: Amiya, leader of Rhodes Island, will fight alongside you.
quote: Keep fighting, Doctor.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You work so hard, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: Dr. Kal'tsit told me you have to be 100% focused on your work to maximize efficiency. So... yes, that's what I'm gonna do!
voicelines.talk_2: Rhodes Island has achieved cruising speed, Doctor. Would you mind sorting out the navigation log for me?
voicelines.talk_3: I still have a lot to learn as leader of Rhodes Island. I hope you'll be there to guide me on our path to the future.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Maybe it's just wishful thinking, but I hope Rhodes Island can be like a second home to everyone.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Making it this far has cost us so much. Sometimes, I can't help but ask myself... is it really worth it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Sometimes I remember where I came from... It was cold, and the air smelled of rusted copper. Rhodes Island is a cozy place in comparison. I'll do everything I can to protect our home.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hehe… Dr. {@nickname}, let me tell you something: I picked up the violin again.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: We've still got a long, long way to go, Doctor. This might be a journey without an end, but as long as you're with me, we'll be okay.
voicelines.idle: There's still lots of work that needs to be done, Doctor. We can't afford to have you resting.
voicelines.onboard: I'm so glad you're back, Doctor. Now we can walk this path together, me with you, and you with me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I see... thank you, Doctor! I've learned so much from you.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm so excited to fight by your side again, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_2: What I saw that day... the despair stuck in my throat, hopelessly trying to scream... I want to bury it all deep inside my mind and never let it out…
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I won't let you down.
voicelines.depart: Operation commencing!
voicelines.begin_operation: Incoming! Get ready, everyone!
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter how difficult the mission, we can handle it as long as you're here, Doctor. I've never doubted you.
voicelines.3-star_result: We may have achieved a perfect victory, but we still can't let our guard down.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Well done, Doctor! You must be exhausted. Be sure to rest when you need it.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm fine... Get it together, everyone!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: You want something to drink, Doctor?
voicelines.trust_tap: Ehehe...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Meteorite
biography: Formerly a member of Firewatch's group, she is now a freelance mercenary. Other details of her history are unknown.Now serving as a sniper Operator for Rhodes Island, she uses the bowgun in her hands to exert lethality from afar.
description: Meteorite, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, is ready to pound enemies with her barrage.
quote: She will fulfill her duties as long as she still has a weapon in her hands.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: It's time for my shift. If I'm interrupting your work, I can wait outside.
voicelines.talk_1: Have you gone through every new operator's personnel files and info?
voicelines.talk_2: Nowhere in the world is completely safe with a war going on. Not even Rhodes Island. Please remember that.
voicelines.talk_3: To be frank, you're surrounded by people from all walks of life. That can be quite dangerous, don't you think?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm surprised that so many other Sarkaz have come to Rhodes Island. What's more surprising is that they actually get along…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My bowgun may not be easy to operate, but it's just as powerful as the Laterano guns. I use it to defend the glory of my people.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I see Firewatch is here. I can't believe she's using the name of our old guerrilla group as her codename. It's like time stopped for her the day her home was destroyed...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: As for what happened between Firewatch and I... she'll tell you when she's ready. All I can say is that I was not the one who led the rebels to her village... but no one would believe the words of a Sarkaz, right?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: She wants her revenge, and I have my duty. Even though we've met again at Rhodes Island, it probably won't affect anything. Our paths aren't likely to cross.
voicelines.idle: What's that sound? Is someone monitoring this room? Or am I just… imagining things?
voicelines.onboard: Codename Meteorite, a freelance mercenary. I'm Sarkaz, as you can see. Do you still want to hire me?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: My aim with my bowgun has improved.
voicelines.promotion_1: You want to promote me? I see that I made the right choice to work here.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you so much for this, really. I can't believe someone like me could work a stable job here at Rhodes Island. I'll do everything I can to repay your trust in me.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Reporting for duty.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Me, a leader? To be honest, I'm not that good at giving orders.
voicelines.depart: I'll do my best to take care of everyone.
voicelines.begin_operation: Enemy status confirmed. All units, prepare to engage.
voicelines.4-star_result: I don't want to see anything laid to waste in the fires of war ever again. Let us put an end to this, once and for all.
voicelines.3-star_result: Trying to escape after I laid you to siege? Don't be silly.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Someone's escaped. Not the time to let our guard down.
voicelines.operation_failure: Retreat! Back to the stronghold and regroup.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What's this place?
voicelines.trust_tap: Is this for me? Thanks.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Platinum
biography: Platinum was previously an assassin for the Kazimierz Armorless Union. The rest of her background is unknown. She has demonstrated considerable talent and special tactical accomplishments in high-mobility operations, clearance, and urban warfare.Under the leadership of Dr. Kal'tsit, she is a Sniper Operator for Rhodes Island.
description: Platinum, member of Kazimierz Armorless Union, will provide versatile fire support on the battlefield.
quote: A carefree girl, and the nightmare of all knights.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: *Yaaawn*... Doctor, could I take a quick break?
voicelines.talk_1: Don't worry about my bow. I keep it well maintained. It's much tougher than you, so stop asking about it already.
voicelines.talk_2: There are so many interesting people at Rhodes Island. Would be nice if I could make a friend or two to travel with.
voicelines.talk_3: Nowadays, the Knights of Kazimierz are little more than a bunch of musclehead jocks, or clowns obsessed with billboards and firework shows. Man, it's so lame.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I was planning to return home after finishing this job, but now I've changed my mind. Why, you ask? You should know better than to ask a girl a question like that.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Want to know the origin of my codename? You see, there are different ranks for the Knight Assassins in Kazimierz. There's three Darksteel and two Lazurite assassins above me, but I and I alone bear the rank of Platinum, from now till the day I die. So I figured it'd make a good codename.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Ah, it's Miss Nearl! No, no, I wasn't going to lay a hand on her. I'm just worried she's going to charge at me with her hammer.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Kazimierz is... a boring place. *Sigh*, I'm almost mad at how much more amusing life here at Rhodes Island is.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Have you thought about how you're going to maintain your relations with everyone here at Rhodes Island? You know, all suits of armor have small gaps which leave you vulnerable, and that's where the enemies always try to jam their blades. One hit to your weak point can bring down everything you've painstakingly built.
voicelines.idle: I'm so bored. Hoping something amusing happens.
voicelines.onboard: Assassin of the Armorless Union of Kazimierz here as per our agreement. What am I called? Hmm... Call me Platinum, then. Nice to meet you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Good. My bow feels even lighter. Thank you.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? Isn't the rank of Platinum already intimidating enough? Oh, you are an interesting one.
voicelines.promotion_2: Hah. Do you have the guts to gaze upon the true face of the one called Platinum, my dear Doctor?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Platinum, reporting for duty.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Really? I'm commanding? It's not my strongest suit, but all right.
voicelines.depart: Will this battle be an interesting one?
voicelines.begin_operation: You may as well attack at the same time. You're all too weak anyway.
voicelines.4-star_result: Nice. I had quite an enjoyable time.
voicelines.3-star_result: Checkmate. I'm sorry, but victory is mine.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: What a pity that we left some alive.
voicelines.operation_failure: Don't give up... He who laughs last laughs best.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The atmosphere here is surprisingly good.
voicelines.trust_tap: Want to go on a walk? If you're busy, there's always next time.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Blue Poison
biography: Blue Poison's real identity remains unknown and her background a mystery. She is highly skilled at neutralizing targets using toxins. Now a sniper with Rhodes Island, she regularly contributes her expertise in toxicology research.
description: Blue Poison, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will attack the enemy with her venom.
quote: Hold her hands, and give her confidence.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Greetings, Doctor. You're glowing today. To see you so well... it's all I could ever hope for.
voicelines.talk_1: I prepared an antidote to nullify the effects of any common poison. I'd like you to take one dose before every battle. Do you mind?
voicelines.talk_2: Actually, the toxin in my body is an ingredient in some high-quality medicines. That's why Dr. Kal'tsit needs me in her lab a lot.
voicelines.talk_3: Hmm, why do you keep staring at me... You mean, it's because my eye color is special? Is that a compliment, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm the one our enemies fear the most. After all, who wouldn't want to kill me before I can torture them to death with my poison? What really worries me is that my teammates might think the same…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Why am I staring at this cake? Actually... I baked it to share with everyone, but no one wanted it... Would you like to try it, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, you're always wearing the same outfit. How about I choose some new clothes for you? I think I have pretty good taste. Oh... it's a uniform? So you can't change it? Okay…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm 'toxic'... so people prefer to stay away from me. But now I have you by my side, Doctor, and I'm really, really happy.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My body isn't that different from everyone else. I may be 'toxic,' but nothing bad will happen if someone touches me. Doctor, if you can prove this to everyone, then maybe they won't always keep away from me. Could you... hold my hand out there?
voicelines.idle: Doctor? Oh, already asleep. Gotta find a blanket to keep the Doctor warm...
voicelines.onboard: Nice to meet you, I'm Blue Poison. I'm sure Dr. Kal'tsit must have told you about me. In that case, it'll be up to you to decide how to use my 'toxic' powers.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I think I hear the sound of toxic liquid boiling, like music to my ears.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you so much... I'm so glad I get to help out in all these battles. It's like a dream come true.
voicelines.promotion_2: I used to hold back and hide my 'toxic' self, but now I've accepted what I am, trying to move forward to change my fate. I have you to thank for helping me make this shift, Doctor. You have my sincerest gratitude.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Great. I'm good at supporting assaults.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'd be much better off supporting the others. Wouldn't want my poison to harm you, Doctor...
voicelines.depart: Everyone, there's no need for you all to stand so far from me...
voicelines.begin_operation: I prepared a 'gift' for you. Like it?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Please don't be scared of me.
voicelines.deployment_1: Don't worry, my poison is not contagious.
voicelines.in_battle_1: My toxins will slowly burn your life away...
voicelines.in_battle_3: Honey to me, poison to you.
voicelines.4-star_result: Use poison to fight the evils and crimes... Isn't that ironic to you?
voicelines.3-star_result: I've got a poison to melt away all these remains in an instant. Want me to show you?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Good, finished before my clothes got dirty.
voicelines.operation_failure: How ridiculous. Feels like I killed myself with my own poison...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Resting when you're tired helps you focus on your work.
voicelines.trust_tap: D-Did you just touch me? C-Can you do that again? Please?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Specter
biography: Specter, true identity unknown, records missing. Demonstrated extraordinary ability in combating large creatures and destroying sturdy targets, speculated to correlate with extensive prior combat experience. Now stationed as a Guard at Rhodes Island.
description: Specter from the Abyssal Hunters is already done with her prayer and is now prowling the battlefield.
quote: Her madness is terrifying.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...
voicelines.talk_1: O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…
voicelines.talk_2: Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...
voicelines.talk_3: Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…
voicelines.idle: Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...
voicelines.onboard: I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Power... is flowing into me...
voicelines.promotion_1: I have no right to go against your will...
voicelines.promotion_2: Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Good night, my brothers and sisters.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: As you wish.
voicelines.depart: This will be a path paved with sacrifice.
voicelines.begin_operation: All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Please let me know the results.
voicelines.deployment_1: I come from the depth of the ocean…
voicelines.deployment_2: You are the one who woke me.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I care not for valueless ones.
voicelines.4-star_result: I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?
voicelines.3-star_result: Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: None of you shall leave this place!
voicelines.operation_failure: They shall pay for this... They must pay…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

lore.infection_status: Showed no outward symptoms of Originium Infection, but Infection was confirmed by medical examination. More clinical research is required to fully diagnose Specter's Infection status.

name: Lappland
biography: Lappland's real identity is unknown, her background a mystery. She has demonstrated impressive destructive prowess in tactical assaults and search-and-destroy missions. She is currently a special ops Operator for Rhodes Island.
description: Operator Lappland can't wait to slash apart the enemies in front of her.
quote: Just pray. Pray that she will listen to your orders.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.
voicelines.talk_1: Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.
voicelines.talk_2: If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.
voicelines.talk_3: It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.
voicelines.idle: Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.
voicelines.onboard: A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?
voicelines.promotion_1: Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?
voicelines.promotion_2: Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Make Texas the leader!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Put Texas on my team!
voicelines.depart: Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.
voicelines.begin_operation: We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.
voicelines.in_battle_4: You'll have to try harder than that!
voicelines.4-star_result: It's over? Ah, che noia!
voicelines.3-star_result: Hahaha, sliced 'em up like a millefoglie. How do you like it?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Not my best work. You can lay it on me for letting a few get away.
voicelines.operation_failure: Bravo! Now I want to crush them that much harder! Hahaha!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Hm? Did I see a red shadow flash by?
voicelines.trust_tap: The more I get to know you, the better I understand Texas. I Love it.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Indra
biography: Ran the Glasgow Gang in Victoria, one of the Siege's subordinates and her personal guard on Rhodes Island. Puts in occasional cameos as combat instructor (actually, in the role of opponent).
description: Indra, member of the Glasgow Gang, will gladly brawl with the big guys for you.
quote: She is good at negotiating with her fists.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If you got enemies about, just scream. I'll keep ya safe.
voicelines.talk_1: Where's that kid gone off to? Y'know, her... the really tanned shorty who's always trailing our Master... 'Morgan' is her nam- Oi! Stop right there!
voicelines.talk_2: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, we keep it real that way, yeah? You treat me with respect, I'll do the same for you.
voicelines.talk_3: Seems our Majesty's really into your place. Don't see that every day, seeing as we're never anywhere same for long.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Work or what have ya, you've gotta have guts!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Whoa, whoa, chew before you swallow, mate! HEY! SOMEONE BRING US MORE MEAT! This girl's got an empty belly to fill!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Bleeding Morgan... she might seem like a layabout mostly, but she's our tactician when push comes to shove. Gets the job done. Gets on my nerves otherwise, though, and she loves it. Tch...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doesn't she look brilliant, like a liege with a hammer in hand? I'm even more keen to see the look of her holding a sword, though.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Out with it! Don't beat around the bush, just say it: who do you want dealt with?
voicelines.idle: Tch. look at you spacing out like an idiot... Your own bloody fault if a tiger bites you.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Indra. I don't have any of those weird crazy powers -- I let my fists do the talking. Nice to meet ya!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Niiice, this is good stuff.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotions are great, almost as great as fighting is!
voicelines.promotion_2: Don't be afraid. I'll protect ya.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Where's the battlefield?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: So, who's in the market for a walloping?
voicelines.depart: Mind your own sodding business and let me be!
voicelines.begin_operation: Come on! Show me what you've got!
voicelines.4-star_result: That's the stuff! That's what I call a kick!
voicelines.3-star_result: You don't go home happy without some bloodshed!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Tch, we've got some who fled. Bunch of cowards.
voicelines.operation_failure: Not bad... But I'll get you back for this!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What's this room about? More of a squeeze than anywhere I've been.
voicelines.tap: Oi! You got a bleedin' death wish?
voicelines.trust_tap: C'mere, lemme get my arms around you! Yes, I mean hug you!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Franka
biography: Franka, biohazard protection and response specialist for Blacksteel Worldwide, is very experienced and proficient in VIP protection, raid, and combat support operations. She is currently undergoing treatment for Oripathy at Rhodes Island and providing professional security as a Blacksteel Operator.
description: Franka, Guard Operator of B.P.R.S. of Blacksteel, is waiting for your orders.
quote: This scorching thermite blade shall penetrate all defenses.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: We're changing shifts right now, Doctor. Just ignore me and get on with your work.
voicelines.talk_1: Back in BSW, I was appointed as a BPRS... you know, Biochemical Protection Response Staff. You can probably imagine what it was like... bulky hazmat suit and all that...
voicelines.talk_2: Hmm? You think I'm a clean freak? Well, Doctor, I see you're unexpectedly direct! I admire your courage.
voicelines.talk_3: Some of the Operators' rooms are in dire need of cleaning. For example, the one belonging to that high-and-mighty teacher's pet. What do you think?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You want to see the intricate pattern on my sword up close? Sure, hold it tight, then. Don't let go—it'll heat up to 2,500 degrees Celcius in 3 seconds! Haha, just kidding! Don't be scared!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Stay clear of that room full of chemical haze, toxins and harmful radiation... that's right, I mean Dr. Kal'tsit's lab.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You're asking me for advice regarding the prevention of biochemical contamination? Well, for example... always brush your teeth after eating?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Liskarm's been looking so flashy since she got her promotion. 'Hey! Hot girl here! Get your gunsight on me!' I bet that's how she greets the enemies.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Good golly, if this is how free life is at Rhodes Island then I might just quit my job at BSW. Liskarm would be upset, though.
voicelines.idle: There's a mosquito on your arm, Doctor.
voicelines.onboard: I'm chemical specialist operator, Franka, here to do my bit to help minimize the pollution wrought by Originium.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I could perform these techniques anywhere, anytime!
voicelines.promotion_1: Wooow, you're giving me a promotion? I'm having a lot more fun here than at BSW.
voicelines.promotion_2: *Giggle*, you want to see my sword at its most glorious? Too bad, Doctor—you're not qualified yet! If you work at it, maybe one day you'll gain the privilege!
voicelines.added_to_squad: All right, I'm ready.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: The best thing about training capable subordinates, is that I get to let them handle all the annoying stuff for me.
voicelines.depart: Well, let's go, then.
voicelines.begin_operation: Too bad... these people have already been contaminated. In that case...
voicelines.deployment_1: Offense isn't what I trained for, but hey...
voicelines.deployment_2: Heavy defenders are SO scary... Hehe, just kidding.
voicelines.4-star_result: Obsession with power is a fool's game.
voicelines.3-star_result: That was perfect from start to finish. Well done.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Just as expected.
voicelines.operation_failure: What, you still have time for that upset face? Fall back now.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Say, do you have black tea here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Want to hear about my time at BSW?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Texas
biography: Texas is a Penguin Logistics staff member who is extraordinarily skilled in single combat. She was sent to Rhodes Island as a liaison, where she assists with a variety of operations.
description: Texas, employee of Penguin Logistics, will give the squad a tactical advantage with her Originium Arts at the start of every battle.
quote: You can trust her with your cargo.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: I don't say much? That's because I'd rather avoid thinking about most things.
voicelines.talk_2: Our job is to deliver life and death.
voicelines.talk_3: I usually listen to Sora's songs when I'm driving.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Cigarette? Oh, no, this is chocolate. You've gotta replenish your energy regularly. Which reminds me... do you want some coffee?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: How long have I worked for Penguin Logistics? When did I start...? I don't even know how long it's been.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Watch out for the Red Wolf. She's not evil, but... she's not like us.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: No matter how hard I run, my past will catch up to me one day.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My independent lifestyle and rowdy friends have brought me a lot of trouble... but I kind of like it this way.
voicelines.idle: Is it time for a break?
voicelines.onboard: Code name Texas. I'm responsible for driving, moving cargo, and keeping our people safe. Try to get the mission briefings as concise as possible, please.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thanks.
voicelines.promotion_1: This will work as payment.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thanks for trusting me, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: What do you need?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm not good at barking orders.
voicelines.depart: Let's go.
voicelines.begin_operation: Exusiai, cover me.
voicelines.4-star_result: Whew... No problem.
voicelines.3-star_result: Weaklings.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A few of them got through.
voicelines.operation_failure: I may have underestimated this operation.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Do you need any supplies? Just let me know.
voicelines.trust_tap: What is it, Doctor?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Zima
biography: Before the Chernobog incident, Zima was a middle school student. In school, she displayed a peculiar interest in fighting and violence. Multiple tests have shown she has the strength and solid constitution characteristic of the Ursus race.Currently, she leads a squad of Vanguard Operators.
description: Zima, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island, will give the squad a tactical advantage with her physical strength at the start of every battle.
quote: She always stands up for her friends, no matter what happens.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'm here to help. So? Whose ass are we kicking next?
voicelines.talk_1: You can't go out without permission? Что? Aren't you the one in charge? Screw the rules, let's just get out.
voicelines.talk_2: You said something? My headphones were on.
voicelines.talk_3: The leader of Rhodes Island looks younger than even Istina. How can you let a kid like that go to battle?!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Why do I stare at you all the time? 'cause I'm onto you, gotta see what you're doing.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.
voicelines.idle: …You really finished all your work?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Not too bad.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?
voicelines.promotion_2: I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.

biography: ...I have chosen an accurate answer for you from 20,593 search results.Operator Ptilopsis. Formerly a data maintenance specialist at the Rhine Lab company. Has made considerable accomplishments in the area of Originium Healing Arts. Experienced in medical data processing, routine medical program applications, multi-project medical operations, and other related fields.Now a member of the medical staff at Rhodes Island. She is also a member Dr. Silence's clinical team and assists with treatment programs at Rhodes Island....
description: Ptilopsis, database maintainer of Rhine Lab, activated. Please enter commands to operate.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Greetings Doctor. How may I assist you?
voicelines.talk_1: Deep Sleep Mode enabled... Zzzzz... Setting advanced config and power interface... Zzzzz…
voicelines.talk_2: My racial traits, in conjunction with my infection, may cause me to fall asleep in mid-conversation. Do not be alarmed.
voicelines.talk_3: I met Dr. Silence at Rhine Lab. I assisted her with data and risk analysis on a secret project.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Warning! Formatting Rhodes Island database... Don't worry. It's just a joke. Please don't panic.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I recommend you refactor my data if optimization fails to increase my performance. This will improve communication efficiency, and Ptilopsis will... Zzzz...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The way I speak? It is a side effect of Originium poisoning. By no means do I enjoy articulating my thoughts this way.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Warning, system has recovered from a fatal error. Reconfiguring to last normal system boot point. Do not be alarmed.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: It is, in fact, quite burdensome to speak in this manner. But this is a necessary measure to prevent the system nexus from being devoured by that other voice. Doctor, if I lose control, please guide me back onto the right path.
voicelines.idle: System... is now in Sleep Mode...
voicelines.onboard: I am Ptilopsis, former data analyst at Rhine Lab. Please submit your orders via the Command Line.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Reading package data… Installation complete.
voicelines.promotion_1: Update installation complete. Ptilopsis's system permissions have been revised.
voicelines.promotion_2: Warning. Reverting Rhodes Island database to previous save state. Time since save state: two years… Just joking. Please calm down. System update complete.
voicelines.added_to_squad: New data used to assemble package build.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Squad leader permissions acquired.
voicelines.depart: Direct memory access for application map and enemy coordinates authorized. Please stand by.

voicelines.4-star_result: Even such a challenging scenario couldn't stop you, Doctor. Perhaps one day you will find the solution to the non-deterministic polynomial time problem.
voicelines.3-star_result: Your logical deduction was absolutely correct. What a perfect calculation.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A number of errors have been detected. Please confirm.
voicelines.operation_failure: A fatal error occurred during the operation. Reboot the system to proceed.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is this place like a disk array?

name: Humus
biography: Humus is the de facto supervisor of a disposal plant in the Columbian wilderness. Referred by a local field office operator, he came to Rhodes Island for Oripathy treatment. He provides his services to Rhodes Island as a member of the Engineering Department, as well as assisting with the disposal of solid waste.
description: Waste management expert Humus firmly believes that everyone and everything has a purpose.
quote: Capable of fixing everything other than his unkempt appearance.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Can I have this printer that's written off? And my gosh, how could you dump that whole pile of paper in the shredder? You can still write on the back!
voicelines.talk_1: Whoa whoa, Stay back. I just finished work, so I'm all sweaty. You need something? If it's not urgent, just go back to your office. Let me wash up and get a change of clothes, then I'll come talk to you.
voicelines.talk_2: Hahaha, Check me out! I made this whole outfit by myself. Yeah, it looks like crap, but it's sturdy! And you see this sickle? I tore a door off a huge car to make it. I've used it for years, and it's good as new.
voicelines.talk_3: See that electric cooker of mine? I made it out of an old heater. And my space heater there, I made it out of an old TV. And As for the TV here, I put that together from the parts of a broken bread maker. Where did I get this bread maker? Aha, I modded an electric cooker I scavenged.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The Pioneer guys are different from us. They get to wander around. Not us. Once you come to the disposal plant, you're staying forever. Think you can run? Not happening, my friend. Look at your supplies, how far could you go? There's nothing but wasteland for miles. Your only shot at survival is staying inside.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You have no idea how heartless those snobs are. They dump just about anyone in the disposal plant. Kids barely old enough to work, old folks in bad health. I can't stand it, but there's not much I can do other than making sure they get fed alongside me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, remember that printer I took off your hands? Here, I fixed it. Oh, but keep an eye on the thermometer up top when you use it. If it goes over the threshold, it could explode.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Yeah, Doctor, I've got a temper, and I can't just sit by and watch bad things happen. In the end, I made the wrong enemies, and got thrown in the disposal plant. A whole decade came and went in the blink of an eye, like a nightmare... But now the dream's gone, and I'm awake! I don't regret it one bit. I'll keep my temper and make no compromises.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Ever since we were kids, if folks like us wanted to eat, we had to count on the scraps the snobs let slip from on high. Sadly, that's not enough to fill your stomach. So some folks end up stealing, naturally. That's not something anyone should do, I know. But if there was another way, why would you need to steal?
voicelines.idle: Whatever it is, it can wait until tomorrow! There's unlimited steak at the canteen today, I'd better get over there right away!
voicelines.onboard: Doctor, Rhodes Island has done so much for me. What can I say except thank you? If you need anything, just say the word. I'll do whatever it takes to make it happen!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Doctor, I can read a little bit, but the jargon in this video is pretty dense. I can barely make any sense of it.
voicelines.promotion_1: What? You're giving me a promotion? Me? For real? Hold up, what was I doing before this?
voicelines.promotion_2: Thanks, Doctor... If only my old man had lived long enough to see this day. His kid... always up to no good... has finally made a name for himself.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Agh... It's been a while since I beat anyone up. Hope I didn't get too rusty.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Yeah, I can be the captain and chaperone these kids. I'll make sure all of them come back alive.
voicelines.depart: Stop right there, you little cubs! Don't just rush in ahead!
voicelines.begin_operation: You come at me like that, you can't blame me for what happens next.
voicelines.deployment_1: Huh? I thought you wanted me here to fix a lock!
voicelines.deployment_2: Whose car is this? I... How should I know?
voicelines.in_battle_2: What, you think you're gonna grind me down with numbers?
voicelines.in_battle_3: There's more of you? Ugh, what a day.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Arghhhh screw it! Bring it on, all of you!
voicelines.4-star_result: Ugh, I just hope these punks learned their lesson.
voicelines.3-star_result: No enemies in sight. But I'm sure they left behind some pretty good stuff.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: No, no, don't chase them. Just let them be. They got beaten so bad, they won't be causing trouble for a long while.
voicelines.operation_failure: Relax, nobody wins every fight. Go home, wash your face. Life goes on.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Man, this bed is too soft. I just can't fall asleep. Could you give me something firmer? That's how I like it.
voicelines.tap: Hm? Need some help? I'm your man.
voicelines.trust_tap: Here, I grabbed you some tangerines from the canteen.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: No matter how busy you are, be sure to eat right, Doctor.

name: Quartz
biography: An unremarkable mercenary from Columbia.Although her combat skills are nothing to write home about, she is nonetheless a dependable operator and an asset to her squad thanks to her excellent adaptability and ability to adjust operational plans on the fly in even the most complicated battlefield environments.
description: Quartz, mercenary. Here per the rules, reporting in.
quote: When on a mission with Quartz, you can be free from the torment of Rhodes Island standard rations.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'm not so good at desk work, but if all you need is someone to stay by your side and help you arrange your tasks and schedule... I can give it a shot, perhaps.
voicelines.talk_1: This pocket watch? My father gave it to me before he left home. It's nothing fancy, but it keeps time if you keep the movement and dial maintained… Uh, Doctor, is there anyone at Rhodes Island who can fix watches?
voicelines.talk_2: Out in the field, you can leave the cooking to me. That's what they had me doing back in the Columbian barrenlands. I can't promise, you know that, it's gonna taste very good… But at least it won't give you a stomachache.
voicelines.talk_3: Back when I was with the Pioneer Team, the company left us undersupplied, and we did not take that sitting down. We ended up escaping into the barrelands. That's when I got this scar on my eye. It's not a disgrace, but it's not a badge of honor either. It's just the kind of bad luck that us regular Columbians deal with all the time. Mine's just a little more obvious than others.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Planning your time and planning your life couldn't be more different. When you're eking out a living, you've got no choice but to use every last second. Even when you space out, you have to keep an eye on the clock. On the other hand, to plan out your life, you need enough time to think and feel. Those aren't contradictory. It's just the second one's more of a luxury to most people.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Is my sword heavy? You bet it is. But I need a heavy one to protect my friends and defend our overdue freedom. The truer the weight I carry is, the mightier I can wield it... And when I'm hurt, it also comes in handy as a walking stick.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: When my mother died, I didn't even get to mourn her. I had a huge pile of medical debt waiting for me to pay off. Why did I join the Pioneer Team, and why did I become a merc? It's not like I had other options. But I came to Rhodes Island after giving it serious thought.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: A free mercenary only takes a mission she thinks is worth the time. There was this one night when I was sitting by the fire, affixing some beast teeth to my sword. My friends were sleeping, and the only sound in the air was my watch ticking away. Time is always on my mind, but that was the first time I really felt its passing.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The mercenary crew I joined was doomed to disband, sooner or later. Without a clear goal and strict discipline, you can't survive in the wilderness… Maybe only an organization like Rhodes Island can really protect what's beautiful out there. I'm thankful that I could come here.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, if you don't need anything from me, I'll just zone out here for a bit... Feel free to talk to me anytime you need me.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. I'm Quartz... I think I'm on time.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I wish our squad could've fought like this back there.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thanks for your recognition, but remember to tell me if there's anything I can improve on.
voicelines.promotion_2: Rhodes Island's promotion process and standards are pretty transparent. That's not easy to do.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Hope I can help.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't worry. I think my decisions through.
voicelines.depart: I propose we begin our operation at the top of the hour. It'll be easier to keep track of time.
voicelines.begin_operation: Hide, and make sure to put out the cooking fire.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Sheathe my weapon for the time being? Then my sword…
voicelines.deployment_2: A bit late, not a big problem.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Time your strike. It's more important than brute strength.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Keep your distance. I only want to strike the enemy.
voicelines.in_battle_3: You're staring at my eyepatch, it reveals a lot.
voicelines.4-star_result: When every phase of the mission proceeds with watchlike precision, victory is assured.
voicelines.3-star_result: This is worth celebrating... When we get back to Rhodes Island, we won't have to eat my cooking anymore.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Even the most accurate of watches isn't always accurate. Don't be so fixated on perfection
voicelines.operation_failure: Sorry, Doctor, we had a few problems with the plan because my watch is broken. Go, and leave the rest to me.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This is much more comfortable than a tent in the wilderness... Will someone stand watch at night?
voicelines.trust_tap: Let's space out together, Doctor. We can chill for as long as we need... No need to watch the clock like we used to.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hello, Doctor. Careful. You almost bumped into my sword.

name: Totter
biography: Totter, real name Totter, is a semi-retired mercenary living in the forests along the border of Victoria. To repay a favor, he left the forests and came to the battlefields of Londinium at great personal risk. After the incident concluded, he chose to occasionally participate as a sniper in Rhodes Island's fieldwork.
description: A mercenary came tottering to us against the blizzard, and Totter he was.
quote: The footprints linger in the snow in pairs, one deep, one shallow.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You keep the place so messy but find what you need anyway? *sigh* Well, that's also a talent, I guess.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, am I able to file for exemption from paperwork? I have a bad case of farsightedness. It's a lot of strain to read, and fatigue strikes easily.
voicelines.talk_2: I'm a repressed sort, not talkative. If you're not entertained, you can head out for now. No, I don't mean to drive you off, I just...
voicelines.talk_3: I don't need to be issued a scope. In my crossbow's killing range, my naked eye sees clearly enough.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My bolt points are a custom make. They pierce armor and cause massive blood loss in a short time. They're based on what Sargon hunters specially use to hunt big beasts, then I made modifications after coming to Victoria. Now they fly lighter, and kill harder.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The merc business is tough, absolutely. Sometimes I'd be in the snow and an entire day would pass on my watch, and my feet would be frostbitten by the end. I appreciate your look of concern, but it was fine. Even lucky. My left foot hurt less when it was frozen.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Why I like snow, you wonder? Let me think... Does never seeing it in Sargon count? Heh, it's not really that deep. People always have their inexplicable fancies.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: ...If it's alright for me to ask, could you read the poem in this book to me, Doctor? I borrowed it from Istina. She says it's a fine poem, about winter in Deity Grypherburg.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Do you know what's most precious? Someone to peacefully watch the snow with. Maybe I've met one at some point before, but who knows? Once the snow descends, it covers all traces of anything, including the fading footprints.
voicelines.idle: How about a mug of hot water? You seem a little pale.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor, I'm Totter. Long-range sniping's my specialty. You can leave any task to me as long as it's a workday.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hold on, Doctor, it's too close. Let me put on my glasses and try again.
voicelines.promotion_1: If you're pleased with my work, then I couldn't ask for more.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you, Doctor, but your appreciation actually leaves me at a loss. Err. If I'm being honest, I don't have big dreams for my work.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Orders ASAP, please.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everyone, please coordinate. Thanks in advance.
voicelines.depart: Let's move. Time waits for nobody.
voicelines.begin_operation: They're fast on the move, but I can still read their tracks.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Great luck. Got a tail wind today.
voicelines.deployment_1: I see clouds rising. Probable hostiles in the snow.
voicelines.deployment_2: I see fowl taking off. Probable ambush in the grass.
voicelines.4-star_result: The best kills are one-shot. Less pain for them.
voicelines.3-star_result: Target down. Mission clear, no setbacks.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: *Tut*, not my best shot.
voicelines.operation_failure: Sorry, Doctor, target's out of range. I can't hit them.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Nice. Luxurious compared to my safehouse.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, is that you? You're blurry, but you've got distinct footsteps. I can tell them apart.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Luo Xiaohei
biography: Luo Xiaohei, a small feline friend recommended by Lee. Kind, but not weak. Brave, yet not reckless. After some tests, he formally joined Rhodes Island as a guard operator.
description: Executor-in-Training Luo Xiaohei, here to protect his friends with all he has.
quote: A lot of what you say flies over his head, but his heart will always take it in.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: This table's really high! I guess it's easier if I just use my old form to jump up.
voicelines.talk_1: What are you doing here? There's these Medic Operators who keep chasing my tail all the time saying they wanna study me! I need to lay low! Still, why are you hiding here too? You're not slacking off, right, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_2: My power is controlling metal, stuff like the thing on your table. I can make it turn pointy, round, or flat, and even more complicated shapes too.
voicelines.talk_3: The people here look a lot like the spirits in our world. So maybe, the spirits in this world look like you do, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: This place is a lot like the Hall for Spirits to me, with all the Infected staying here because they have nowhere to go. But... the Infected have it really different from spirits. They can't even escape just by staying far away from everyone.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: There's so many Catastrophes here... Is this why your cities have to keep wandering everywhere all the time?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I get it! Operators are Executors, aren't they? Executors do errands for the Hall for Spirits, and Operators do errands for Rhodes Island! Huh? No?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'll be an Executor someday, just like my master. My master's really mighty! Um... you too. Everyone on this battleship listens to you, so you've got to be somebody incredible.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, are we friends now? Then if you can, you should visit our side to play sometime!
voicelines.idle: Doctor, are you eating something secret there?
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor, my name's Xiaohei, and I'm a spirit.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Doctor... if I don't understand these tapes, can I ask you about them?
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? What does that mean?
voicelines.promotion_2: I still don't really get it, but thanks, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Doctor, I'm here! Huh? Is there something on my face? Ah, I just finished eating, haha.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm gonna be the captain? Can I handle that...?
voicelines.depart: Doctor, grab onto me, I'll use my power to send us there. It's quicker that way.
voicelines.begin_operation: Are... all of them bad guys?
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Heixiu, we have to help the Doctor out.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Uh-huh, Doctor, I'm here, don't worry.
voicelines.deployment_1: I'm actually pretty good at assassinating.
voicelines.deployment_2: I won't let you hurt them!
voicelines.in_battle_2: If you get any closer, I'll get mean!
voicelines.in_battle_3: I'm super strong! I'll show you how mighty I am!
voicelines.4-star_result: Is everyone okay? I'm so, so glad!
voicelines.3-star_result: There's just mighty people everywhere.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Phew—lucky. You're still fine, right?
voicelines.operation_failure: It's all my fault for being so weak, Doctor...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I can't forget about the mission the Doctor gave me. But this mat's so comfortable, and the sun's so warm. I think I'm getting kinda sleepy...
voicelines.tap: Doctor, don't mess with my ears!
voicelines.trust_tap: What are you still working for, Doctor? It's almost food time!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Chestnut
biography: Chestnut, a geological surveyor of his Durin tribe. A quiet, introverted man, he is adept at using minerals to provide medical treatment with his Originium Arts, and he chose to become a doctor when he came aboveground.
description: This pint-sized doctor puts all his heart into wiping clean the crystal in his hands.
quote: 'Look how beautiful it is,' he says to you, lifting his head.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Um, Doctor, the documents on the shelves are a bit messy. Back home, I had a tabletop assistant device that automatically organized our files. All you had to do was stick the files in, then it would package and seal them. I think you should get something like that too.
voicelines.talk_1: Wanting to see new places is a pretty common reason for leaving home, isn't it? But every time I climb a tall mountain or dive into a deep lake, I feel like I've made the right choice.
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor, are you fan of wide-open landscapes? For example, imagine yourself next to a lake, watching the surface of the water rise and fall, the clouds gathering and dispersing, the sun slowly drooping behind the horizon, painting the lake a dazzling gold... That's the kind of scenery I love.
voicelines.talk_3: A Catastrophe? Are we really going to cruise past a Catastrophe?! I didn't get to see the last one up close, so I can't let this opportunity slip by! Lemme see–– Huh? The door to the bridge is locked?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My staff turns minerals into healing agents, sometimes with other special effects depending on the type of material used. Don't believe me? I'm being serious here, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've helped more and more people, which gives me a sense of accomplishment. But as a physician, I still wish there were fewer and fewer casualties from people fighting each other.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, have you seen fluorescent mushrooms before? There used to be a bunch of them growing by the rocks near the waterfall I played at as a kid. Some of them grew taller than the tallest person in the clan, bringing light to places where the city could not reach.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My original reason for coming above ground was simple – I wanted to survey the geography around my homeland, and soak up the sights and sounds along the way. But the more I traveled, what kept me up here wasn't the places I had been, but the people who needed my help.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, why do people bloody themselves fighting each other? I can treat a wound or two, maybe even a lot more than that, but what can I do as a physician if we can't change their minds?
voicelines.idle: Your desk is still a bit messy. Let me clean things up for you.
voicelines.onboard: Please to meet you, Dr. {@nickname}. This is for you. It's a specimen box made from gemstones I collected – lapis lazuli, turquoise, plum tourmaline, chalcedony...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: The lens doesn't move, Doctor. Do you think if we gave this to Operator Durin, she'd be able to upgrade it so it automatically followed the subject? I should do it, since I thought of it? Hrmm...
voicelines.promotion_1: I... never expected to be promoted so soon! I'll carry on my research into the curative properties of gemstones!
voicelines.promotion_2: I left home so I could realize my dreams, I gained recognition here, and found a place where I could learn even more from my peers in the Medical Department. I've truly found a good job.
voicelines.added_to_squad: The mood among the squad members might deteriorate over time due to injuries sustained in battle...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I don't like war, but that's my personal feelings. As a squad leader, I vow to uphold my responsibility.
voicelines.depart: Be careful, everyone! Nothing's more important than your own safety!
voicelines.begin_operation: Is this really the only way to settle our problems?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I trust the Doctor will lead us to victory.
voicelines.deployment_1: I will take away your pain.
voicelines.deployment_2: Don't worry, I've got your back.
voicelines.in_battle_1: If you feel unwell, report it right away!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Don't push yourself too hard in battle!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Relax, tense muscles will only make your treatment more difficult.
voicelines.4-star_result: The more prep work we do, the more beautiful scenery we'll get to see. Hard work pays off.
voicelines.3-star_result: Now's a great time to watch the sunset. Let's head over there and sit down for a spell.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We fight now so there may be peace later...? If only our enemies felt that way.
voicelines.operation_failure: Run, I'll cover you!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The decor here is really different from back home.
voicelines.tap: Hmm, who's there...? Oh, it's you, Doctor.
voicelines.trust_tap: I'm putting together a new specimen box, Doctor. Want to see it?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Want to head up to the deck for some fresh air?

name: Pudding
biography: Pudding, Columbian electrical engineer. Contracted Oripathy while investigating in the countryside, and came to Rhodes Island to apply for work and seek treatment. Seems to fit in very well as assistant to Closure, having been swiftly dragged away to become a helper at the Engineering Department after her onboarding.
description: Electrical engineer Pudding, putting in assiduous work as Closure's assistant in the Engineering Department.
quote: She can help with anything, anything electrical anyway.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, can I borrow half of your desk? Thank you very much. Huff... Ah, it's a blueprint for a new electrical system. I need to get it drawn up by today. Are you busy too? Let's be partners in overtime, then?
voicelines.talk_1: I've been into electricity ever since I was a kid. Just listening to currents crackling really soothed me. Huh? You think that's weird?
voicelines.talk_2: You learn a lot when you're in Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. The Operators bring weapons and equipment from all over, all sorts of technological applications you've never seen before, and all of them worth plenty of research time. If I put more efforts to my work, I might be able to stay in the Engineering Department.
voicelines.talk_3: This is 'Pillow,' a childhood friend of mine. Our family moved from somewhere way far all the way to Columbia, and I found myself very lonely at school. My mom gave me Pillow to keep me company. Oh, Doctor, you should know it can't speak!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I got into an accident while I was on a lone study out in the country, and was unable to contact the rescue team. Pillow and I had to make it all the way back to inhabited land on foot. After that... I didn't really want to go out doors.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My dreams... that I work well, and everyday is a nice day. Also, I want to buy a holiday villa in Sami, and after my parents are retired, they can live there together... yeah, I've gotta stay healthy, and keep on trucking until they retire.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Since I was little, my mom and dad would find time every year to take me to the tundras on vacation. We're all really into cold places! Although if I wanted to cover the cost for my own vacations, I'd have to go pick up work in the city again.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Haah, *yawn*... Sorry, Doctor, can I take a break here for a little bit...? Ever since this new project kicked off, the shift schedule's been completely crazy! I still have to go check over the base station later...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: To tell the truth, I've wanted to try going outdoors lately. I've gotten to know a lot of people in the same line as me at Rhodes Island, and I wanna experience more along with them. At least... I'm not ever going to be stuck on my own again, not now.
voicelines.idle: Oh, the Doctor's asleep…? Well, I'd better turn this machine down a bit. It's kind of loud…
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm an electrical engineer from Columbia, codename... Well, Closure suddenly started calling me 'Pudding', but I don't know if that's too weird...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: So this is how professionals fight… Alright, I'd better put in some training if I'm gonna make it through this safely.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you for the recognition. I still have a ways to go compared to Rhodes Island's other Operators, so if there's any more high-effort work, throw it my way. If I just get enough sleep, I can hold out for some real long shifts.
voicelines.promotion_2: Combat missions in the tundra? At this point, I think I can be of help. Doctor, thank you, and all of Rhodes Island for always encouraging me. I'd like to pitch in some of my own strength now.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm being assigned to combat? Just give me a bit more time to get ready... I... I can do this.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I don't have much confidence in commanding, but I do know a thing or two about basic survival in the countryside.
voicelines.depart: Pillow, don't you go leaving my sight.
voicelines.begin_operation: Getting shocked hurts, you know?
voicelines.4-star_result: Mission complete. Right now, I got the same feeling I get seeing a blueprint come perfectly to life. What a relief!
voicelines.3-star_result: That wasn't too bad of a job... heheh, can you put this in my evaluation?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Ugh... no. A discrepancy like this should be totally avoidable.
voicelines.operation_failure: Everyone, orderly retreat, please! I don't want anyone to fall behind!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Phew, now where should I put Pillow...
voicelines.trust_tap: Ahh... please don't throw out any of the pink household goods in the Engineering Department. Those are for overtime use!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Good morning, Doctor. *yawn*... I should probably catch up on some sleep.

name: Roberta
biography: Roberta, a well-known makeup artist from Columbia. At her own insistence, has been evaluated by the Engineering Department, displaying accomplishment in the field of automated machinery. With Closure's approval, has become an operator aboard Rhodes Island.
description: Makeup artist Roberta is here to provide you with custom beautification services.
quote: To keep you looking sharp, she doesn't mind taking on some of Rhodes Island's other work.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hello, Doctor. Have you figured out the style you wanna go with today? Huh...? You didn't call me here for that? I really, really hope you can give it at least a little more thought. Please?
voicelines.talk_1: Watch out! I've got tons of stuff in my pocket here. If this negative ion hair softener bumps into the horn growth stimulant and spills... Well... I could end up getting hanged on the deck! It's no joke!
voicelines.talk_2: You've probably heard how assassins who know their stuff in anatomy work more efficiently, no? Of course, my goal's not to take anyone's hope to survive away. Instead, I want to turn that hope into something more vivid and brilliant! Styling is an art, but it's also a science!
voicelines.talk_3: She looks familiar... Is that the girl who shows up in all those kung fu movies? Whoa, don't ever tell her I'm here! Nah, it's not her that I'm afraid of, but I really don't wanna run into her stylist, Lauder! The last thing I need is anybody calling me 'Bobbi'...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm a researcher, not a modeler, and I definitely don't want to be the kind of girl who works her mindless brush on monotonous faces under spot light day in and day out! Coming on the ship's been kind of like a vacation to me, I guess? If I had to stare at those lifeless faces all day, my brain would get completely fried sooner or later. I'm not doing that no matter how much I get paid.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: If I got no money, I can't buy any new tools or materials. That's why even I got to work sometimes. Hm... I think the girl who came to me last time just got an academy award? She'd be fine to spot me, right?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, I asked Dr. Warfarin for some info about your body... and modified my brush texture based around that. I promise you it won't trigger any allergies this time!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: If you want to touch my hair, go right ahead. It's pretty messy already anyway. Is that weird? When you do styling work for as many people as I do, you definitely won't find yourself in the mood to work on yourself even if you have the time.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Interesting faces are like stories in their own right. Dr. {@nickname}, you are like... a kinda damaged videotape, waiting for someone to dust you off. If the day ever comes that you get repaired, what kind of story will you reveal?
voicelines.idle: Did you really fall asleep? In that case, I guess I can get to work? Your bone structure, your skin... Whoa, this is even more spectacular than I thought!
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm Roberta! We meet again! Once I sign here, I'll be your personal stylist, right? Huh... 'You'll be an operator?' Doesn't matter as long as I get to stay!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Beat up all the annoying guys, right? No more difficult than swinging ten brushes around while taking a sip of coffee. I'm from Siracusa, after all.
voicelines.promotion_1: I've got an entire room full of medals like this one back in my studio in Wrankwood... Hey, Doctor, can't you give me something a little more interesting for my reward?
voicelines.promotion_2: Since you're giving me another promotion, I want a bigger studio. You'll approve it, right?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Should I go with eyeshadow palette #3001... or perhaps #3002?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Doesn't look like we have a color base that works for all of us...
voicelines.depart: Let's go, everyone! I'll do the re-touch in case your makeup slides off.
voicelines.begin_operation: I know exactly which part of the face is the most fragile!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: You gotta put on the most suitable style even when you're giving out commands in the frontlines.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: These real battlefields give me so much more inspiration than any film set I've been to.
voicelines.deployment_1: Bring your face closer this way, okay? Thanks. I'll pay attention to how much force I use.
voicelines.deployment_2: Even the biggest stars out there gotta book me in advance, you know? You should count yourselves lucky!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Infused Originium Slug acid styling spray!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Facial bone full structured self-image shading highlighter!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Wet/Dry ambient color adapted lipstick and blusher!
voicelines.4-star_result: Whoa... Not even I can replicate that look on your face right now.
voicelines.3-star_result: What a perfect operation. Makes me want to add a few more touches to bring out that joy on your face.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: There's nothing as boring as watching the cowards run. They always stiffen up like Rock Spiders that've spent a bit too much time in antiseptics.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, need me to give your face a little blush? If you go back like this, the others might worry when they look at you.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can I do my experiments here? Relax, I won't blow the walls out. At most... I guess the doors and windows might bend a little?
voicelines.tap: Didn't I say I'm not seeing anyone...? Oh, it's you.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, can I come over to your room this evening? Your face could really use a massage.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey, Doctor, want to try this new look I designed just for you?

name: Indigo
biography: A wandering Caster from Iberia. Indigo used to be an apprentice lighthouse keeper at a seashore lighthouse. During her travels, she met Blue Poison and Glaucus while they were on a field operation, and came onboard after receiving a referral from Blue Poison.
description: Caster Indigo, come bearing a light.
quote: Don't ask for her opinions on Rhodes Island's current lighting systems, unless you're looking forward to a deck-wide lightshow.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hm... Huh? Did you say something? W-Why, I'm not ignoring you... I'm just... thinking of something else.
voicelines.talk_1: I... I'm not very good at making conversation. I've always been alone. When I first left home to the outside world, I came across many people who were afraid of me. I even got my things stolen. It's no problem, though... As long as I still have my staff, I can work, so I don't often go hungry for long.
voicelines.talk_2: Life inside the lighthouse was hardly boring at all. The seas are always changing. However, my teacher drove me out of the lighthouse, and said to me, 'If you don't see more of this world, you won't be able to protect even a small corner of the sea.' That's how I made my way here.
voicelines.talk_3: Blue Poison gave me a new pair of gloves. Pretty, aren't they? She said the materials are improved as well. With these, it'll be harder for me to come in contact with any poison even if I hang out with my poison-wielding friends more. Actually, since I've been touching poisons by mistake all the time... it seems I may have built up an immunity.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I used to gaze out at the sea each and every night. No one in town knew what it was we were guarding, and my teacher never told me. All I know is that, where there is darkness, there must always be lighthouses. I will stand firm, with all my power, until that day comes.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Some people say this light is Originium Arts, but according to my teacher, this is a power that originates from my heart. With the light's guidance, those who sail through the foggiest nights will be able to resist the raging tides and find the correct bearing. That is why I will do my best to protect this light.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My tail has a beautiful color? Thank you very much. It's okay. You may touch it. Despite the color, it's not poisonous.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My hair can get tangled up if they get too long. Could you hold it for me? It takes time to get my hair set properly, but it makes it much easier to stay on the move while I'm on the battlefield. I want to be able to help you even more.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I've been starting to think that humans and lighthouses are very much alike... Some people can shine much farther and brighter than even lighthouses. Like you, Doctor. Would it be okay if I stay beside you for a little longer before I go back?
voicelines.idle: You don't need me to keep watch while you're asleep? Huh? You want me to join you? I-I'll try...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. My name is Aria... Uh, my mistake. It's Indigo. I used to be a lighthouse keeper... apprentice. Now, I'm a Caster... Also an apprentice. Please look after me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Are these techniques for fending off enemies? My teacher taught me a little, but I didn't know you could do this.
voicelines.promotion_1: Huh...? A promotion? A lighthouse needs only one keeper. Is that... not the case here?
voicelines.promotion_2: Eh? I can do much more? It's true. My light is able to shine on a much larger area than before... Thank you. I will keep doing all I can.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Indigo at the ready.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Very well... I'll keep this light up. Please be careful not to wander off.
voicelines.depart: Follow the light, please.
voicelines.begin_operation: If you won't let us pass through, then we have no choice but to defeat all of you.
voicelines.in_battle_1: These enemies do not compare to the seas' ferocity.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I will stand guard here until daybreak.
voicelines.in_battle_3: It's only for the evil in your heart that you fear the light.
voicelines.in_battle_4: If you want to run away, let me guide you.
voicelines.4-star_result: Why, if we are so strong, perhaps we don't need to fear the coming of that day.
voicelines.3-star_result: Thank goodness. Another calm evening.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: S-Some enemies got away? I saw. We must let everyone know.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, this way... Don't be afraid. It doesn't matter how dark the path up ahead is, I'll light it for you.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's okay. I'll be fine by myself.
voicelines.tap: Oh... Be careful... My hair's all tangled up... It'll hurt if I trip...
voicelines.trust_tap: You will stay here with me? Why, if there's two of us, the nights won't feel as quiet.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, would you like me to make the light brighter?
