name: Beanstalk
biography: Professional Metal Crab breeder Beanstalk was born into a family of Columbian farmers. Although she has sent a variety of proposals to large corporations and business platforms, her attempts at courting their financial support have proven largely unfruitful, and she was advised to seek employment at Rhodes Island.Having passed our examinations, she has been granted official operator status, and is now providing Rhodes Island with logistics and reconnaissance services
description: Top specialist Metal Crab breeder Beanstalk, commanding her Metal Crab teams to guard the frontline.
quote: Carefully examine any expense applications she submits. Once in a while, her contracts hide tiny traps.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Want my help? Hehe, I'll think about it if you give my buddies three days of luxury pet food! How about it, sounds like a deal, isn't... Hey, wait up! I'm just kidding! Don't go!
voicelines.talk_1: Outta the way, outta the way~ Beanstalk Breeding Center coming right through! Watch your feet! Careful not to step on any of us~
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor! Click is here at Rhodes Island? I can't believe you haven't ever told me! I'm a huge fan of her outdoorsy videos! She called Pea cute, and she even said she'll bring Pea along the next time she goes on a shoot!
voicelines.talk_3: There's been all these morons saying they'd go mining and then dug up a bunch of holes out in the wilderness. Fine, but how dare they make a mess of everyone's home! If I ever catch those bastards, I'm blowing a hole in their asses with my crossbow!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, I'm done with my breeding proposal. Take a look, will ya? Huh? The budget doesn't add up...? Tsk, he found out, huh? Oh, my bad! I probably got the numbers messed up somewhere! I'll get it fixed right away~
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Before I came to Rhodes Island, I sent my resume to so many companies out there, and they all turned me down. Well, just look at how helpful my little buddies are now, both in the battlefield and in logistics. Those big shots only have themselves to blame. It's their loss!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You see, Pea may be the smallest of the Metal Crabs I brought with me, but she's also the brightest of the bunch! She's gonna be so amazing in the future~! My little buddies are nothing like the normal Metal Crabs out there. They're so smart! They won't be controlled by anyone out there so easily!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: 1, 2! 1, 2! Line up! Defense position, and block! Okay! All of you are doing amazing! Here's your reward. Eat up~! Let's switch it up now. Attac—Whoa, Doctor, how long've you been here? How come you're always so quiet when you walk?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My old man doesn't really support me raising my little pals. He says they're useless, and that I'd be better off raising burdenbeasts. Hmph, I'm show him. I'll make it big with my buddies, and we'll see if he has anything to say then! Hey, Doctor, have you ever thought of investing in me? I guarantee you you'll be raking in lots of money!
voicelines.idle: Alright, focus! Doctor, you can't just space out while you're working. Take a look at what a good girl Pea is. Be more like her.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. My name's Beanstalk. Starting today, I'll be... Eh? What's in my case? Oh, this is Peacake. Here, Pea, say hi to the Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Aha! That was awesome! Did you see that, Pea?
voicelines.promotion_1: Ehe, you're promoting us because of how well we did in the last operation, right?
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, thanks for giving me and my buddies a chance to prove ourselves! I'll cut the formalities. We'll get even more amazing than this! You're in for a surprise!
voicelines.added_to_squad: It's our time to shine~
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Alright! Everyone, do what I say!
voicelines.depart: Team Beanstalk, here we go!
voicelines.begin_operation: Huh? Are these who we're up against?
voicelines.deployment_1: Go! Show them what we've got!
voicelines.in_battle_3: I won't let you get past us!
voicelines.in_battle_4: You assholes! I won't let you hurt my buddies!
voicelines.4-star_result: Hehe, you guys are no match for us~
voicelines.3-star_result: Mission complete~! How's that? My buddies did great, huh?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Oh, some of them got through! Wait here, Doctor. I'll go after them!
voicelines.operation_failure: *Sob*. It's okay, everyone. Don't cry. I'll beat those jackasses up next time!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I don't mind sleeping anywhere. Where's the breeding room, though?
voicelines.tap: Why'd you do that? Stop pulling my ribbon!
voicelines.trust_tap: Hm? What's up? Wanna pet Pea?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Pinecone
biography: Pinecone is a former construction worker from Columbia. After she became involved in the Mansfield incident, she came to Rhodes Island to seek work alongside Mountain. Owing to her previous work experience, she is currently assigned to the Engineering Department as an assistant to some of our operators there.
description: Construction worker Pinecone, all spaced out while she gets the job done.
quote: She looks half-asleep, but her work's laser-accurate. How does she do it?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor? No, I wasn't taking a nap! I... I was just spacing out!
voicelines.talk_1: Is it raining outside? I used to really hate rainy days... There's mud everywhere, and the rain affects construction. My father always came home really late on those days. But it also feels really comfortable once the rain lets up, and it feels really nice to just stay inside my room, just like what we are doing right now.
voicelines.talk_2: When I used to be a construction worker back in Columbia, every day was a struggle. I had to get up early every morning and go to bed late every night. Sometimes, I even had to work overtime and didn't have any time to sleep...
voicelines.talk_3: Oh, Doctor, would you like to go somewhere together? Hm? Ahh...! W-Where's my tool bag...? Did I leave it at the construction site again? I-I'm sorry, I'll be back right away!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: What I want to do...? Hmm... as long as I have a stable job and get to live a honest life, I think that's good enough for me. In that case, why did I become an operator here, you ask? Well... The pay is a little better, and the work here isn't all that different, either... so I thought I'd give it a try... I guess?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The Infected... There were a lot of Infected workers in Columbia... Everyone told me to stay away from them, but, just going by the way they work, I don't think they're any different from the rest of us.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Oh... What was it that Ms. Closure wanted me to do for her again...? She's gonna be really mad if I go back and ask her... Um, Doctor? Do you think you can help me out...?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My father always told me to study hard if I want a better life. Doctor, you know all sorts of things, right? Do you think you can teach me? I'll try my best to not zone out. I'll really try to.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I never thought that much about the future before. I figured I would find work in the exploration teams and work as a craftsman my whole life. But now... I really need to thank the big guy. I wouldn't have met you if it wasn't for him... Uh... A-Anyway, I really appreciate what he did for me.
voicelines.idle: Fwahh... I'm so tired... I guess maybe I'll take a nap with the Doctor...
voicelines.onboard: Codename Pinecone... I'm starting at Rhodes Island today... Um... Have you seen my portable battery?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Um... Umm... I don't get it...
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you, Doctor... But what should I do now? Oh... Do I just need to follow the others' examples? All right...!
voicelines.promotion_2: Hm...? Another promotion? Ehehe, you're pretty forgetful yourself, Doctor. Didn't you already give me a promot—This is a new one? Um... Okay. I'll always listen to what you say. So, when are we leaving?
voicelines.added_to_squad: It's my turn to shine now.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I guess it's just like being foreman at a construction site?
voicelines.depart: Um... Where are we going again...?
voicelines.begin_operation: It's the enemy! Don't hold back, anyone!
voicelines.deployment_2: I'll stay right here like a nail.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I still have lots of batteries on me!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Just gotta think of it as driving nails!
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew... That was a lot harder than building a house. Doctor, that makes us kinda impressive, don't you think?
voicelines.3-star_result: That was perfect... Doctor, are you happy with how we did?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hmm... Maybe I did it in the wrong order...? I'm sorry. It didn't go as well as I was hoping.
voicelines.operation_failure: Eh? Why are there sparks... S-Sorry... It's all my fault...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Yes, is there anything that needs maintaining?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, want to watch the rain together? There's not much to see, though...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Bubble
biography: A young warrior girl from a tribe of Sargon Ceratos, she is inexperienced, with no knowledge of the norms and customs for interacting with others. Her father sent her to Rhodes Island, ostensibly for 'training,' but actually to treat her Oripathy. She uses a massive shield as a weapon, relying on charging and bashing tactics. She needs Rhodes Island training to ensure she doesn't make any catastrophic mistakes in actual combat.
description: Defender Operator Bubble isn't scared of anything.
quote: Well, she's a little scared of getting yelled at.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Let's see what goodies the Doctor hides in this drawer.
voicelines.talk_1: I'm probably only about as big as one of Papa's legs right now, but I'm gonna be as big as him and trample over all the bad guys! Graaagh!
voicelines.talk_2: I'm really, really sorry! I won't run in the hallways ever again!
voicelines.talk_3: Fighting is easy. I point my shield one way, and nobody can beat me. Huh? What if they get behind me? Uh oh, why didn't I think of that?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Gavial? Never heard of her. She's tough? And famous in Sargon? Okay, whatever. I'll see for myself how tough she is.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Oh, you're talking about Gavial? I'm Gavial's number one fan. See, she even signed my shield for me. That's her autograph! I think, besides Papa, pretty much nobody could take down Gavial.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, shhh, tell me the truth. Kay says Vulcan can hammer straight through the floor, can she? No? I knew it. That means my Papa is definitely stronger. He could bust down a Rhodes smoke stack with one punch.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Do I really... have to keep writing this...? Fine... 'I knocked over Lancet-2 today. I won't do it again.'
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: This is my shield. It'll be one of my greaves someday, or maybe a pauldron. Then as long as I'm standing behind you, hehe, nobody'll ever bully you.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, wake up! Somebody's here to see you.
voicelines.onboard: You're the boss of this training camp? And they call you the Doctor? Hrm... But you don't look strong... Whatever. I'm Bubble. I may be the weakest in my tribe right now, but you're gonna train me until I'm the second strongest.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hit 'em! Hit 'em again! What, why'd they stop. Is it over?
voicelines.promotion_1: A reward for my training? Great! I can't eat it? Grrr...
voicelines.promotion_2: I think I got a good chance of beating Kay now! Okay, lemme at her. Doctor, you come watch!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Be good? I'll try.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I count down to one and we charge, okay?
voicelines.depart: Chaaarge!
voicelines.begin_operation: Waaar!
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, if you're strong enough, you gotta be warrior like my Papa!
voicelines.3-star_result: What did I tell you? I'm super strong.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Huh? Some of them got away? Did I let them through?
voicelines.operation_failure: I can't beat them! What do I do?!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I need a way, waaay bigger room. How can anyone live in a little place like this?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, let's play hide-and-seek!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Arene
biography: Operator Arene is a Laterano-born Sankta who was exiled from Laterano after contracting Oripathy during a Laterano firearm inheritance-related incident several years ago. After he departed Laterano, he left for Leithanien to pursue further studies. Having passed a battery of examinations, he is currently serving as a Rhodes Island Guard Operator and receiving treatment.
description: Vanguard Operator Arene, always taking pleasure in toying with his enemies on the field.
quote: Don't come too close. It's dangerous.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: The files are in order. Is that all we have to do today? Why don't we talk about the operation the other day, Professor?
voicelines.talk_1: Try not to come too close when I use Arts, okay? Not moving out of the way? Okay, if you insist.
voicelines.talk_2: Why do I call you 'Professor', you ask? Because I'm actually learning quite a lot from you. The placement of personnel on the battlefield, how to command, among other things... What more reason do we need?
voicelines.talk_3: Here, you can have this. I think it's some sort of candy? No need to thank me. I got it from someone else anyway, and I don't really like these things very much.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You don't see Sankta using staves much? The guys who shoot up everything day and night and solve all their problems with violence must have given you a bad impression. Not all Sankta use guns as their weapons. At the very least, I don't like them.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Rather than sharing a single secret, we should exchange our secrets with each other. That's how you build a strong, equal relationship. So if you want to learn any of my secrets, you better come up with something just as saucy for me, Professor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There are no Infected in Laterano. Once a Sankta contracts Oripathy, he is immediately exiled. But even if you become Infected, no matter where you are, you still enjoy all kinds of privilege as a Laterano... You just don't get to set foot in your homeland again, that's all.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My parents' will left me with quite a bit of trouble, and it was really a hassle to get it taken care of. If it wasn't for that uptight executor making things difficult for me, it all could've been much easier... Oh, whatever, it still went according to plan.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I want to capture a few people to try out some new Arts in our next operation. I can't...? Alright, fine. It's a shame, but if that's what you say, Professor, maybe some other time, then. Eh? Not this time, and not ever? Geez, don't be so uptight.
voicelines.idle: Are you asleep? People who fall asleep at work get their faces drawn on, you know...? Just kidding, I know you're awake.
voicelines.onboard: Codename Arene, officially joining today, it seems. So you are the Doctor... I hope we'll get along, Professor {@nickname}.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Studying tactics? Sounds kinda interesting.
voicelines.promotion_1: This doesn't seem all that different than before. Or are you going to teach me some secret strategies you have, Professor?
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, you aren't testing me, are you? Alright then, I'm just getting in the mood. Okay, starting right now, whatever that happens is going to be our own little secret.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Okay, I'll follow your orders.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: So actual combat for my next assignment? Okay, let me think about the placement...
voicelines.depart: As long as we achieve our goals, it doesn't matter if the process of getting there is a little rough, huh?
voicelines.begin_operation: Welcome. I'll be waiting.
voicelines.deployment_2: I can do whatever I want, right?
voicelines.in_battle_3: Tell me. How are you feeling right now?
voicelines.in_battle_4: That's not a bad scream at all.
voicelines.4-star_result: That went far better than I expected. I shouldn't have thought so little of you.
voicelines.3-star_result: That was just as expected. No surprises, even a little boring.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A few of them slipped past. Should I go after them? Strategically speaking, I don't recommend it.
voicelines.operation_failure: This is quite the bad situation... I shouldn't have to tell you what the appropriate course of action is now, right?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Isn't there a closer room to the Professor's?
voicelines.trust_tap: We have some time to spare. Why don't we review our last mission, Professor?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: You look tired. It's okay if you sleep a little longer, Professor.

name: Aciddrop
biography: A street girl of Columbia, born to a normal working-class family. Her parents are both truck drivers and often work through the night, pushing Aciddrop out to the streets at a young age. From practicing skateboarding in her spare time after school to becoming a champion at local skateboarding tournaments, Aciddrop has become a renowned street icon throughout the city, and her success has drawn countless haters in the process. During a deliberate fight, Aciddrop was infected with Originium dust, later coming to Rhodes Island to seek treatment.
description: Aciddrop, Rhodes Island Operator, is a free-spirited skateboard warrior.
quote: Goes around in circles for a week before hitting the target.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: No problem, Doctor. I've got your back.
voicelines.talk_1: How do I aim while I'm skating? It's real simple, want me to show you? Here, put your hand on mine.
voicelines.talk_2: Way back when, I, like a lot of my friends, took pride in being different. But after I became infected, I realized that alone wasn't cool. Life isn't something that you should let a little bit of Originium dust control, you gotta take charge yourself.
voicelines.talk_3: An old cop taught me how to shoot with a crossbow, and his daughter taught me how to skate. As for how to put the two together... that's called being self-taught.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Don't get me wrong, skateboarding is just one of my hobbies... and the first way I had to really find myself. The real exciting part comes after that though, wanna hear?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Why'd I want to become a combat operator...? Doctor, what do you think is most important for us giggling and laughing 'street gangsters?' Of course it's freedom. I'm willing to fight for freedom, so that's why I'm fighting for Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I have a lot of regrets about becoming Infected, such as the graffiti mural at the park that I left half-finished. Also, I can't eat any more of that old cop's secret-formula onion rings, huh? That's about it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I came to Rhodes Island with the mindset of getting my illness treated. Thought it'd be some stuffy place that reeked of disinfectant where everyone would be confined to their rooms... But man, I was surprised to find out, even though tagging isn't allowed inside the ship and all, that Ethan guy... Actually, nevermind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I found a way to express myself through donut hamburger combo meals, skateboarding, and hip-hop competitions. How 'bout you, Doctor? If you get burnt out, you should come kick it with me and Vigna. We'll just... hang out. Hanging out is in our DNA. Gotta respect it.
voicelines.idle: If you're tired, just go rest. I'll be here.
voicelines.onboard: Aciddrop, Operator. This skateboard here is a piece of registered equipment, yeah. If you have any problems, just give me a holler.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Damn, that's cool.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion, huh? Thanks. The last time this happened was when I just won the Crab Cup, huh?
voicelines.promotion_2: That old geezer originally taught me to use a crossbow so I could protect myself from the chaos on the streets. Who would've thought that one day, I'd be using it to protect the freedom of the Infected?
voicelines.added_to_squad: You got it.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Teamwork's an important part of scoring as well.
voicelines.depart: Let's go.
voicelines.begin_operation: Enemy sighted.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: C'mon, how do I deal with these guys?
voicelines.deployment_1: Now this is some exciting stuff.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Time to show off a bit.
voicelines.4-star_result: Good work out there, Doctor... Oh, can you come with me to get a couple screws switched out after we get back?
voicelines.3-star_result: The moment when you overcome a challenge is always the best feeling, right?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Should we chase after 'em? If you ask me, I can still catch up.
voicelines.operation_failure: Ugh... Can't believe I messed up such an amateur move...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This bit of wall here looks pretty suitable... Uh, I didn't say anything.
voicelines.trust_tap: Wanna head down to the canteen together? If I don't make any mistakes on this trip, promise to treat me to some juice.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Jaye
biography: Lungmen seafood hawker, introduced to us by Officer Hoshiguma, onboarded as an operator after testing. Skilled in the use of knives, currently serves as a Specialist Operator, and a lively presence on the battlefield.
description: Jaye, Specialist Operator, will use his expert knife skills to force enemies back.
quote: He is rather terrifying when he's out there fighting.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Need a midnight snack, Boss?
voicelines.talk_1: Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.
voicelines.talk_2: When I'm off, I practice cooking... Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?
voicelines.talk_3: ...Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun, but not exactly safe.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me permission to use Rhodes Island's special channels to get some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I've been told that with my looks, plus my knife skills, I was born to be evil. I didn't like that, but what could I do...? After coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just do what makes me happy.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.
voicelines.idle: Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading.
voicelines.onboard: Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Huh, so cooking and warfare are pretty much the same.
voicelines.promotion_1: Boss, does this mean I can spread out a bit more?
voicelines.promotion_2: Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy as food, this battle thing is a lot easier.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Oh, I forgot to close up...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I know how to lead a fishing crew.
voicelines.depart: ...Oh? We're going?
voicelines.begin_operation: That's a lot.
voicelines.4-star_result: Boss, did we just do something special?
voicelines.3-star_result: Boss, is it... over?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Boss, should we go after them?
voicelines.operation_failure: Boss, I think we should probably run.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall...
voicelines.trust_tap: Boss, I don't know if you have any vices...
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey Boss, the weather's not bad today.

name: Click
biography: Operator Click, an independent video producer who is popular online, mostly shoots content of natural scenery and survival in the wilderness. She decided on her own to join Rhodes Island and serves as a Caster, but primarily works on providing support from the rear and recording battle footage.
description: Click, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, has been shooting video footage non-stop.
quote: If possible, hit that Like button on her work.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Don't you just need me to push some papers around? I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, hurry up and check out my new video. You're gonna love it.
voicelines.talk_2: Yeah, that's the icon. Mind clicking on it for me? And if possible, can you click that icon next to it? Hehe, thanks a bunch.
voicelines.talk_3: Raw footage! Ideas! Plotlines! I can't think up any content! I'm gonna lose subs......
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'm just an amateur explorer. I only plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, how could being outdoors be as cozy as chilling in my room?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The folks in the Medical Department must've put some weird ideas in your head again. Look, I admit, I get weird impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any trouble.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My unique skill is video editing. Did you wanna do a Rhodes Island promo, Doctor? Got a plan for me? All righty, let's take a look. Hmm... Rhodes Island precautions, balanced diet videos, fire safety videos... What the hell are these?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My instincts are telling me, there's a terrible Feline approaching, Doctor. Don't let your guard down. The moment you're distracted, they'll jump out of a dark corner and smack you to the ground in a single swipe of the paw. Eh? They won't?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The joy of living together with everyone, and the thrill of finding new things to film go hand in hand! It is for that reason I decided to become an operator, so I can share my happiness with you.
voicelines.idle: Time to quietly sneak in a photo op. Mm, just one.
voicelines.onboard: 'Sup everyone, this is the Click Channel! Eh? I'm not allowed to take footage of the Doctor's office? Fine...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Let me do the filming next time.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? Sweet! Let's take a group photo to celebrate the occasion, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_2: Relax, Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but there's nothing to be afraid of.
voicelines.added_to_squad: 'Sup, everyone!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Leave it to me!
voicelines.depart: Doctor, you'd better not forget anything~
voicelines.begin_operation: Let's see what interesting things can be filmed this time~
voicelines.4-star_result: That was a sweet clip I just got! Make sure to come by and watch it after you return to the ship.
voicelines.3-star_result: Wonderful! We can just use this as a real-time battle record!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I was too caught up with filming that someone slipped through.
voicelines.operation_failure: My lens broke...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: My video studio's about to open!
voicelines.trust_tap: Hey Doctor, lemme show you something good!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Podenco
biography: Podenco is an operator who applied to join Rhodes Island through a normal process, and is responsible for taking care of the greenhouse and cultivating flowers in Perfumer's Convalescent Garden. Can also be deployed as a combat operator and is capable of utilizing her understanding of plants to heal teammates or disrupt enemies.
description: Podenco, Supporter Operator, brings a touch of floral fragrance to an otherwise tense battlefield.
quote: Her fragrance is so soothing, enough to make people drop on the spot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Ehehe~ Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?
voicelines.talk_1: This is a floral tea that I made myself! Doctor, come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day!
voicelines.talk_2: The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfortable. Even though I'm an operator, it sometimes makes me want to slack.
voicelines.talk_3: Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget about their sorrows and worries. That's probably the tenet of all gardeners, don't you think~?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I much rather prefer growing things to destroying them. But as long as I think about how I can help everyone, I can muster up my courage.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: These bottles? Inside are all the pollen and seeds that I've been collecting. I usually wear a gas mask and gloves before handling them, or I might get poisoned.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Umm, everyone seems to be a bit weary these days. But, I'm sure they'll cheer right back up when they see the flowers I've planted!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? It seems like everyone's been really busy the last few days... If nobody comes by the greenhouse, the blooming season's going to pass right by. Wouldn't that be a darn shame?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Tending to the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as I can make others smile with the flowers I grow, all my hard work will be worth it!
voicelines.idle: Doctor? Oh, you're asleep... I hope the fragrance of these petals can drift over to your dreams.
voicelines.onboard: Doctor, this is Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love if you could come by the greenhouse!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Aw, I thought this was a video about gardening techniques.
voicelines.promotion_1: Artist? N-n-no, I'm just a normal gardener.
voicelines.promotion_2: Look, Doctor! The new varieties I've been tending to for so long have finally started to bloom! Aren't they so pretty?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Hm? Am I coming along as well?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Ah... I only have experience in tending a greenhouse. Is there anything I can do?
voicelines.depart: I see the enemy! Everyone, let's go!
voicelines.begin_operation: Everyone, make sure to take care of yourselves!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Ah, I'll take care of them.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I've seen weeds like these before.
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew, is it safe already? Good job, everyone!
voicelines.3-star_result: Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, everyone is awaiting your next orders.
voicelines.operation_failure: Ah... I never thought things could become like this...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Shall we plant some flowers over here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Jackie
biography: A former Columbian auxiliary police officer who came to Rhodes Island to receive treatment after contracting Oripathy. With her father's consent, she joined Rhodes Island as an operator, displaying above average talent in close combat and participating in various missions.
description: Jackie, Guard Operator, is always brimming with energy.
quote: Watching her, you feel like all your worries could disappear without a trace.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, let me help!
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, you've been sitting there for a while, that's really unhealthy. Come do some stretches with me! Exercise and recover your energy. That way, you'll be able to work better.
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's really amazing! I've only ever seen her in recruitment ads before! She's also a really good person! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor, I'm actually pretty lithe for my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts... Arts something. Ah, right, Arts Unit! I applied for one out of habit when I came here, but I still prefer my fists over Arts.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Even though I know I'm very lucky, I only realized how badly other Infected are doing after coming to Rhodes Island... Doctor, what can I do to help? I really want to help them!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: ...Hm? Ah, Doctor! I'm writing a letter to my dad. Eh, I haven't introduced my dad to you yet? He's a really amazing policeman, you know! Let me tell you how great he is!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Actually, it was my dad who suggested Rhodes Island. After he found out you could treat Oripathy, he pushed really hard for me to be able to come here. I don't really want to be away from him, but I know that he'll be happiest if I live a healthy life.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You're really reliable, although dad is still better. Yup, you're now the second most reliable person in my heart! Hehe. Ah, Doctor, I talked a lot about you in my letters to dad. He said he really wants to meet you!
voicelines.idle: Doc——! Ah, Doctor's asleep. I'll have to be quieter...
voicelines.onboard: Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm the new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Let's get along!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Amazing... It feels even more amazing than dad...
voicelines.promotion_1: Eh, am I being promoted? Wow, that's great!
voicelines.promotion_2: I've learnt a lot living at Rhodes Island... Maybe I can even catch up to dad one day! Doctor, I'll continue to work hard. Please guide me well~
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm here!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll work hard!
voicelines.depart: Let's do our best!
voicelines.begin_operation: Mission start!
voicelines.deployment_2: Time for me to show my power!
voicelines.in_battle_4: I'll do it in one go!
voicelines.4-star_result: I thought we were gonna lose a few time, but we actually won in the end. Doctor, you're amazing!
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, Doctor, I've worked hard!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, want me to chase after them?
voicelines.operation_failure: Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's so big inside!
voicelines.trust_tap: Hi, Doctor~
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Cutter
biography: Cutter, a mercenary who has long been active in the fringes of Columbia's controlled territories, has come seeking medical treatment. She has shown excellent close-quarters combat capabilities across several operations. She currently serves in one of Rhodes Island's Guard squads, having participated in many VIP escort jobs among others.
description: Cutter, mercenary, will complete all tasks on the battlefield in a calm and disciplined manner.
quote: The kitchen is more dangerous than the battlefield, and it would be best to not let her in the kitchen.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Excuse me, Doctor, am I on duty today... Huh? Umm, how'd my blade get stuck in the doorframe...
voicelines.talk_1: Back home, the soil gets more and more barren each day, and what we harvest isn't enough to feed ourselves. Most people aren't able to make a living, so their only option is to become mercenaries. They'll do anything, as long as it pays.
voicelines.talk_2: Uhh, they said my blade was too dangerous and forbade me from going back into the kitchen. I just wanted to help, but, as soon as I tapped that cutting board with my blade, it split wide open... Well, um, should I pay for it?
voicelines.talk_3: Every time I bask in the sun, I can't help but to get a bit sleepy. But don't worry, before I've confirmed that it's completely safe, I won't actually fall... asleep... ZZZzzzzz...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: In my line of work, I have a set of principles that I follow: I don't harm the innocent, and I don't get bystanders involved... To be honest, it's really hard.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: This necklace, I'm lending it to you, it's a protective charm. No, I can't give you my blade. When I'm not here, just use this.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, I need you to look at me, and don't move. Hey, I said not to move... Hm, hmm... Don't worry, you're not the kind of person who would use others to commit evil. I can tell.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: To be honest, I don't really remember much from when I was little. My teacher raised me and taught me how to use a knife. He also told me that my parents got caught up in a fight and died because of it. When he found me, I was holding onto a knife and wouldn't let go even if it was cutting into me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Those who wield the blade will always pursue the duel, and those who kill will eventually become a notch on the blade of another. Perhaps one day, I will also find such an ending... and when that happens, I hope you'll be there to witness it.
voicelines.idle: I'm standing guard, so you can rest easy.
voicelines.onboard: Cutter. Just an ordinary mercenary. I have Oripathy, so I plan to trade my abilities for some treatment. Hope this blade's good enough to get things done for you... Mm, that's about it.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Amazing! Didn't know you could use a blade like that!
voicelines.promotion_1: Other than this blade, freedom's the only treasure I have. If you're willing to protect that, then I'll listen to you.
voicelines.promotion_2: A mercenary's blade isn't some toy that's never tasted blood before. Maybe one day, I'll no longer be able to control it. But don't worry, at least for now... it'll work for you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it. Joining the team.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Understood. Can I select my own teammates then?
voicelines.depart: Prepare yourself, and make sure not to get any innocents involved.
voicelines.begin_operation: Hey, blade, you sharp enough?
voicelines.deployment_2: Wielding a blade is all I need to do.
voicelines.4-star_result: Maybe one day, there'll be something that my blade can't cut. But that day isn't today, and it certainly isn't you.
voicelines.3-star_result: Phew... Everything done, just as specified in the contract. Need to take a look?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Those who've lost the will to fight should not be my targets.
voicelines.operation_failure: Go, Doctor, go as far as you can! I'll... hold them back.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Finally, some sunlight... Ahh, so warm...
voicelines.tap: Uhh, don't pull on my ears.
voicelines.trust_tap: Wanna go sunbathing together?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Oh, Doctor, you're here. Got any work today?

name: Conviction
biography: Conviction, also known as the Boxing Artist, is a figure from legends and historical stories, said to have been from the ancient country of Agamemnon (Present-day Minos, 1045-1080/1091-controlled territory).
description: Conviction is ready to join!
quote: Where there are sinners, there must be Conviction!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Since you summoned me, you must be eager to feast your eyes upon my elegant dancing form, right? Uh...? Help you move the luggage...? Hey! I didn't come here to do manual labor!
voicelines.talk_1: You're such a weak and ineffectual leader! How could you be so fragile? If it wasn't for the sorrowful tears Amiya would then shed, I'd convict you right here, right now!
voicelines.talk_2: You don't even know what conviction is? Now prick up your ears! The art of conviction is an assassination technique created by the first Conviction master, who combined traditional dance moves with ancient fighting techniques. And now, standing before you is his third-generation successor!
voicelines.talk_3: Conviction is not some barbaric fighting technique! It's an artform where beauty and ideals are poured into the fist, then delivered through the fist straight into the heart! Now you know!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: This art is the crystallization of hard work and great insight. When people ignore the true value of art and use this sacred product as some sort of game, Conviction will descend to right all wrongs.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Do you not revere in awe my aestheticly perfect image and overwhelming pressure? Then you're unworthy of your place on the same team as your savior! Ughhh! Con! Viction!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I'm actually someone infected with Oripathy, an incurable disease?! Curses... is this my destiny? Is this the fate of all who wield the Conviction Punch? Hey, why are you looking away?! I'm clearly telling you a sad story!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You also wish to become Conviction? In that case, chew upon this question! 'You're standing at a junction in a railroad, with a train full of Durin people approaching. The junction splits off into two tracks, one upon which several artists with meager artistic achievements are...'
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You don't even have the gumption to answer the easiest of Conviction's dilemmas! You have no artistic talent! Taaaaake this! Conviction - Second Style!
voicelines.idle: ...Hoo! Hah! No, wait, wrong move. Let's try again!
voicelines.onboard: I am Conviction. I shall use this name, with all the faith it entails, as my code name. You ask what my talents are? I'm a master of the deadly and beautiful art of conviction! Now shiver in reverence!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: An opportunity like this to become stronger is readily taken!
voicelines.promotion_1: Ahaha, a promotion! I can see the day when Conviction's hidden powers roar across the lands!
voicelines.promotion_2: This sensation... it feels as if my artistic accomplishments have deepened, but also like something is welling up inside me...!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Due to my tendency to sometimes convict teammates, it would be safer for me to work alone.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: At last, your conviction arrives!
voicelines.depart: Your judgement is nigh!
voicelines.begin_operation: Now, count up your sins!
voicelines.deployment_2: You think you're a worthy opponent?
voicelines.4-star_result: History is written by the winners… This is the doctrine of Conviction!
voicelines.3-star_result: How about it! Aren't you awed by my heroic majesty-- Hey, wait up! Don't leave me behind!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: It's fine. This victory might not be the most gorgeous, but it'll still serve us well.
voicelines.operation_failure: Ugh... the magnificent Conviction must never allow such a blunder…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's going to be another dilemma for me to convict this room…
voicelines.trust_tap: Woahh! What are you trying to do this time! I'll teach you to behave!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Oh, if it isn't the Doctor!

name: Utage
biography: An ordinary student from Higashi who came to study in Lungmen, Utage contracted Oripathy after getting pulled into an incident with Infected persons. After coming to Rhodes Island per physician's advice, Utage passed the evaluation to become an Operator.She is level-headed in her view of Oripathy, living life largely the same as before she became Infected. However, when she is working, she exhibits a terrifying demeanor.
description: Utage, Guard Operator, is standing around on the front lines lazily.
quote: Enemies are taken out in an absolutely terrifying manner.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, ready to get to work? I won't take no for an answer! C'mon! 3, 2, 1, start!
voicelines.talk_1: Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take care of them properly.
voicelines.talk_2: Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. I just want to be happy as if we were throwing a party every night. As long as I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.
voicelines.talk_3: You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad... C'mon, let's use up this two-person discount coupon.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: When I contracted Oripathy and was to be sent here, my mother was afraid I'd be bullied, and gave me the family heirloom, Shishiou, to defend myself with. Didn't find any bullies, but I did manage to cut some pretty nasty folks. Doctor, you really know how to appeal to people.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Everyone here gets pretty scary when they get serious. I'm as scary as six people combined? Am I really that terrifying...?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Help me pick up ten boxes of limited-edition cookie sticks tomorrow? Just take the money out of my account. Huh? Preorders are already sold out? Then... c'mon, you've gotta think of a way, Doctor! Please!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, you're razor-sharp some of the time and dull as a piece of wood at others. I don't get why. Oh, I see, right out of 'Flirting Guidebook,' huh? I'd expect nothing less from you, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: It's not good to rely too much on any single person, but I'll make an exception for... Eek, Doctor! Oh it's nothing, I was just rambling to myself! D-d-did you need anything from me?
voicelines.idle: If you're tired, just go to bed. Not that complicated.
voicelines.onboard: Hey, Doctor. I'm the Operator who just joined recently, Utage. My interests are... Oh, I don't need to go into the details? In that case, I look forward to working with you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Is it over?
voicelines.promotion_1: Do I get to do less work if I get promoted? No dice? Oh well...
voicelines.promotion_2: It's time to move out. Let's crush those nasty folks~
voicelines.added_to_squad: All right everyone, I'll be counting on your orders!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm the team leader? ...Eh? Me? Team leader?
voicelines.depart: Let's go.
voicelines.begin_operation: C'mon, c'mon! I can't wait any longer.
voicelines.in_battle_2: It won't hurt if I don't miss.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Just send me the leftover parts.
voicelines.in_battle_4: You look rather cute when you're crying.
voicelines.4-star_result: Ahh, I'm finally done blowing off steam, how exciting. Doctor, let's get some crepes.
voicelines.3-star_result: How exciting. Thanks for all the support~
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: You're saving the stragglers for me? Well, I'll dig right in.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor, stop spacing out and start running.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: As long as I can buy the new magazines, it doesn't really matter where I'm staying.
voicelines.trust_tap: Let's go sing karaoke?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Purestream
biography: Operator Purestream has always been involved in work related to water treatment, and has extensive experience in water purification.After making contact with Rhodes Island, she passed the examination process and signed on as an Operator.
description: Purestream, water treatment specialist, is working hard as always, cautious and conscientious.
quote: She always thought that throwing coins into water to make a wish was a rather silly practice.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Smiling can help you feel revitalized. Why don't you try smiling, Doctor~
voicelines.talk_1: Rhodes Island shouldn't be like those black-hearted corporations, right? Lungmen Industrial Waste Disposal License, Lungmen City Sewage Permit... Well, it seems like there are no problems with your certification, and the sewage treatment seems good enough... It's good that you're a law-abiding organization!
voicelines.talk_2: Woah, this water tastes amazing~! It's cool and sweet, just like the springs back in my hometown... Where's the water source? How is it filtered? What are you using to filter it? Please tell me quickly, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_3: There are signs of excessive wastewater discharge this mon-- Huh? Did I take too many baths again? ...Oh no, I must reflect upon my behavior!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I love my hometown! Although it's not as lively in the country as it is in the city, and daily life isn't as comfortable, the water there is cool and delicious, and the air is always fresh. Hehe, these are sometimes hard to come by in the city!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The pollution near the city is getting worse and worse. Earlier, we even had problems with the water supply in my hometown, and resolving that situation required a lot of effort. While Catastrophes pose a very clear threat to us, pollution will also erode away at our habitable spaces! Therefore, protecting our environment is also of great importance!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Heave, ho! That should be the last shoe... Got it! Phew, now, this waterway will be much cleaner, and my daily efforts here won't go to waste! Thank you for accompanying me, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: There is a legend among my people that we came from a place far, far away. Now that there are fewer and fewer of us, nobody seems to know where we came from, or where we are going...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Back in my hometown during harvest season, each family will make lots and lots of delicious food! Braised, sweet and sour, steamed, fried, marinated, anything you can imagine! Doctor, why don't we go visit together? The people there are very hospitable~
voicelines.idle: Ugh... So dry... I want to soak in a bath...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I am the municipal waterway cleaner, codename Purestream! From now on, I will handle the water treatment and sanitation of this ship, so please rest assured! Oh, these are pickled vegetables from my hometown. Everyone is welcome to try some - I assure you, it's delicious!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: If the purpose is to gain experience, wouldn't it be faster to do it directly?
voicelines.promotion_1: Am I getting a raise? With this promotion and salary increase, I'm well on my way to the top! Hehe, I'll have to tell everyone back home the good news~
voicelines.promotion_2: While there is a difference in urgency between visible threats and less evident threats, they are both dangerous to us! I'm glad you understand, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: No problem, just leave it to me!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Such an important task... I'll do my best!
voicelines.depart: Rhodes Island Water Treatment Team, heading out!
voicelines.begin_operation: Surprise inspection! Seize that scoundrel who just poured paint down the sink!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Roll up my sleeves and fight? ...Um, my outfit doesn't have any sleeves though.
voicelines.deployment_2: I bring the gift of water~
voicelines.in_battle_3: Water works to the benefit of all.
voicelines.in_battle_4: How's that? Feeling a bit more awake after being splashed with cold water?
voicelines.4-star_result: No more contaminants! Very good, this mission was a great success~
voicelines.3-star_result: Operation complete! I'll handle the post-battle clean-up.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hey, where'd the enemy run off to? I-I can't find them!
voicelines.operation_failure: The situation is looking bad, but we have nothing to fear as long as we stay strong! Let's fall back for now?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I hope I can get a nice, big bathtub~
voicelines.trust_tap: Let me tell you a secret - I can swim while standing up~
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Good morning, Doctor! Would you like a cup of cool, refreshing spring water?

name: Ambriel
biography: Ambriel is a citizen of Laterano. After many tests, she was allowed to join Rhodes Island, where her skills in ambushing and long-range sniping helped her perform well in asymmetric operations.She now serves in the Rhodes Island sniper team, providing long-range support.
description: Ambriel, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, has her sights on your back from somewhere you cannot see.
quote: A well-rounded and capable sniper, as long as she doesn't doze off.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Any work to do today? If it's not urgent, just push everything back a bit.
voicelines.talk_1: I can detect nearby creatures with my Originium Arts, and this auxiliary device can further amplify the effect. Sounds great, huh? That's why the Garrison Team sent me to patrol the city, in case there were any students trying to skip school. They sure know how to put people to use.
voicelines.talk_2: Just to get this out of the way, this so-called secret of Laterano or whatever? I don't know a single thing about it. I just want to live a leisurely life. The less I know, the better off I'll be, wouldn't you agree?
voicelines.talk_3: Hmm? Isn't that person over there from the Notarial Hall? He wanted to make sure I'm 'fulfilling my obligations?' Oh please, I pay my taxes on time every month. Anyway, whether or not that's true, give me a whisper if he's looking for me so I have time to go on a run.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I was bored earlier, so I headed down to the bridge to slack off... Err, I meant, I wanted to take a look at the scenery, but everyone was looking at me like I was getting ready to off somebody. Hey, doesn't that mean people see me as a killer? Like I'd ever want a job like that, way too messy.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: In the past, the top brass used to always harp on 'protecting the glory of Laterano with your life,' but I have no interest in that slogan, and I hate how static and immutable life was during that time. Working with you is way better, since you can give me something more practical.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My hair's a bit messy? Oh, seems like I forgot to tidied up after getting out of bed. After all, it's not like I have anything to do today... What a pain in the butt. Anyway, come help me out, is my braid all crooked? It always feels a bit weird to me. You really should have a mirror in your office.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hey, I have some cake for you. What do you usually do during break? You really should take a lap around the city and get some fresh air, don't you think? As for security, just grab an Operator that can go 'pow pow' on any baddies near you, and you're set.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Wanna go watch a movie? Our work's just about done anyway. How about that romantic movie about the princess and the wanderer from afar? Wait, I need to hang up my do-not-disturb sign. Wouldn't want someone walking in.
voicelines.idle: ...Gotta take advantage of a time like this.
voicelines.onboard: Ambriel, sniper, from Laterano... Introductions are a pain in the butt, so that's it. Here, I just opened this pack of chocolate. Break off a stick.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: How long is this thing... Is there no option to play all of these at once?
voicelines.promotion_1: Thanks. Speaking of which, do these promotions come with a salary increase? There's something I've been looking at recently...
voicelines.promotion_2: Oh, thank you very much. I've been with Rhodes Island for quite some time now, right? Without realizing it, I've gotten a whole lot out of this, and made some good memories as well.
voicelines.added_to_squad: My teammates seem quite capable this time.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll say this up front. My tactics are a little unorthodox.
voicelines.depart: Ready? Let's get going.
voicelines.begin_operation: I hope we can wrap this mission up before dinner.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Let me finish this piece first.
voicelines.4-star_result: As expected, Doctor, you're the only one who can consistently achieve results like this!
voicelines.3-star_result: Not a single wasted shot - perfect.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Not the prettiest victory, but a win's a win, right?
voicelines.operation_failure: The number of targets is still increasing, and they're about to launch an attack. Doctor, let's get out of here...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Doctor, it's about time to replenish the cookies in the vending machine.
voicelines.trust_tap: I heard that a new line of clothing just arrived in the Procurement Division? Hehe, Doctor, you simply must take me to see it.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: May
biography: Claims to be a Victorian Royal Detective; claims to have cracked a number of cases, and thus has gained some fame; claims to have been dispatched to Rhodes Island on high recommendations from her boss.Regardless of what she claims to be, Ms. May is now serving Rhodes Island as a sniper.
description: May, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, has issued a warning to wrongdoers and is not afraid to sanction them.
quote: Does not accept frivolous investigations and odd jobs, such as searching for lost pets.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, even though I'm now your employee, if your conduct is even slightly shady, I won't stand by idly!
voicelines.talk_1: Rhodes Island has a suspicious smell about it...
voicelines.talk_2: Careful observation is fundamental to all investigations! It might seem basic, but it always works!
voicelines.talk_3: You, over there! Face me, and put your hands where I can see 'em! Ah, sorry... I got the wrong person...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I always thought that penguin over there is super suspicious. Look, even though it dresses like that, it spends money like it's water or something. It's even wearing a gold necklace! You know how much detectives like me make... that kind of lifestyle is simply unthinkable!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Mmmm... so frustrating! How am I going to investigate that shady logistics company? ...Should I break in? Err, but those two guards give off fierce vibes that make my skin crawl... No, no, I'm not scared or anything, I'll just have to use my head and come up with a plan!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Why are you giving me this bean paste bun? I would neber eat shumfing libe ris on an inweshtigation, you musht watch too mush TV or...(chewing)... A real detective only eats donuts while on a mission!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Three months, then three months after that. Then another three months after that. I've already been undercover for ten months! Chief, what the heck is going on...? ...Hey! You scoundrels, stop eavesdropping on my call!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, that penguin seems to have noticed that I'm investigating it... I'm starting to fear for my life...!
voicelines.idle: Wake up! Waaake uppp! Stop slacking off!
voicelines.onboard: I'm the Royal Detective, May. Please cooperate with my investigation! Eh? I've got the wrong address? Impossible! I have evidence that proves that penguin is hiding here!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Don't I look super cool when I'm conducting my investigation?
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you for the promotion Chief I'm so very grateful for... Hey, wait, you aren't even my real boss!
voicelines.promotion_2: Elite team? Hey, I'm a Royal Detective! Why am I being promoted by some mercenary organization?!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Be careful not to let any shady people onto the team.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Hehehe! Leader? Nay, call me Inspector General!
voicelines.depart: All troops, move out! All troops, moooove outttt!!
voicelines.begin_operation: You criminals! Behave and turn yourselves in!
voicelines.deployment_1: It's time to investigate the scene!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Now you're going to get a taste of my taser!
voicelines.in_battle_4: It won't hurt, it'll just give you a little buzz!
voicelines.4-star_result: For a master detective, there is no case that can't be solved!
voicelines.3-star_result: Take away all these suspects! Ugh... Fine, I'll do it myself...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hmm... I feel like we missed some of the clues?
voicelines.operation_failure: R-requesting backupppp...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I have a hunch as to what will happen here!
voicelines.tap: You and your villainous hand! I'll remember this!
voicelines.trust_tap: D-don't think you can wash away your crime just like that...!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Ethan
biography: Operator Ethan's place of birth remains unknown. He hopped around between several different underground Infected groups before finally separating himself from the Reunion Movement. A thorough investigation has determined Ethan's goals are not a threat and he is indeed worth hiring. Tactical analysis shows that he is particularly skilled in battlefield infiltration and solo operations. He currently serves Rhodes Island in a special ops team, providing specialist support.
description: Ethan, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will utilize unique abilities to carry out special missions for you.
quote: You... can't see me!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Yo, Doctor! Is it time for my shift? Hmm? I suddenly popped up out of nowhere? Nope, just got here.
voicelines.talk_1: C'mon, man, I worked with you on my background check. And I told you a million times: My last job was with Reunion, sure. But I wasn't mixed up in any of the criminal stuff. No guilt here!
voicelines.talk_2: If there's one thing I really hated about Reunion, it was the food! If you can even call it food… My team mostly got by on rock-hard black bread. I had to throw it in a pot and simmer it into stew every time. Those people were just brutal on their stomachs.
voicelines.talk_3: You must've run into Reunion's 'Wraith' guys a whole bunch of times, right? I was one of those. They sent me to scout stuff, never did any fighting. I used to place bets on who would or wouldn't get seen as a way to deal with the boredom. Thinking back, I guess that was kind of rough on the other guys.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: What did I do before I joined Reunion? I was playing hide n' seek with the Infected hunters, duh. With my sneaky little power here, they went home empty-handed every time, haha… But all I could do was hide. And that wasn't gonna help change things for the Infected.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I joined up with the underground because I wanted to help other Infected. But over time, I got jaded, then I stopped being a good guy... Well, at least my hands are 'clean' again. What do I mean by that? Hehe, that's enough questions, friend. Never you mind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Look, camouflage Arts are really complicated! First, you gotta actually know the compisition and texture of your surroundings. Then, you memorize the shape of every crack in the wall, and all the colors of all the soil and every tree. If you don't have those down, even your nerves will get you popping out, and then it's only a matter of time until you're made.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You were the only one in the office, and your snacks disappeared as soon as you turned your head? Wow, that's weird. Why don't you leave it to me? I'll solve this mystery and bring the thief right to you. Yep.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: So this is a map of the operating area? Let's see… Wow, you're really something. Your strategies are so clever, no wonder Reunion always got their asses handed to them. Okay, I'm moving out!
voicelines.idle: Hm? The door isn't locked?
voicelines.onboard: Where am I? Right in front of you! You can call me Ethan. How did I get in here? Haha! Can't answer that one yet.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Where was I? C'mon! Right over there! Look at the top left of screen. Top left corner!
voicelines.promotion_1: Haha, I told you before right? You won't regret putting work into my hands.
voicelines.promotion_2: Yo, Doctor. Make sure you remember the little guys like me. I could die in some battle somewhere and nobody would even know I was gone. So please, remember where I am!
voicelines.added_to_squad: The wall moved, right before your eyes? Naw, you're exaggerating, definitely.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Eyyy! I'm the captain now, so you'd all better listen up!
voicelines.depart: Don't panic if you suddenly notice a missing squadmate.
voicelines.begin_operation: Time to fight? I gotta hide first!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Violence can't solve all your problems, but it can solve you!
voicelines.4-star_result: Are we done fighting? Ahh, I'm beat!
voicelines.3-star_result: I worked pretty hard. You saw me, right? Right?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: So what if they got away. Just let 'em go.
voicelines.operation_failure: You should go first, at least I can grab their legs.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Nice room you got here. Let's see what sticks out the most.
voicelines.trust_tap: Hey, wanna go for a stroll?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey, Doctor, somebody looks happy. Did something good happen?

name: Dur-nar
biography: Dur-nar was once a lieutenant in Columbia's standing army. For unknown reasons, she was discharged from military service and through regular recruitment channels, she joined Rhodes Island. She has serves as a drill instructor and defensive operator. She excels at using a specially-constructed shield for protection and at finding opportunities to strike enemies with her electric blade.
description: Dur-nar, Defender of Rhodes Island, vows to stop all rioters with her shield.
quote: Those foolhardy enough to try to overcome her shield soon find themselves eating dirt.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.
voicelines.talk_1: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.
voicelines.talk_2: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_3: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.
voicelines.idle: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.
voicelines.onboard: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!
voicelines.promotion_2: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.
voicelines.depart: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.
voicelines.begin_operation: I never did get used to the stench of war.
voicelines.deployment_1: I'll leave the support to you.
voicelines.4-star_result: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.
voicelines.3-star_result: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?
voicelines.operation_failure: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!
voicelines.trust_tap: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Vermeil
biography: Vermeil's place of birth remains unknown. She was in the wilderness outside Siracusa prior to joining Rhodes Island. We speculate that she was a hunter. She demonstrates extraordinary skill in the fields of hunting, sniping, and guerrilla warfare. She currently serves Rhodes Island on a sniper team, providing force protection and sharpshooting assistance.
description: Vermeil, Siracusan hunter, will identify the direction of the prey in the wilderness.
quote: When hunting, please remember to remind your teammates about where the traps are hidden.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Did you call me here for a new hunt? No? Gah…
voicelines.talk_1: This claw pendant? It's a symbol of revenge. The Ursus mercenaries who hurt my people treat these things as dogtags, so there's no mistaking them.
voicelines.talk_2: A beast took my left hand when I was hunting. Luckily, a mechanic gave me a prosthetic limb, so I can draw my bowstring again.
voicelines.talk_3: There was a time when I would've turned anyone who mocked my scars into a pincushion! But if you ask me now... Well, people like that aren't even worth the trouble.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: If you're ever facing a difficult decision, let your instincts decide for you. Your body won't lie—This is what I've learned after a lifetime of hunts.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've been living alone ever since my village was wiped out. So, I… I'm still getting used to being around people... But since you trust me and give me important work, I swear I'll return the favor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Ehh, a pebble got stuck in my prosthetic finger...? Darn it, I'm going to need a mechanic to fix it... N-No, I don't need you, I can handle this myself!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You'll make sure I don't ever lose anyone else? Hmph. Big words. But I'll see for myself if you can back those up.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The doctors here offered to get rid of my more recent scars, but I said no. I want to keep them. They're proof of my work here... You, you understand what I'm getting at?
voicelines.idle: You're sleeping? Looks like this one can fall asleep almost anywhere. Well, that's a trait we hunters share…
voicelines.onboard: Vermeil, hunter. You won't regret giving me work.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Can I take another look at that?
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you, but... are you sure it's okay to promote someone like me?
voicelines.promotion_2: I don't really care about stuff like Oripathy or 'the rest of my life.' Right now, the happiest thing I can imagine is fighting by your side.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm here.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You want me to be the captain? Am I... really cut out for the job?
voicelines.depart: The big game hunt is about to start!
voicelines.begin_operation: You don't seem to understand your situation here. You've fallen into my trap.
voicelines.deployment_1: I can smell the game on the wind.
voicelines.in_battle_1: You'd better start running, or there's only one way this ends.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Don't underestimate the people of the wilderness.
voicelines.in_battle_4: This arrow will find your throat!
voicelines.4-star_result: Strong game is still just game.
voicelines.3-star_result: Nice. If you were born in Siracusa, you would've been a great hunter.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The target got away. I'm going after it.
voicelines.operation_failure: We can't let it end like this…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This place has walls and a roof… that's enough for me.
voicelines.trust_tap: ...My plans for the day? Help you with missions. Shoot at enemies. Use up all my arrows. Finish the mission. Eat dinner, go to sleep. Simple enough.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Myrtle
biography: Myrtle is a Durin. She has insisted that her previous job title be recorded as: Generalissimo.Her appearance and temperament are somewhat childish, but on the battlefield, she displays considerable enthusiasm and knack for command. She is able to boost operator morale while at the same time, providing them treatment. She is totally reliable.
description: Myrtle, Vanguard of Rhodes Island, is ready to lead the charge into battle!
quote: Maybe she should have a talk with Zima.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hey, Doctor. I'm here to hang!
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, don't look down on me just 'cause I'm little. Back where I'm from, all the kids looked up to me.
voicelines.talk_2: Durin used the name of our race as her codename because she's so lazy, but isn't it kind of dumb how calling me 'Myrtle of Durin' made me sound like I belong to her or something?
voicelines.talk_3: I understand how all the machines here work, but it still feels weird using them. Some have a lot of different parts, but some are surprisingly simple.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My banner? Good eye, Doctor. It sure is a tablecloth from my house. I sneaked it out with me because it can't get dirty. My dad is probably pretty mad about it!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Is my apple really that great? They're popular back home. You can study or play with it if you want, Doctor, just don't break it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There are still many things I'm not used to on land, but I love the many delicious foods. The cafe on Rhodes Island is my favorite!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I do have to point out the fact, Doctor, that I am a full-grown adult! And I'm tall by Durin standards! Please tell everyone to stop patting me on the head and giving me candy!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Say, Doctor, are you interested in my homeland? I can take you there! But it's pretty far, so wait till I'm in the mood.
voicelines.idle: Are you taking a break? You can use my banner as a blanket.
voicelines.onboard: Reporting in! You must be the Doctor? Call me Myrtle, Myrtle of Durin. Durin said I could get a job here, so what have you got for me? I may be small, but I'm tough!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Cool fight... Got some more, Doctor?
voicelines.promotion_1: Oh, did I get promoted? Does that mean I can go somewhere I couldn't before?
voicelines.promotion_2: I told you I'm tough! Told you!
voicelines.added_to_squad: There's a mission? I wanna go!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't anyone wander away.
voicelines.depart: Let's go!
voicelines.begin_operation: Don't worry, you got me!
voicelines.in_battle_1: I have to get serious now!
voicelines.in_battle_3: We're counting on you again today, little apple.
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew, I'm exhausted! I wanna go to lie down, Doctor.
voicelines.3-star_result: Flawless victory! I was pretty good, wasn't I, Doctor?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We won, Doctor, and that's what counts!
voicelines.operation_failure: Run!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Wow, Rhodes Island is huge!
voicelines.trust_tap: Why can't the cafe open 24 hours?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Any more fun things to do, Doctor?
