name: Sussurro
biography: Sussurro is a graduate of the Siracusa-Palermo Medical Academy. She has a sufficient level of knowledge in basic medical care.She is now a medic at Rhodes Island and is a respected member of the headquarters' logistics system.
description: Sussurro, Medic of Rhodes Island, is on standby to provide first aid at the front.
quote: She will strictly follow the operator guidelines when providing medical assistance.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Time for a break, Doctor. Have you been at it since the last round? Take a break now, please.
voicelines.talk_1: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.
voicelines.talk_2: Do you know everything an amnesia patient should know? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!
voicelines.talk_3: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, a doctor can't ignore a cry for help.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The cruelty of war and disasters have often spurred the development of medicine, so doctors must be at the forefront of pain and suffering. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face that fact.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The time I've worked with you has been, uh... some of my happiest! Come on, Doctor, you know I'm not good with words, so don't play dumb!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm still far below the level of Doctors Silence and Shining, but I'm not afraid of how hard it may be for me. How can I measure up to your confidence in me otherwise?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The sun is indeed warm on the deck, and the breeze is cozy as well... No, I'm not slacking off. Even a doctor needs to relax, right? Why don't you tell me what's bothering you? You can even whisper it.
voicelines.idle: Who designed this meal plan? It's simply horrifying!
voicelines.onboard: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in and reminding you to follow your doctor's orders, no matter how much you have on your plate.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...
voicelines.promotion_2: For this promotion, I have to thank the entire hard-working Medical Unit behind me and the guidance of the Doctor. I'm very, very grateful to you all!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exam to deploy!
voicelines.depart: Attention, medics, please follow all standard procedures in a battle.
voicelines.begin_operation: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!
voicelines.deployment_1: Look over here for a doctor!
voicelines.in_battle_1: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!
voicelines.in_battle_2: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!
voicelines.4-star_result: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.
voicelines.3-star_result: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.
voicelines.operation_failure: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?
voicelines.trust_tap: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Greyy
biography: Greyy, approved for entry into Rhodes Island after passing a battery of exams, has great potential for the Arts. Currently serving Rhodes Island as a Caster, working primarily in power supply maintenance.
description: Greyy, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will repel all enemies carefully with his Originium Arts.
quote: Shine out, no matter how dim your light may be.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hi, Doctor. If you need anything, please tell me... Um, I assume you still remember my code name...?
voicelines.talk_1: Doc-Doctor, hi... Um, I just checked the Medical Department's power grid, and taking some files around while I'm at it... No, nobody's forcing me! I mean, they take such good care of me, it's the least I can do for them...
voicelines.talk_2: I decided to learn electric Arts just so my friends back in the slums could have some light, just so the nights would be a little less miserable... That pitch black, it's really scary. And the kinds of people who live in the dark, they can be scary too...
voicelines.talk_3: These Originium generators here at Rhodes Island are amazing... You know, if we had anything like them back home, we wouldn't need to live in the dark all the time, like life without light is normal.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My mother taught me the basics of Arts. She told me I use Arts just like she did when she was younger, but I'm also as sickly as she was... If she were still alive, I'd hope she could come with me to Rhodes Island...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctor, before I got the training from you, all I could do with my Arts was light up one little room. But now that little spark has turned into something that can help lots of people...! Thank you so much!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Huh? A current anomaly in Miss Mayer's storeroom? W-why is it her again... What? Dr. Kal'tsit wants more cables for her lab? And another outage in Ifrit's room? Waahhhh... Doctor, help meee...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Zzz... Wha? Doctor...? Ah! Sorry! I wasn't napping! I, um, I was... Oh, is this Medical?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, are you going out again...? Okay, I know. I'll wait here for you... Um, Doctor, please hurry back...
voicelines.idle: Whoa...! Aaaugh... Static electricity. Gave me a jolt...
voicelines.onboard: H-Hi. My name is Greyy. I'm kind of an electrician... Erm, th-thanks for taking me on...!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: C-could you pause it for a minute? I-I'm taking notes…
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? Okay, I'll take it to... Huh? It's, it's for me...? Really?
voicelines.promotion_2: Hehe. Doctor, I shall light the way for you!... Um, sorry, just got too full of myself... But I actually mean it...!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Everyone, I'm here to help...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm the Captain...? O-Okay! If that's your wish, Doctor!...
voicelines.depart: Let me handle the logistical support...!
voicelines.begin_operation: Doctor, I see the enemies rallying...
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I should be able to do it...!
voicelines.in_battle_2: I won't let you hurt my friends...!
voicelines.in_battle_4: An electric shock c-can really hurt...!
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, we've done a wonderful job...! Cou-Could we go home now?...
voicelines.3-star_result: We-We won, Doctor!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, the ones who ran off... We won't see them again, will we?
voicelines.operation_failure: Err... Doctor...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What am I doing today?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, you're really tall... I-I wonder when I'll get to be that tall...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Beehunter
biography: Former Ursus underground fighter, joined Rhodes Island after the scene broke up. Now a guard who loves to show off her destructive prowess.
description: Beehunter, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will beat up enemies with her fighting skills.
quote: Boxing comes second, honey comes first.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Boss, let's go grab a bite. On you this time. What? You bought last time? Doesn't sound right to me.
voicelines.talk_1: Use my head to win fights? Hmm… Hmm… Pummel them until I win, train harder if I lose. That's using your head!
voicelines.talk_2: Honey's sweet, but getting it hurts. I went for some the other day and the bees served me up some beating.
voicelines.talk_3: My knucklers? They're my precious babies. Wouldn't have racked up all those wins without 'em!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: There's more rules in the underground fight scene than you might think. Plenty of gopniks dove in before they had 'em figured out. They usually ended up dead.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Oripathy? Who cares? Infected, Uninfected... They're all the same after I knock their lights out.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: What? The fin in the kitchen? Hah! Right here in my belly now!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My book of names here? Hah, looks like that big brain of yours doesn't know everything. Gotta meet people to fight people, right? I don't want to run out of enemies.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The only reason I joined the underground fight is 'cause I didn't have two kopecks to rub together. But here on Rhodes Island I got that load off my mind. It's all thanks to you, Boss!
voicelines.idle: *Sniff sniff* Smells like grilled fish!
voicelines.onboard: Yo! Boss, you know a winner when you see her! Now, put your hands together for the strongest underground fighter out there. The one! The only! BEEEEEEEE-HUNTERRRRRR!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I really don't wanna study. Send me out to fight already!
voicelines.promotion_1: Hah hah hah! Somebody likes me a lot!
voicelines.promotion_2: Hah! After this promotion, ain't no way I'm gonna let you down! Lemme show you what I can do in a fight, Boss!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Here I come!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Oooh yeah! Chow's on me after we win this one!
voicelines.depart: Relax, Boss. Ain't nobody can go three rounds with me!
voicelines.begin_operation: So you're the ones looking for a beatdown. You guys?
voicelines.4-star_result: The stronger the matchup, the more pumped I get!
voicelines.3-star_result: K.O.! Check it out, Boss. See 'em all piled up there?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: That's a wrap. Let's head back and chow down!
voicelines.operation_failure: Ouch… *Gasp* Where's the Boss? Is the Boss okay?!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This room's a lot better than any I had before!
voicelines.trust_tap: You brought food? Yeah! You're the best, Boss!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Earthspirit
biography: Earthspirit is a geologist. She fills the gaps we have in fields such as environmental assessment, battlefield analysis, and terrain utilization. She currently serves with a support squad performing geological surveys, early Catastrophe warnings and other related services for Rhodes Island.
description: Earthspirit, Supporter Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide reliable support on the battlefield when she's on duty.
quote: Is she hearing things again?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, I've finished sorting the Originium from the other ores, as you requested. Is there anything else?
voicelines.talk_1: Oripathy is indeed troublesome. I can't even go on operations without approval from Dr. Kal'tsit. Oripathy shortens one's lifespan, you say? Yes, that's true, but I don't really mind.
voicelines.talk_2: This tuning fork? It's actually a staff — not only a weapon but also useful for geological surveys. I find it always comes in handy.
voicelines.talk_3: Without Rhodes Island, I'd probably still be a full-time geological researcher. And without you people... I'd probably already be dead.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: What? I have dark circles under my eyes? Aw, I knew it…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: What's that behind me, you ask? Well... ah, never mind, it's really hard to explain. I'll tell you when we have more time.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Some rocks talk to me, you know. They chatter and even squabble away. Sometimes, I lose sleep because of it… You think I'm kidding? Do I look like I'm kidding?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Provence is as careless as always. She needs to be careful or she'll end up like me, seriously ill. You'd better give her a good talking-to.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Astonishing...! Look at this, Doctor! This surface... it couldn't have been formed without high pressure in the crust three hundred and fifty thousand years ago. Isn't it incredible…? Guess what, Doctor? The theory is correct! Those who refuted it are the true fools!
voicelines.idle: Doctor—oh, you're sleeping? You must be tired from all your hard work.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Earthspirit, a geology scholar and Caster, reporting in. I work eight hours each day. Make me work any more and you'll have to pay me extra.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hm, is this academic data, or something else?
voicelines.promotion_1: We must continue to refine our scientific method.
voicelines.promotion_2: Forgive my bluntness, but do bear in mind you are paying me only a single salary. No matter how far you promote me, I won't do more than a single person's work.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I hope this squad performs well in all types of extreme environment.
voicelines.depart: Don't worry, we'll be right back.
voicelines.begin_operation: We can't let them misuse Originium like this.
voicelines.in_battle_4: You shouldn't have set foot here.
voicelines.4-star_result: What the enemy was doing… would only bring disaster.
voicelines.3-star_result: All enemies have been dealt with.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A fine victory, Doctor.
voicelines.operation_failure: How is this possible…?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This environment is quite suitable for research.
voicelines.trust_tap: This piece of ore is… for me? Really? But… it must be very expensive, no?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, time to get to work.

name: Deepcolor
biography: Deepcolor's origin is shrouded in mystery, with large gaps in her background missing. She is remarkably gifted in the use of Originium abilities, Arts support and combat coordination. Deepcolor is currently a special ops Operator for Rhodes Island.
description: Deepcolor, Supporter Operator of Rhodes Island, is ready for combat with her 'assistants.'
quote: You don't want to know how she draws.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Good morning, Doctor. Can I paint a portrait of you? And don't worry, I'll try not to... bring it to life. Besides, it's not like I can bring everything to life, you know.
voicelines.talk_1: Maybe I wasn't supposed to appear here?…
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor... what color are you, reflected in my eyes?
voicelines.talk_3: There are lots of fun, creative things here at Rhodes Island. I'm feeling inspired…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: See my lovely 'assistants'? Hehe… What? You think they're scary? But, but they're so cute!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Heh, so these are the colors of your soul…? Alright then, look at me. And paint me in those colors, your colors.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: That's right. Even if no one understands me, I'll keep making art. No matter what kinds of monsters my works might become…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: We artists are a unique breed… We spend at least thirty days a month stuck in a rut, thinking all our work is trash. And we only make any progress when inspiration strikes after midnight.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: In the end, the mottled world sleeps peacefully in the dark depths—Yes, that's the true color of the ocean. Black is the only color you see? Looks like I still have more to share with you…
voicelines.idle: Are you... dreaming? Is the world in your dreams as colorful as the beings of this world, Doctor…?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Deepcolor, a painter. Yes, just a 'painter', nothing more.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: What's this unsettling feeling...?
voicelines.promotion_1: Um, could you just... stop caring about me? If you keep treating me so well... I-I don't know what I might become…
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you, Doctor. Now, let's complete this work of art, shall we?
voicelines.added_to_squad: You're sending me to fight? Seriously?!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I can't lead so many people.
voicelines.depart: Do your best, everyone!
voicelines.begin_operation: Is that who we're fighting?!
voicelines.deployment_2: Aww, I just need a minute!
voicelines.in_battle_3: You'll have to get past my 'assistants' first.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Can you defeat my little ones?
voicelines.4-star_result: If you really make me mad... you won't like what happens next.
voicelines.3-star_result: Let me sketch these triumphant heroes.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Aw, got my clothes dirty again...
voicelines.operation_failure: If only battles were like sketches. I'd just erase that one and redo it…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This room's got a nice design.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, since we happen to have some time off, want to see my latest work?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Gummy
biography: Gummy was once the teenage group runner-up in the Ursus Youth Scout competition. Before the Chernobog incident, she was a middle school student in the city. She is skilled in Ursus-style cooking.In a number of tests, she has exhibited the strength and solid physique characteristic of most Ursus. Gummy has been approved for an internship in a squad of Defender Operators. She also provides logistical support and combat culinary services for Rhodes Island.
description: Gummy, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will heal her teammates while protecting them.
quote: She whips up an absolutely scrumptious breakfast.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hello, Doctor! You hungry? Heehee, I heard your stomach growling from a mile away! It sounded like thunder!
voicelines.talk_1: My shield? I can lift it easy! One, two, lift! Hehe, see? Oh, Relax, Doctor. I'm not gonna drop it or anything. You don't have to stand all the way over there.
voicelines.talk_2: The bad guys who destroyed my hometown are gonna pay! I'll smash them with my frying pan!
voicelines.talk_3: Zima says she'll protect me, but I'm not a baby! Me and my shield kept everyone safe before we made it here! It's not a shield, it's a vault door? No it isnnnn't! I can't believe you're calling it that!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, you wanna taste my cooking? Hehe, you can try it soon. I've already asked Closure if I can work the cafeteria! Just waiting to hear back.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Tadaaah! Here comes Gummy's specialty: bacon and eggs! So, do you like it? It's tough to get the heat right when I'm out in the field, but most days I can make it perfect!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Me and the other four weren't always together, you know.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Why am I always so cheery? Umm, actually... After the things we've seen, it's hard to be cheery... But I really want my friends to forget about all that awful stuff. So I need to pull myself together and smile a whole bunch to make that happen!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I... I miss my parents, and I do want to find them. I think about them all the time... but if I leave now, I don't think I could do anything by myself... So... Doctor, could you please teach me how to fight? I don't want everyone to think of me as some kind of kitchen girl!
voicelines.idle: Are you sleeping, Doctor? Hmm, maybe a bit of reading here would be okay, I guess?
voicelines.onboard: My name's Gummy! You must be the Doctor. Thank you and everyone from Rhodes Island for helping us! I don't have any special skills, but I'll do what I can as good as I can!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I can feel my power surging! I might even be able to lift you up, Doctor!
voicelines.promotion_1: I'll become a three-star Rhodes Island chef after the promotion, right? Just kidding! Hehe.
voicelines.promotion_2: I want to do much, much more besides cooking! I don't know if I'm strong enough to do everything you want me to, but I'll give it my all!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Gummy, ready to go!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Что?! You're making me the leader?!
voicelines.depart: Just wait for us to get back, Doctor!
voicelines.begin_operation: Nope, I'm not scared!
voicelines.4-star_result: The bad guys should just give up! With the Doctor on our side, they'll never beat us!
voicelines.3-star_result: I didn't want to have to do that… but if we don't fight, the bad guys will get us!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We won, and that's what matters! It's a good thing!
voicelines.operation_failure: Ughh… did anybody get hurt…? Doctor? Is the Doctor okay?!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Wow, what a big room! You could get so many people in here!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, I know my food tastes great, but don't eat too much of it! You'll get fat!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, you want something to eat?

name: Cuora
biography: Cuora, real identity unknown, missing history. Demonstrated remarkable defensive ability in battle. Now undertaking many missions for Rhodes Island as a Defender Operator.
description: Cuora, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide reliable defense for the squad.
quote: Yeah, it's time to get sturdy. Real sturdy.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Here I am! What should we play, baseball or board games? Oh, you're working?
voicelines.talk_1: Where was I born, you ask? Well, umm...no idea. But that doesn't matter, right?
voicelines.talk_2: Hello, Professor Rhodes Island! Wait, am I calling you by the right name?...
voicelines.talk_3: Hm, what's my assignment today? To capture some long, sleek animals?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Hey! Don't knock on my backpack! Oh, sorry, I'm not mad, I'm just worried. If you're not careful, you could hurt your hand! Here, let me show you how it's done.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: If anyone dares to hurt you, I'll smash them with my baseball bat. Oh, uh... so... there really are people who hurt you? Um... actually, I'm not that good at fighting, hehe…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I love spending the whole day just walking down the street. I get to watch the people, enjoy the sunshine, and then… lose my way!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You've been treating my sickness, and you gave me a place to live... you're really so kind...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, are you my big brother? Or big sister?... Well, does't matter! I'm not leaving you, even if you throw me out! It's not like I can walk far anyway.
voicelines.idle: Oh, the Doctor is busy. I'll just play by myself then...
voicelines.onboard: Hm? Where am I? Who am I?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I can make myself super tough! It's my only special skill!
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? What's a promotion?... Whatever, let's play for a bit longer! You and me, together!
voicelines.promotion_2: New position or not, I don't really care. All I want is to be by your side every day. Can you grant this tiny wish of mine?
voicelines.added_to_squad: I've got lots of friends here!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Everybody, let's go!
voicelines.depart: We'll be fine if we stick together!
voicelines.begin_operation: Everyone, let's play!
voicelines.in_battle_2: C'mon, show me what you got!
voicelines.4-star_result: Was that tough? Didn't feel much different from any other battle.
voicelines.3-star_result: Homerun!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Safe!
voicelines.operation_failure: Aww... struck out…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Just don't throw fireballs at me, okay?
voicelines.trust_tap: Hey Doctor! Can we play a little bit longer? Just a little bit!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Matterhorn
biography: A member of the Karlan Trade Co. LTD born in Kjerag. He is part of the cooperation agreement between the Karlan Trade Co. and Rhodes Island, but he also helps carry out missions for the latter as well.
description: Matterhorn, Defender of Karlan Trade CO.,LTD, is at your service as a Defender Operator.
quote: The reliable shield of Kjerag.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I've moved your belongings where you wanted. No worries, it wasn't heavy.
voicelines.talk_1: The shield is a symbol of a steadfast guardian.
voicelines.talk_2: I've been responsible for protecting Young Master SilverAsh... I mean, Master SilverAsh... ever since he was young.
voicelines.talk_3: It's not exactly polite to talk about Miss Enya behind her back, but... *sigh* I do pity Miss Enya for what she has suffered. She really deserves a better life.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: If my shield gets damaged, I should take it to the artisan called Vulcan for repairs. Is that correct?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: This is far beyond my expectation. That artisan is truly skilled. I need to thank her properly.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Life at Rhodes Island is fun. The Snow Realm is rather bland in comparison.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Master did send me to protect Ensia. But I honestly don't think she's the type who would sit there and ask to be protected.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I am slowly starting to understand why Master SilverAsh holds you in such high regard. Doctor, from this day, feel free to command me as your shield.
voicelines.idle: Sometimes, I suddenly start missing my life in the Snow Realm.
voicelines.onboard: Ally, I salute you in true Snow Realm fashion. My codename is Matterhorn, and I am one of the guards dispatched here by Master SilverAsh.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You have my gratitude.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you for the approval, Doctor. I am greatly flattered.
voicelines.promotion_2: I will not step back, not even if this shield shatters the very next second. Not because of my loyalty, but because of my conviction.
voicelines.added_to_squad: At your service.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I am honored.
voicelines.depart: I shall protect the team.
voicelines.begin_operation: All is ready.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I'm not here just for show!
voicelines.in_battle_3: With my conviction, I shall bring any monster to its knees!
voicelines.in_battle_4: You don't have what it takes!
voicelines.4-star_result: I wasn't even giving my all!
voicelines.3-star_result: Their strikes can barely tickle me.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I'll pull off a perfect victory next time for you, I promise.
voicelines.operation_failure: I should not have taken the enemies lightly. Now I pay the price.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Very nice room, this one. Furnished tastefully, with a peaceful atmosphere.
voicelines.trust_tap: This is my signature dish. How do you like it?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Perfumer
biography: Lena the Perfumer is from a renowned, well-off Minosian family, unfamiliar with the ways of the world. Her race prides themselves on their keen sense of smell, but hers is outstanding even among the Vulpo, give Lena a special edge in the world of perfume making. She joined Rhodes Island through regular application channels, overseeing the 'Convalescence Garden' and providing assistance to operators as needed.
description: Perfumer, manager of 'Health Garden,' will use her fragrant aromatherapy to heal the squad.
quote: Anyone with a pollen allergy should stay away.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Listen to me, Doctor, it's for your own good.
voicelines.talk_1: How do you like this fragrance? You feel refreshed, right? It's all thanks to Melantha. Her samples inspired me.
voicelines.talk_2: Thank you for building me that flower greenhouse. It'll be a good place for our people to rest and ease their minds.
voicelines.talk_3: Oh, you're up? Try stretching, see if you got all the tiredness out. Nice. I put a lot into this new fragrance. Glad it works.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Narcissus, rabbitear iris, kalanchoe, boronia... I always carry all sorts of flower seeds on me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Oh, you mean this little one? She's still young, but she's been a big help with my fragrances.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I've heard that scents are the foundation of ant society. The relationship between perfumers and their clients is the same.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You seem to visit the greenhouse a lot these days. Oh, there's some pollen on your sleeve. Let me wipe it for you… Alright, you're good.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You were asleep for quite a while. What did you dream about, I wonder?
voicelines.idle: Doctor? Doctor...? Wow, the lavender was much more effective than I expected…
voicelines.onboard: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm Lena, the perfumer. Interesting job, right? Have you heard the word before?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Please take a look and tell me how I did.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion...? You came to tell me in person? I'm flattered. Oh, just a moment, Doctor… There we go, your collar was wrinkled, so I smoothed it out for you.
voicelines.promotion_2: I don't appreciate violence as a tactic... But I'll do my best to get used to it for Rhodes Island, Doctor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: With pleasure.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Whether you need me as a perfumer or a healer, I won't let you down, Doctor.
voicelines.depart: Do be careful, everyone.
voicelines.begin_operation: What kind of battle will it end up being, I wonder…?
voicelines.in_battle_3: How do you like this scent?
voicelines.4-star_result: I always knew we'd win, Doctor, so long as you're the one in command.
voicelines.3-star_result: Very well done, Doctor.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Good job, everyone. Go get some rest.
voicelines.operation_failure: It's too bad we didn't win, but I won't let it discourage me.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I always feel best when I'm at your side, Doctor.
voicelines.trust_tap: I sense… a pleasant smell from you, Doctor
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Gavial
biography: Gavial is a former mercenary, forced to leave home after contracting Oripathy and ultimately joining Rhodes Island after a period of instability. Above-average in physical strength, destructive prowess and tactical skills, she nonetheless opted to be a combat medic.
description: Gavial, Medic Operator of Rhodes Island, will protect the lives of her squad members using her special techniques.
quote: Her patients always have a peaceful look on their faces.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Yeah, yeah, I get it, you deserve a nice rest in your off time. But you gotta get your treatment right now.
voicelines.talk_1: Huh? You want me to be gentle and caring? That's nurse stuff, pal. I'm a doctor, from top to toe. That means healing. Treatment. Don't waste my time with the fluff.
voicelines.talk_2: Strange, why does Dr. Kal'tsit keeps telling me to 'be nice to patients'? She's been doing it ever since I got here.
voicelines.talk_3: Your average doctor's biggest concern is keeping herself safe. Mine, on the other hand... it's getting my patients to stop being scared of me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Treatment time, ears open! Eyes on me! Hands up! Don't move!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctors and fighters... life-savers, life-takers. People think we're polar opposites, but I think we're one and the same—we both sacrifice.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Huh? I didn't beat anyone up, I just wanted to say hi. Watch, lemme demo... I initiate physical contact, and that's how I get closer to people, see?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm kinda missing my homeland... I chose to be a medic myself, but it's crazy it all turned out the way it did. Life sure took me down some wild paths, huh?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor... you and I are both travelers on a lonely road. I guess that's why we understand each other so well.
voicelines.idle: What the... you're asleep, huh? Heheh.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Medic Operator Gavial. First things first... Don’t judge me by the way I look. Got it?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Tch, I thought we were gonna have combat class.
voicelines.promotion_1: Everyone's so scared of me treating them... You're the only one who accepts me for what I am. Thanks for that.
voicelines.promotion_2: All right, no more fooling around. I'll be serious from now on.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave the rear to me. Go show what you're made of!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: All right, get in line, everyone!
voicelines.depart: All right, ladies. Let's keep it cool.
voicelines.begin_operation: Coming!
voicelines.in_battle_1: If you want treatment, you gotta come closer!
voicelines.4-star_result: Meh, pushovers. I wasn't even breaking a sweat.
voicelines.3-star_result: Man those guys were weak. I regret not giving 'em a few whacks with the staff here.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Have you guys never taken emergency response training courses?
voicelines.operation_failure: Darn it... I'm not giving up yet!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's see if there are any interesting people here!
voicelines.trust_tap: You want me to just nod and listen? No. Freaking. Way.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Myrrh
biography: Myrrh, birthplace Unknown, apothecary. Showed great promise in the arts and science of medicine research. Currently a member of the Rhodes Island medical staff and provides pharmaceutical services.
description: Myrrh, Medic Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide medical care for the squad with her herbs.
quote: She might be sweet, but her herbs are sure bitter.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Pardon, but that report you submitted to Dr. Kal'tsit... we could barely read the last few lines as they are nearly indecipherable... Please don't stay up late so much...
voicelines.talk_1: So many things in here I've never seen before... Oh, sorry, I shouldn't be looking around... sorry...
voicelines.talk_2: I know herbs are rather bitter, but people could pay more attention to how effective they are…
voicelines.talk_3: Um, Doctor... is Harmonia still not getting any better? ... I see... I'll attend to her as soon as I finish work.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I know my herbs aren't popular because they're bitter... Aww...but I don't know how to make them taste better... Oh, you mean I should ask around for tips? Bu-bu-but... I'm not that good at small talk... I guess I'll try my best…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Harmonia and I would explore all sorts of places together when we were kids. Yeah, we grew up in the city ruins, and were really hoping to see the world outside back then...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Harmonia is both my oldest and best friend... But I'm the one to blame for her Oripathy infection, and what she is right now... I will find the cure and make up for the life Oripathy has taken away from her. I promise.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Ms. Perfumer suggested that I add some spices into my herbs and now they taste much better! I'm so glad I managed to summon the courage to ask everybody for their advices...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Harmonia says I'm in higher spirits these days. Do you agree as well, Doctor? It's all thanks to your timely advice. I wouldn't know what to do without you…
voicelines.idle: Doctor... oh, are you asleep? Yay! Now I can look around the office to my heart's content.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm Myrrh, an herbalist. Dr. Kal'tsit gave me this title... she said myrrh symbolizes the ephemerality of life and wanted me to keep this in mind.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you so much! This way I'll be able to concoct even better medicine.
voicelines.promotion_1: This is called a... promotion? Is that it...? Um, I don't really know much about stuff like that…
voicelines.promotion_2: This reminds me of childhood with Harmonia, when we explored secret places and abandoned buildings. The more dangerous the place was, the rarer the ingredients we could find.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Uh... I'll try my best not to drag everyone down...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll start by doing my best to make eye contact...
voicelines.depart: Ah, Doctor, I'm ready to go.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'll do my best to make sure no one gets hurt...!
voicelines.4-star_result: We won? Really? Even against those really tough opponents? Wow... you're so cool, Doctor!
voicelines.3-star_result: How's the medicine this time, everyone? ...Um, I guess I'll ask when we get back...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: So much to do in so little time... Thank goodness I didn't mess up too badly…
voicelines.operation_failure: My vials... All shattered...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Uh... I can still smell herbs on my clothes...
voicelines.trust_tap: Excuse me, Doctor. I made you some herb soup good for soothing the body and calming the mind. It's just... a bit bitter…
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Rope
biography: Rope is a cat burglar from the slums of Lungmen, who got caught during a botched caper. Sent to Rhodes Island on a special recommendation from Madam Ch'en after Lungmen formed a partnership with the island. Responsible for intelligence gathering. Uses a rope and grappling hook in combat to disorient the enemy.
description: Rope, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide assistance for the squad with her grappling hook.
quote: Snag 'em and grab 'em! Who's next?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doc~tor~, you didn't forget anything, did you?
voicelines.talk_1: Picking pockets to feed myself? Yeah, that was how I grew up. I didn't exactly have a choice. I woulda starved to death otherwise.
voicelines.talk_2: If you want sturdy grappling hooks, the key thing's a good rope. Hm? Why do I like my hook so much? Well, go scale a building with your bare hands and you'll see.
voicelines.talk_3: Fine, fine, your word's the word, Doctor. Can I go back to my room now? I've got stuff coming up. What? Still no? C'mooon, cut me some slack! Pleasie please?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: If it wasn't you Rhodes Island, I'd probably still be rotting in jail. Say, how'd you find me anyway? Hmm… Maybe you heard about my skill through the grapevine?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: There's lots of ways if you wanna survive in the slums, though more people simply die without a way at all. Never had much of a choice myself. Hope you can understand, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My parents kicked me out, and I had to fend for myself on the streets. Compared to my days in the gutter, life at Rhodes Island is a massive improvement.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Saw a lot of people get same disease as mine who didn't end well. I kinda gave up on myself too, until I got lucky enough to be found by you guys… Tell me straight, Doctor. You can cure me, right? You...you can't? *Sigh*, I can live with that, I guess.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Before, I was always looking for the next meal. Now I can really eat my fill. Gotta hand it to you, Rhodes Island's alright in my book. Huh? You wanna hear me say 'thank you'? Nah-ah, in, your, dreams. *Gasp*, I just said it...
voicelines.idle: Ugh, this chair... ahhh….dangit... so comfy...!
voicelines.onboard: The name's Rope, nice to meet ya. Oh, here's your ID card, don't forget it. Huh? Why do I have it? That's a se-cret!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Does watching this stuff actually help?
voicelines.promotion_1: C'mon, lets talk about payment. Promotions are cool, but my salary is what really matters.
voicelines.promotion_2: Fine, fine. Now that I've got my due, I guess I should give my best.
voicelines.added_to_squad: All right, coming!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm doing captain biz? I would've asked for a bonus usually, but I can let this slide since it's you.
voicelines.depart: Look at the map and figure out your route before we get in there. This is experience talking.
voicelines.begin_operation: So, what kind of good stuff will our enemies be carrying today?
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: I don't really do straight-up fights.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Put me to good use, ooo-kaaay?
voicelines.deployment_2: Hmm, is this a good spot?
voicelines.in_battle_4: Once I hook you, you're not getting away.
voicelines.4-star_result: A lot more excitement on that one than usual! A lot more profit too... whoo-hoo~!
voicelines.3-star_result: It'd be a waste to leave all that good stuff here. The enemies don't need them anyway, right?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Some of 'em got away? Just leave them be. They might turn over a new leaf, who knows.
voicelines.operation_failure: Hey! Let's just bug out now, Doctor! We must save ourselves first!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is there an air vent in this room? Nothing, just curious.
voicelines.trust_tap: I mean, I'd like to figure out how a normal girl lives sometime... but, you know... I mean, maybe that's not really me?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Gravel
biography: A Rank 4 Knight of Kazimierz, staying at Rhodes Island for undisclosed reasons. Proficient in covert ops and assassinations, Gravel volunteered to be the Doctor's personal bodyguard.
description: Gravel, Specialist Operator of Rhodes Island, will zip around the battlefield to defend the squad.
quote: Is she really a knight? Really?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Aaaahhh! You want me to stay by your side? I can barely keep my heart in my chest!
voicelines.talk_1: Fascinating...
voicelines.talk_2: Don't mind me, just continue with your work.
voicelines.talk_3: Hmm? What am I looking at? Why, you, of course!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: If that's what you ask, Doctor, I will do what it takes to become stronger.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Heheh... You don't need to worry about any ambushes or assassination attempts. Because I'll aaalways be here with you.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Are you finally... a little bit interested in me now? Well, I've always been a big bit interested in you.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Thanks for taking such good care of me these days. By my knighthood of Kazimierz, I hereby pledge to repay your kindness with my life—huh? You're not used to me talking this way? But I'm an honest-to-goodness knight. Surely I can improvise a speech or two.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Ever since I was taken away to Kazimierz, it's rare for someone to be so kind to me. So, if you don't mind, Doctor... I, Gravel—no, I Senomy, on my honor as a knight, shall serve you always at your side.
voicelines.idle: When I'm here with you, don't you feel your heart racing?
voicelines.onboard: Mmmwah. Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello. Don't think too much about it. Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Heheh.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Are you the one who comes up with all the Rhodes Island's battle tactics, Doctor? Oh~ that's even more intriguing.
voicelines.promotion_1: You think I'm doing well, Doctor? Yaay!
voicelines.promotion_2: This means you need me, doesn't it? Heheh.
voicelines.added_to_squad: You want to go together? Hehe...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Oh~ You chose me!
voicelines.depart: I'll come with you~
voicelines.begin_operation: Hehehe...
voicelines.in_battle_3: You really think you'll get away?
voicelines.4-star_result: Of course the Doctor's tactics are flawless~
voicelines.3-star_result: My blade hasn't even been stained red yet... hehe...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Run all you like, Let's see how far you can get.
voicelines.operation_failure: Sorry... did I... mess up again...?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Hmm, looks like there's a lot of good hiding places here in this room~
voicelines.trust_tap: Yes. I'm right here, always and forever.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Mousse
biography: Mousse was an apprentice baker in Londinium, Victoria when she became infected with Oripathy. Her parents sent her to Rhodes Island for treatment. At her request, Mousse was recruited as an Operator following psychological counseling and a battery of tests. Now a regular logistics staff member, she provides combat support.
description: Mousse, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, thinks of her enemies as oversized scratching posts.
quote: In a word, scratch.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: We've got more kitties! Yeah…
voicelines.talk_1: Laterano cakes are so delicious! But we operators have to pay attention to our diet, right?... aww...
voicelines.talk_2: Not my gloves... I'm sorry, I can't take my gloves off... I don't want you to see my hands. That's the one thing I ask... sorry…
voicelines.talk_3: A-Are we departing now? Al-Alright, let me just prepare one moment...!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Do you think it's odd that I have two tails? Do-do-do I look even stranger than I thought? Umm...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: When my symptoms aren't flaring up, my hand stays all normal... It feels so nice, just being able to hold the kitties like this...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, what kind of cake do you prefer? Mango, or matcha? I tried making a few, and... you already ate? Oh, umm, Okay...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: D-Doctor! Sora... sh-she's the super idol, Sora, isn't she?! I'd recognize her anywhere! I'm her biggest fan! Why is she here at Rhodes Island? And... and... can I ask her for an autograph?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, have you heard of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées? Yes, I happened to be born there. I really wish I could go back and visit one day... what? Oh, no, I appreciate it, but I'm not lonely. I have you, after all! You're my family.
voicelines.idle: Aw... Doctor... why are you ignoring me...
voicelines.onboard: Good day... p-please call me Mousse. And... and please don't stare at my hand so much...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This is a favor I'll never forget!
voicelines.promotion_1: Huh? Pro...promotion?! I-I'm not prepared for this...
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, I know there's a limit to what I can accomplish, so I swear... I'll do all that I'm able, as well as I'm able! It's... It's the only way I could ever repay you, Doctor...
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yes, I'll do my best!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: This is in my hands! You can do this, Mousse!
voicelines.depart: I essentially blend into the walls, so I'm a good choice for scouting...
voicelines.begin_operation: Scouting complete. Sending you enemy coordinates.
voicelines.deployment_2: From now on, this is my battle...!
voicelines.4-star_result: It was a tough fight... but I stayed steady through it all...!
voicelines.3-star_result: Yay... Oh, oh, sorry, it's not that I like battles that much, but...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: D-Did I drag us all down?
voicelines.operation_failure: I can... keep going...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: E-Excuse me... May I come in...?
voicelines.trust_tap: D-Doctor... I really can't hold it in anymore... do we have a scratching post? Urghh...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Estelle
biography: Estelle, her infection only at a moderate stage, attracted attention due to mutations triggered by Oripathy. She later sought medical asylum at Rhodes Island after trying several other treatment programs. She received psychological counseling and a battery of examinations with her consent before officially joining Rhodes Island as a guard with a squad of operators.
description: Estelle, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, still doubts if she can help.
quote: Please trust her capability!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Uh... w-where should I stand? O-oh, you want me to sit? Then... where should I sit?
voicelines.talk_1: That little bird is my friend. But it's always disappearing on me these days... Oh no... It's not disliking me, is it...
voicelines.talk_2: The way I look... is nothing like an Operator at all... And I understand having someone like me in your team won't make you pround... But don't worry, I won't go around saying I'm with Rhodes Island.
voicelines.talk_3: You've probably noticed, but my hair is quite difficult to sytle... So I have to let my hair down like this... It's not very appropriate, is it?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My mutant horns... they don't really fit in with the crowd... I thought I was used to other people staring at them... but … but it's still embarrassing...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: The friends I made in the wilderness... they're all coming to Rhodes Island too. So... I'll feel less lonely. I'll do my best to fight hard and protect everyone.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Actually, ever since my childhood, I've always been dreaming to be a... a princess... I-I mean it's okay if you find it ridiculous...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: The bad guys always call me 'freak'... but… yeah, I'm a freak, a freak that wants to protect you and everyone else.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Um... that really energetic doctor... she's an Archosaurian too, huh? I do want to talk to her... but I'm still a bit scared…
voicelines.idle: No one's staring at me now, right? Ah, finally...
voicelines.onboard: H-hello... Uh... s-sorry, my horns... I accidentally broke your office door with my horns...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Powers stronger than what I already have... can I really control them...?
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? What's that?... I don't really get it, but I think it means that I've been helpful, right?
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you, Doctor, for giving me a bit more confidence... Now I am starting to understand what to do and how to wield my power.
voicelines.added_to_squad: P-please don't look at me...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Wahh... me? R-really? Is that really okay?
voicelines.depart: Uh, everyone... it's... it's time to attack! I-is this how I'm supposed to give orders?
voicelines.begin_operation: I... I won't let the bad guys win!
voicelines.deployment_1: My pushover look should pull a lot of enemies here...
voicelines.deployment_2: To intimidate the enemy... I... I'm capable of that, right?
voicelines.in_battle_3: I won't let you escape this easily!
voicelines.4-star_result: I can do better... yes, even better!
voicelines.3-star_result: Are you proud of what we've achieved, Doctor?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Great... we won, Doctor!
voicelines.operation_failure: In the end... I'm good for nothing... just as expected...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Wow, this place... it's so spacious! I love it!
voicelines.trust_tap: You're always so kind to me... I... I'm so happy!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Frostleaf
biography: Frostleaf is a former Columbian Junior Army soldier, 'retired' after her unit was destroyed. Came into contact with Rhodes Island later as a mercenary, before officially joining following a period of collaboration with the company. Extensive combat experience and undeniably skilled, Frostleaf is an excellent asset to Rhodes Island.
description: Frostleaf, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will obey all your orders.
quote: Try to become her beacon.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Want to listen to some music? I'll lend you my headphones.
voicelines.talk_1: Sorry, please keep a little distance from me.
voicelines.talk_2: I never imagined that I'd have the chance to become a rescue worker.
voicelines.talk_3: I picked up this axe a long time ago, maybe even before I learned to read.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The songs I like are probably not so popular. They're only good for humming to myself when I'm alone.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Don't blink—you have but one moment to witness this epic move.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Want something to drink? My treat. You should relax a bit after work, you know.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I only realized how precious life is after everyone around me died, one by one. Ironic, huh? I think so, too.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I'm a mercenary. I just do my job. As for the purpose of my mission and its consequences, I don't have a say in any of that. So, from now on, all my responsibilities are your concern.
voicelines.idle: Dun... dun dun♪dun... dun dun...♪
voicelines.onboard: Frostleaf, former mercenary. From now on, I'm your operator. Assign me any job you want, I can do pretty much anything.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thanks.
voicelines.promotion_1: Things are on the right track now.
voicelines.promotion_2: Whew... not bad. Feeling fulfilled for the first time in a while.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll do my job.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Go your own ways and do your own jobs.
voicelines.depart: Great, I feel like some exercise.
voicelines.begin_operation: You will shatter.
voicelines.in_battle_1: My bodily fluids aren't the only thing that's chilling.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Life, brittle as frost, fragile like leaves.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Let's chill down some hot heads.
voicelines.4-star_result: I've been through countless battles... seen the carnage, witnessed the silent nothingness at the end.
voicelines.3-star_result: I remember every enemy I fought. Not a single one escapes.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We didn't lose anyone, did we?
voicelines.operation_failure: I'll hold up the rear.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'd like... a more private space.
voicelines.trust_tap: How about a drink?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Matoimaru
biography: This nomadic warrior from the Far East joined Rhodes Island by sheer chance.What she lacks in strategic acumen, she makes up with a mean giant sickle swing.
description: Matoimaru, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will wield her blade to wipe out the enemy.
quote: Fast reactions, fast attacks, and even faster recovery.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, you gotta be hungry! Try some of my onigiri. They're great!
voicelines.talk_1: I've actually got a lotta hobbies. They go way beyond martial arts. I'm also really into soccer, and flower arrangement. Wouldn't want you thinking I'm just some kinda bloodthirsty monster!
voicelines.talk_2: My race eats other races? That's some old crap! Who told you that? Pff, what kinda coward goes around talking that crap behind my back? I'll give 'em a peace of my mind when I find 'em.
voicelines.talk_3: My body? Heals right up whenever I get hurt. Even in the middle of a fight, the wounds close right back up. Handy, huh.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Hey, Doctor, Rhodes Island's got a soccer tournament! Let's sign up together. When you got me on your team, it's in the bag, don't worry. Doctor, you better start thinking up a cool victory pose!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You don't even recognize me on the battlefield? I just start cutting through enemies one by one with a blank expression on my face? Wow! Sounds hella badass! Wish I could watch myself out there.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I got this problem where I kinda end up breaking stuff, so I'm working with my flower arrangement teacher to control my strength. Being around all those pretty flowers makes me real happy too.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Strategy? Ehh, not really my specialty. That's why I keep hopping right into the enemy's plans. But with you, Doctor, you always stop me before I screw up too bad. Been a big help!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I've always been pretty gullible. It's almost gotten me killed. But now I, Matoimaru, swear loyalty to you, Doctor! I know you'll never betray me, Doctor!
voicelines.idle: Grrr... Hey, no falling asleep, Doctor! You gotta listen to my stories or I'm gonna die of boredom!
voicelines.onboard: Matoimaru has officially joined Rhodes Island! You let me do the fighting and I'll take the orders, Doctor!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Hey now I can beat 'em even harder.
voicelines.promotion_1: Doctor, you put my strength to good work and I'll be a happy lady!
voicelines.promotion_2: Doctor, stand back a bit. I don't wanna hurt you swinging my naginata around. I, Matoimaru, will bring victory in the name of the Doctor!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Hah hah! You all look pretty strong. Let's do some warm-ups!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Ugh, you want me to play captain? That means I get to beat 'em as hard as I want, right?
voicelines.depart: You guys ready to rumble? We'll wipe the floor with 'em.
voicelines.begin_operation: Sorry to keep you waiting, bad guys!
voicelines.in_battle_1: You're standing up to Matoimaru. Ballsy.
voicelines.4-star_result: A sea of fire and a mountain of blades... That was awesome! It's the battlefield I've always dreamed of!
voicelines.3-star_result: Doctor, I got 'em all! Hey, what happened here? Everything's busted. Did I do that?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I'll get 'em before they escape! Can't call the battle over until I do!
voicelines.operation_failure: Retreat! I'll cover your escape. Make sure you don't get hit!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Agh! Ow! My horn...!
voicelines.trust_tap: You look happy about something. You gotta tell me too!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Dobermann
biography: Former Bolívarian military, Dobermann joined Rhodes Island as a drill instructor, primarily training entry-level Operators. She also assists with prisoner interrogation when necessary. Proficient in military operations of various scales, Dobermann is a highly disciplined soldier and often leads the charge in battle as a guard.
description: Dobermann, Starter instructor of Rhodes Island, is always ready to offer advice on the battlefield.
quote: You could always use the advice of a veteran.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, are the new recruits keeping up with my basic training regimen?
voicelines.talk_1: A balanced, regular diet is also an important part of daily training. Any complainers get fifty laps around the deck.
voicelines.talk_2: As a military instructor, it's important to achieve the perfect balance between strictness and leniency. To be honest... I may be a bit too hard on Fang...
voicelines.talk_3: When putting your Operators into squads, it's crucial to assign them positions where they can exercise their skills to the fullest. It's true that Operators' ability is important, what's really being tested here is your judgement.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, when training Operators, you need to work on spiritual fulfillment as much as improving their physiques and skills. After all, they need to be mentally strong enough to survive interrogations and all sorts of attacks on their minds.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: You're looking for the newbies? They're training out on the deck. Yes, I do realize what the weather's like right now. Of course I do.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Anomalies... ha. You can never fool the eyes of the 'Hound'.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: If you believe that command allows you to slack off whenever you want, then I WILL correct your misconception, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: If I hope to remain at your side through all the difficulties to come, I must be even harder on myself. After all, with the world around us being what it is... the only way we can keep it together is to keep training our mental strength.
voicelines.idle: No slacking off!
voicelines.onboard: Attention! I am Dobermann, former military instructor for the Bolívarian armed forces. Now, let's cut to the chase. Hand over the list of Operators in need of training.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This is how our training pays off.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion, huh? Thanks. I'm just doing my job.
voicelines.promotion_2: The responsibility for training the future of Rhodes Island is on my shoulders. I will do my best to be worthy of that responsibility.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Then show me the briefing docs for the mission.
voicelines.depart: Calling all hands. This is not a drill!
voicelines.begin_operation: Time to interrogate.
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter the challenges we face, strong fundamental combat skills can mean the difference between life and death.
voicelines.3-star_result: Come back when you're less mediocre.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The operation was successful, but we still have room for improvement.
voicelines.operation_failure: We have failed. I am the one to blame.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The newbies are intimidated by me, you say? That's only natural.
voicelines.trust_tap: You want to cheer me up? Hm, let me interrogate someone, then.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Vigna
biography: Vigna is a Sarkaz that was admitted into Rhodes Island following a battery of screenings, showing good potential in skirmishes, raids, and coordinated combat. Currently a Vanguard with an advance squad at Rhodes Island, with outstanding performance in both tactical raids and frontline combat.
description: Vigna, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island, is ready for combat with the lance in her hands.
quote: Playing rock 'n roll is a battlefield of its own. This is a fact that she knows well.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hey, hey! I'm watching a rock concert, Doctor! Stop blocking the TV! Just missed the best part thanks to you!
voicelines.talk_1: You get people who say things like 'fight the power' and 'be yourself.' But for us Sarkaz, that's just life.
voicelines.talk_2: I like bands... no, I LOVE bands! As a guitarist myself, I know every beat, every chord is important. I gotta practice on and on, day and night. That's the only way to give the audience the ultimate face-melting solo!
voicelines.talk_3: I'm going exceptionally harsh on you, given I've been so nice to everyone else you say? Well, isn't it only natural? Those who shoulder the responsibility of management like you need more than their self-discipline to do their job, Doctor. I have high standards for myself, and I think it's only right for these standards to be applied to you as well.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Hmm, this smell... is this the lunchbox Hibiscus brought you? You want me to eat it for you? No way! This... this wasn't in my job description!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: If there's something you want out of life, you gotta work hard for it. Like, I want to become stronger, so I train. I want a sharper weapon, so I customize this one myself. People can judge as they want, but I'll stick to my belief until I get what I want!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Wha?! It's pouring outside? I-I don't... believe it has anything to do with my outdoor concert! Now get aside if you hear me 'cause I'm setting off right NOW! I won't let this sprinkle dampen my passion by one bit!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You got an important mission you want me to handle? Hehee, you can count on me! Let's see here... 'You are to acquire the following products for Rhodes Island during a time-limited mega-sale...?' Th-that's impossible!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Even if the crowd starts booing, the show must go on. You can't quit in the middle of a performance just because you messed something up. Same is true for the Sarkaz and infected. We won't have anything left with us if we just call it quits.
voicelines.idle: Hey, you can't sleep over here! Ugh... you're too heavy for me to carry...
voicelines.onboard: Excuse me, is this the office of the Doctor? I've been looking for the place quite a while and it'd be really appreciated if—what? YOU'RE the Doctor? Hmpf, I see. Operator Vigna, reporting in!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You gotta be willing to sweat a lot to keep up the battle tempo!
voicelines.promotion_1: Am I wearing my elite medal right? Great! In that case, it's time to get a picture for this remarkable moment!
voicelines.promotion_2: Pure strength might not be my forte, but my spear and unparalleled skills shall always leave them with a deep impression!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll learn from others' battle techniques.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I may be the team captain, but you can all let me know where and how I might improve.
voicelines.depart: Everyone, prepare to deploy. And please keep in mind that coordinated actions bring victory.
voicelines.begin_operation: Eyes on me—it's showtime!
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter how tough the bad guys are, I won't stop strumming! Oh… 'fighting' might be the better word here!
voicelines.3-star_result: You all deserve a commendation from me, oh, but not you, Doctor, not yet! Your job's not finished until I see everyone back home safe and sound.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We're not out of trouble yet! Hold formation!
voicelines.operation_failure: Ugh... This can't be it. We have to fight harder!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is there a soundproof room here? My fingers are itching for guitar strings so BAD!
voicelines.tap: Hey! That just gave me a chill!
voicelines.trust_tap: D-Don't pat me on the head! It might make me shorter!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Scavenger
biography: Banished from her community for being Infected, she has made a living as a mercenary in the criminal underworld. She is skilled in matters best left unsaid, and as a result of the base nature of the work has become known as 'Scavenger.' Since her introduction to Rhodes Island through an intermediary, she has given up her mercenary life to become an Operator.
description: Scavenger, executor of S.W.E.E.P, is ready for combat at any time.
quote: She can clean everything, except her own room.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Better to get your job done first than wasting time on chitchat.
voicelines.talk_1: You'd better remember that failing to adapt makes you a useless burden.
voicelines.talk_2: Work, eat, run, repeat. Big fricking whoop. Isn't that how life is for anyone these days?
voicelines.talk_3: My job was to take care of 'troubles' for my employers. Eventually they started to call me Scavenger.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Just like the two sides of a coin, no matter how splendid the face is, the backside is always stained with dirt.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I've adapted to this place really well since I joined? Pfft, rubbish. It's just that I've gotten used to working on the surface.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: That's Provence, isn't it…? The wretched girl who got Infected while rescuing people from a Catastrophe... Look at that massive tail she's got...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You know, Doctor... I hated the idea of working with other people, at first. I figured our methods would clash. But at some point, I came to realize that's not the case.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: If only she were still alive... Now all I can do is carry on alone, carrying her dreams on my back.
voicelines.idle: How can you sleep so soundly when you're defenseless…?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Scavenger. Leave the dirty work to me. Just pay me like my other employers and we'll be good.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: No, it's not enough...
voicelines.promotion_1: This still isn't enough. I need to become stronger...
voicelines.promotion_2: Thanks, Doctor. I feel like I have a reason to fight now.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Do I need to quip just 'cause I joined the team?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Don't you hold me back.
voicelines.depart: Conceal yourselves so the enemy won't find you.
voicelines.begin_operation: Hmph, time for a clean up.

name: Courier
biography: Courier is an employee of the Karlan Trade Co. LTD, and was born in Kjerag. He is part of the cooperation agreement between the Karlan Trade Co. and Rhodes Island, by which he helps carry out missions for the latter.
description: Courier, contact of Karlan Trade CO.,LTD, is at your service as a Vanguard Operator.
quote: Deliveries or combat, you can always rely on him.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: It's not the duty of a guard to stand here and do nothing. Why don't we chat a bit?
voicelines.talk_1: With perfect positioning and a suitable environment, my letters will arrive just fine. After all, it's my job, right? I need to do well to survive.
voicelines.talk_2: Are you hungry? If you want something to eat, just say the word. I can't compete with Matterhorn in the kitchen, but I can at least cook a decent meal.
voicelines.talk_3: The comms equipment here at Rhodes Island is way too good. At this rate, I'm going to lose my job...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Anything else you need? Just don't keep me on the line for too long.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Huh? There's a faint smell on the letters? No, you must be imagining things.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I owe my life to Master SilverAsh. If necessary, I would do anything for him.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: You want me to transport... all these? That's a lot, Doctor! Come on, I'm not a miracle worker!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Seems I'm no match for you. I suppose it's time to retire my business smile for now... *Ahem*... I'd like to show you my true face, from now on.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, there's a new message for... Ah, never mind.
voicelines.onboard: Esteemed Leader of Rhodes Island, your ally—Courier of the Snow Realm—is here at your service. If you get into any sort of trouble during your contract with Master SilverAsh, just snap your fingers and I'll be there.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Whoa, that's an incredible job well done.
voicelines.promotion_1: You'd save a lot of trouble if you sent me onto the battlefield.
voicelines.promotion_2: As a Messenger of the Snow Realm, I'm sure to appear whenever you need me.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave the scouting to me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I won't blemish the name of the Snow Realm.
voicelines.depart: Too bad some people just can't live and let live.
voicelines.begin_operation: They'll pay for what they've done.
voicelines.4-star_result: I'll bring news of our victory to Rhodes Island right away!
voicelines.3-star_result: Let's grab a nice dinner after we clean up the battlefield. My treat!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Anyone injured? I've got medicine and bandages.
voicelines.operation_failure: Let's get out of here first. Here, this way! Hurry!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'll greet my roommates and neighbors first.
voicelines.trust_tap: Alright, I'll whip up a meal for you later.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Call me whenever you need me.

name: Shirayuki
biography: Formerly the personal bodyguard of Lady Fumizuki, wife of Lungmen's Chief Wei Yenwu, Shirayuki was sent to Rhodes Island to serve the Doctor in the same role, after the Lungmen Guard Department partnered with the company. She uses large shurikens as her weapons of choice, and is well-versed in covert ops and intelligence gathering. She protects the Doctor from behind the scenes.
description: Shirayuki, bodyguard of Mrs. Fumizuki, will provide help for you under the orders of her master.
quote: To your surprise, she always reappears out of nowhere.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Shirayuki, at your service.
voicelines.talk_1: Princess Fumizuki is my master, and you're my employer.
voicelines.talk_2: My hobby? Standing on the coast, watching the snow fall.
voicelines.talk_3: My affiliation? Secret.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My birthplace? Higashi.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: My weapon? A shuriken, the Silver Wind, made by Eastern Heavy Industries.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Favorite food? Sushi.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My age? Confidential.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My duty? Protecting you.
voicelines.idle: How tranquil...
voicelines.onboard: I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Miss Ch'en and follow all your orders.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You have my gratitude.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion? I, Shirayuki, am honored.
voicelines.promotion_2: I, Shirayuki, may devote greater strength to you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Orders received.
voicelines.depart: Commencing operation.
voicelines.begin_operation: A snowstorm will bury this battlefield.
voicelines.4-star_result: The enemy dies, I advance. I advance, the enemy dies.
voicelines.3-star_result: The enemy has fallen. Total victory.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Of their ranks, some flee. Wariness, a must.
voicelines.operation_failure: Should we fight again, we will return the favor one hundredfold.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: A very nice room.
voicelines.trust_tap: Your consideration, I, Shirayuki, will engrave upon my heart.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Meteor
biography: Meteor is a former forest warden from Kazimierz, an amazing archer with extensive experience in tracking and wilderness survival. She serves as a frontline sniper for Rhodes Island concurrent with her medical treatment.
description: Meteor, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, is always ready to draw her bow.
quote: Like a meteor, she crossed the sky and landed by your side.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I sense something familiar in the wind. Where are we?
voicelines.talk_1: Do you feel the wind from Kazimierz?
voicelines.talk_2: Rhodes Island is very different from the places I used to live. There's nowhere to start a campfire here... too bad. Maybe on the deck? I'd like to create a space where everyone can talk and grow closer together.
voicelines.talk_3: Umm, how does this mission signup system actually work? I'm really bad at electronics…
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: There have been lots of new faces at Rhodes Island. I'll gladly help them adjust to the environment.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: That Kazimierzian knight... Oh, it's her. I knew that girl years ago. She used to be a shy, bookish type. I wonder what made her change so much.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Shh... look what I found! A solitary Doctor... gotta catch this one! Oh, did I scare you? Haha…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I sometimes recall the time back home in the forest. We had lots of different competitions every year…ah, the good old days. I wonder what my hometown is like now.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I'll always have your back, Doctor.
voicelines.idle: So you can fall asleep without a care, just like that? Heheh...
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm Meteor, the archer from the woods. Do you need an Operator who excels in long-distance support?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Archery requires constant practice. No one can afford to slack off for even one day.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm honored to receive this promotion.
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you, Doctor, for recognizing my skill. I'll continue to do my best to serve you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave the long-distance support to me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll keep everyone safe.
voicelines.depart: Everybody, let's go.
voicelines.begin_operation: Time to show them what we can do.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I've been waiting for a while.
voicelines.deployment_1: The wind is blowing in the right direction.
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter how difficult the battle, we can handle it, as long as we work together as one.
voicelines.3-star_result: Perfect! You all did well.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: All injured personnel, please stay put, don't move. I'll be right there.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm sorry... I didn't want it to end up like this...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: It's hard to get used to such a small room.
voicelines.trust_tap: Being by your side feels like basking in the spring sunshine. So warm, so comfy.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
