name: Jessica
biography: A fully enlisted Operator from Blacksteel, stationed at Rhodes Island as part of an exchange training program.
description: Jessica, Sniper Operator of Blacksteel, will provide effective attack power for the squad with her professional skills.
quote: If only she wasn't such a scaredy-cat...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I-Is there anything I can help with? Just say the word and I can do it.
voicelines.talk_1: Franka and Liskarm are so incredible! I really admire them. I want to become as great as they are someday. I can... I can do it! Will you help me, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_2: Um, I heard word that Vanilla's here too? She was in my squad when she first joined Blacksteel. We went on missions together! She's become such a reliable Operator now... but I'm still just me...
voicelines.talk_3: Dr. {@nickname}, do I come off as... spineless? I know I shouldn't let people walk all over me... I'm trying to change...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Sometimes I feel like I'm back in Blacksteel, even after going through so much with Rhodes Island. I'm not the old me anymore, either... it's weird. Is it because I miss how it was back then? No, no. I don't miss the person I used to be, I know that for sure...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Hard work doesn't mean anything without results. That's what I think at least! That's why I don't want anyone to see me training alone. Having you, though... it's really comforting when you're with me, for some reason.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I pulled a muscle training a couple days ago... but don't worry, I-I'm okay! Urk...! I won't let this get in the way of you or anyone at Rhodes Island, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Freeze, hands in the air! Oh, did I scare you? I'm sorry, it's just Franka told me to be bold and assertive, and I only wanted to try it out... I'm really sorry...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Everyone at Blacksteel and Rhodes Island is so amazing and talented. I know I'm nothing compared to them... but, still, just every once in a while, I really like it when I get compliments...
voicelines.idle: Doctor... Doctor? Are you sleeping? I'll clean your desk up for you, then...
voicelines.onboard: Um, are you Dr. {@nickname}? Nice to meet you. I'm Jessica from Blacksteel Worldwide. Sorry... I'm really bad at introducing myself...
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This seems a lot more effective than training by myself.
voicelines.promotion_1: Doctor... I'm... I'm so happy you're honoring me... Just... let me cry it out for a bit, I'll be fine...
voicelines.promotion_2: Ah, Doctor, does this mean you think I'm a great Operator? Thank you so much for all your help. You were by my side all the way...!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Just give your orders and I'll carry them out!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I won't let you down!
voicelines.depart: Stay focused... look straight ahead.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'll definitely prove myself this time!
voicelines.in_battle_4: I'll show them what I can do!
voicelines.4-star_result: I'm going to climb to the top of the mountain. I won't stop halfway!
voicelines.3-star_result: I... I really did it? I managed to protect everyone by myself?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I could do better. I can't get complacent just because we won!
voicelines.operation_failure: Requesting medevac! I dragged everyone down... it's all my fault! Sorry! I'm sorry!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I wonder if the people at Rhodes Island are nice...?
voicelines.trust_tap: I can do a little cooking...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Gitano
biography: Gitano is a mystic from Sami, tarot expert and a great card player. She has never spoken to anyone of her past prior coming to Rhodes Island, and it remains a mystery. All anyone knows is that her readings are very accurate.
description: Gitano, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will draw plans for the squad with her Originium Arts.
quote: Your fortune for the day is...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Alright, Doctor, your tarot card for today is...
voicelines.talk_1: Would you like to learn more about your future?
voicelines.talk_2: Bear it in mind that excessive reliance on unfathomed power will eventually backfire on us.
voicelines.talk_3: Tarot cards aren't divine, all-seeing tools. Instead, we use them for guidance when we feel lost.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Destiny is like the world we walk upon—no one can escape it.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Humans might never be able to escape this world... but we can change it. Our actions belie endless possibilities.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There are countless topics for which you can consult the tarot, the most common one being your luck in card games. To change it, however, you must be brave enough to change your fate first.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: We have a ritual among diviners that's all the rage these days. We call it the 'Hand of Fate.' Would you like to try it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: It's a divination taboo to do readings concerning death. But I don't believe death is the end—it's the beginning of something new.
voicelines.idle: Dreams can often enlighten you in strange ways. If you have an enlightening dream like that, you'd best remember every detail, Doctor.
voicelines.onboard: Following the guidance of the arcana, our paths have finally converged. Nice to meet you, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I feel inspired now.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'd already foreseen this promotion in my crystal ball. Heheh, just kidding.
voicelines.promotion_2: You want to know your destiny, Doctor? Too bad, I can't help you. I'm not the one to share it with you, for the fate forbids me to do so.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Wait a minute, let me predict the results of this battle.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Well then, let me pray for everyone.
voicelines.depart: Fate is a fickle thing... only the victorious will be forever revered.
voicelines.begin_operation: I can see the outcome. Victory belongs to Rhodes Island.
voicelines.in_battle_4: All will fall before the Priestess's might.
voicelines.4-star_result: Will fate have us in a chokehold… or will we turn the table?
voicelines.3-star_result: I have moved all of them to the graveyard.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Time to reshuffle the deck.
voicelines.operation_failure: Impossible... this isn't what I saw in the cards...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Bad omens seem to lurk inside this room. May I use my powers to help you manage them?
voicelines.tap: Hm? What can I do for you?
voicelines.trust_tap: Want me to do a reading on your future? All right, please give me a minute.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, you're blessed by the winds of luck.

name: Haze
biography: Haze is an operator from Victoria, where she did time in an Infected quarantine lockup. She finally escaped after multiple attempts, eventually joining Rhodes Island under an alias.
description: Haze, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide support for the squad with her Originium Arts.
quote: Nothing can get in her way.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Didn't notice me behind you, eh? It's only natural. I'm a cat. We're known for being silent prowlers!
voicelines.talk_1: Hey, don't touch my hat... it's crazy, you know! If it feeds you too many secrets, Doctor, you'll be in trouble.
voicelines.talk_2: So rare to see a pharma take in runaway kitties from a jail. Did you all want a peek at my maps? Or, was it some advice on prison breaks?
voicelines.talk_3: We thieves have our own principles and standards too... perhaps. Who can say?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Meow, meow, meow... Meow? Never you mind, I'm just talking to myself.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Anytime you want. Don't you worry, I have friends everywhere. Eyes everywhere.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Curiosity can kill a cat, you know.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm in a good mood right now, so here's a riddle for you. 'Why is a raven like a writing desk?'
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Thank you, for this 'Haze' I'm now.But... did you catch a peep of any of them, along the way? Any of, well... my secrets?
voicelines.idle: Asleep like a baby... Time to get 'meown to business,' then.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, I'm Haze. I like relaxing work environments, and an employer who knows better than to bother me with too many questions.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Yummy.
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? What's that? Does it taste good?
voicelines.promotion_2: Finally out of those old shackles... and here I am, straight into new ones. The destiny of a thief's no wonder.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Give me a bit of freedom and I'll be happy.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: What do we need a leader for? Can't everyone just fight on their own?
voicelines.depart: Meow... It's driving me wild... this sweet, sweet smell of freedom!
voicelines.begin_operation: Everyone, no need to have cold feet here.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Careful, kittens. Don't lose your mittens.
voicelines.in_battle_3: You think you've got all the trimmings, don't you?
voicelines.4-star_result: No one stands above a kitty in the end!
voicelines.3-star_result: Perfect victory? Whatever. A victory's a victory afterall.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Do you know how many enemies you let go? That will be a spanner in the works.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm no stranger to running for it, but this is just too embarrassing...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Kotatsu. Where's the kotatsu?
voicelines.trust_tap: Meow? I'm not satisfied yet. You know my rule: if I can't have it, I want it.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Spot
biography: Originally a Sargonsoldier, Spot took the initiative and came to Rhodes Island seeking employment himself. After passing the examination battery, he was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.He has a lot of experience as a guard; and serves as the defensive specialist on the team.
description: Spot, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide basic medical care while defending against enemies.
quote: He seems polite and gentle... until he opens his mouth.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.
voicelines.talk_1: I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.
voicelines.talk_2: What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.
voicelines.talk_3: Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.
voicelines.idle: Can I go back to my room now?
voicelines.onboard: Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I wanna get back to my dorm.
voicelines.depart: Got it.
voicelines.begin_operation: Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Don't see any harm in this.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Holding this shield is tiring, pal.
voicelines.4-star_result: Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.
voicelines.3-star_result: With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Perfection is for suckers, you know.
voicelines.operation_failure: Relax, you're doing fine.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Yeah sure.
voicelines.trust_tap: If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Popukar
biography: Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, Popukar requested and passed the trial to become an Operator for Rhodes Island. She was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.She possesses tremendous destructive power, becoming the team's heavy.
description: Popukar, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will use her chainsaw to drive away enemies that pose a threat to the Doctor.
quote: A good girl when she behaves herself, but a devil when she goes out of control.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!
voicelines.talk_2: Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!
voicelines.talk_3: The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!
voicelines.idle: Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...
voicelines.onboard: Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. I'm sorry my teammates are always fighting each other, Doctor… But don't worry, I know what to do.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!
voicelines.added_to_squad: My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…
voicelines.depart: Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!
voicelines.begin_operation: Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.
voicelines.deployment_1: I want to stop this fight.
voicelines.4-star_result: Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…
voicelines.3-star_result: Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.
voicelines.operation_failure: **A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Please don't leave me here alone...
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, headpats…
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

name: Midnight
biography: Initially a patient at Rhodes Island, volunteered to become an Operator. He was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6 after completing his examination battery.
description: Midnight, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will dispose of enemies with his swordsmanship.
quote: Surprisingly, he's quite skilled at fighting. Impressive.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Thank you for choosing me, Darling. Now, what kind of secret are you going to share with me under this velvet of the night?
voicelines.talk_1: Fiend of the Night? Ah, I can't hide anything from you. But past glory is nothing to me. After all, I have an even brighter future waiting.
voicelines.talk_2: I may work in a different place now, but my job is still the same—to put a smile on everyone's face.
voicelines.talk_3: I bet Ms. Orchid must have been born with a negative number on her happiness scale. Why else would she always look so stern whenever I'm there to light her up? If you know anything about her, please tell me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: People say my swordsmanship is top notch. All due credit, I have to say. Practicing swordsmanship helps me maintain my figure and cultivate my elegance. It'd be a crime for me to slack off on the pratice. After all, you either keep the momentum and hold the lead or end up getting overwhelmed. Please keep that in mind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: People used to say that I sold feelings as commodities, that I treated 'happiness' as a product. Fools, all of them. How can I expect my customers to open their hearts to me if I don't open mine to them first?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I believe happiness can be contagious. It's a tangible atmosphere that truly exists. I feel the joy when others treat me with sincerity, and I will make sure my happiness reaches right into their hearts.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My colleagues in team A6... they may be a bit weird, but they're truly kind souls. They're a gift from destiny, a gift that continues to remind me to cherish those important to me.
voicelines.idle: Now that I have some free time, I should read.
voicelines.onboard: Show me your brightest smile, my esteemed customer! Happiness is at arm's reach when you're by my side. Midnight, at your service.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: It's important to never stop learning!
voicelines.promotion_1: Whoa, so my hard work really paid off! Let's set up a champagne tower to celebrate. My treat.
voicelines.added_to_squad: With me on your side, success is guaranteed!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Follow this handsome me!
voicelines.depart: Show me your spirit, everyone!
voicelines.begin_operation: Behold, here comes my flamboyant moves!
voicelines.in_battle_1: O sword, pierce the moonlight that veils the night!
voicelines.4-star_result: Impressive, Dr. {@nickname}, truly impressive. Your blazing brilliance almost stole my show today.
voicelines.3-star_result: There's only one thing that's impossible for me: being imperfect.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Not too shabby. Such a heart-warming result calls for a little celebration.
voicelines.operation_failure: No need to look back. We'll greet each other with a smile next time.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: A wonderful place. Let's have a drinking party tonight.
voicelines.tap: There now, would you please leave my collar as it is?
voicelines.trust_tap: Thanks for taking care of me.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Catapult
biography: Originally a patient, she was accepted by Rhodes Island because she was found to be incredibly observant in examinations. Assigned to Reserve Op Team A6.
description: Catapult, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, is an expert at dealing with large targets.
quote: She can barely follow the Operator Regulations, but you'll never find her working overtime.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: We got a lot to do today, Doctor. So how about we play some games first? Isn't getting nice and relaxed the best way to prepare for a hard day of work?
voicelines.talk_1: Aw, I feel so lazy today for some reason! Maybe because Midnight isn't around? I love watching him chat up girls with that flashy smile of his. It's especially fun when the girls turn him down! Totally makes my day.
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor, you know who's the most reliable in our group? Oh, you can't guess? It's Spot! He might be quiet, but he's very reliable. So why don't we get him here to offer a hand? After all there's so much work for only two of us, don't you think?
voicelines.talk_3: Aw... Ms. Orchid yelled at me again today. She's such a nag! Must be work getting into her head and stressing her out. She should learn from me—I have the perfect balance between working hard and playing hard!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Hey, where's Dobermann? She's out on business today? Yay, finally! I can slack off all day now, wonderful! I'm gonna go get some snacks first. Doctor, you want some chips or popcorn? I'll grab a bag for you!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Uh, Popukar, sweetie, please listen to me, I'll do anything you say, okay? J-just put down the chainsaw! Oh no, she's out of control! This is the worst! Doctor, run! Run! We gotta jump out the window! Yeah, the window! Follow me!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: The town I came from... the mayor was a tyrant, a fat cat with no heart, no sympathy. Drove the townspeople nuts. I hated him too, so I blasted open his vault and handed out all the money I found to the townies. Now that was a good time!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I don't care what anybody thinks of me—it's more important that I just enjoy every day doing what I like. My life belongs to me, so I alone decide what I do. Isn't that right?
voicelines.idle: Doctor's asleep? Well, can't interrupt a beauty nap. Guess I'll go out and have some fun.
voicelines.onboard: Reserve OP Team A6, Catapult, reporting in! Hey, I can tell you're hella different from that stuffy old bit—I mean, that esteemed, honorable instructor Ms. Dobermann. Right? Like it's obvious!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: ...Ahhh, that was a nice nap.
voicelines.promotion_1: Hehe, I finally finished basic training. Wait, what? Dobermann will keep overseeing the newbies, even AFTER their promotions? You gotta be kidding me! No—
voicelines.added_to_squad: It's not time to head out yet, right? Let me hang out for a bit longer...
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm the captain? Haha~I've been waiting forever to hear those words!
voicelines.depart: Aw man, where did I leave my ammunition belt?
voicelines.begin_operation: Ugh, I hate fighting. But what else can I do?
voicelines.in_battle_1: Watch how I get them with one shot!
voicelines.4-star_result: What an awesome formation! You got some great tactics, Doctor. And it all went down perfect!
voicelines.3-star_result: I love commanders that lead us to victory! Just like you, Doctor!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Relax, I set a whole bunch of traps right where the enemy's gonna be running. What? They didn't step in any of them? No way!
voicelines.operation_failure: Oh shoot! Hurry up, Doctor. We gotta move!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Psst, care to take a peek and tell me if Dobermann's in there?
voicelines.tap: You can't catch me! ...Oh, you can.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, you're an awesome leader!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Orchid
biography: Former editor of a Columbian fashion magazine, Orchid began treatment at Rhodes Island following Oripathy. She expressed her desire to become an Operator, passed the examination battery and was assigned to Reserve Op Team A6 as the squad leader. She manages the team and provides support with her Arts in combat.
description: Orchid, Supporter Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide support for the squad with her Originium Arts.
quote: Make sure every second of her work time is recorded.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I'll make the arrangements. Just leave it to me.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, I certainly hope my teammates won't cause any trouble while I'm here working for you... Aagh, the more I think of it the worse this headache gets...
voicelines.talk_2: An ordinary job, a peaceful life. That's all I ever wanted.
voicelines.talk_3: Yeah, it's not that I don't get along with the other A6 members... I just get a little headache whenever I see them...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: My group members just bump into new troubles every day. There is the anti-social one, the never listening one, the awfully stubborn one… Just when will they ever settle down and work?...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I don't know how I ended up on this team either. All I wanted was an ordinary life. Why did I end up in charge of these... problem children?! Wait a minute, Midnight is a grown man!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Popukar... gotta pat her on the head. Catapult... gotta tie her up. Spot... never make him mad. As for Midnight, just knock him out. There, Doctor, now you know the proper protocol for dealing with Team A6.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I made a cake for my teammates. Wanna take a slice, Doctor? Everyone in A6 just love fruitcakes. They really are a bunch of kids, aren't they?
voicelines.idle: Not much time left. Done with your work for the day, Doctor?
voicelines.onboard: Captain of Reserve Op Team A6, Orchid, reporting in. Are you the Dr. {@nickname}? I look forward to working with you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I learned a lot from this video. I'll keep it in mind for sure.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you so much. I'll work hard to improve my skills from now on and strive for better results for you!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll complete my mission to the best of my ability.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Please follow the tactical combat manual closely, everyone. Thank you for your cooperation.
voicelines.depart: The battle has begun! Be careful, everyone!
voicelines.begin_operation: Please make sure you follow every detail on the plan. Alright, everyone, now spread out!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Oh come on, I already have enough work to deal with!
voicelines.4-star_result: Well done, Doctor! Impeccable leadership even against such a tough opponent.
voicelines.3-star_result: A perfect job! Looks like we can have a good rest today.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We need to work harder next time.
voicelines.operation_failure: Is everyone okay? Let's get out of here!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Oh, What a noisy place...
voicelines.trust_tap: Huh?! Overtime again?! Ugh, I knew it...
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Greetings, Doctor. Let's start today's work just as planned.

name: Steward
biography: Steward is a member of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Kjerag. Before he officially took the position, he worked as a freelancer. After an exceptional performance on his tests, he received permission to join Rhodes Island and now serves on the reserve team. He shows promise in the areas of Arts support, navigation, and combat support.
description: Steward, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will make way for the squad with his Originium Arts.
quote: Mr. Nice Guy of Reserve Squad A4.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.
voicelines.talk_1: Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.
voicelines.talk_2: I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.
voicelines.talk_3: People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.
voicelines.idle: Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.
voicelines.onboard: Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I have learned a lot. Thank you.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.
voicelines.added_to_squad: What can I do for you?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.
voicelines.depart: Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.
voicelines.begin_operation: They probably won't make it to tomorrow.
voicelines.4-star_result: With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.
voicelines.3-star_result: A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.
voicelines.operation_failure: Did we make a mistake somewhere...?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Ansel
biography: Ansel is a member of the Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Rim Billiton. Before officially taking up his post, he was a member of the Rhodes Island pharmaceutical intern staff. After excelling on multiple tests, he was permitted to join the Rhodes Island medic team.
description: Ansel, Medic Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide various first aid solutions for the squad.
quote: Do your best, Ansel!

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, it's time for your injection. Oh, um, are you alright?! Are you scared of needles?
voicelines.talk_1: Like Dr. Kal'tsit is always telling you, Doctor, you really need some exercise. I'm new here, but you still need to listen to my advice.
voicelines.talk_2: Cardigan! We've told you, if you move like that when you strike, you'll wind up getting hurt.
voicelines.talk_3: Good grief... Doctor, you need to take care of yourself. You can't make us do it for you.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Are you worried about my health after so many night shifts? You shouldn't be. My race has a unique way of producing hormones, which allows us to handle night activities better. So I can hand my shift over to Hibiscus at just the right time.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You must stop with the midnight snacks. Don't go bringing up my eating habits. I eat at night because of my race! Yes, it's a racial trait!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm Ansel. It's a little embarrassing to admit, but I chose to become a Medic because I've been sickly since I was young. But now that I'm an Operator, I'll make sure not to burden you. So please treat me just the same way you treat the others.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I know everyone does what they can. But I heard from Dr. Kal'tsit that Steward and Melantha's conditions aren't looking too good... My job is to make their lives as easy as possible. Doctor, let's redouble our efforts, together.
voicelines.idle: Adnachiel, could you ask Cardigan to settle down for a moment? The Doctor is resting.
voicelines.onboard: I am Ansel, a medical intern. I'll be assisting with surgery and internal medicine, among other things. I look forward to working with you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I hope I didn't cause you any trouble.
voicelines.promotion_1: I'm glad that you care so much for the wellbeing of us Medics.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Ready whenever.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Medical support should be the top priority for any tactical squad.
voicelines.depart: Alright, all medicine has been prepared.
voicelines.begin_operation: Injections ready. Prepare for battle.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Your medication is here. Take it!
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew, thank goodness I brought enough medicine. Please don't worry.
voicelines.3-star_result: I was very impressed by everyone's performance. It was fantastic.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Please hold on, I'll treat your injuries right away.
voicelines.operation_failure: We've sustained injuries! I need to get the wounded to the rear. Cover me!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I'm checking on the medical supplies here.
voicelines.tap: Whoa, Doctor, please don't mess with me!
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, I'm very glad that you like me.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Hibiscus
biography: Born in Londinium in Victoria, Hibiscus is the older twin sister of her fellow Operator, Lava. After contracting Oripathy, she came to Rhodes Island for treatment. While undergoing that treatment, she began to dream of helping others. Her passion for caring for others, as well as her hard work, have led Hibiscus to become a Rhodes Island Medic.
description: Hibiscus, Medic Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide reliable medical care for the wounded.
quote: Please handle her relationship with Operator Lava carefully.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Did you call for me, Doctor? I feel so happy to be with you!
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit said that you need to look after your health more. In two words, E-A-T L-E-S-S! So there!
voicelines.talk_2: You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!
voicelines.talk_3: Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!
voicelines.idle: Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.
voicelines.onboard: This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!
voicelines.promotion_1: It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...
voicelines.depart: Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!
voicelines.begin_operation: Ready to heal!
voicelines.in_battle_2: I can heal that wound in no time!
voicelines.4-star_result: Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!
voicelines.3-star_result: Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?
voicelines.operation_failure: No... First aid needed!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Anything I can help with?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

name: Lava
biography: Born in Londinium in Victoria, Lava is the younger twin sister of her fellow Operator, Hibiscus. After contracting Oripathy, she came to Rhodes Island for treatment. She found the idea of saving lives appealing, and so volunteered for training.
description: Lava, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will make way for the squad with her Originium Arts.
quote: Please handle her relationship with Operator Hibiscus carefully.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Need something? If you don't ,how about some divination?
voicelines.talk_1: Just tell me when there's work to do. But don't ever put her and me on the same team. I hate her guts. And don't get me started on all the weird food she makes me eat... Just thinking about it makes me... euurghh...
voicelines.talk_2: No one told me Hibiscus was at Rhodes Island before I got here... It's too late for me to quit now.
voicelines.talk_3: If you grow up sheltered, you don't know how to taunt, how to destroy, and how to handle yourself in a real fight. Am I right, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Have you ever heard the saying 'little sisters are justice'? If that's true, then my big sis is evil by default... at least as far as I'm concerned.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Instruments? I can play the piano a little. My teacher in Leithanien said learning an instrument can improve your Arts affinity. It also apparently eases the impact that Oripathy has on your mind...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm starving... Huh, what's this? You keep sweets in here? Nom... I'm in the middle of training. Should I really be eating this?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: See, like, I don't have a big beef with Hibiscus... It's all water under the bridge. I'm fine with her as long as she doesn't force me to eat her medicine and food. After all, she was the one... who saved my life...
voicelines.idle: I almost envy your ability to sleep like a log...
voicelines.onboard: I'm Lava, a Caster, here to join you simply because I'm bored and want something to do… But I heard my sworn nemesis is here too, though... Can I just quit now?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thanks.
voicelines.promotion_1: Did you forget? I don't need a cause to work for, and I don't need a team... but... thanks, I guess...
voicelines.added_to_squad: As far as teamwork's concerned... I don't mind, as long as nobody messes up.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm not good at this sort of stuff, but if you insist...
voicelines.depart: Let's go. Keep an eye on my back.
voicelines.begin_operation: I can see their souls. They're mine to reap.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Even the dead can't save you.
voicelines.4-star_result: The supreme form of Arts. I'm interested in seeing what it's like.
voicelines.3-star_result: I foresaw this result earlier. A perfect victory.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Well… My fortune telling isn't always right. Sometimes there's a lot of external noise that affects the outcome.
voicelines.operation_failure: Dammit... These evil spirits are too strong...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Oh, come on. I'd rather be alone.
voicelines.trust_tap: Eh, you're not scoring any points with me like that!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Adnachiel
biography: Adnachiel is a citizen of Laterano and enjoys rights one through thirteen afforded to all citizens of Laterano. Before his arrival at Rhodes Island, he worked as a freelancer. He received excellent results on a battery of tests and was assigned to Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4.He has demonstrated great potential in the areas of rapid response, marksmanship, and support operations.
description: Adnachiel, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will interrupt the enemies' attacks with his crossbow.
quote: His halo is lower than usual, but not his accuracy.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: That device you're holding seems to be in poor shape. Would you mind if I take a look at it?
voicelines.talk_1: Hey, Ansel. Cardigan looks good today. Anything I can help you with?
voicelines.talk_2: We have a squad of very interesting people, especially Melantha. She always seems to be hiding from me, but I can sniff her out.
voicelines.talk_3: Cardigan, what are you doing? You look so happy.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Not every Laterano has the right to use guns, rare weapons that they are. In my hometown, we're pretty good at making knockoff gun parts. The crossbow crafting industry is also on the rise. The result is what I have here - a crossbow with a tactical rail attachment.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Would you like to try some of my handmade sweets? I'm kind of ashamed that I can only make 25 types of desserts. It feels like I've disgraced the Laterano people.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: What's wrong with my halo? I don't know why, but it seems to have deviated slightly. According to Dr. Kal'tsit, it probably has something to do with my abnormal hippocampus.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Instead of watching you from afar, I feel much better standing by your side, Doctor.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, you strike an impressive figure, even when you rest like that.
voicelines.onboard: My name is Adnachiel. I'm a Sniper from Laterano. Although I'm not yet certified to carry a gun, I can match the veterans with my crossbow!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Put me to good use and I'll be more than happy.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you very much for the promotion.
voicelines.added_to_squad: We will be fine.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: If anything breaks, bring it to me. I may be able to fix it for you.
voicelines.depart: It's time to go. Are you ready?
voicelines.begin_operation: Let the hunt begin.
voicelines.4-star_result: Everything went just as you planned, Doctor.
voicelines.3-star_result: We have the Doctor's orders to thank for this.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Our operation was a success, but something feels a bit off...
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm so sorry...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This place has a great vibe.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor? I'm so happy to be with you!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

name: Kroos
biography: Originally from Rim Billiton. Kroos also received her training from the Columbian Garrison at Holmegard with Fang and Beagle. She is calm and constantly smiling as she maintains a gentle demeanor. However, she sometimes breaks her facade, revealing a sharp-tongued, ferocious side.
description: Kroos, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will interrupt the enemies' attacks with her crossbow.
quote: She is always aiming at her target.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, it's such a nice day, so can't we take a little nap?
voicelines.talk_1: Hmm...? We're about to leave? But I just got up... Wait, is this the Doctor's office? How'd I get here?
voicelines.talk_2: Why am I always squinting? Because I don't want anyone to see my eyes. Nope, nobody~
voicelines.talk_3: I'm really careless and get hurt a lot... But Hibiscus heals me every time, so I'm not afraid of getting injured. Oh gosh, that 'Curing Cuisine' of hers though, I'm terrified of it...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor! Someone left 10 alarm clocks by my bed! Who would do something so awful?!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, let's play a game~ Put an apple on your head and we'll start~
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm always looking for fun things to do as a way to ease the pain of my Oripathy, I guess. Plus, I love seeing other people smile~
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: One day, our journey with Rhodes Island will come to an end, and hopefully we'll all get to have a warm, neverending dream, lying in the sunshine~ That's my number one dream~
voicelines.idle: Can't believe the Doctor's a heavier sleeper than me...
voicelines.onboard: Hi-hiii~ I'm Kroos~ I might be inexperienced, but I'll do the best I can~
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you so much!
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion~ What a lovely dream~ Huh? I'm not dreaming?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Umm, where's the rally point?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Huhhh~? Fang would make a better captain than me!
voicelines.depart: Listen, everyone~! Stay calm~
voicelines.begin_operation: Why can't everyone try to get along...?
voicelines.deployment_2: I won't sleep on the job~
voicelines.4-star_result: Phew, that was tough...
voicelines.3-star_result: I think we did alright!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hmm, I guess this was a bit of a letdown...
voicelines.operation_failure: S-sorry... I'll fight harder next time...!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can I get my beauty sleep in here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Hmm, have I matured?

name: Beagle
biography: A frontline Operator on Reserve Op Team A1. She originally came to Rhodes Island with Fang and Kroos. Though immature in some respects, she has gradually displayed professionalism, resilience, and extreme talent. As a result, she has earned the recognition of others as a reliable Operator.
description: Beagle, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide a solid defense for the squad.
quote: Try to encourage her more.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, I'm your guard for the day! Don't worry, I won't let any sketchy people near you! Just relax!
voicelines.talk_1: My training score for today...? Um, I mean, we could talk about something else...
voicelines.talk_2: I can't shake the pre-battle jitters, and that makes Captain Fang really nervous too... What should I do? Doctor!
voicelines.talk_3: Hibiscus and Lava always complain to me about each other, but both of them are my good friends, and neither of them are wrong... Doctor, what should I do?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Instructor Dobermann always told us, 'Even when after you finish your training, your number one goal on the battlefield is to stay alive.' Urgh... How can I become as strong and awesome as she is?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I'm still a rookie Operator, but I'm working hard! Hehehe, I'd really love a compliment or two, if you agree.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: My Oripathy? It doesn't bother me all that much, I'm used to it. I just want to be with the people I care about until my disease gets cured... Ughh...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I didn't have much confidence before I came here, but I'm so glad that I can protect you and everyone on Rhodes Island! It's my dream to protect everyone! I really wish days like these could last forever.
voicelines.idle: Aww... seeing the Doctor sleeping all vulnerable like that makes me want to doodle something on a certain someone's face...
voicelines.onboard: My codename is Beagle! I know I didn't do very well on my assessment, but I'll still do my best at my internship!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I did it! I've become stronger!
voicelines.promotion_1: Finally, FINALLY! Now nobody's going to call me 'the Rookiest Rookie in the Rookieverse' anymore!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll do all I can!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Huh? I am the leader? I don't feel right about Fang not being the leader...
voicelines.depart: Everyone, let's roll out!
voicelines.begin_operation: Everyone, enemies incoming!
voicelines.4-star_result: It's my duty to protect everyone! My resolve will never falter, no matter the odds!
voicelines.3-star_result: All enemies have been defeated! We Rhodes Island Operators are the finest!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hooray, we won! Although a few enemies managed to get away... *sigh*...
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm sorry... so sorry...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: What can I do for you?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, can I come to your place to study every day?

name: Cardigan
biography: Cardigan is a member of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Leithanien. Before taking up her current position, she was a member of the Bobsled Patrol Team. After an exceptional performance on her tests, she received permission to join Rhodes Island.
description: Cardigan, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will run to the battlefield to provide reliable defense for the squad.
quote: If only she could quiet down for a while...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hello! It's my shift now, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_1: What does my 'Cardigan' codename mean? Ahh, It's actually the name of my clan. It's a family tradition to use it as a codename.
voicelines.talk_2: Wow, I found one of my people on another team! I've got to invite her to hang out with me sometime!
voicelines.talk_3: I was born in the north of Leithanien, a place full of snowy forests. Oh, that reminds me, I can teach you to ski, Doctor!
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: A lot of people say stuff like 'it's a Defender's job to hold her ground,' but that's such an outdated concept. Speed is what you need! This is the age of maneuver warfare! Mobility is the key to victory!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: *Sniff sniff*... I recognize that perfume, it's gotta be Melantha! I hope we can become closer friends... 'Cause then we'll be able to work better as a team!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Hehe, I really enjoy playing with kids. Back in my hometown, I took my brothers and sisters sledding every year. I really miss it! Oh, speaking of sleds... I wonder if Adnachiel can make one for me.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I have plenty of things I don't like. Oripathy, for instance... But there's no point in worrying too much. I would rather live my days in happiness! Plus, I've got you with me, Doctor!
voicelines.idle: Woof!
voicelines.onboard: Heeellooo! I've never been in such a big mobile facility before! I'm so excited! Merry of the Cardigan here. Are you the Doctor?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ehehe, thanks!
voicelines.promotion_1: Yay! I will keep fighting hard for my next promotion! I'm sure it will come in time!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Awesome! Finally, my time has come!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Ansel! Come on! I promise I won't lead everyone on a wild-goose chase!
voicelines.depart: Formation ready! Advance to the objective!
voicelines.begin_operation: Let's go! ...Steward, what was I supposed to do next?
voicelines.4-star_result: I knew we could do it. Right, Adnachiel?
voicelines.3-star_result: Yeeaaah! A flawless victory!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Thanks, Medics! You saved my life...
voicelines.operation_failure: Ughh... Sorry, Ansel...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Steward, what should I do next?
voicelines.trust_tap: Melantha? Huh? Why are you here, Doctor?!
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Melantha
biography: Melantha is the captain of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Victoria. Before she took up her current post, she was a typical jobless Infected. After an exceptional performance on her tests, she received an offer to join Rhodes Island.
description: Melantha, Guard Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide outstanding attack power for the squad.
quote: Never underestimate her blade.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: H-Hello, Doctor... It's nice meeting you...
voicelines.talk_1: Um... Sorry... I'm not a good talker...
voicelines.talk_2: Yes... My parents are Victorian merchants. But I haven't been able to contact them for a long time... I picked this code name because it reminds me of home.
voicelines.talk_3: Th-That masked Operator... makes me feel... nervous...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: It's not that... I'm trying to avoid people, it's just, I'm not sure... what I should do...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Sorry to make you worry again, Ansel... But you don't have to give me special treatment. Many more people need your help.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Oripathy granted me powerful senses, but they're slipping away, little by little... Even so, I will not crumble... There's so much more I want to talk about with everyone...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Doctor, could you take this bottle of perfume, please? I brought it from home... This type of perfume lifts spirits. I often take a sniff when I feel down.
voicelines.idle: Merry? Keep it down... The Doctor is very tired.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Melantha... From now on, my blade is yours.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you... for your guidance.
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you very much... Um, were the others promoted as well? I think they all deserve it just the same.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Understood... I'll follow your orders.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: The leader? But I'm not particularly good at giving orders...
voicelines.depart: Let's work to make the world a more peaceful place.
voicelines.begin_operation: Ansel... I'm counting on you now.
voicelines.4-star_result: No matter what difficulties are in store for me, I will keep on advancing.
voicelines.3-star_result: We won? Thank goodness for that...
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I can still fight.
voicelines.operation_failure: We failed... How did things end up this way?
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is there... anyone else here?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of me... Um, actually... I'd like to keep taking on the fight.

name: Plume
biography: Plume is a Liberi from Laterano, and former member of the Laterano Guard who bumbled her way out of Laterano and into Rhodes Island. She performs security, inspection, and loss prevention duties.
description: Plume, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide reliable defense for the squad and hold back the enemy.
quote: A guard of Laterano who looks serious all the time.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter what happens, I'll protect you.
voicelines.talk_1: Liberi have excellent eyesight. According to legend, some can even tell one droplet from another in a rainstorm. Sounds incredible, huh?
voicelines.talk_2: I take everyday life too seriously? My apologies. I think that comes from my time serving as a Laterano Guard. I'll work on that in the future.
voicelines.talk_3: To most Lateranos, heavy armor doesn't serve much of a purpose. Of course, when we perform the large-scale rituals of our homeland, we do dress up in ceremonial garb.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I appreciate your faith in my abilities, Doctor. I won't let you down.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Right... I submitted a request to the HR office... to become your personal bodyguard. I guess maybe I miss my old job too much.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I grew up in Laterano and didn't really have the chance to learn about other cultures. Here at Rhodes Island, I get to see such diversity, way beyond my imagination. Actually...it's not so bad.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I have no regrets. Yes, true, they did drag me out of Laterano against my will... but this has been a great adventure. I've enjoyed it.
voicelines.idle: It is my duty to protect you, Doctor. Rest assured.
voicelines.onboard: My name is Plume, formerly of the Pontifica Cohors Lateran. I will be your sword, and your wings, as I defend your very life.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ah, so tactics can help you overcome a more skilled opponent, huh?
voicelines.promotion_1: Thank you, Doctor. As your bodyguard, your approval is the best reward I can ask for.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm ready.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: As the leader, it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.
voicelines.depart: Watch the friendlies!
voicelines.begin_operation: Keep your guard up!
voicelines.in_battle_1: You think you're faster than me?
voicelines.in_battle_2: No move can escape my sight!
voicelines.in_battle_3: My resolve lies with my spear!
voicelines.in_battle_4: I fight for the glory of Laterano!
voicelines.4-star_result: Nothing can hold me back.
voicelines.3-star_result: Like a wave crashing against an immovable stone, isn't it?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Regroup! I'll look out for the remaining enemies!
voicelines.operation_failure: I can't... fall... yet!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Should I patrol this area?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor... it feels like I'm abusing my position...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Vanilla
biography: Vanilla is a Blacksteel trainee, currently training and studying as part of exchange program with Rhodes Island. She has learned to use her race's combat abilities to her advantage, and performs well as a Vanguard.
description: Vanilla, Vanguard Operator of Blacksteel, will make way for the squad on the battlefield with her professional skills.
quote: Don't let her know if you meet any wild animals.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Awaiting your orders, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: The two seniors from the BPRS squad are here too? In that case... Could you assign me to their squards in future missions, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_2: Huff... huff... three more sets of physical training and I'll be half-done for today. Doctor... please... fetch my water bottle for me...
voicelines.talk_3: You want to know about my hometown? My hometown… it's a cruel wilderness. Even survival itself is a difficult feat there. Compared to that, Rhodes Island is like heaven.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I've become stronger than when I was an intern for Blacksteel.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The 22nd rule of Blacksteel: 'Anyone who loses her weapon no longer belongs here.' That's why I always bring my hellebarde with me wherever I go. The rule doesn't apply to everyday situations, you say? But... if I remember correctly... wait, let me check. 'This rule only applies to contracted Operators and new recruits under training.' What?... Ms. Franka didn't tell me about this part...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Instructor Dobermann's really got a heart of stone! Why choose me other than anyone elase to deal with all those live Originium slugs? I... I just can't!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I think I know now why Franka and Liskarm decided to stay at Rhodes Island. Compared to Blacksteel, this is a place we can call home. There's lots of fun things to do here besides the missions...
voicelines.idle: Shh, the Doctor's having a rest now. Keep your volume down, would you?
voicelines.onboard: I'm Vanilla, trainee Operator from Blacksteel. Looking forward to learning from you, Doctor.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: It's time to organize my notes. I need to digest what I've just learned.
voicelines.promotion_1: A promotion medal? For me? My-my sincerest gratitude!
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'm here to help everyone!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Me, the leader? Are you sure about that?
voicelines.depart: I'll work even harder.
voicelines.begin_operation: I will not bring shame to Blacksteel!
voicelines.in_battle_2: This hellebarde isn't just for show!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Battles aren't always won by the most experienced!
voicelines.4-star_result: Whew, perfect victory!
voicelines.3-star_result: A very successful operation.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: If we worked a bit harder, we could have done better.
voicelines.operation_failure: I... I'm still not strong enough...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: At your service.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, would you like to dine with me tonight?

name: Fang
biography: Captain of Reserve Op Team A1. She has prior experience working with a Columbian garrison, and has proven herself to be outstanding in combat. After joining Rhodes Island, she had no problem adjusting to her current work. She joined the Operation Planning Group with its original members, Beagle and Kroos, and has worked hard to become its leading Operator.
description: Fang, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island, will fight on the battlefield to give the squad a tactical advantage.
quote: She runs really fast.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Is there anything I can help you with, Doctor?
voicelines.talk_1: Thank you for believing in me! I'll keep up my work!
voicelines.talk_2: Hibiscus and Lava are fighting again... What a pain. Why are they like this? They're sisters.
voicelines.talk_3: Instructor Dobermann puts us through mock battles a lot, but I can never get a handle on her skill. Doctor, next time you and Amiya observe our training, would you please give us some notes?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Someone on my team is late again, huh? I'll make sure that gets fixed.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Lava and I are both Infected, but I didn't get a talent for Arts like she did...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Rhodes Island is our home and shelter, Doctor. I will protect everyone here with my life.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: The ever-honest and reliable Beagle, the perceptive Kroos, the resourceful Lava and the energetic Hibiscus. I like everyone in this team... as long as Hibiscus doesn't force her health food innovations on me.
voicelines.idle: Shhh! The Doctor's resting. We can talk outside.
voicelines.onboard: Lancer Fang, captain of Reserve Op Team A1. My team and I will do our best to serve Rhodes Island.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you for your guidance.
voicelines.promotion_1: Your approval means so much to me, Doctor. This promotion proves my hard work is paying off.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Leave it to me.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I know the captain's duty well. Rest easy.
voicelines.depart: Team, check your gear before departing.
voicelines.begin_operation: Enemy spotted. Prepare to fight!
voicelines.4-star_result: With the right plan, even rookies like us can win a tough fight!
voicelines.3-star_result: We have accomplished our objective as planned.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: We can't call a mission complete if we let even a single enemy get through. Beagle, let's do better on the next one.
voicelines.operation_failure: I'm sorry I failed you, Instructor Dobermann...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Yes. I'm back. Is Kroos here too?
voicelines.trust_tap: Am I helping?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: I'm ready whenever you need me, Doctor.

name: 12F
biography: 12F was the alias commonly used by this Operator in his mercenary work. By his own account, he vacillated between different factions and was involved in several famous battles over the past few years. The few verifiable documents we have confirmed that 12F was indeed present for these conflicts, either as a regular mercenary or security for a local facility. He joined Rhodes Island with Owl, having been admitted for his unique combat experience as well as his experience in general. Now a standard Arts Operator assigned to normal duty.
description: 12F, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide tactical aid for the squad with Originium Arts.
quote: At least he can help out with something.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Forgive me, Doctor... There are limits to what I can do, including in conversation... but I'm honored to be your assistant. I look forward to helping you with your work.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, time heals all wounds. Please have more confidence in yourself. Your Operators have chosen to follow you because we believe that you will bring positive change.
voicelines.talk_2: Many Infected have relocated to Rhodes Island... not because they have any particular goals to achieve, but simply because they want a place to call home. The world outside no longer accepts them, after all...
voicelines.talk_3: Owl may not seem very friendly, but she's got a good heart. Please excuse her and pay her no mind.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: 12F? That was the day I 'came to' this world. You could consider it my birthday.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I might not be able to spend my entire life serving one person... but at least I can start working on it now.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: She has finally found you, Doctor. What a perilous journey it's been. You're very important to her, as well as to everyone else.
voicelines.idle: I'll be by your side watching over you, Doctor, even in your sleep. So rest easy, you have nothing to fear.
voicelines.onboard: You have my thanks for allowing me to join you. From now on, I will do my best to serve you, Doctor, with my alchemical skills. I have never had a name... but if you must call me something, you can refer to me as 12F.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I see, I understand now. Thank you for your guidance.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I may not possess outstanding skills, but I will do my best.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Will it be alright for me to be the leader? Anyway, thank you for your trust, Doctor.
voicelines.depart: Relax, Doctor. We will complete this operation in no time.
voicelines.begin_operation: Everyone, get ready for battle.
voicelines.4-star_result: I'm used to failure... but a victory after countless defeats is always the most precious one. Don't you agree, Doctor?
voicelines.3-star_result: This victory is all yours, Doctor. And I am honored to be a pawn in your game of chess.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: That was a hard-won victory, but we did it. Are you all right, Owl?
voicelines.operation_failure: Failure is only normal. Don't be discouraged. I've been in many wars, and my experience tells me that your victory will come soon.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: If you'd like, I can help. No trouble.
voicelines.trust_tap: I am so thankful for all that you have done for me. I feel ashamed I have so little with which to repay your kindness. Forgive me, Doctor.

name: Durin
biography: Durin serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. She has a tremendous aptitude for Arts but is unable to fully realize her potential due to her physiology. Extremely narcoleptic, she is able to fall asleep at just about any place or time despite averaging more hours of sleep than most operators. Despite this, she makes very few mistakes in her work.
description: Durin, Caster Operator of Rhodes Island, will give the squad a tactical advantage with her Originium Arts.
quote: She looks quite sleepy.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...
voicelines.talk_1: How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?
voicelines.talk_2: What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...
voicelines.talk_3: You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.
voicelines.idle: After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...
voicelines.onboard: Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.
voicelines.added_to_squad: The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!
voicelines.depart: I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.
voicelines.begin_operation: Take over for me. Thaaanks.
voicelines.4-star_result: Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.
voicelines.3-star_result: Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?
voicelines.operation_failure: Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!
voicelines.trust_tap: I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Rangers
biography: Rangers serves on Rhodes Island Reserve Op Team A4. A longtime veteran, he has traveled to many different places prior to serving in Rhodes Island's reserves. An expert archer, he still retains the characteristic agility and vigor of the Savras despite his advanced age.
description: Rangers, Sniper Operator of Rhodes Island, will repel enemy attacks with his longbow.
quote: His energetic disposition conceals his age.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.
voicelines.talk_1: A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_2: I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.
voicelines.talk_3: I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.
voicelines.idle: Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.
voicelines.onboard: I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Not bad.
voicelines.added_to_squad: My turn, is it?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.
voicelines.depart: Let's get going.
voicelines.begin_operation: Prey spotted. Commence operation.
voicelines.4-star_result: Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?
voicelines.3-star_result: What a satisfying battle!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.
voicelines.operation_failure: Oh no, I'm out of breath...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: If you need anything, just say the word.
voicelines.tap: Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...
voicelines.trust_tap: You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Doctor, how can I help you?

name: Noir Corne
biography: One of Rhodes Island's core Operators. On the battlefield, he rushes to the vanguard to protect his teammates, but back at the Ark, he quietly dedicates himself to logistical duties.
description: Noir Corne, Defender Operator of Rhodes Island, will provide a solid defense for the squad.
quote: You can see him cleaning his mask carefully every day.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.
voicelines.talk_1: My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.
voicelines.talk_2: What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.
voicelines.talk_3: Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.
voicelines.idle: Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.
voicelines.onboard: Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.
voicelines.added_to_squad: We bringing friends?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm gonna get even stronger!
voicelines.depart: Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!
voicelines.begin_operation: We're doing it!
voicelines.4-star_result: Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.
voicelines.3-star_result: That was all right.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Well, we managed.
voicelines.operation_failure: This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Alright, let's take a breather.
voicelines.trust_tap: You wanna get some drinks after work?

name: Yato
biography: Yato is the team leader of the core operators. She is a loyal and dependable warrior.
description: Yato, Vanguard Operator of Rhodes Island, will fight on the battlefield to give the squad the upper hand.
quote: Everyone admires how much effort she puts into training.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.
voicelines.talk_1: I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.
voicelines.talk_2: Hm? Do you need something?
voicelines.talk_3: My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...
voicelines.idle: Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...
voicelines.onboard: Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Thank you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yato has joined the team.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.
voicelines.depart: All Operators, be on alert.
voicelines.begin_operation: Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.
voicelines.4-star_result: As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.
voicelines.3-star_result: The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Victory is the most welcome news.
voicelines.operation_failure: I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.

voicelines.greeting: Doctor, I will be your shield.

name: Terra Research Commission
biography: The Terra Research Commission is formed of three Felynes, and despite being officially established as the 'Felyne Special Operations Unit,' nevertheless retains its name due to the Scholar's fierce attachment to the 'Commission' title. The group contains a Scholar specializing in ecological research, an Artisan specializing in smithing, and a Palico with a wealth of hunting experience. While acting as a unit they specialize in pushing wooden carts. The Felynes are broadly popular owing to their lovable appearances, and presently undertake work responding to unusual foreign species.
description: A trio of Felynes willing to brave death to satiate their curiosity for the world of Terra.
quote: This may not necessarily earn you victory, but it will get you back to camp safely.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Remember, you two, this purr-ticular assistant role calls for maximum vigilance. If any meownsters come knocking, we throw the Doctor on the cart and go!
voicelines.talk_1: Curious about our latest research? We're gnawing on 'An Investigation into Biological Discrepancies Between Us Felynes with a Y and Terran Felines with an I.' We were halfway done, but then we found out you have Aslans too, so it's back to the scratching post for us... You Terrans are meowder with your subspecies!
voicelines.talk_2: Your Meowjesty, never forget to eat your fill before you go on a hunt. Dive into a fight with full stamina, and you might end up doing things you didn't even think you could... mrrreow!
voicelines.talk_3: *dink* *dink* No Machalite Ore left... Could substitute with Rock Spider stones and gloompincer shells... Don't know without trying. In you go.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The mountains never fail to remind me of an old bud, built just as tall and strong. He broke his weapon once and quit the Palico life after, but if memory serves, he then went with the Research Commission to take up cheffing in the New World... You never know what turn your next life'll take.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Say, Doctor, I'll let you in on a secret trick, friend to... maybe furless friend. If you ever get hurt in battle and you need to chug a Potion, set off a Barrel Bomb behind you while you do. Why? It'll stop any baddies getting the pounce on you, that's why!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Terra has new materials. Lots of ores. Very lovely... Maybe I can make a weapon just like that Great Sword in the ice cave back home! For mew, Doctor!
voicelines.idle: Meow, meow, lots of... fascinating things in Doctor's room. Want to move them elsewhere, while Doctor's asleep... Smithy! Stay your paw!
voicelines.onboard: On Your Meowjesty's summons, we the Felyne Special Corps... cream of the crop of the Terra Research Commission's Furst Fleet, have arrived! Meowch! Get your hind paws off my head!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: What are you doing inside this box, Smithy? Im... Impawssible! It's all moving! How is it done?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Ready for departure!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: A simple task! I'm a purr-ime leader, after all!
voicelines.depart: Let's go, 'Hunters!' Put some pep in your step!
voicelines.begin_operation: Purr-ey spotted. Watch out, Your Meowjesty.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Taste the flaming soul of a hunter!
voicelines.4-star_result: Are... Are we out of danger meow? Can I open my eyes yet?
voicelines.3-star_result: Absolutely stellar command, Your Meowjesty. That's what I call great gains... mrreow.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Equipment everywhere... grabbing, all of it. Grabbing and going.
voicelines.operation_failure: Good gravy, they're catching up! Run, run like your tail's on fire!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Hauling, hauling... Smithy, why do you drag that meowntain of materials with you everywhere you go?
voicelines.trust_tap: What are you doing? Mrrow... right there, please... Hey, save a pet or two for me!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Ah, Doctor! Fine day to mew!
