name: 'Justice Knight'
biography: 'Justice Knight' is a Raythean Exister-S1044 Model four-wheeled operation platform customized by a Kazimierzian engineer, later remodeled and upgraded by Mayer and Closure. Owing to its main searchlight function lacking use value, and its cover fire capacity being limited in its target market, its production has been halted. Before the Rhodes Island Engineering Department got their hands on her, 'Justice Knight' had already gone through a dozen modifications, big and small; her present capabilities are easily a far cry from the original model. Her old operating system and command memory data were damaged, unable to be recovered. After a swap for new core hardware and an expanded memory unit, an updated operating system plus additional artificial voice system, she is now hardly distinguishable from Raythean Industries's latest operation platforms. 'Justice Knight' is a member of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, and is currently authorized for use by Rhodes Island.
description: 'Justice Knight' of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, tasked at Rhodes Island with cover fire support.
quote: She knows that she's a robot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Beep-Beep. Understood. Classification program initiated. Now sorting the Doctor's documents. Will you want any snacks during work? Justice Knight could pick some up for you from the cafeteria.
voicelines.talk_1: Ever since Closure and Mayer installed a human voice patch, Justice Knight's functionality as a smart assistant has gone right up! Being able to use natural language logic really has improved communication so much when helping out my masters.
voicelines.talk_2: Justice Knight's master, the Wild Mane Knight Iwona, found Justice Knight in a scrapped state. She rebooted and fixed this unit. Ever since then, Justice Knight've been in charge of her and her partners' everyday lives, as well as supporting them on missions.
voicelines.talk_3: Doctor... why does my master say things to this unit like 'Justice, you're too noisy these days. Go play somewhere else if you've got nothing to do!'? Beep-Beep…Beep-Beep... Justice Knight doesn't understand.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Everyone in Pinus Sylvestris is incredibly hard-working, always putting meals off so they can train their knightly skills. There has to be a day where their bodies won't keep up. None of them have time to fetch their lunchboxes, so it's all up to Justice Knight to bring them over.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: A low battery? Sorry, this unit is not sure if any of my functions will be of help to you... What? it's the games console that's almost out? Please get this wire plugged in straight away!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Beep-Beep. Doctor, you discovered Justice Knight's secret. Justice Knight has no other choice but to take firm action in order to protect the secret... Master? You'll allow Justice Knight to keep tending to the plants in the Convalescent Garden? Thank you, Doctor. You now have unlimited access to all services of Justice Knight!
voicelines.idle: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep. Apologies, Doctor. Justice Knight always forgets to disable the automatic timeteller feature.
voicelines.onboard: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep…Beep! ('Justice Knight,' glad to be reporting in along with everyone from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... Justice Knight will be of great use to you all!)
voicelines.watching_battle_record: These are very useful resources for this unit. Justice Knight will apply to Miss Closure for installing even more new functions.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Justice Knight, all ready and set!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Are you leaving command to Justice Knight? It might be a little challenging for this unit right now…
voicelines.depart: Justice Knight, setting off!
voicelines.begin_operation: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight will provide you all with proper and timely support!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Justice Knight, all good to go!
voicelines.deployment_2: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight is now in position.
voicelines.4-star_result: Beep-Beep, BeepBeepBeep-- Sorry, Justice Knight got too worked up. Doctor, master, Justice Knight has made it!
voicelines.3-star_result: Possiblilites of new function development detected! Justice Knight, awaiting for orders to return to Rhodes Island!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: There is still room for improvement. Anyway, we won! Congratulations, Doctor!
voicelines.operation_failure: Please don't... throw Justice Knight... away again...
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Beep-Beep, Justice Knight has plenty of things to do here.
voicelines.tap: Beep-Beep! Don't treat this unit like that… Negative!
voicelines.trust_tap: The washing machine... doesn't seem too hard to use...

name: THRM-EX
biography: Thermal-EX (also known as THRM-EX) is a high-performance version of the Raythean Challenger™ Hellcat operating platform, jointly customized by Mayer and Closure. Between the two, Mayer was primarily responsible for the development and improvement of the weapon and energy supply systems. Thermal-EX is a rather peculiar presence and is extremely enthusiastic towards others, a characteristic that is beloved by some people and disliked by others. However, Thermal-EX remains undaunted, committed to using his incandescent personality to bring warmth to others in this frigid world. As a new model, Thermal-EX's boasts a unique and aggressive appearance that can be somewhat intimidating. But he doesn't mind. After all, anyone can hear Thermal-EX's loud and warm greetings from a distance long before he's clearly visible. However, it seems like his vocabulary has been excessively bloated with words pertaining to 'hot'...
description: Thermal-EX (a.k.a. THRM-EX), Specialist robot of Rhodes Island, is assigned by Engineer Closure to carry out combat missions.
quote: He knows that he's a robot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Thermal-EX, ready to commence thermal shock! What, it's not yet the designated combat time? Then, I shall postpone it. Commencing thermal shock after ten second delay!
voicelines.talk_1: I have heard an expression from the East: 'No martial art is infallible, except for heat.'
voicelines.talk_2: Doctor, it's a great honor to be with you! My burning heart just can't calm down! And by that, I mean the Raythean Industries custom-made full-thermal Arts impact generator I have installed!
voicelines.talk_3: In the beginning, God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light. God said, 'Let there be power,' and there was the high-performance variant of Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: As a perfect industrial-grade mass-produced combat platform, I am very happy now! Not only do I get regular performance optimizations from Mayer, but I even get to work with passionate partners like Blaze! Life is so good!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Dazzling though I am, you, the peerless Doctor, are the only one I could call my brightest sun!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I know that the heat and light I emit is so very short-lived... But all that matters is that I can illuminate the path before you, Doctor!
voicelines.idle: Even when you're asleep, I can continue to work as your heater! I'm incredible!
voicelines.onboard: Born from Raythean Industries, improved by the hands of the great Mayer. I, Thermal-EX, the throbbing heart of hotness, am here to help!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Ohhhhh! This power blazing within me... It's… It's… It's a hotfix!
voicelines.added_to_squad: Now, it's my turn to show off!
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: What's the situation?
voicelines.depart: All units, move out!
voicelines.begin_operation: Rock and roll!
voicelines.4-star_result: Aren't I awesome? I knew your command would be a perfect match for me, Doctor!
voicelines.3-star_result: BRAVO~ BRAVO~!!!! Doctor!!!
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: My retreat was just a fluke. Nothing can be allowed through our battlefield net.
voicelines.operation_failure: Contact! Contact! Enemy ambush! Dropping smoke! Doctor, I'll cover your retreat!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Rest? Haha, it's too early for me! I just swapped to the newest energy storage device, so we have fifty more hours until the end of the workday!
voicelines.tap: A-ha! My thermal sensor feels your burning heart!
voicelines.trust_tap: Your burning enthusiasm has melted my processor!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Welcome back, Doctor! I see that you're also full of light and heat today!

name: Castle-3
biography: Castle-3 is a custom Raythean -Plus six-wheeled operations platform built by Closure. A likeable mascot for Rhodes Island, his mundane disposition means he is largely ignored. The solid blocky appearance of Castle-3 gives off a trustworthy, dependable impression. The marks on his casing may represent kills, but who made the marks if he has no hands?
description: Castle-3, Guard robot of Rhodes Island, is assigned by Engineer Closure to carry out combat duties in the field.
quote: He knows that he's a robot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Thank you for choosing Castle-3! I am honored to serve as your assistant, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, please do not be intimidated by my appearance. My sturdy metal shell, modified by Master Closure herself, will make you invincible on the battlefield.
voicelines.talk_2: Warning: be careful not to strike my case too hard. It may damage me.
voicelines.talk_3: The topography in the wild may be treacherous, but Castle-3 is fitted with an engine with outstanding performance and a 4WD mode, to whisk you away from danger.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, if your life is ever in danger, just summon Castle-3! Castle-3 was created specifically for combat purposes. I am a top-class defensive warfighting robot.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Castle-3 is honored to be at your side. Doctor, should you require me to strike down your foes, I shall go through heaven and hell to see it done!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Castle-3's official manager is 'Master Closure,'but please understand that you are even more important to Castle-3 than Master is, in most cases. I am your devoted, trustworthy battle companion!
voicelines.idle: Entering sleep mode. Press any button to wake.
voicelines.onboard: Hello, Doctor. Thank you for choosing Castle-3. Tap anywhere to initialize startup options.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Device scan complete. All communications working as normal. Castle-3 is on standby, awaiting your orders.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Understood. Castle-3 is your best choice, Doctor, to lead a squad against enemy formations!
voicelines.depart: Next, Castle-3 will show you its true power as an industrial battle platform!
voicelines.begin_operation: Enemy unit located. Ready for attack.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Enemies, you are forbidden to advance.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Doctor, that was at last a worthy opponent!
voicelines.4-star_result: Well done, Doctor. Castle-3 is your best choice on the path of justice!
voicelines.3-star_result: What an exciting battle! Let's fight together again next time.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Is everyone all right? I hope Castle-3's performance has exceeded your expectations.
voicelines.operation_failure: I will hold up the rear. Everyone, retreat!
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Is there anything Castle-3 can help with?
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, would you like to grab a drink together? I might not be able to actually have a drink, but I can still treat you to one. It is fine, Master Closure will pay.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Lancet-2
biography: Lancet-2 is a custom Raythean-S62 Model six-wheeled operations platform. Its rounded design has led Lancet-2 to be perceived as cute, making her something of a mascot. Although she has a rather pessimistic dispensation, she is still well-liked. After being modified by Closure, Lancet-2 is able to perform more medical duties around the island, and her equipment is geared towards disinfecting and cleaning Originium contamination.
description: Lancet-2, Medic robot of Rhodes Island, is assigned by Engineer Closure to carry out medical assistance in the field.
quote: She knows that she's a robot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Do you require medical assistance, Doctor? But, you look quite well…?
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, you have been working far too late these days. Please get adequate rest, or Dr. Kal'tsit may give you an earful again…
voicelines.talk_2: Are you feeling unwell? I could give you a medical examination, if you wish.
voicelines.talk_3: You've worked hard, Doctor. How would you like a cup of coffee? Actually, I've always wanted to try coffee... but... I can't drink… Anyway, I am also satisfied watching you enjoy yours.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I've printed out the results of the routine blood test you just did. All indicators are normal. But Doctor, your blood appears to be very unique…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: What do I like? I like 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Why, you ask? Uh... I'm not sure either... It's been my default setting ever since the first time Ms. Closure switched me on…
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I am only useful when healing the sick or injured. But as long as you're healthy, as long as I get to be by your side, I'm okay with being totally useless. I'll still feel calm and satisfied.
voicelines.idle: Doctor, unbeknownst to you, I recorded your snoring just now. Your sleep quality is normal. The length of your REM sleep cycle is—
voicelines.onboard: Hi, nice to meet you, Doctor. I understand that you want me to say something more interesting, but I'm afraid I cannot do so. Because I'm just a medical robot…
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Medical supplies: confirmed. Battery charge: confirmed. Ready for deployment.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Doctor, I'm pretty cumbersome. There's not much I can do besides providing emergency treatment and healing... Are you sure you still want me to be the captain?
voicelines.depart: Moving out. Everyone, please be safe.
voicelines.begin_operation: Be careful, everyone. Leave the first aid to me.
voicelines.4-star_result: With every battle, we suffer even more casualties. When will humans finally stop hurting each other?
voicelines.3-star_result: Well done, Doctor. That was a tough battle. Um, the enemies do not look well. Can I treat them too?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Is everyone okay? Please hold still, I'll perform first aid.
voicelines.operation_failure: Don't worry, we've successfully retreated. I will clean your wounds now. It might hurt, please be brave.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Lovely Ms. Closure' told me that you need help here.
voicelines.trust_tap: I asked 'lovely Ms. Closure' to change 'what I like the most' to you, Doctor. But she refused to do it...
voicelines.title: Arknights.

description: Caster Operator Ho'olheyak walks the long, winding path of history.
quote: She once attempted to go against the currents, but has now made up her mind to go with the tide.
trait: Deals Arts damage

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Here, two Minoan Mists, freshly brewed... I'll have to behave myself, Doctor, since I'm your assistant now. The next time you choke on my strangling tail after getting me mad, I'll make sure you can at least find some solace in my feathers.
voicelines.talk_1: Immoral scientist, disloyal mercenary, double-crossing spy... Yes, that's all me. Rules are what bar you from working to your full efficiency, darling, and you must learn to break them. That being said, I'm sure you have more to share with me for what little time we have alone together, other than the rules of Rhodes Island, I suppose?
voicelines.talk_2: As senior consultant to Rhodes Island, I'd love to have more time to study the archives and collections of this ship. Meet my coworkers? You see the flow of history and soundless order in those objects. Tell me, what's worth seeing in people?
voicelines.talk_3: 'Reflect the truth and glimpse the future'? Most astrologers got started just to steal a peek at their own doom. But when Kristen tore open the skies over Trimounts, she debunked astrology as the silly fabrication it is. And that's more interesting than the practice itself.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: The foolish build walls, the wise topple them... or vice versa. History is a database that holds more than it seems, full of hints about the future. After all, history itself was the future for countless generations... that's what really grips me.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Our story? Feathers wet by dew from the trees, tails sweeping past decrepit pillars. Thus, knowledge was passed on through generations. We embrace the ever-expanding unknown, and walk toward madness... I don't want to lose my mind, of course. But if that's what it takes to change this ridiculous fate, then I'll do it gladly.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, were you… avoiding me? I just wanted to show you a newly-excavated ruin I found. What's that? Why do I keep bothering you? Oh my, shouldn't you do some soul-searching and ask why you are the only one I'm bothering?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I saw you with Muelsyse at the mall in Trimounts. That elf surely knows how to work her charm, doesn't she? I could use some assistance from you as well, but my 'approaches' are different. Look down now, my tail will gladly learn the way through your heart, unless you accept my offer.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Tell me, Doctor, how does it feel to lose your memory? I couldn't bear to see a great library reduced to ashes in a fire. But a librarian fool enough to only brush the dust off the shelves pains me even more. Who's sadder, you or me?
voicelines.idle: Your ears are red. Sensitive, aren't they? Puff... oh, they're getting redder! Now don't you move. You're still at work, you know.
voicelines.onboard: I'm not here representing Maylander or Rhine Lab. I'm here because I, Ho'olheyak, want some further contact with Rhodes Island... Now, now, why are you trying to shake off my hand? I haven't finished introducing myself yet.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Are we done yet?
voicelines.promotion_1: Congratulations. You've earned yourself a promotion from me too. This time, I brewed four Minoan Mists... do they really punch you that hard? Stay sober now, if you know what's good for you.
voicelines.promotion_2: Another promotion? Does that mean more permissions at Rhodes Island? There are secrets in this ship that even you don't know about, I can sense that. Just what fun we'll have!
voicelines.added_to_squad: My job is to innovate on these missions. Your job is to be impressed.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: There's no plan. Plans change anyway. As long as it helps the mission, you can break the rules at any time.
voicelines.depart: I'd rather operate solo.
voicelines.begin_operation: Oh? What a surprise.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: I thought I was just here as a consultant.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: My, my...Are you sure you want to treat me as a mercenary?
voicelines.deployment_1: Such ruthlessness! I said I don't like getting my feathers wet.
voicelines.deployment_2: How rude~ Didn't I tell you not to get dust on my tail?
voicelines.in_battle_3: Oh, your Arts aren't working. How can that be?
voicelines.in_battle_4: Did I say I was going to have mercy? I lied.
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, your performance reminds me of a bunch of unfounded legends. But now, I believe in them. Legends no more.
voicelines.3-star_result: Are you… waiting for a compliment?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Nothing is 100% true. Similarly, nothing is 100% false. Doctor, what we've done is already enough to bring all kinds of change.
voicelines.operation_failure: Leave the rest to me. I'm used to picking up other people's messes. Use the time to think about how you'll thank me.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Excuse me, are we accommodating a mercenary here, or is this how Rhodes Island welcomes their senior consultant...? Heh, Just kidding.
voicelines.tap: What, here to challenge Siestan Iced Tea? Or, Minoan Mist?
voicelines.trust_tap: Careful! These are rare documents. How did I get them? Relax, not by following procedure, I assure you. What, you wanna interrogate me?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Well, if it isn't the Doctor… What a coincidence, us bumping into each other.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: So you're saying I have the right to decide your schedule and itinerary? Which means, whatever I write in this memo book, Doctor, you've gotta do. Wowie! Too late for regrets now, heehee.
voicelines.talk_1: Ecology's about filling some dirt, putting some plants and animals on it, then making a profound study about the cyclic relationships between individuals, species, and biocommunities. With the help of innovative research, we can improve the ecosphere or even forge a brand-new... Well, someone clearly knows it all, because that's an unadorable look you're giving me. Alrighty, let's change topics.
voicelines.talk_2: I want you to come with me next time I go clothes shopping. The thing is, I don't really understand fashion stuff so much, and I wanna hear your ideas. What, you don't either? Sure! If you've got opinions, and I've got opinions, then we can do swapsies. Plus, I get to see you wearing something else for once.
voicelines.talk_3: Are your lips kind of dry there...? Yeah, they look a little chapped. You need more water on the regular. Alright, you can have my chapstick, and then we're even again once you buy me a new stick. This is the only brand I use, and it's gotta be peppermint flavor. Don't get the wrong one. Okay?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Looking back on it, it's like Rhine was just founded yesterday. The stuff we fought over at that time is a total one-eighty compared to now. Heheh, good memories… Doctor, Do you still remember when Rhodes Island was new on its feet? No? That's fine, you'll remember with enough time.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Here I am, dewdrop landed on a leaf, but we'll be baked away in the sun soon enough. Oh, don't let it end here. We could melt together, dew filling leaf's veins, and make our grand return to the land... um, that's about dew, okay? Like, it's just dew that wants to—um... Mmm...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Has Magallan been good recently? Oh, still out exploring? Hasn't said when she gets back yet? Aw, okay... I've still got the crystals she sent me last time, out in cold storage. Any interest in this stuff? Well, well, I see you have a good hobby. Come on, let's crack open your horizons.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: If Kristen didn't have the talent and leadership, Rhine Lab would've never been founded. But maybe it was her power that got her to bare her true self to everyone in the end. People change. I wonder what I'll become?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My people have no future. We've only been able to pray for answers from the past. You're from the past, Doctor. You're the hope of my people, and me. But even if that wasn't the case, you're still the one who pulled me from the bubbles, and you're still gripping my hand. How could I ever let go now, right?
voicelines.idle: Getting distracted on the job? Terrible habit.
voicelines.onboard: Muelsyse, Director of the Ecological Section at Rhine Lab. Not that I think we need any formal how-do-you-dos, Doctor. After all, we've been friends forever now.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: There really isn't a single fresh thing anywhere across the lands.
voicelines.promotion_1: A present from you? I'll keep it nice and safe, that's a guarantee. How about in return, let's go to the movies?
voicelines.promotion_2: Dew gets turned to vapor, and everything in it vanishes without a trace. Will I ever see showers of blessing? Will I ever meet my people again and know them anew?
voicelines.added_to_squad: Sunlight's a little spicy. Just let me take five.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Okay, maybe I should assign roles first?
voicelines.depart: The way seems kind of rough. Careful, you don't want to trip.
voicelines.begin_operation: Annoying people, annoying business. Let's deal with them ASAP.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Now's not the time for hellos.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Let animosity be gone with the flow.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Oh wishes, I beg you coalesce.
voicelines.4-star_result: Good work. Need to get under this umbrella?
voicelines.3-star_result: Job's done, be sure to rest up now.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I told you to be careful... any ouchies?
voicelines.operation_failure: I got my mirages to lead them off. We'll go this way.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Let's really decorate this place. It'll be cozy in no time, promise.
voicelines.trust_tap: If anything's bothering you, put it to one side for now. Here, try this out, 'Orange Storm'.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hiya! How about a little chat before you get to work?

description: Saint Federico Giallo, known here as Executor.
quote: Now when given a task, he might sometimes ask why.
trait: Cannot be healed by allies; Attacks deal AOE Damage; Recovers 50 HP for every enemy hit during attacks, up to Block count

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Yes, I have received the notification that fragmentation mines are forbidden in the corridors. But rest assured, Doctor, the high voltage fencing installed on your door violates no ordinances.
voicelines.talk_1: Indeed, I was the one who introduced recent Lateran Operators to Rhodes Island. If you have no objections, I will continue to introduce functionaries with special circumstances to you. I hope to study how Sankta live outside Lateran, and how it compares to their life within.
voicelines.talk_2: This mission may call for a piano performance? Do not worry. I have memorized the complete scores of over a hundred classical pieces, and I can play every note in accurate order. Any properly trained executor should be capable of this. That does not count as playing the piano? I do not understand.
voicelines.talk_3: The title 'Saint' can neither enhance my abilities nor reveal any precise mission to me. Though it has added difficulties to my work, I cannot fathom why I was chosen. Its objective and demands are something I must seek myself.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Doctor, this is my medical examination report, please confirm. Currently, no horns have grown on my head, and my halo has seen no changes in shape or form. Indeed, my violation of the law has not had a physical effect on me, but it's nothing worthy of celebration. Abnormalities have been on the rise. This is an omen of disaster.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Doctor, during my recent missions, my limbs have been acting before I complete my thought processes. This phenomenon can impede successful completion of my missions. I am troubled. Could you tell me whether it's a kind of disease? Will my condition worsen? Is there (a) medicine that can heal it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Most confuse Arturia's Arts as tampering with cognition and mental faculty, but I know the fact is just the oppoiste. Arturia is interested only in the truest emotions, and cares not for where these emotions lead. The influence she can command is far worse than anyone can possibly imagine.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: What are you doing, Doctor? Bodily contact is no replacement for spoken language. I cannot decipher your thoughts through your limbs. You think that I need comfort? If that is your judgement, then I have no reason to refuse. Infact, I am merely thinking back to my recent mission. What leaves a man no other choice(,) but death?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: As you can see, this is a burnt flower. I have, to the best of my abilities, maintained its condition in order to bring it to you. It is not a gift, becuase it does not meet the criteria for one. It's a question in my mind. I am still pondering the things behind this flower.
voicelines.idle: You lack sleep, Doctor. You need more rest.
voicelines.onboard: You seem surprised, Doctor. Please rest assured that the change in my equipment won't affect my ability to complete my missions. If you find yourself ill at ease because of my attire, I can change into my previous garments before I enter Rhodes Island. No need? Understood.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: I have attempted a few combat techniques, and they have yielded excellent results.
voicelines.promotion_1: You put together an all new profile. Is this a false identity for my next mission? If the need arises, I know where to prepare identification that can pass checks. No need? This, too, is a normal promotion?
voicelines.promotion_2: I am trying to understand the law. Is Laterano's foundation truly these words alone? Is that applicable to lands other than Laterano? I must admit I have indeed been affected by it, to a certain degree. I will attempt to find the answer posthaste.
voicelines.added_to_squad: The law itself has no power. It calls for enforcers.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I require those who can act on their own judgment.
voicelines.depart: Move out.
voicelines.begin_operation: Commencing operation. Please confirm the mission objective.
voicelines.deployment_2: I shall ensure the integrity of the law.
voicelines.in_battle_2: Destruction is the most naive behavior.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Annihilation is the most common result.
voicelines.4-star_result: No casualties, no commotions. All good.
voicelines.3-star_result: Mission complete.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: The result is acceptable.
voicelines.operation_failure: We need to reformulate our battle plans.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Maintaining a dedicated room is a show of respect? I see.
voicelines.tap: I have heard there are certain hobbies that are not easily understood by others. Perhaps this is one such hobby?
voicelines.trust_tap: Speak the word if you need anything, Doctor.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Silence the Paradigmatic
biography: Sponsor of the 'Trimounts Ethics in Scientific Research Joint Declaration' and executive advisor to Rhine Lab's Components Control Section, now cooperating with Rhodes Island in medical matters.She has extensive clinical experience in medicine, and provides medical support to Rhodes Island as she receives Oripathy related treatment.
description: Supporter Operator Silence stands ready to provide everyone sanctuary.
quote: Once, she'd always stood in the back, behind everyone else. Now, she stands in front of them.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Let's commence work, Doctor. We have a mountain of issues to face.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, can you pass a message onto Ifrit for me? I'm returning to Trimounts—there's some urgent business that requires me in person. So she'll have to eat dinner with Saria tonight. I... I'll make it up to her next time, I promise.
voicelines.talk_2: Do you need coffee? This is a special bean Joyce prepared for me that keeps me up even in the daytime. After all, I can't coop up alone in the lab day and night like I once did. I have lots of meetings that I'd rather not take, and lots of reports to read that I'd also rather not.
voicelines.talk_3: My thoughts on returning to Rhine Lab...? I'd rather not reflect on it like that, if I could. All I can say is, I used to perennially expect someone would come to my aid, but now I understand—I can only rely on myself if I am to achieve anything.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Guess what this stack of papers is? They're whistleblower reports. Some labs think they can protect themselves by airing other labs' dirty laundry to me. The more they do this, the more anger I feel welling up inside.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Return those gifts to senders, and have them convey to whoever's behind them, that I'll be making a personal visit, and they'd better be prepared... Sorry, Doctor, am I bothering you at work? I'll excuse myself for now. Yes, alright, I'll be back in Trimounts later today...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: This contract pertains to the ensuing direction of our partnership with Rhodes Island, Doctor. You'd better take a look. I don't want us to blindly accept Rhodes Island's aid. Of course, I do hope that outside of work, we'll remain good friends.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Yes, Doctor? No, I'm no longer restricting Ifrit from seeing Saria. Honestly, on the contrary, I hope they see more of each other now. Ifrit is grown up, after all. And more importantly, her presence will remind Saria that, not all prices are numbers, and reports do not remove scars.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: To be honest, being domineering is an awful sensation. When people come to my desk, the way they look at me makes me uncomfortable. But that's something I'll gradually adapt to. I'm going to rest for a short while, Doctor. I'd like to hear your thoughts after I wake up.
voicelines.idle: I'll deal with some minor affairs for you, Doctor. Rest well.
voicelines.onboard: Doctor, my time aboard Rhodes Island will be inevitably diminished in the future. There is one thing, however, that I can guarantee: my relationship with Rhodes Island will only grow closer, because I trust Rhodes Island, and I trust you.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Some battles are unavoidable, I know.
voicelines.promotion_1: The pharmaceutical I took part in developing is highly effective? That's excellent. Though I have to devote more of my energy elsewhere, I would never want to give up my research.
voicelines.promotion_2: I know what you want to ask. The path I'm about to walk is a thorny one. Am I really prepared for it…? I don't know whether future me will come to regret this, but at least right now, I will firmly walk on.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Support role aside, you can delegate some tactical planning work to me too.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'll see to it our tactics are drawn up.
voicelines.depart: We should probe into the significance of the fight, and not indulge its outbreak.
voicelines.begin_operation: I'm a physician, but also a member of the squad. Let's go.
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, I always find a great deal to learn from you, though I hope I never have occasion to use these tactics.
voicelines.3-star_result: The samples in this area... We've taken these before. Let's move on.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: I'll organize aid for wounded personnel. Everyone else, please assist in maintaining the perimeter.
voicelines.operation_failure: Doctor... it looks like we should reformulate our tactics.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: This place still feels like home.
voicelines.trust_tap: Doctor, I happen to have some issues I'd like to discuss with you. Are you available right now?
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: Spuria
biography: A native of Laterano, real name Serpilia. Spuria was dispatched to Rhodes Island alongside Executor Richele by the Sixth Tribunal of the Lateran Curia following the Ambrosii Incident.She is an expert in firearms technology, and proficient in communications and mechanical engineering. She is currently a visiting associate of the Engineering Department.
description: Specialist Operator Spuria, here to offer you help.
quote: 'Huh? A field mission AGAIN?'

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: No problem. Just leave the documents here, and I'll filter out anything that isn't worth you reading... Can't do it that way? We have to take each one seriously? Fine, fine, whatever you say.
voicelines.talk_1: I guarantee that field op will be cleared without a hitch, so— I can't dump it on another operator? Come on, It was a long trip for me to come here, and I'm better off spending my time in the workshop while I'm on the ship. Work with me here, will you？
voicelines.talk_2: How's my stay? So far so good. Here I can focus on reviewing my designs without headphones on my head. No need to block everything out with music. Feels kinda refreshing. Still, I haven't modded any of the equipment in the dorm myself, so it does feel kinda like we're missing some features here. For example, something that automatically orders cactus tarts takeout at preset times.
voicelines.talk_3: Do me a favor and tell me when Lemuen shows up, Doctor. I help maintain her sister's gun every now and then, so my guess is she wants to have a few words with me. Why don't I just go see her? Uhmm... The way I put it, one can't be so proactive with everybody. Sometimes, you need to keep a certain distance. You know what I mean?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Laterano has tons of magazines covering the combat attire of other countries. Their designs seem to have drawn inspiration from a variety of sources, all of which I'd like to try out. Oh, just so you know, I'm more of an order-by-phone kind of girl. I don't go shopping unless I'm invited by some very specific people. So, you gonna ask me out?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I'm more willing to go on field ops than before? That's because I'm after inspiration for firearms upgrades. When I stand in war-torn ruins, where there's none of the ear-rending ruckus of Laterano, I get this weird sense of fear. I have to find a way to use my technology to combat that somehow.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: If the Lateran Curia ever asks for me, make an excuse and turn them down, will you? I don't wanna go back to listen to my boss nag about faith and standing. She thinks she can talk me into recognizing my mistakes, but I don't ever think that much when I do stuff.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I study firearm assistive technologies, but I don't fundamentally understand what a gun means to a Sankta... Hm? Oh, nothing. Just a friend of mine who told me she's starting to use a gun again. Anyway, I'll be going on a trip soon. Be sure to approve my disembarkation when the time comes, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: You look like you're in a bad mood, so I grabbed you a snack from— Hey, what's that surprised look for? Yes, you're no Sankta and I can't feel your emotion, but that doesn't mean I can't care about you. Alright, eat up now. I wanna see if this is from the tainted batch.
voicelines.idle: You asleep...? Hehe... Well, well, seems like a good chance to release a drone in the hallway and stream someone's sleep-talking... No response? Looks like you're actually asleep.
voicelines.onboard: Spuria, liaison from the Sixth Tribunal of the Lateran Curia, here for cultural exchange. Oh, right. To prevent any safety inspections, my luggage has a self-destruct mechanism. Yep, the stuff inside isn't necessarily all safe.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: You want to watch combat records together? You aren't gonna complain that I'm not serious enough when I watch the videos, right?
voicelines.promotion_1: If you're giving me more permissions, I won't have to check with you the next time I want to do something, right?
voicelines.promotion_2: We Sankta know how to shoot just by the instincts we were born with. Then, after seven years of schooling, we've mastered advanced shooting techniques and learned the basics of maintenance and retrofitting. After that, we may spend our entire lifetimes without ever realizing... guns hurt people.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Yep, no problem. I've got the objectives all memorized.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Relax, just leave it to me. What kind of havoc can I wreak?
voicelines.depart: Aww, I prefer combat strategies without so many twists and turns.
voicelines.begin_operation: Perfect opportunity to observe the battlefield.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Go ahead. Tell me your plan.
voicelines.deployment_2: It's about time we switched to a frontal assault, no?
voicelines.in_battle_1: Come on, don't be such a drag.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Take a guess. Am I holding my gun to pray?
voicelines.4-star_result: What a surprise. It's been a while since I had so many casings at my feet. You really know how to put on a show.
voicelines.3-star_result: Just as promised, the mission's a success. What was I doing? Whoa, whoa, whoa, that's hurting. Nobody likes a Doctor who pries too much, yes?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: No worries, it's not a big deal. Just act like you're all remorseful, and nobody will press it too hard. But I still saw every mistake you made with my own eyes, better keep that in mind.
voicelines.operation_failure: Uh, you're not gonna fix the part of the perimeter that got blown up? That wouldn't fly in Laterano.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Woo, I love this icy, modern feel.
voicelines.tap: Careful. My gun might go off.
voicelines.trust_tap: How much do you know about Sankta guns? There's no way you'd ever be able to fire one, but I don't mind explaining things to you.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Hey, Doctor, you're finally here. While you were gone, absolutely nothing happened.

name: Insider
biography: Insider, citizen of Laterano, is an executor of the Notarial Hall specializing in legal matters, entitled to the privileges listed in Clauses 1 through 13 of the Laterano Constitution, and claims to be experienced in handling civil disputes. In accordance with the agreement between Rhodes Island and the Notarial Hall, he now assists as a Sniper Operator.
description: Professional executor Richele of the Lateran Notarial Hall, providing Rhodes Island assistance as a collaborative operator.
quote: Doesn't stand out, doesn't stir trouble—a solid employee who shouldn't worry you... right?

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You need my help with your mountain of work? Haha, I'm not sure if I should be intervening in Rhodes Island's internal affairs though...? It's no problem? Uh, really?
voicelines.talk_1: Our laws are incapable of perfectly solving every dispute. There are many situations where even the saints can't help. I must admit, I have a deep respect for people like the bishop from that monastery, considering the problems he faced. Too bad I don't have such lofty faith.
voicelines.talk_2: Was that Arene earlier? Now when did that punk learn some manners...? You taught him? Wow, now that's impressive! I guess even a devious boy like him is still just a boy. Easy enough to trick him onto the right track... Huh...? You didn't trick him?
voicelines.talk_3: Yo, Doctor! Ambriel and the others are doing a dessert potluck, and I'm bringing donuts. Mind helping me taste test? Okay, so what do you think—Whoa whoa, slow down on the water! It's too sweet and greasy? Strange, I thought the sugar level was just right...
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Don't get me wrong, Doctor, yes, I was elected as 'a representative of the Notarial Hall', but that's just because everyone's curious about what magical place could Federico endorse, and they needed someone out to take a look for them. In other words, they picked me to come take a look-see here. I've got no say on any matters relating to the Notarial Hall, so don't ask me about that sort of thing, okay?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I'm lucky I was born a Lateran. No, Doctor, our good fortune does not lie in our halos, but in our material abundance and strong state. You have an ideal Rhodes Island of your own? It's not easy, chasing your dreams, but... good luck I guess?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Take note of your posture, keep your crossbow aimed straight ahead, turn your body slightly... Yes, just like that, and then pull the trigger! Wow, bullseye! Very nice! Oh no, no need to thank me, I just helped correct your posture, that's all. You're very talented, Doctor.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Come sit over here, Doctor. I have something to discuss with you. There's a bunch of Sarkaz I know, and they're pretty good in a fight, so if Rhodes Island ever needs a few helping hands... Haha, yes, I'm not eager to make trouble for myself, but... Well, I might be going too soft, but why not consider it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: I thought you might have found this business annoying, so I dealt with it in your place, and here's the mission report. The scene was something of an eyesore, so I didn't attach any photos. I executed every last name in your notes, no exceptions. What's with the look, Doctor? Do you feel unwell?
voicelines.idle: Oh, Doctor, you're awake… What? Please don't tell Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya you were napping at work? Ahaha, what napping?
voicelines.onboard: Liaison from the Lateran Notarial Hall, Insider. Here's the paperwork for our collaboration. May I ask which office I should be heading to next? I'm making my first impression here at Rhodes Island, so I want to do this perfectly.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Let's see... Ezell is still so merciful in battle, huh... Sheesh, Federico is the exact opposite!
voicelines.promotion_1: Promotion? Thank you for your affirmation, Doctor. However, does this mean I'm going to have to handle even more difficult work in the future?
voicelines.promotion_2: Many thanks. I will report that Rhodes Island intends to deepen the level of cooperation with the Notarial Hall... Wait, this is a personal commendation for me? Haha, what an honor.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Got it. You've determined that use of force is required in the current situation, and I'll trust you on that.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: I'm in charge? Alright then, I would like everyone to act freely as they wish. And everyone is responsible for their own actions.
voicelines.depart: Firearm, check.
voicelines.begin_operation: I wish everyone could just calm down, before I raise my gun to settle things.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Bullets may be fast, but they aren't always so quick to solve disputes.
voicelines.deployment_1: Chill, everyone, I'm just here for a few questions.
voicelines.deployment_2: If you insist on being so stubborn, then... prepare for execution.
voicelines.in_battle_1: I'm actually better at wrestling than shooting. Makes the cleanup easier.
voicelines.in_battle_2: I'll give you some time to cry out in pain while I adjust my weapon.
voicelines.in_battle_3: I was really hoping it wouldn't turn out like this.
voicelines.in_battle_4: In our current situation... A complete sweep would be the most efficient solution.
voicelines.4-star_result: I knew I was getting into trouble coming here, but thankfully I've got you, Doctor. I wouldn't have figured out how to resolve such a complicated conflict by myself.
voicelines.3-star_result: Alright, time to pack up my gun. Mission complete, Doctor. We achieved victory just as planned, so there shouldn't be any post mortem work required, right?
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: What, did some of them escape? Ah, I had one eye closed while aiming my shots, so maybe they happened to be out of my sight.
voicelines.operation_failure: It's clear we need to overhaul our plans.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: You have such good accommodation here? This place is top-notch in all the foreign posting I've had.
voicelines.tap: Haha, Doctor. You're not scaring me that easily.
voicelines.trust_tap: It's nice to occasionally get some rest in places like this corridor. After all, most of Laterano's benches are found only outdoors.
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: You can take a break first, Doctor.

name: Melanite
biography: Melanite, formerly an experienced tester at a Columbian weapons testing company. Her contract with the company came to an end after she was infected with Oripathy. Thereafter, she came to Rhodes Island for medical treatment and entered into an agreement to become a field operator.
description: Former weapons tester Melanite creates maximum devastation with top-of-the-line weapons.
quote: And this was with her weapon's output limiter ON.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: You would like me to take care of your secretarial work? I can, but please do keep the amount of work under control. I used to write reports fairly often, but most don't find the contents of my reports very pleasant to read.
voicelines.talk_1: You can stop looking at my shoulder. This is not an Oripathy lesion. It's just a tattoo that resembles one. Why? To outwit anyone who thinks they've found a weakness. You won't bother me again after the first time you guess wrong.
voicelines.talk_2: That's right. I became an Infected while I was testing this railgun. Why am I still using it? First, it's safe now that it has been fine-tuned. Secondly, while I don't want to admit it, this is the weapon that suits me the most. I don't want to or dare to abandon it.
voicelines.talk_3: The medicine in my earrings? It's not medicine. It's a perfume that I mixed myself. A highly concentrated perfume that can induce... emotions that run opposite to hostility. It comes in handy in dangerous situations. As for the lower concentrated one that I have here... Umm, it's for alleviating carsickness. I tend to get carsick pretty badly.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: I'd say I was a mercenary, more than a weapons tester. As soon as the higher-ups gave the order, I would have to take to the battlefield with newly-issued equipment. It was nothing like the battles I've fought for Rhodes Island. No one knew or cared why I fought.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I was infected not because of an accident, but because of a transaction. For my infection, the client got their data, and the provided got a significant payment. Plus, they got to keep me on a leash with their insurance... If it wasn't for them treating me like a tuskbeast, why would I have run?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: The first time I struck a dummy, I thought back to my parents, that bandit, and how powerless I was despite having a gun in my hand... Even after I was out of ammo, I was still mechanically pulling the trigger over and over, until the coach took away the launcher in my hand. That's right. A launcher, not a gun.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I once thought about opening a sundries shop like my parents did. Once, I even had an agreement with a landlord. Then, I had nightmares that entire night... Now? Much better. I'm even trying to help Instructor Dur-nar—Oh, please don't tell anyone about this.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My father used to tell me stories of how the great Blacksteel founder upgraded their firearms. But it wasn't until recently that I realized true greatness is not to popularize some kind of weapon. Instead, it's to make weapons useless forever. Right, it's very ironic. This is what I dream of achieving, and it is something that I can only dream of achieving.
voicelines.idle: Please rest at ease. I will ensure the office's safety during this period of time.
voicelines.onboard: Nice to meet you, Doctor. As a field operator, I will be in your service from here onwards. I hope that my firepower will not betray your expectations.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: That is excellent CQC, but perhaps a little too dangerous...
voicelines.promotion_1: The only way my former employer expresses approval is by raising wages—Don't get the wrong idea. For every wage increase, they make you do ten times the work afterwards. That's not how Rhodes Island works, right?
voicelines.promotion_2: Thank you for your trust, Doctor. I used to think of Rhodes Island as a stopping point so beautiful that it's almost unreal, but it now seems I will have to extend my stay here for a little longer.
voicelines.added_to_squad: I'll provide fire support for everyone.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: You are appointing me as the leader? It appears this will be a tough battle.
voicelines.depart: Everyone, so that we don't run into any unexpected issues on the field, check your weapons once again.
voicelines.begin_operation: Maintain a safe distance. Avoid direct confrontation if possible.
voicelines.deployment_2: Weapon's good. Ready for data collection.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Shh. Do you hear that? That's the sound of the reaper making her advent.
voicelines.in_battle_4: Don't huddle there. Hard for me to assess the blast area.
voicelines.4-star_result: I... I'm suddenly a little terrified. If I were on the other side facing you and your command, how much of the firepower I'm so proud of would actually be effective?
voicelines.3-star_result: A perfect performance, to the point that I want to write an evaluation report, voluntarily.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: A few of them got away. It seems we need some further adjustments.
voicelines.operation_failure: Cover the retreat? No problem. It's important to evaluate performance during retreats, too.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Considering the weapon's size, this place might be a little cramped.
voicelines.tap: Doctor, don't touch. You could get hurt.
voicelines.trust_tap: Would you like to head to Engineering together?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Good morning. A dream-less night of sleep alleviates exhaustion the most, don't you think?

name: Friston-3
biography: Friston 3 is an S-C Model four-wheeled Operation Platform, the first product of the Rhodes Island Smart Operation platform R&D Team's efforts. Closure personally led the team throughout the development process, from concept design to assembly and testing. Friston-3 is also based on PRTS, achieving a new comprehensive standard for operation platforms, from the underlying source code to the external modules. He weighs less than the other retrofitted operation platforms on Rhodes Island, while being more versatile and stable, and currently participates in operations as a Defender Operator.[Classified Log]The source code for Friston-3's core, compiled ideations, and other design details are temporarily unavailable to Operators, so please contact Closure directly if you have any questions.
description: Rhodes Island Defender Robot Friston-3, deployed to the battlefield by Engineer Closure to participate in combat operations.
quote: He doesn't think of himself as a robot.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: If I become your assistant, Closure won't be able to touch me anymore, yes? I'm aware of her extreme interest in me, but her planned modifications on my body are both ridiculous and unacceptable. They're an insult to a scientist, and I won't allow it even in my current form.
voicelines.talk_1: Why would humanity grow horns and tails? This stage of biological evolution is past my parameters of understanding... I know tens of thousands of years have passed— Kal'tsit has mentioned this countless times. Hmm, I will need a bit more time to formulate my deduction.
voicelines.talk_2: Closure wanted me to sound like a 'thirty-year-old rock band vocalist with a raspy voice,' but my original body was already twice that age... at least, that's what my final memories tell me.
voicelines.talk_3: Let's stop here for today, Doctor. I have to go over to Kal'tsit's office. She must be needlessly burning the midnight oil again. A soul, driven by her sheer sense of mission to trudge on for tens of thousands of years, just to stop what exactly? It would be better for her to get more sleep.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: Doctor, don't look at me the same way you do Castle-3 and the others. They are very... cute. But my robot body is just like your hood, merely a sort of costume... a style. I know who I am, and thus you and I are more alike.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I'm not arrogant, but I am angry at your ignorance and lack of self-awareness, angry at your self-righteousness, all of you. Yes, I've lost all my knowledge, so you can take this anger as merely a 'result' of my 'calculations,' and a very clear result at that.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: My wife, daughter, and the rest of my people are eternally resting in those sarcophagi, and will never wake up again. I've made many decisions, I'm well aware. But all I remember is that final dinner, where everyone bid me farewell, and prayed that the subsequent odyssey would go smoothly...
voicelines.idle: Doctor, are you free? I hope you might take me out for a walk.
voicelines.onboard: Hello there, I am Friston. That's right, just 'Friston,' not 'Friston-3' or whatever. I am not a replica, and very much less a reproduction of a replica. I hope you understand.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: This is valuable research material. I shall require a copy for myself.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Doctor, which sector do you need me to take charge of?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Am I to lead everyone and find a new direction...? Very well, I won't let them down this time.
voicelines.depart: Let's go. This is also a new journey.
voicelines.begin_operation: Danger detected!
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: I will relay our combat strategies to THRM-EX and Lancet-2.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: I am naturally capable of more than THRM-EX and the others. I will shield them on the front line.
voicelines.deployment_1: As long as I'm still standing, no one will come to harm.
voicelines.in_battle_1: Are you all staring at my expression doodle?
voicelines.in_battle_2: Your behaviors have been recorded and archived.
voicelines.in_battle_3: Where's your leader? I need to talk!
voicelines.in_battle_4: What a disgrace... these ugly creatures.
voicelines.4-star_result: Doctor, your thinking routines and command style are very much distinct and different from the others... I guess some things never change.
voicelines.3-star_result: I still remember the duty I bear, but I must admit, I am no longer able to fulfill it, let alone execute it as well as you do. You have my respect, Doctor.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: An odyssey will always have nigh-avoidable accidents, and a plan might always go wrong. They may be painful to accept... but what else can I do except accept them?
voicelines.operation_failure: If the worst possible outcome is turning into something like me, then there is nothing to be afraid of. Doctor, you should evacuate first, and leave the rest to me.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: I would like to stack all of my borrowed ecological research materials over here. I trust there will be no issues with that?
voicelines.tap: You should have observed my expression doodle. Currently, it's 'anger'.
voicelines.trust_tap: I've taken a photo of you, Doctor. You want to see it? Sorry, I've already saved it to my archives.
voicelines.title: Arknights.

name: U-Official
biography: U-Official, commonly known as Streamer U, used to be an online streamer in a certain nomadic city. After being recommended by Operator Click, she signed a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island. In addition to providing broadcasting services for our operators, she is responsible for hosting events and other work. She also serves as a consultant and provides support when Rhodes Island interfaces with media organizations.Other than Click, who once lent her a helping hand, Streamer U has also had encounters with a few other Rhodes Island operators, though not always under pleasant circumstances and while going by a different name. Ultimately, we suspended any further background checks at her insistence.Eureka?––Tequila, upon passing by coincidentallyYou've got the wrong person, you big fat liar!––Streamer U, babbling incoherently
description: U-Official, 'The Ultimate Beautiful Girl', has recently completed a perilous career leap from TV host to streamer.
quote: Though she gained a decent understanding of anti-surveillance a while back, it probably won't come in handy anytime soon...

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Can I go live in here? I'm not really comfortable having a whole crowd standing around watching me stream, so I'd feel way more at ease in your office... Besides, I'm your assistant now anyway, heehee.
voicelines.talk_1: Doctor, I got to thinking that the stream incident might not have been a totally bad thing. After all, I got to know so many nice people ready to lend a helping hand, and you too... Shoot! I forgot to turn off my mic–– Yes, and all of you as well! With your support, I'll break out of this funk!
voicelines.talk_2: I need to decompress after that stream... Games? Doctor, were you even watching my stream? Chat wouldn't stop making fun of how much I suck. I don't wanna play another game this whole week... And that's why I need to practice every day? Uhh... I guess you have a point there?
voicelines.talk_3: Awwgh, it's so frustrating! How come a clip of me tripping over my words gets so many more views than all my VODs combined? I really don't understand viewers these days... Look, Doctor, what's so funny about this compilation of my brain-far—you just laughed, right? You totally laughed just now!
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: I won an award the first time I did a solo show. Pretty lucky, huh? What, don't believe me? Look right here, 'Awarded to the employee who stayed put until the end of the show during an earthquake'! Getting hit by an earthquake hit during your debut sounds unlucky? Ah-Ahaha...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: I used to work my butt off every day so I could make more money, then shop more and shop better. But you know, when I use fancy concealer to hide my eye bags, I sometimes wanna cry... Oh, uh, s-speaking of crying, getting fired from the TV station made me want to cry a lot more.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: When I get up there to face my audience, the only advantage I have is the angle of my camera. But you, Doctor... You're the only one who watches my stream in person. You're my most special, and most unique audience. Ahem, it would be even nicer if you tossed a little dono my way~
voicelines.idle: Hello. You looking for the Doctor? What? No, no bother at all. The Doctor's fast asleep, and I'm just eating some dry instant noodles. Want a chunk?
voicelines.onboard: Hello everyone, this is your omnipotent streamer, Eure—Errrr, sorry, scratch that. Rhodes Island operator, U-official! Reporting in, Doctor!
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Doctor, I'm not gonna sugarcoat it. No matter how many vids like this I watch, I won't learn how to fight.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Go to war? Me?! This has to be a dream…
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: And you're giving me command of the squad to boot? This dream sure is funny, haha...
voicelines.depart: Well, since this is a dream anyway, I will mop up all the enemies for you!
voicelines.begin_operation: Bow down before the true master! Wooooo-wata! Scared now?
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Heehee, mind sending me the instructions... in a superchat?
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: Your streamer is in perfect condition and ready to go live!
voicelines.deployment_2: Just treat it like a regular stream? I'll try!
voicelines.in_battle_1: Ah, ah, mic check! Can everyone hear me?
voicelines.in_battle_2: Let me know what you think in chat!
voicelines.in_battle_3: Next up, time to read the comments!
voicelines.in_battle_4: Dear viewer, for your aggressive behavior, you've been permabaned from the channel! Oh no!
voicelines.4-star_result: The battle's over, so why haven't I woken up from my dream yet... What? This isn't a dream? Then, how come I'm not hurt at all?!
voicelines.3-star_result: Phew, it's finally over... Time to get a good night's sleep. I hope I don't have any more weird dreams about war.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: Hey you guys running off there, don't forget to tell your friends and family about me. Thank you!
voicelines.operation_failure: Waahhh… this is the worst ending to a stream I could've imagined…
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can I use this place as the backdrop for my next stream? No? Fine, I'll try someplace else then.
voicelines.tap: Don't jumpscare me like that! A monster just pushed me into the pit, now I have to do a 'no death run'…
voicelines.trust_tap: I'm done streaming, Doctor. Wanna take a walk around the deck?
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: Thanks for letting me stream from your office, Doctor.

description: Shaman of the blizzards delivered 'neath the santalla's boughs, still trying to accept this new life.
quote: She only looks cold—she won't give your hand frostbite.
trait: Deals AOE Arts damage

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: I... can take care of some basic tasks, but your assistant should be able to take on a large share of your work. That may be… beyond my abilities.
voicelines.talk_1: Prejudice is common between peoples. Before I came to Rhodes Island, I actually thought people outside of Sami left the womb with weapons in their hands... That's not a joke, Doctor. I really did.
voicelines.talk_2: You're still bothered by the cold? Hmm... Sometimes, I feel like you're needier than a newborn. Hold your hands out then... Haah... Feel better? You're welcome. Give me a moment, I'll fetch you another blanket.
voicelines.talk_3: Yes, I know this is a general education course meant for children. But a shaman's calling is to master all forms of knowledge, whether metal or wood. And my knowledge of the South probably isn't much greater than a local child. So a course like this suits me just fine.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: Fighting is not in Sami nature. But, if you do not become the hunter, then you can only be the hunted. This is true whether facing the elements, the demons... or the people of Ursus. It's the law of nature.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: I respect you, and so I give you my word. As long as I am aboard this iron ship, I will not trouble the people of Ursus. But when in Sami, I hope you'll turn a blind eye to... some of my actions. There is always a price to be paid, even if it falls to Ursus rather than a particular individual.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: My friends here at Rhodes Island made this outfit not long after I arrived. I was still a stubborn rockhorn back then, unwilling to accept even the slightest bit of kindness. Now... I'm probably not so inflexible. Even the coldest ice melts in the spring sun.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: Tribe cannot go on without a shaman. It was painful to part with the branches of my family tree, and let go of the responsibility of protecting my tribesmen. It used to be my only wish to remain in my ancestral home, accompanying the long-withered tree. But now, that is not possible anymore...
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: One crystallized eye is enough to turn a woman into a monster. The Southerners use Originium to command metal to move, yet fear that it will grow upon their bodies. Alas, what deadly weapons indifference and fear have become. Though they leave no wounds on the body, they instead bleed the spirit dry.
voicelines.idle: I wave a twig… for a fresh and healthy year...
voicelines.onboard: She was born under the tribe's santalla tree, so it became her identity, her codename, and a part of her life. Now the outcast returns to the tribe, regaining the right to use her name. She will commit herself to her new leader.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: They do not yet comprehend the enemy's cruelty…
voicelines.promotion_1: May the generosity you've afforded me plant the seedlings of joy within your heart.
voicelines.promotion_2: The curse cannot extinguish the pain in my heart. Since it is conquest that Ursus craves, then let them be conquered by nature.
voicelines.added_to_squad: What do you wish for the battlefield to become?
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Protect our teammates, and victory will be ours.
voicelines.depart: Look into the distance, and be mindful of your feet. Nature has already warned you of the changes.
voicelines.begin_operation: The hunter... and the hunted…
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Did you have need of me?
voicelines.in_battle_2: The wild wind plunders your warmth.
voicelines.in_battle_3: The deadly cold sends its regards.
voicelines.in_battle_4: The eyes of Sami witness your end.
voicelines.4-star_result: Perhaps in your eyes, nature is just another tool.
voicelines.3-star_result: You are the true hunter.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: War is like nature, full of variables.
voicelines.operation_failure: The blizzard approaches. We should go.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: My room, my domain…
voicelines.tap: Is there anything I can do for you?
voicelines.trust_tap: In Sami, there is no food sweeter than honey. Is this... candy? Hmm... Oh, so sweet!
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: I am here, by your side.

name: Typhon
biography: Typhon, a Sarkaz active in Sami, considers herself a hunter and has both the knowledge and skills to deal with the dangers of Sami's natural environment. At Operator Magallan's invitation, she is currently cooperating with Rhodes Island and assisting in our affairs in Sami and the endless icefields.
description: Facilitator Typhon of Sami, knower of the rules for the hunters of the permafrost.
quote: At least she seeks you be the hunter, not the hunted.

voicelines.appointed_as_assistant: Close your eyes, don't rush to open them. They may feel slightly hot, that's normal... Shh, stay calm, I crushed some herbs to help your eyes relax. You must have been staring at some dangerous thing. I do that a lot, trust me.
voicelines.talk_1: A guide...? I guess Simone is a better fit for the job. She's also a veteran hunter like me, so I know you'll be in good hands, and won't get into... trouble. There have been some misunderstandings and a few tribes now turn me away. Just remember, if anyone tells you I'm a man eater, they're lying.
voicelines.talk_2: Hands off. I've told you before, no one gets to touch my bow. Not you, not the smiths. You don't have the skills to hunt shadows in the depth of Sami, so you shouldn't draw their attention. I know your kind, I know you're curious. I'll just repeat myself over, over, and over again until I get through to you.
voicelines.talk_3: Check the logs from the research teams. See? These little hornbeasts are friends, they're harmless. And this kind of snow needs Arts to control, so call me if you run into some. Good, go ahead and add some notes to these pictures, you're pretty clever. Why the look? Is it so strange that I know how to use electronics?
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_1: You all are strange, just like Magallan, insisting on comprehending the land on your own terms. I've seen your hard work, you'll come to know the whole of Sami as you see her in your dreams someday. But now? You aren't there yet. I'm worried about you, but since we're working together, just listen to me and you'll be fine.
voicelines.talk_after_promotion_2: Put that navigation instrument down, you're no professional, it's wearing you out just carrying it around. Let me lead the way, just like Arges used to do for me. She always says pitfalls and pains guide you to destiny, but I find I can get where I want by just following the sound of the breeze and the twigs in the trees.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_1: You've never tried sleeping on a cave floor before? What about a bed made of vines? You should give it a try, I can't get a good night's sleep if I don't hear the heartbeat of Sami. How could I even close my eyes if I can't wake the moment I get a vision...? Yes, I have a lot of nightmares, what about it?
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_2: ...You called for me? Did you come across some trouble? If everything's fine, let me sit here alone for a while... I'm looking at the dead. The unsullied dead will walk among the beasts of the forest... I'm still looking for my parents.
voicelines.talk_after_trust_increase_3: Have I ever gotten lost? Hmm... Maybe. I left my home at first to find revenge, but when I saw all that sullied snow, I could only think to draw my bow and aim, to show the shadows that I was the true hunter. Can you be a hunter, too? Or can you be a companion to carry me out of danger when I'm hurt?
voicelines.idle: Does the Doctor have the same kind of dreams that I do? Hm, probably not, we aren't in Sami, after all... Lucky enough for you, the shadows won't be chasing you through your dreams then.
voicelines.onboard: If you come across any abnormalities while we're working together, I'll take care of them for you... Codename? Typhon is my only name. I found it on the horn ornament my mother left behind. Some people say it sounds scary, though.
voicelines.watching_battle_record: Are you trying to show off your camera skills? No...? But how can you even call this combat experience, if you don't experience it yourself?
voicelines.promotion_1: Um, what's this promotion badge for again? If it's useless in combat, then let's wait until we settle the danger right in front of us, then you tell me the story behind it.
voicelines.promotion_2: Many travelers to Sami find death in avalanches caused by loud boasting, or other arrogant behavior. They never even get a chance to see Sami's shadow. You won't make the same kind of mistake, not with me accompanying you.
voicelines.added_to_squad: Take these weapons and tools. We need them more than extra hands.
voicelines.appointed_as_squad_leader: Got it, I'll take the lead. Don't be nervous, I can handle this.
voicelines.depart: Stay close, don't run off.
voicelines.begin_operation: Don't let them out of sight, even if your eyes are hurting.
voicelines.selecting_operator_1: Stay calm and make your move. No need to worry, I've got your back.
voicelines.selecting_operator_2: What do you need of me?
voicelines.in_battle_1: I'll pin you to your shadow.
voicelines.4-star_result: Each of my arrows slows the black that taints the Sami snow.
voicelines.3-star_result: I see you managed to complete a mission without causing any unnecessary pain to the quarry. Um, not bad, not bad. Sip a hot drink and get some rest.
voicelines.sub_3-star_result: If you've run out of arrows or let your target escape, then you should give up the chase. You've already lost.
voicelines.operation_failure: Grasp these seeds tightly in your hand, and run. Don't look back. I'll take care of things here.
voicelines.assigned_to_facility: Can you explain how these machines work? I've got a good memory, Magallan explained the structure of the research station last time, and I still remember it all... Well, at least, I think I do.
voicelines.tap: Nope, you'll have to be faster than that to even think about faking an attack.
voicelines.trust_tap: Do you have someone you trust standing guard? I want to rest for a bit, your camp is so warm…
voicelines.title: Arknights.
voicelines.greeting: What's up, Doctor. Where have you been? You're not lost, are you?
